321.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

321.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
321.t: paarabraham furamaiaa meeh vuThaa sahaj subhai ||
321.e: The Supreme Lord God gave the Order, and the rain automatically began to fall.

321.g: ਅੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਰਜੀ ਤਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
321.t: a(n)n dha(n)n bahut upajiaa pirathamee rajee tipat aghai ||
321.e: Grain and wealth were produced in abundance; the earth was totally satisfied and satiated.

321.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
321.t: sadhaa sadhaa gun ucharai dhukh dhaaladh giaa bilai ||
321.e: Forever and ever, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and pain and poverty shall run away.

321.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
321.t: poorab likhiaa paiaa miliaa tisai rajai ||
321.e: People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive, according to the Will of the Lord.

321.g: ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
321.t: paramesar jeevaaliaa naanak tisai dhiaai ||1||
321.e: The Transcendent Lord keeps you alive; O Nanak, meditate on Him. ||1||

321.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
321.e: Fifth Mehla:

322.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ॥
322.t: jeevan padh nirabaan iko simareeaai ||
322.e: To obtain the state of life of Nirvaanaa, meditate in remembrance on the One Lord.

322.g: ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਧੀਰੀਐ ॥
322.t: dhoojee naahee jai kin bidh dheereeaai ||
322.e: There is no other place; how else can we be comforted?

322.g: ਡਿਠਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
322.t: ddiThaa sabh sa(n)saar sukh na naam bin ||
322.e: I have seen the whole world - without the Lord's Name, there is no peace at all.

322.g: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਛਾਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
322.t: tan dhan hosee chhaar jaanai koi jan ||
322.e: Body and wealth shall return to dust - hardly anyone realizes this.

322.g: ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਬਾਦਿ ਕਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਣੀਆ ॥
322.t: ra(n)g roop ras baadh k kareh paraaneeaa ||
322.e: Pleasure, beauty and delicious tastes are useless; what are you doing, O mortal?

322.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਲ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥
322.t: jis bhulaae aap tis kal nahee jaaneeaa ||
322.e: One whom the Lord Himself misleads, does not understand His awesome power.

322.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਚਾ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
322.t: ra(n)g rate nirabaan sachaa gaavahee ||
322.e: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord attain Nirvaanaa, singing the Praises of the True One.

322.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹੀ ॥੨॥
322.t: naanak saran dhuaar je tudh bhaavahee ||2||
322.e: Nanak: those who are pleasing to Your Will, O Lord, seek Sanctuary at Your Door. ||2||

322.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
322.t: pauRee ||
322.e: Pauree:

322.g: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
322.t: ja(n)man maran na tin(h) kau jo har laR laage ||
322.e: Those who are attached to the hem of the Lord's robe, do not suffer birth and death.

322.g: ਜੀਵਤ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
322.t: jeevat se paravaan hoe har keeratan jaage ||
322.e: Those who remain awake to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - their lives are approved.

322.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੇਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
322.t: saadhasa(n)g jin paiaa seiee vaddabhaage ||
322.e: Those who attain the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are very fortunate.

322.g: ਨਾਇ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਤੂਟੇ ਕਚ ਧਾਗੇ ॥
322.t: nai visariaai dhirag jeevanaa tooTe kach dhaage ||
322.e: But those who forget the Name - their lives are cursed, and broken like thin strands of thread.

322.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੂੜਿ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸਾਧ ਲਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਿਰਾਗੇ ॥੧੬॥
322.t: naanak dhooR puneet saadh lakh koT piraage ||16||
322.e: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy is more sacred than hundreds of thousands, even millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines. ||16||

322.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
322.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
322.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

322.g: ਧਰਣਿ ਸੁਵੰਨੀ ਖੜ ਰਤਨ ਜੜਾਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ॥
322.t: dharan suva(n)nee khaR ratan jaRaavee har prem purakh man vuThaa ||
322.e: Like the beautiful earth, adorned with jewels of grass - such is the mind, within which the Love of the Lord abides.

322.g: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੇ ਥੀਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ॥੧॥
322.t: sabhe kaaj suhelaRe the'ee gur naanak satigur tuThaa ||1||
322.e: All one's affairs are easily resolved, O Nanak, when the Guru, the True Guru, is pleased. ||1||

322.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
322.e: Fifth Mehla:

322.g: ਫਿਰਦੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਾ ਜਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਬਨਰਾਇ ॥
322.t: firadhee firadhee dheh dhisaa jal parabat banarai ||
322.e: Roaming and wandering in the ten directions, over water, mountains and forests

322.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਡਿਠਾ ਮਿਰਤਕੋ ਇਲ ਬਹਿਠੀ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
322.t: jithai ddiThaa mritako il bahiThee aai ||2||
322.e: - wherever the vulture sees a dead body, he flies down and lands. ||2||

322.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
322.t: pauRee ||
322.e: Pauree:

322.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਫਲ ਲੋੜੀਅਹਿ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਉ ॥
322.t: jis sarab sukhaa fal loRe'eh so sach kamaavau ||
322.e: One who longs for all comforts and rewards should practice Truth.

322.g: ਨੇੜੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
322.t: neRai dhekhau paarabraham ik naam dhiaavau ||
322.e: Behold the Supreme Lord God near you, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

322.g: ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥
322.t: hoi sagal kee renukaa har sa(n)g samaavau ||
322.e: Become the dust of all men's feet, and so merge with the Lord.

322.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਉ ॥
322.t: dhookh na dheiee kisai jeea pat siau ghar jaavau ||
322.e: Do not cause any being to suffer, and you shall go to your true home with honor.

322.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਾਵਉ ॥੧੭॥
322.t: patit puneet karataa purakh naanak sunaavau ||17||
322.e: Nanak speaks of the Purifier of sinners, the Creator, the Primal Being. ||17||

322.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਦੋਹਾ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
322.t: salok dhohaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
322.e: Shalok, Dohaa, Fifth Mehla:

322.g: ਏਕੁ ਜਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
322.t: ek j saajan mai keeaa sarab kalaa samarath ||
322.e: I have made the One Lord my Friend; He is All-powerful to do everything.

322.g: ਜੀਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸੰਦੜੀ ਵਥੁ ॥੧॥
322.t: jeeau hamaaraa kha(n)neeaai har man tan sa(n)dhaRee vath ||1||
322.e: My soul is a sacrifice to Him; the Lord is the treasure of my mind and body. ||1||

322.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
322.e: Fifth Mehla:

322.g: ਜੇ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
322.t: je kar gaheh piaaraRe tudh na chhoddaa mool ||
322.e: Take my hand, O my Beloved; I shall never forsake You.

322.g: ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਨਿ ਸੇ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਦੋਜਕ ਕੈ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
322.t: har chhoddan se dhurajanaa paReh dhojak kai sool ||2||
322.e: Those who forsake the Lord, are the most evil people; they shall fall into the horrible pit of hell. ||2||

322.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
322.t: pauRee ||
322.e: Pauree:

322.g: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
322.t: sabh nidhaan ghar jis dhai har kare su hovai ||
322.e: All treasures are in His Home; whatever the Lord does, comes to pass.

322.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਪਾਪਾ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
322.t: jap jap jeeveh sa(n)t jan paapaa mal dhovai ||
322.e: The Saints live by chanting and meditating on the Lord, washing off the filth of their sins.

322.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਹਿ ਸੰਕਟ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
322.t: charan kamal hiradhai vaseh sa(n)kaT sabh khovai ||
322.e: With the Lotus Feet of the Lord dwelling within the heart, all misfortune is taken away.

322.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
322.t: gur pooraa jis bheTeeaai mar janam na rovai ||
322.e: One who meets the Perfect Guru, shall not have to suffer through birth and death.

322.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੈ ॥੧੮॥
322.t: prabh dharas piaas naanak ghanee kirapaa kar dhevai ||18||
322.e: Nanak is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; by His Grace, He has bestowed it. ||18||

322.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਡਖਣਾ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
322.t: salok ddakhanaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
322.e: Shalok, Dakhanaa, Fifth Mehla:

322.g: ਭੋਰੀ ਭਰਮੁ ਵਞਾਇ ਪਿਰੀ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਹਿਕੁ ਤੂ ॥
322.t: bhoree bharam van(j)ai piree muhabat hik too ||
322.e: If you can dispel your doubts, even for an instant, and love your only Beloved,

322.g: ਜਿਥਹੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥਾਊ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
322.t: jithahu va(n)n(j)ai jai tithaauoo maujoodh soi ||1||
322.e: then wherever you go, there you shall find Him. ||1||

322.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
322.e: Fifth Mehla:

322.g: ਚੜਿ ਕੈ ਘੋੜੜੈ ਕੁੰਦੇ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਖੂੰਡੀ ਦੀ ਖੇਡਾਰੀ ॥
322.t: chaR kai ghoRaRai ku(n)dhe pakaReh khoo(n)ddee dhee kheddaaree ||
322.e: Can they mount horses and handle guns, if all they know is the game of polo?

322.g: ਹੰਸਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਉਲਾਸਹਿ ਕੁਕੜ ਦੀ ਓਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
322.t: ha(n)saa setee chit ulaaseh kukaR dhee oddaaree ||2||
322.e: Can they be swans, and fulfill their conscious desires, if they can only fly like chickens? ||2||

322.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
322.t: pauRee ||
322.e: Pauree:

322.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋ ਉਧਰੈ ਮਿਤਾ ॥
322.t: rasanaa ucharai har sravanee sunai so udharai mitaa ||
322.e: Those who chant the Lord's Name with their tongues and hear it with their ears are saved, O my friend.

322.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਹਿ ਲਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਸੇ ਹਸਤ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
322.t: har jas likheh lai bhaavanee se hasat pavitaa ||
322.e: Those hands which lovingly write the Praises of the Lord are pure.

322.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
322.t: aThasaTh teerath majanaa sabh pu(n)n tin kitaa ||
322.e: It is like performing all sorts of virtuous deeds, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

322.g: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਤੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੜੁ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
322.t: sa(n)saar saagar te udhare bikhiaa gaR jitaa ||
322.e: They cross over the world-ocean, and conquer the fortress of corruption.

323.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਉਧਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਦਯੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੧੯॥
323.t: naanak laR lai udhaarian dhay sev amitaa ||19||
323.e: O Nanak, serve the Infinite Lord; grasp the hem of His robe, and He will save you. ||19||

323.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
323.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
323.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

323.g: ਧੰਧੜੇ ਕੁਲਾਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
323.t: dha(n)dhaRe kulaeh chit na aavai hekaRo ||
323.e: Worldly affairs are unprofitable, if the One Lord does not come to mind.

323.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਤੰਨ ਫੁਟੰਨਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਂਈ ਵਿਸਰੈ ॥੧॥
323.t: naanak seiee ta(n)n fuTa(n)n jinaa saa(n)iee visarai ||1||
323.e: O Nanak, the bodies of those who forget their Master shall burst apart. ||1||

323.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
323.e: Fifth Mehla:

323.g: ਪਰੇਤਹੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ॥
323.t: paretahu keeton dhevataa tin karanaihaare ||
323.e: The ghost has been transformed into an angel by the Creator Lord.

323.g: ਸਭੇ ਸਿਖ ਉਬਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
323.t: sabhe sikh ubaarian prabh kaaj savaare ||
323.e: God has emancipated all the Sikhs and resolved their affairs.

323.g: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਪਕੜਿ ਪਛਾੜਿਅਨੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
323.t: ni(n)dhak pakaR pachhaaRian jhooThe dharabaare ||
323.e: He has seized the slanderers and thrown them to the ground, and declared them false in His Court.

323.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
323.t: naanak kaa prabh vaddaa hai aap saaj savaare ||2||
323.e: Nanak's God is glorious and great; He Himself creates and adorns. ||2||

323.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
323.t: pauRee ||
323.e: Pauree:

323.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
323.t: prabh bea(n)t kichh a(n)t naeh sabh tisai karanaa ||
323.e: God is unlimited; He has no limit; He is the One who does everything.

323.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਜੀਆਂ ਕਾ ਪਰਣਾ ॥
323.t: agam agochar saahibo jeeaa(n) kaa paranaa ||
323.e: The Inaccessible and Unapproachable Lord and Master is the Support of His beings.

323.g: ਹਸਤ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
323.t: hasat dhei pratipaaladhaa bharan pokhan karanaa ||
323.e: Giving His Hand, He nurtures and cherishes; He is the Filler and Fulfiller.

323.g: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਚੇ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
323.t: miharavaan bakhasi(n)dh aap jap sache taranaa ||
323.e: He Himself is Merciful and Forgiving. Chanting the True Name, one is saved.

323.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੨੦॥
323.t: jo tudh bhaavai so bhalaa naanak dhaas saranaa ||20||
323.e: Whatever pleases You - that alone is good; slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||20||

323.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
323.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
323.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

323.g: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਕਾ ਰਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
323.t: ti(n)naa bhukh na kaa rahee jis dhaa prabh hai soi ||
323.e: One who belongs to God has no hunger.

323.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੋ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
323.t: naanak charanee lagiaa udharai sabho koi ||1||
323.e: O Nanak, everyone who falls at his feet is saved. ||1||

323.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
323.e: Fifth Mehla:

323.g: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਬੂਲੁ ॥
323.t: jaachik ma(n)gai nit naam saahib kare kabool ||
323.e: If the beggar begs for the Lord's Name every day, his Lord and Master will grant his request.

323.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਜਜਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
323.t: naanak paramesar jajamaan tiseh bhukh na mool ||2||
323.e: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord is the most generous host; He does not lack anything at all. ||2||

323.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
323.t: pauRee ||
323.e: Pauree:

323.g: ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਜੋੜੇ ॥
323.t: man rataa govi(n)dh sa(n)g sach bhojan joRe ||
323.e: To imbue the mind with the Lord of the Universe is the true food and dress.

323.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਏ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ॥
323.t: preet lagee har naam siau e hasatee ghoRe ||
323.e: To embrace love for the Name of the Lord is to possess horses and elephants.

323.g: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਘਣੀ ਧਿਆਇ ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮੋੜੇ ॥
323.t: raaj milakh khuseeaa ghanee dhiaai mukh na moRe ||
323.e: To meditate on the Lord steadfastly is to rule over kingdoms of property and enjoy all sorts of pleasures.

323.g: ਢਾਢੀ ਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਦਰੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋੜੇ ॥
323.t: ddaaddee dhar prabh ma(n)ganaa dhar kadhe na chhoRe ||
323.e: The minstrel begs at God's Door - he shall never leave that Door.

323.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਲੋੜੇ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ਕੀਚੇ
323.t: naanak man tan chaau eh nit prabh kau loRe ||21||1|| sudh keeche
323.e: Nanak has this yearning in his mind and body - he longs continually for God. ||21||1|| Sudh Keechay||

323.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ
323.t: raag gauRee bhagataa(n) kee baanee
323.e: Raag Gauree, The Word Of The Devotees:

323.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
323.t: ikOankaar satinaam karataa purakh gur prasaadh ||
323.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

323.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧੪ ॥
323.t: gauRee guaareree sree kabeer jeeau ke chaupadhe 14 ||
323.e: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourteen Chau-Padhay Of Kabeer Jee:

323.g: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਲਤ ਰਾਮ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
323.t: ab moh jalat raam jal paiaa ||
323.e: I was on fire, but now I have found the Water of the Lord's Name.

323.g: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਤਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
323.t: raam udhak tan jalat bujhaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
323.e: This Water of the Lord's Name has cooled my burning body. ||1||Pause||

323.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਣ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
323.t: man maaran kaaran ban jaieeaai ||
323.e: To subdue their minds, some go off into the forests;

323.g: ਸੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
323.t: so jal bin bhagava(n)t na paieeaai ||1||
323.e: but that Water is not found without the Lord God. ||1||

323.g: ਜਿਹ ਪਾਵਕ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਹੈ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
323.t: jeh paavak sur nar hai jaare ||
323.e: That fire has consumed angels and mortal beings,

323.g: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਜਨ ਜਲਤ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
323.t: raam udhak jan jalat ubaare ||2||
323.e: but the Water of the Lord's Name saves His humble servants from burning. ||2||

323.g: ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
323.t: bhav saagar sukh saagar maahee ||
323.e: In the terrifying world-ocean, there is an ocean of peace.

323.g: ਪੀਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਜਲ ਨਿਖੁਟਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
323.t: peev rahe jal nikhuTat naahee ||3||
323.e: I continue to drink it in, but this Water is never exhausted. ||3||

323.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਜੁ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
323.t: keh kabeer bhaj saari(n)gapaanee ||
323.e: Says Kabeer, meditate and vibrate upon the Lord, like the rainbird remembering the water.

323.g: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
323.t: raam udhak meree tikhaa bujhaanee ||4||1||
323.e: The Water of the Lord's Name has quenched my thirst. ||4||1||

323.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
323.t: gauRee kabeer jee ||
323.e: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

323.g: ਮਾਧਉ ਜਲ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
323.t: maadhau jal kee piaas na jai ||
323.e: O Lord, my thirst for the Water of Your Name will not go away.

323.g: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਠੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
323.t: jal meh agan uThee adhikai ||1|| rahaau ||
323.e: The fire of my thirst burns even more brightly in that Water. ||1||Pause||

323.g: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਉ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਮੀਨੁ ॥
323.t: too(n) jalanidh hau jal kaa meen ||
323.e: You are the Ocean of Water, and I am just a fish in that Water.

323.g: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਜਲਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਨੁ ॥੧॥
323.t: jal meh rahau jaleh bin kheen ||1||
323.e: In that Water, I remain; without that Water, I would perish. ||1||

323.g: ਤੂੰ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਹਉ ਸੂਅਟਾ ਤੋਰ ॥
323.t: too(n) pi(n)jar hau sooaTaa tor ||
323.e: You are the cage, and I am Your parrot.

323.g: ਜਮੁ ਮੰਜਾਰੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੨॥
323.t: jam ma(n)jaar kahaa karai mor ||2||
323.e: So what can the cat of death do to me? ||2||

323.g: ਤੂੰ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਹਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਆਹਿ ॥
323.t: too(n) taravar hau pa(n)khee aaeh ||
323.e: You are the tree, and I am the bird.

323.g: ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀ ਤੇਰੋ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
323.t: ma(n)dhabhaagee tero dharasan naeh ||3||
323.e: I am so unfortunate - I cannot see the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan! ||3||

324.e: You are the True Guru, and I am Your new disciple.

324.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਿਲੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
324.t: keh kabeer mil a(n)t kee belaa ||4||2||
324.e: Says Kabeer, O Lord, please meet me - this is my very last chance! ||4||2||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

324.g: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
324.t: jab ham eko ek kar jaaniaa ||
324.e: When I realize that there is One, and only One Lord,
why then should the people be upset? ||1||
I am dishonored; I have lost my honor.

324.g: ਹਮਰੈ ਖੋਜਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
324.t: hamarai khoj parahu mat koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
324.e: No one should follow in my footsteps. ||1||Pause||
I am bad, and bad in my mind as well.
I have no partnership with anyone. ||2||

324.g: ਪਤਿ ਅਪਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਜ ॥
324.t: pat apat taa kee nahee laaj ||
324.e: I have no shame about honor or dishonor.
But you shall know, when your own false covering is laid bare. ||3||
Says Kabeer, honor is that which is accepted by the Lord.
Give up everything - meditate, vibrate upon the Lord alone. ||4||3||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
If Yoga could be obtained by wandering around naked,

324.g: ਬਨ ਕਾ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
324.t: ban kaa mirag mukat sabh hog ||1||
324.e: then all the deer of the forest would be liberated. ||1||
What does it matter whether someone goes naked, or wears a deer skin,

324.g: ਜਬ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
324.t: jab nahee cheenas aatam raam ||1|| rahaau ||
324.e: if he does not remember the Lord within his soul? ||1||Pause||
If the spiritual perfection of the Siddhas could be obtained by shaving the head,
then why haven't sheep found liberation? ||2||
If someone could save himself by celibacy, O Siblings of Destiny,

324.g: ਖੁਸਰੈ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
324.t: khusarai kiau na param gat paiee ||3||
324.e: why then haven't eunuchs obtained the state of supreme dignity? ||3||
Says Kabeer, listen, O men, O Siblings of Destiny:

324.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
324.t: raam naam bin kin gat paiee ||4||4||
324.e: without the Lord's Name, who has ever found salvation? ||4||4||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
Those who take their ritual baths in the evening and the morning
are like the frogs in the water. ||1||

324.g: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
324.t: jau pai raam raam rat naahee ||
324.e: When people do not love the Lord's Name,

324.g: ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
324.t: te sabh dharam rai kai jaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
324.e: they must all go to the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||1||Pause||
Those who love their bodies and try different looks,

324.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
324.t: tin kau dhiaa supanai bhee naahee ||2||
324.e: do not feel compassion, even in dreams. ||2||
The wise men call them four-footed creatures;
the Holy find peace in this ocean of pain. ||3||
Says Kabeer, why do you perform so many rituals?
Renounce everything, and drink in the supreme essence of the Lord. ||4||5||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

324.g: ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
324.t: kiaa jap kiaa tap kiaa brat poojaa ||
324.e: What use is chanting, and what use is penance, fasting or devotional worship,

324.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
324.t: jaa kai ridhai bhaau hai dhoojaa ||1||
324.e: to one whose heart is filled with the love of duality? ||1||

324.g: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
324.t: re jan man maadhau siau laieeaai ||
324.e: O humble people, link your mind to the Lord.
Through cleverness, the four-armed Lord is not obtained. ||Pause||
Set aside your greed and worldly ways.
Set aside sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||2||
Ritual practices bind people in egotism;
meeting together, they worship stones. ||3||
Says Kabeer, He is obtained only by devotional worship.
Through innocent love, the Lord is met. ||4||6||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

324.g: ਗਰਭ ਵਾਸ ਮਹਿ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
324.t: garabh vaas meh kul nahee jaatee ||
324.e: In the dwelling of the womb, there is no ancestry or social status.
All have originated from the Seed of God. ||1||

324.g: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬਾਮਨ ਕਬ ਕੇ ਹੋਏ ॥
324.t: kahu re pa(n)ddit baaman kab ke hoe ||
324.e: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: since when have you been a Brahmin?

324.g: ਬਾਮਨ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਤ ਖੋਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
324.t: baaman keh keh janam mat khoe ||1|| rahaau ||
324.e: Don't waste your life by continually claiming to be a Brahmin. ||1||Pause||
If you are indeed a Brahmin, born of a Brahmin mother,

324.g: ਤਉ ਆਨ ਬਾਟ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
324.t: tau aan baaT kaahe nahee aaiaa ||2||
324.e: then why didn't you come by some other way? ||2||

324.g: ਤੁਮ ਕਤ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਹਮ ਕਤ ਸੂਦ ॥
324.t: tum kat braahaman ham kat soodh ||
324.e: How is it that you are a Brahmin, and I am of a low social status?

324.g: ਹਮ ਕਤ ਲੋਹੂ ਤੁਮ ਕਤ ਦੂਧ ॥੩॥
324.t: ham kat lohoo tum kat dhoodh ||3||
324.e: How is it that I am formed of blood, and you are made of milk? ||3||
Says Kabeer, one who contemplates God,
is said to be a Brahmin among us. ||4||7||

325.e: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

325.g: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਸੁਖਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ॥
325.t: a(n)dhakaar sukh kabeh na soiee hai ||
325.e: In the darkness, no one can sleep in peace.

325.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਰੰਕੁ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਈ ਹੈ ॥੧॥
325.t: raajaa ra(n)k dhouoo mil roiee hai ||1||
325.e: The king and the pauper both weep and cry. ||1||

325.g: ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਬੋ ॥
325.t: jau pai rasanaa raam na kahibo ||
325.e: As long as the tongue does not chant the Lord's Name,
the person continues coming and going in reincarnation, crying out in pain. ||1||Pause||
It is like the shadow of a tree;

325.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਏ ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
325.t: praan ge kahu kaa kee maiaa ||2||
325.e: when the breath of life passes out of the mortal being, tell me, what becomes of his wealth? ||2||
It is like the music contained in the instrument;

325.g: ਮੂਏ ਮਰਮੁ ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕਰ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
325.t: mooe maram ko kaa kar jaanaa ||3||
325.e: how can anyone know the secret of the dead? ||3||
Like the swan on the lake, death hovers over the body.
Drink in the Lord's sweet elixir, Kabeer. ||4||8||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

325.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੀ ਜੋਤੀ ॥
325.t: jot kee jaat jaat kee jotee ||
325.e: The creation is born of the Light, and the Light is in the creation.
It bears two fruits: the false glass and the true pearl. ||1||

325.g: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਘਰੁ ਜੋ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
325.t: kavanu su ghar jo nirabhau kaheeaai ||
325.e: Where is that home, which is said to be free of fear?

325.g: ਭਉ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
325.t: bhau bhaj jai abhai hoi raheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
325.e: There, fear is dispelled and one lives without fear. ||1||Pause||
On the banks of sacred rivers, the mind is not appeased.
People remain entangled in good and bad deeds. ||2||
Sin and virtue are both the same.

325.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੁਨ ਆਨ ॥੩॥
325.t: nij ghar paaras tajahu gun aan ||3||
325.e: In the home of your own being, is the Philosopher's Stone; renounce your search for any other virtue. ||3||
Kabeer: O worthless mortal, do not lose the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Keep this mind of yours involved in this involvement. ||4||9||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
He claims to know the Lord, who is beyond measure and beyond thought;
by mere words, he plans to enter heaven. ||1||
I do not know where heaven is.

325.g: ਜਾਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਤਹਾ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
325.t: jaan jaan sabh kaheh tahaa hee ||1|| rahaau ||
325.e: Everyone claims that he plans to go there. ||1||Pause||
By mere talk, the mind is not appeased.

325.g: ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਈ ਹੈ ॥੨॥
325.t: tau man maanai jaa te haumai jiee hai ||2||
325.e: The mind is only appeased, when egotism is conquered. ||2||

325.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
325.t: jab lag man baiku(n)Th kee aas ||
325.e: As long as the mind is filled with the desire for heaven,

325.g: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਹੀ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
325.t: tab lag hoi nahee charan nivaas ||3||
325.e: he does not dwell at the Lord's Feet. ||3||
Says Kabeer, unto whom should I tell this?
The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is heaven. ||4||10||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
We are born, and we grow, and having grown, we pass away.
Before our very eyes, this world is passing away. ||1||

325.g: ਲਾਜ ਨ ਮਰਹੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
325.t: laaj na marahu kahahu ghar meraa ||
325.e: How can you not die of shame, claiming, ""This world is mine""?

325.g: ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
325.t: a(n)t kee baar nahee kachh teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
325.e: At the very last moment, nothing is yours. ||1||Pause||
Trying various methods, you cherish your body,
but at the time of death, it is burned in the fire. ||2||
You apply sandalwood oil to your limbs,

325.g: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
325.t: so tan jalai kaaTh kai sa(n)gaa ||3||
325.e: but that body is burned with the firewood. ||3||
Says Kabeer, listen, O virtuous people:
your beauty shall vanish, as the whole world watches. ||4||11||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
Why do you cry and mourn, when another person dies?
Do so only if you yourself are to live. ||1||
I shall not die as the rest of the world dies,

325.g: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਹੈ ਜੀਆਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
325.t: ab moh milio hai jeeaavanahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
325.e: for now I have met the life-giving Lord. ||1||Pause||
People anoint their bodies with fragrant oils,
and in that pleasure, they forget the supreme bliss. ||2||
There is one well, and five water-carriers.
Even though the rope is broken, the fools continue trying to draw water. ||3||
Says Kabeer, through contemplation, I have obtained this one understanding.
There is no well, and no water-carrier. ||4||12||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
The mobile and immobile creatures, insects and moths
- in numerous lifetimes, I have passed through those many forms. ||1||

326.e: I lived in many such homes, O Lord,

326.g: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਰਾਮ ਗਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
326.t: jab ham raam garabh hoi aae ||1|| rahaau ||
326.e: before I came into the womb this time. ||1||Pause||
I was a Yogi, a celibate, a penitent, and a Brahmchaaree, with strict self-discipline.
Sometimes I was a king, sitting on the throne, and sometimes I was a beggar. ||2||
The faithless cynics shall die, while the Saints shall all survive.
They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Essence with their tongues. ||3||
Says Kabeer, O God, have mercy on me.
I am so tired; now, please bless me with Your perfection. ||4||13||

326.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
326.t: gauRee kabeer jee kee naal ralai likhiaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
326.e: Gauree, Kabeer Jee, With Writings Of The Fifth Mehla:
Kabeer has seen such wonders!

326.g: ਦਧਿ ਕੈ ਭੋਲੈ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਨੀਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
326.t: dhadh kai bholai birolai neer ||1|| rahaau ||
326.e: Mistaking it for cream, the people are churning water. ||1||Pause||
The donkey grazes upon the green grass;
arising each day, he laughs and brays, and then dies. ||1||
The bull is intoxicated, and runs around wildly.
He romps and eats and then falls into hell. ||2||
Says Kabeer, a strange sport has become manifest:
the sheep is sucking the milk of her lamb. ||3||
Chanting the Lord's Name, my intellect is enlightened.
Says Kabeer, the Guru has blessed me with this understanding. ||4||1||14||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Panch-Padhay:

326.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਇਓ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
326.t: jiau jal chhodd baahar bhio meenaa ||
326.e: I am like a fish out of water,

326.g: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਹਉ ਤਪ ਕਾ ਹੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
326.t: poorab janam hau tap kaa heenaa ||1||
326.e: because in my previous life, I did not practice penance and intense meditation. ||1||

326.g: ਅਬ ਕਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਕਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
326.t: ab kahu raam kavan gat moree ||
326.e: Now tell me, Lord, what will my condition be?

326.g: ਤਜੀ ਲੇ ਬਨਾਰਸ ਮਤਿ ਭਈ ਥੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
326.t: tajee le banaaras mat bhiee thoree ||1|| rahaau ||
326.e: I left Benares - I had little common sense. ||1||Pause||
I wasted my whole life in the city of Shiva;
at the time of my death, I moved to Magahar. ||2||
For many years, I practiced penance and intense meditation at Kaashi;
now that my time to die has come, I have come to dwell at Magahar! ||3||
Kaashi and Magahar - I consider them the same.
With inadequate devotion, how can anyone swim across? ||4||

326.g: ਕਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਜ ਸਿਵ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
326.t: kahu gur gaj siv sabh ko jaanai ||
326.e: Says Kabeer, the Guru and Ganaysha and Shiva all know
that Kabeer died chanting the Lord's Name. ||5||15||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
You may anoint your limbs with sandalwood oil,

326.g: ਸੋ ਤਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਕਾਠ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
326.t: so tan jalai kaaTh kai sa(n)gaa ||1||
326.e: but in the end, that body will be burned with the firewood. ||1||

326.g: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
326.t: eis tan dhan kee kavan baddaiee ||
326.e: Why should anyone take pride in this body or wealth?

326.g: ਧਰਨਿ ਪਰੈ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
326.t: dharan parai uravaar na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
326.e: They shall end up lying on the ground; they shall not go along with you to the world beyond. ||1||Pause||

326.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਜਿ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਾਮ ॥
326.t: raat j soveh dhin kareh kaam ||
326.e: They sleep by night and work during the day,

326.g: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਲੇਹਿ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥੨॥
326.t: eik khin leh na har ko naam ||2||
326.e: but they do not chant the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||2||

326.g: ਹਾਥਿ ਤ ਡੋਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਖਾਇਓ ਤੰਬੋਰ ॥
326.t: haath ta ddor mukh khaio ta(n)bor ||
326.e: They hold the string of the kite in their hands, and chew betel leaves in their mouths,
but at the time of death, they shall be tied up tight, like thieves. ||3||

326.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
326.t: gurmat ras ras har gun gaavai ||
326.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, and immersed in His Love, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, and find peace. ||4||
In His Mercy, He implants the Naam within us;
inhale deeply the sweet aroma and fragrance of the Lord, Har, Har. ||5||
Says Kabeer, remember Him, you blind fool!
The Lord is True; all worldly affairs are false. ||6||16||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Thi-Padhay And Chau-Thukay:

326.g: ਜਮ ਤੇ ਉਲਟਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
326.t: jam te ulaT bhe hai raam ||
326.e: I have turned away from death and turned to the Lord.
Pain has been eliminated, and I dwell in peac and comfort.
My enemies have been transformed into friends.
The faithless cynics have been transformed into good-hearted people. ||1||

326.g: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
326.t: ab moh sarab kusal kar maaniaa ||
326.e: Now, I feel that everything brings me peace.

326.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ ਜਬ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
326.t: saa(n)t bhiee jab gobidh jaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
326.e: Peace and tranquility have come, since I realized the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

327.e: My body was afflicted with millions of diseases.
They have been transformed into the peaceful, tranquil concentration of Samaadhi.
When someone understands his own self,
he no longer suffers from illness and the three fevers. ||2||
My mind has now been restored to its original purity.
When I became dead while yet alive, only then did I come to know the Lord.
Says Kabeer, I am now immersed in intuitive peace and poise.

327.g: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਡਰਉ ਨ ਅਵਰ ਡਰਾਵਉ ॥੩॥੧੭॥
327.t: aap na ddarau na avar ddaraavau ||3||17||
327.e: I do not fear anyone, and I do not strike fear into anyone else. ||3||17||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

327.g: ਪਿੰਡਿ ਮੂਐ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
327.t: pi(n)dd mooaai jeeau keh ghar jaataa ||
327.e: When the body dies, where does the soul go?
It is absorbed into the untouched, unstruck melody of the Word of the Shabad.
Only one who knows the Lord realizes Him.
The mind is satisfied and satiated, like the mute who eats the sugar candy and just smiles, without speaking. ||1||
Such is the spiritual wisdom which the Lord has imparted.

327.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਪਵਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
327.t: man re pavan dhiraR sukhaman naaree ||1|| rahaau ||
327.e: O mind, hold your breath steady within the central channel of the Sushmanaa. ||1||Pause||

327.g: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
327.t: so gur karahu j bahur na karanaa ||
327.e: Adopt such a Guru, that you shall not have to adopt another again.

327.g: ਸੋ ਪਦੁ ਰਵਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਰਵਨਾ ॥
327.t: so padh ravahu j bahur na ravanaa ||
327.e: Dwell in such a state, that you shall never have to dwell in any other.

327.g: ਸੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
327.t: so dhiaan dharahu j bahur na dharanaa ||
327.e: Embrace such a meditation, that you shall never have to embrace any other.

327.g: ਐਸੇ ਮਰਹੁ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
327.t: aaise marahu j bahur na maranaa ||2||
327.e: Die in such a way, that you shall never have to die again. ||2||
Turn your breath away from the left channel, and away from the right channel, and unite them in the central channel of the Sushmanaa.

327.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਸੰਗਮ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਨੑਾਵਉ ॥
327.t: bin jal sa(n)gam man meh n(h)aavau ||
327.e: At their confluence within your mind, take your bath there without water.
To look upon all with an impartial eye - let this be your daily occupation.
Contemplate this essence of reality - what else is there to contemplate? ||3||
Water, fire, wind, earth and ether
adopt such a way of life and you shall be close to the Lord.
Says Kabeer, meditate on the Immaculate Lord.

327.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਉ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
327.t: tit ghar jaau j bahur na aavau ||4||18||
327.e: Go to that home, which you shall never have to leave. ||4||18||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Thi-Padhay:
He cannot be obtained by offering your weight in gold.

327.g: ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਲੀਆ ਹੈ ਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
327.t: man dhe raam leeaa hai mol ||1||
327.e: But I have bought the Lord by giving my mind to Him. ||1||

327.g: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
327.t: ab moh raam apunaa kar jaaniaa ||
327.e: Now I recognize that He is my Lord.

327.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
327.t: sahaj subhai meraa man maaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
327.e: My mind is intuitively pleased with Him. ||1||Pause||

327.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
327.t: brahamai kath kath a(n)t na paiaa ||
327.e: Brahma spoke of Him continually, but could not find His limit.
Because of my devotion to the Lord, He has come to sit within the home of my inner being. ||2||
Says Kabeer, I have renounced my restless intellect.
It is my destiny to worship the Lord alone. ||3||1||19||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
That death which terrifies the entire world
- the nature of that death has been revealed to me, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

327.g: ਅਬ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਰਉ ਮਰਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
327.t: ab kaise marau maran man maaniaa ||
327.e: Now, how shall I die? My mind has already accepted death.

327.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
327.t: mar mar jaate jin raam na jaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
327.e: Those who do not know the Lord, die over and over again, and then depart. ||1||Pause||
Everyone says, ""I will die, I will die.""
But he alone becomes immortal, who dies with intuitive understanding. ||2||
Says Kabeer, my mind is filled with bliss;
my doubts have been eliminated, and I am in ecstasy. ||3||20||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

327.g: ਕਤ ਨਹੀ ਠਉਰ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਤ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
327.t: kat nahee Thaur mool kat laavau ||
327.e: There is no special place where the soul aches; where should I apply the ointment?

327.g: ਖੋਜਤ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
327.t: khojat tan meh Thaur na paavau ||1||
327.e: I have searched the body, but I have not found such a place. ||1||
He alone knows it, who feels the pain of such love;
the arrows of the Lord's devotional worship are so sharp! ||1||Pause||
I look upon all His soul-brides with an impartial eye;
how can I know which ones are dear to the Husband Lord? ||2||

327.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
327.t: kahu kabeer jaa kai masatak bhaag ||
327.e: Says Kabeer, one who has such destiny inscribed upon her forehead

327.g: ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥੩॥੨੧॥
327.t: sabh parahar taa kau milai suhaag ||3||21||
327.e: - her Husband Lord turns all others away, and meets with her. ||3||21||

328.e: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

328.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
328.t: jaa kai har saa Thaakur bhaiee ||
328.e: One who has the Lord as his Master, O Siblings of Destiny
- countless liberations knock at his door. ||1||
If I say now that my trust is in You alone, Lord,

328.g: ਤਬ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
328.t: tab kaahoo kaa kavan nihoraa ||1|| rahaau ||
328.e: then what obligation do I have to anyone else? ||1||Pause||

328.g: ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਹਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
328.t: teen lok jaa kai heh bhaar ||
328.e: He bears the burden of the three worlds;
why should He not cherish you also? ||2||
Says Kabeer, through contemplation, I have obtained this one understanding.

328.g: ਕਿਆ ਬਸੁ ਜਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੨॥
328.t: kiaa bas jau bikh dhe mahataaree ||3||22||
328.e: If the mother poisons her own child, what can anyone do? ||3||22||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

328.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤ ਸਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
328.t: bin sat satee hoi kaise naar ||
328.e: Without Truth, how can the woman be a true satee - a widow who burns herself on her husband's funeral pyre?
O Pandit, O religious scholar, see this and contemplate it within your heart. ||1||
Without love, how can one's affection increase?

328.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਸੁ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
328.t: jab lag ras tab lag nahee neh ||1|| rahaau ||
328.e: As long as there is attachment to pleasure, there can be no spiritual love. ||1||Pause||
One who, in his own soul, believes the Queen Maya to be true,

328.g: ਸੋ ਰਮਯੇ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਸੁਪਨੈ ॥੨॥
328.t: so ramaye kau milai na supanai ||2||
328.e: does not meet the Lord, even in dreams. ||2||

328.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
328.t: tan man dhan girahu saup sareer ||
328.e: One who surrenders her body, mind, wealth, home and self
- she is the true soul-bride, says Kabeer. ||3||23||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
The whole world is engrossed in corruption.
This corruption has drowned entire families. ||1||

328.g: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਨਾਵ ਚਉੜਿ ਕਤ ਬੋੜੀ ॥
328.t: re nar naav chauR kat boRee ||
328.e: O man, why have you wrecked your boat and sunk it?

328.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਤੋੜਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋੜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
328.t: har siau toR bikhiaa sa(n)g joRee ||1|| rahaau ||
328.e: You have broken with the Lord, and joined hands with corruption. ||1||Pause||
Angels and human beings alike are burning in the raging fire.

328.g: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨੀਰੁ ਪਸੁ ਪੀਵਸਿ ਨ ਝਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
328.t: nikaT neer pas peevas na jhaag ||2||
328.e: The water is near at hand, but the beast does not drink it in. ||2||
By constant contemplation and awareness, the water is brought forth.
That water is immaculate and pure, says Kabeer. ||3||24||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

328.g: ਜਿਹ ਕੁਲਿ ਪੂਤੁ ਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
328.t: jeh kul poot na giaan beechaaree ||
328.e: That family, whose son has no spiritual wisdom or contemplation
- why didn't his mother just become a widow? ||1||

328.g: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹਿ ਸਾਧੀ ॥
328.t: jeh nar raam bhagat neh saadhee ||
328.e: That man who has not practiced devotional worship of the Lord

328.g: ਜਨਮਤ ਕਸ ਨ ਮੁਓ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
328.t: janamat kas na muo aparaadhee ||1|| rahaau ||
328.e: - why didn't such a sinful man die at birth? ||1||Pause||

328.g: ਮੁਚੁ ਮੁਚੁ ਗਰਭ ਗਏ ਕੀਨ ਬਚਿਆ ॥
328.t: much much garabh ge keen bachiaa ||
328.e: So many pregnancies end in miscarriage - why was this one spared?
He lives his life in this world like a deformed amputee. ||2||

328.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਰੂਪ ॥ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਬਜ ਕੁਰੂਪ ॥੩॥੨੫॥
328.t: kahu kabeer jaise su(n)dhar saroop || naam binaa jaise kubaj kuroop ||3||25||
328.e: Says Kabeer, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, beautiful and handsome people are just ugly hunch-backs. ||3||25||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

328.g: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਲੇਹਿ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
328.t: jo jan leh khasam kaa naau || tin kai sadh balihaarai jaau ||1||
328.e: I am forever a sacrifice to those humble beings who take the Name of their Lord and Master. ||1||

328.g: ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
328.t: so niramal niramal har gun gaavai ||
328.e: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Pure Lord are pure.

328.g: ਸੋ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
328.t: so bhaiee merai man bhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
328.e: They are my Siblings of Destiny, so dear to my heart. ||1||Pause||

328.g: ਜਿਹ ਘਟ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਹਮ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
328.t: jeh ghaT raam rahiaa bharapoor || tin kee pag pa(n)kaj ham dhoor ||2||
328.e: I am the dust of the lotus feet of those whose hearts are filled with the All-pervading Lord. ||2||
I am a weaver by birth, and patient of mind.
Slowly, steadily, Kabeer chants the Glories of God. ||3||26||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
From the Sky of the Tenth Gate, the nectar trickles down, distilled from my furnace.

328.g: ਸੰਚਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਤਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਕਾਠੀ ॥੧॥
328.t: sa(n)ch mahaa ras tan bhiaa kaaThee ||1||
328.e: I have gathered in this most sublime essence, making my body into firewood. ||1||
He alone is called intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise,

328.g: ਪੀਵਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
328.t: peevat raam ras giaan beechaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
328.e: who drinks in the juice of the Lord's essence, contemplating spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||
Intuitive poise is the bar-maid who comes to serve it.
I pass my nights and days in ecstasy. ||2||
Through conscious meditation, I linked my consciousness with the Immaculate Lord.
Says Kabeer, then I obtained the Fearless Lord. ||3||27||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
The natural tendency of the mind is to chase the mind.

329.e: Who has established himself as a Siddha, a being of miraculous spiritual powers, by killing his mind? ||1||

329.g: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਨਿ ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ॥
329.t: kavanu su mun jo man maarai ||
329.e: Who is that silent sage, who has killed his mind?

329.g: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
329.t: man kau maar kahahu kis taarai ||1|| rahaau ||
329.e: By killing the mind, tell me, who is saved? ||1||Pause||
Everyone speaks through the mind.

329.g: ਮਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
329.t: man maare bin bhagat na hoiee ||2||
329.e: Without killing the mind, devotional worship is not performed. ||2||
Says Kabeer, one who knows the secret of this mystery,
beholds within his own mind the Lord of the three worlds. ||3||28||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
The stars which are seen in the sky
- who is the painter who painted them? ||1||

329.g: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
329.t: kahu re pa(n)ddit a(n)bar kaa siau laagaa ||
329.e: Tell me, O Pandit, what is the sky attached to?
Very fortunate is the knower who knows this. ||1||Pause||
The sun and the moon give their light;
God's creative extension extends everywhere. ||2||
Says Kabeer, he alone knows this,
whose heart is filled with the Lord, and whose mouth is also filled with the Lord. ||3||29||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
The Simritee is the daughter of the Vedas, O Siblings of Destiny.
She has brought a chain and a rope. ||1||
She has imprisoned the people in her own city.

329.g: ਮੋਹ ਕੈ ਫਾਧਿ ਕਾਲ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
329.t: moh kai faadh kaal sar saa(n)dhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
329.e: She has tightened the noose of emotional attachment and shot the arrow of death. ||1||Pause||

329.g: ਕਟੀ ਨ ਕਟੈ ਤੂਟਿ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ ॥
329.t: kaTee na kaTai tooT neh jaiee ||
329.e: By cutting, she cannot be cut, and she cannot be broken.

329.g: ਸਾ ਸਾਪਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
329.t: saa saapan hoi jag kau khaiee ||2||
329.e: She has become a serpent, and she is eating the world. ||2||

329.g: ਹਮ ਦੇਖਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ॥
329.t: ham dhekhat jin sabh jag looTiaa ||
329.e: Before my very eyes, she has plundered the entire world.

329.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਿ ਛੂਟਿਆ ॥੩॥੩੦॥
329.t: kahu kabeer mai raam keh chhooTiaa ||3||30||
329.e: Says Kabeer, chanting the Lord's Name, I have escaped her. ||3||30||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
I have grasped the reins and attached the bridle;
abandoning everything, I now ride through the skies. ||1||
I made self-reflection my mount,

329.g: ਸਹਜ ਕੈ ਪਾਵੜੈ ਪਗੁ ਧਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
329.t: sahaj kai paavaRai pag dhar leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
329.e: and in the stirrups of intuitive poise, I placed my feet. ||1||Pause||

329.g: ਚਲੁ ਰੇ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਲੇ ਤਾਰਉ ॥
329.t: chal re baiku(n)Th tujheh le taarau ||
329.e: Come, and let me ride you to heaven.

329.g: ਹਿਚਹਿ ਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਚਾਬੁਕ ਮਾਰਉ ॥੨॥
329.t: hicheh ta prem kai chaabuk maarau ||2||
329.e: If you hold back, then I shall strike you with the whip of spiritual love. ||2||

329.g: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਭਲੇ ਅਸਵਾਰਾ ॥ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੩੧॥
329.t: kahat kabeer bhale asavaaraa || bedh kateb te raheh niraaraa ||3||31||
329.e: Says Kabeer, those who remain detached from the Vedas, the Koran and the Bible are the best riders. ||3||31||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
That mouth, which used to eat the five delicacies
- I have seen the flames being applied to that mouth. ||1||

329.g: ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
329.t: eik dhukh raam rai kaaTahu meraa ||
329.e: O Lord, my King, please rid me of this one affliction:

329.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਦਹੈ ਅਰੁ ਗਰਭ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
329.t: agan dhahai ar garabh baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
329.e: may I not be burned in fire, or cast into the womb again. ||1||Pause||
The body is destroyed by so many ways and means.

329.g: ਕੋ ਜਾਰੇ ਕੋ ਗਡਿ ਲੇ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੨॥
329.t: ko jaare ko gadd le maaTee ||2||
329.e: Some burn it, and some bury it in the earth. ||2||
Says Kabeer, O Lord, please reveal to me Your Lotus Feet;

329.g: ਪਾਛੈ ਤੇ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਪਠਾਵਹੁ ॥੩॥੩੨॥
329.t: paachhai te jam kiau na paThaavahu ||3||32||
329.e: after that, go ahead and send me to my death. ||3||32||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee:
He Himself is the fire, and He Himself is the wind.
When our Lord and Master wishes to burn someone, then who can save him? ||1||

329.g: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਤਨੁ ਜਰਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
329.t: raam japat tan jar kee na jai ||
329.e: When I chant the Lord's Name, what does it matter if my body burns?

329.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
329.t: raam naam chit rahiaa samai ||1|| rahaau ||
329.e: My consciousness remains absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

329.g: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਜਰੈ ਕਾਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਾਨਿ ॥
329.t: kaa ko jarai kaeh hoi haan ||
329.e: Who is burned, and who suffers loss?
The Lord plays, like the juggler with his ball. ||2||
Says Kabeer, chant the two letters of the Lord's Name - Raa Maa.
If He is your Lord and Master, He will protect you. ||3||33||
Gauree, Kabeer Jee, Dho-Padhay:

329.g: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
329.t: naa mai jog dhiaan chit laiaa ||
329.e: I have not practiced Yoga, or focused my consciousness on meditation.
Without renunciation, I cannot escape Maya. ||1||
How have I passed my life?

330.g: ਜਬ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
330.t: jab na hoi raam naam adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
330.e: I have not taken the Lord's Name as my Support. ||1||Pause||

330.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਖੋਜਉ ਅਸਮਾਨ ॥
330.t: kahu kabeer khojau asamaan ||
330.e: Says Kabeer, I have searched the skies,

330.g: ਰਾਮ ਸਮਾਨ ਨ ਦੇਖਉ ਆਨ ॥੨॥੩੪॥
330.t: raam samaan na dhekhau aan ||2||34||
330.e: and have not seen another, equal to the Lord. ||2||34||

330.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
330.t: gauRee kabeer jee ||
330.e: Gauree, Kabeer Jee:

330.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਬਾਧਤ ਪਾਗ ॥
330.t: jeh sir rach rach baadhat paag ||
330.e: That head which was once embellished with the finest turban

330.g: ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਚੁੰਚ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਕਾਗ ॥੧॥
330.t: so sir chu(n)ch savaareh kaag ||1||
330.e: - upon that head, the crow now cleans his beak. ||1||

330.g: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕੋ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬਈਆ ॥
330.t: eis tan dhan ko kiaa garabieeaa ||
330.e: What pride should we take in this body and wealth?

330.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
330.t: raam naam kaahe na dhiraR(h)eeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
330.e: Why not hold tight to the Lord's Name instead? ||1||Pause||

330.g: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
330.t: kahat kabeer sunahu man mere ||
330.e: Says Kabeer, listen, O my mind:

330.g: ਇਹੀ ਹਵਾਲ ਹੋਹਿਗੇ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੨॥੩੫॥
330.t: eihee havaal hohige tere ||2||35||
330.e: this may be your fate as well! ||2||35||

330.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਪੈਤੀਸ ॥
330.t: gauRee guaareree ke padhe paitees ||
330.e: Thirty-Five Steps Of Gauree Gwaarayree. ||

330.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ
330.t: raag gauRee guaareree asaTapadhee kabeer jee kee
330.e: Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Ashtpadheeyaa Of Kabeer Jee:

330.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
330.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
330.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

330.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਂਗਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਆਵੈ ॥
330.t: sukh maa(n)gat dhukh aagai aavai ||
330.e: People beg for pleasure, but pain comes instead.

330.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਂਗਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
330.t: so sukh hamahu na maa(n)giaa bhaavai ||1||
330.e: I would rather not beg for that pleasure. ||1||

330.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅਜਹੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਸਾ ॥
330.t: bikhiaa ajahu surat sukh aasaa ||
330.e: People are involved in corruption, but still, they hope for pleasure.

330.g: ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
330.t: kaise hoiee hai raajaa raam nivaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
330.e: How will they find their home in the Sovereign Lord King? ||1||Pause||

330.g: ਇਸੁ ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਿਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਡਰਾਨਾ ॥
330.t: eis sukh te siv braham ddaraanaa ||
330.e: Even Shiva and Brahma are afraid of this pleasure,

330.g: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
330.t: so sukh hamahu saach kar jaanaa ||2||
330.e: but I have judged that pleasure to be true. ||2||

330.g: ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਸੇਖਾ ॥
330.t: sanakaadhik naaradh mun sekhaa ||
330.e: Even sages like Sanak and Naarad, and the thousand-headed serpent,

330.g: ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੩॥
330.t: tin bhee tan meh man nahee pekhaa ||3||
330.e: did not see the mind within the body. ||3||

330.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
330.t: eis man kau koiee khojahu bhaiee ||
330.e: Anyone can search for this mind, O Siblings of Destiny.

330.g: ਤਨ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
330.t: tan chhooTe man kahaa samaiee ||4||
330.e: When it escapes from the body, where does the mind go? ||4||

330.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਨਾਮਾਂ ॥
330.t: gur parasaadhee jaidheau naamaa(n) ||
330.e: By Guru's Grace, Jai Dayv and Naam Dayv

330.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੫॥
330.t: bhagat kai prem in hee hai jaanaa(n) ||5||
330.e: came to know this, through loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||5||

330.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
330.t: eis man kau nahee aavan jaanaa ||
330.e: This mind does not come or go.

330.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
330.t: jis kaa bharam giaa tin saach pachhaanaa ||6||
330.e: One whose doubt is dispelled, knows the Truth. ||6||

330.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
330.t: eis man kau roop na rekhiaa kaiee ||
330.e: This mind has no form or outline.

330.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
330.t: hukame hoiaa hukam boojh samaiee ||7||
330.e: By God's Command it was created; understanding God's Command, it will be absorbed into Him again. ||7||

330.g: ਇਸ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
330.t: eis man kaa koiee jaanai bheau ||
330.e: Does anyone know the secret of this mind?

330.g: ਇਹ ਮਨਿ ਲੀਣ ਭਏ ਸੁਖਦੇਉ ॥੮॥
330.t: eeh man leen bhe sukhadheau ||8||
330.e: This mind shall merge into the Lord, the Giver of peace and pleasure. ||8||

330.g: ਜੀਉ ਏਕੁ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
330.t: jeeau ek ar sagal sareeraa ||
330.e: There is One Soul, and it pervades all bodies.

330.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੯॥੧॥੩੬॥
330.t: eis man kau rav rahe kabeeraa ||9||1||36||
330.e: Kabeer dwells upon this Mind. ||9||1||36||

330.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
330.t: gauRee guaareree ||
330.e: Gauree Gwaarayree:

330.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਜੋ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
330.t: ahinis ek naam jo jaage ||
330.e: Those who are awake to the One Name, day and night

330.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
330.t: ketak sidh bhe liv laage ||1|| rahaau ||
330.e: - many of them have become Siddhas - perfect spiritual beings - with their consciousness attuned to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

330.g: ਸਾਧਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
330.t: saadhak sidh sagal mun haare ||
330.e: The seekers, the Siddhas and the silent sages have all lost the game.

330.g: ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕਲਿਪ ਤਰ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
330.t: ek naam kalip tar taare ||1||
330.e: The One Name is the wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree, which saves them and carries them across. ||1||

330.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਆਨਾ ॥
330.t: jo har hare su hoh na aanaa ||
330.e: Those who are rejuvenated by the Lord, do not belong to any other.

330.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੩੭॥
330.t: keh kabeer raam naam pachhaanaa ||2||37||
330.e: Says Kabeer, they realize the Name of the Lord. ||2||37||

330.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਭੀ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਭੀ ॥
330.t: gauRee bhee soraTh bhee ||
330.e: Gauree And Also Sorat'h:

330.g: ਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਨਿਲਜ ਲਾਜ ਤੋੁਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
330.t: re jeea nilaj laaj tuoh naahee ||
330.e: O shameless being, don't you feel ashamed?

330.g: ਹਰਿ ਤਜਿ ਕਤ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
330.t: har taj kat kaahoo ke jaa(n)hee ||1|| rahaau ||
330.e: You have forsaken the Lord - now where will you go? Unto whom will you turn? ||1||Pause||

330.g: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
330.t: jaa ko Thaakur uoochaa hoiee ||
330.e: One whose Lord and Master is the highest and most exalted

330.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਸੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
330.t: so jan par ghar jaat na sohee ||1||
330.e: - it is not proper for him to go to the house of another. ||1||

330.g: ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
330.t: so saahib rahiaa bharapoor ||
330.e: That Lord and Master is pervading everywhere.

330.g: ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
330.t: sadhaa sa(n)g naahee har dhoor ||2||
330.e: The Lord is always with us; He is never far away. ||2||

330.g: ਕਵਲਾ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
330.t: kavalaa charan saran hai jaa ke ||
330.e: Even Maya takes to the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet.

330.g: ਕਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੩॥
330.t: kahu jan kaa naahee ghar taa ke ||3||
330.e: Tell me, what is there which is not in His home? ||3||

330.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਕਹੈ ਜਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
330.t: sabh kouoo kahai jaas kee baataa ||
330.e: Everyone speaks of Him; He is All-powerful.

330.g: ਸੋ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
330.t: so sa(n)mrath nij pat hai dhaataa ||4||
330.e: He is His Own Master; He is the Giver. ||4||

330.g: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਗ ਸੋਈ ॥
330.t: kahai kabeer pooran jag soiee ||
330.e: Says Kabeer, he alone is perfect in this world,

330.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੩੮॥
330.t: jaa ke hiradhai avar na hoiee ||5||38||
330.e: in whose heart there is none other than the Lord. ||5||38||

331.g: ਕਉਨੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕੋ ॥
331.t: kaun ko poot pitaa ko kaa ko ||
331.e: Whose son is he? Whose father is he?

331.g: ਕਉਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਕੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੰਤਾਪੋ ॥੧॥
331.t: kaun marai ko dhei sa(n)taapo ||1||
331.e: Who dies? Who inflicts pain? ||1||

331.g: ਹਰਿ ਠਗ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
331.t: har Thag jag kau Thagauree laiee ||
331.e: The Lord is the thug, who has drugged and robbed the whole world.

331.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਬਿਓਗ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਅਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
331.t: har ke biog kaise jeeaau meree maiee ||1|| rahaau ||
331.e: I am separated from the Lord; how can I survive, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

331.g: ਕਉਨ ਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਉਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
331.t: kaun ko purakh kaun kee naaree ||
331.e: Whose husband is he? Whose wife is she?

331.g: ਇਆ ਤਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
331.t: eiaa tat leh sareer bichaaree ||2||
331.e: Contemplate this reality within your body. ||2||

331.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਠਗ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
331.t: keh kabeer Thag siau man maaniaa ||
331.e: Says Kabeer, my mind is pleased and satisfied with the thug.

331.g: ਗਈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਠਗੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੩੯॥
331.t: giee Thagauree Thag pahichaaniaa ||3||39||
331.e: The effects of the drug have vanished, since I recognized the thug. ||3||39||

331.g: ਅਬ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
331.t: ab mo kau bhe raajaa raam sahaiee ||
331.e: Now, the Lord, my King, has become my help and support.

331.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਟਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
331.t: janam maran kaT param gat paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
331.e: I have cut away birth and death, and attained the supreme status. ||1||Pause||

331.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੀਓ ਰਲਾਇ ॥
331.t: saadhoo sa(n)gat dheeo ralai ||
331.e: He has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

331.g: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤੇ ਲੀਓ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
331.t: pa(n)ch dhoot te leeo chhaddai ||
331.e: He has rescued me from the five demons.

331.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
331.t: a(n)mirat naam japau jap rasanaa ||
331.e: I chant with my tongue and meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

331.g: ਅਮੋਲ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਅਪਨਾ ॥੧॥
331.t: amol dhaas kar leeno apanaa ||1||
331.e: He has made me his own slave. ||1||

331.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀਨੋ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ॥
331.t: satigur keeno paraupakaar ||
331.e: The True Guru has blessed me with His generosity.

331.g: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
331.t: kaadd leen saagar sa(n)saar ||
331.e: He has lifted me up, out of the world-ocean.

331.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
331.t: charan kamal siau laagee preet ||
331.e: I have fallen in love with His Lotus Feet.

331.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
331.t: gobi(n)dh basai nitaa nit cheet ||2||
331.e: The Lord of the Universe dwells continually within my consciousness. ||2||

331.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਅੰਗਿਆਰੁ ॥
331.t: maiaa tapat bujhiaa a(n)giaar ||
331.e: The burning fire of Maya has been extinguished.

331.g: ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
331.t: man sa(n)tokh naam aadhaar ||
331.e: My mind is contented with the Support of the Naam.

331.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
331.t: jal thal poor rahe prabh suaamee ||
331.e: God, the Lord and Master, is totally permeating the water and the land.

331.g: ਜਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
331.t: jat pekhau tat a(n)tarajaamee ||3||
331.e: Wherever I look, there is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||3||

331.g: ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥
331.t: apanee bhagat aap hee dhiraRaiee ||
331.e: He Himself has implanted His devotional worship within me.

331.g: ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
331.t: poorab likhat miliaa mere bhaiee ||
331.e: By pre-ordained destiny, one meets Him, O my Siblings of Destiny.

331.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਜ ॥
331.t: jis kirapaa kare tis pooran saaj ||
331.e: When He grants His Grace, one is perfectly fulfilled.

331.g: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਰੀਬ ਨਿਵਾਜ ॥੪॥੪੦॥
331.t: kabeer ko suaamee gareeb nivaaj ||4||40||
331.e: Kabeer's Lord and Master is the Cherisher of the poor. ||4||40||

331.g: ਜਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਥਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
331.t: jal hai sootak thal hai sootak sootak opat hoiee ||
331.e: There is pollution in the water, and pollution on the land; whatever is born is polluted.

331.g: ਜਨਮੇ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਮੂਏ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕ ਪਰਜ ਬਿਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
331.t: janame sootak mooe fun sootak sootak paraj bigoiee ||1||
331.e: There is pollution in birth, and more pollution in death; all beings are ruined by pollution. ||1||

331.g: ਕਹੁ ਰੇ ਪੰਡੀਆ ਕਉਨ ਪਵੀਤਾ ॥
331.t: kahu re pa(n)ddeeaa kaun paveetaa ||
331.e: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: who is clean and pure?

331.g: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
331.t: aaisaa giaan japahu mere meetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
331.e: Meditate on such spiritual wisdom, O my friend. ||1||Pause||

331.g: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਬੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
331.t: nainahu sootak bainahu sootak sootak sravanee hoiee ||
331.e: There is pollution in the eyes, and pollution in speech; there is pollution in the ears as well.

331.g: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਪਰੈ ਰਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
331.t: uooThat baiThat sootak laagai sootak parai rasoiee ||2||
331.e: Standing up and sitting down, one is polluted; one's kitchen is polluted as well. ||2||

331.g: ਫਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ਛੂਟਨ ਕੀ ਇਕੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
331.t: faasan kee bidh sabh kouoo jaanai chhooTan kee ik koiee ||
331.e: Everyone knows how to be caught, but hardly anyone knows how to escape.

331.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥੪੧॥
331.t: keh kabeer raam ridhai bichaarai sootak tinai na hoiee ||3||41||
331.e: Says Kabeer, those who meditate on the Lord within their hearts, are not polluted. ||3||41||

331.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
331.t: gauRee ||
331.e: Gauree:

331.g: ਝਗਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਹੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
331.t: jhagaraa ek niberahu raam ||
331.e: Resolve this one conflict for me, O Lord,

331.g: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਸੌ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
331.t: jau tum apane jan sau kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
331.e: if you require any work from Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||

331.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਾ ਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
331.t: eih man baddaa k jaa sau man maaniaa ||
331.e: Is this mind greater, or the One to whom the mind is attuned?

331.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਬਡਾ ਕੈ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
331.t: raam baddaa kai raameh jaaniaa ||1||
331.e: Is the Lord greater, or one who knows the Lord? ||1||

331.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਾਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
331.t: brahamaa baddaa k jaas upaiaa ||
331.e: Is Brahma greater, or the One who created Him?

331.g: ਬੇਦੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਜਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
331.t: bedh baddaa k jahaa(n) te aaiaa ||2||
331.e: Are the Vedas greater, or the One from which they came? ||2||

331.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
331.t: keh kabeer hau bhiaa udhaas ||
331.e: Says Kabeer, I have become depressed;

331.g: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਬਡਾ ਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੩॥੪੨॥
331.t: teerath baddaa k har kaa dhaas ||3||42||
331.e: is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage greater, or the slave of the Lord? ||3||42||

331.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ॥
331.t: raag gauRee chetee ||
331.e: Raag Gauree Chaytee:

331.g: ਦੇਖੌ ਭਾਈ ਗੵਾਨ ਕੀ ਆਈ ਆਂਧੀ ॥
331.t: dhekhau bhaiee gayeaan kee aaiee aa(n)dhee ||
331.e: Behold, O Siblings of Destiny, the storm of spiritual wisdom has come.

331.g: ਸਭੈ ਉਡਾਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਾਂਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
331.t: sabhai uddaanee bhram kee TaaTee rahai na maiaa baa(n)dhee ||1|| rahaau ||
331.e: It has totally blown away the thatched huts of doubt, and torn apart the bonds of Maya. ||1||Pause||

331.g: ਦੁਚਿਤੇ ਕੀ ਦੁਇ ਥੂਨਿ ਗਿਰਾਨੀ ਮੋਹ ਬਲੇਡਾ ਟੂਟਾ ॥
331.t: dhuchite kee dhui thoon giraanee moh baleddaa TooTaa ||
331.e: The two pillars of double-mindedness have fallen, and the beams of emotional attachment have come crashing down.

331.g: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਛਾਨਿ ਪਰੀ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਫੂਟਾ ॥੧॥
331.t: tisanaa chhaan paree dhar uoopar dhuramat bhaa(n)ddaa fooTaa ||1||
331.e: The thatched roof of greed has caved in, and the pitcher of evil-mindedness has been broken. ||1||

332.g: ਆਂਧੀ ਪਾਛੇ ਜੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਖੈ ਤਿਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਨਾਂ ॥
332.t: aa(n)dhee paachhe jo jal barakhai teh teraa jan bheenaa(n) ||
332.e: Your servant is drenched with the rain that has fallen in this storm.

332.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਉਦੈ ਭਾਨੁ ਜਬ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੪੩॥
332.t: keh kabeer man bhiaa pragaasaa udhai bhaan jab cheenaa ||2||43||
332.e: Says Kabeer, my mind became enlightened, when I saw the sun rise. ||2||43||

332.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ
332.t: gauRee chetee
332.e: Gauree Chaytee:

332.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
332.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
332.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

332.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
332.t: har jas suneh na har gun gaaveh ||
332.e: They do not listen to the Lord's Praises, and they do not sing the Lord's Glories,

332.g: ਬਾਤਨ ਹੀ ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਗਿਰਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
332.t: baatan hee asamaan giraaveh ||1||
332.e: but they try to bring down the sky with their talk. ||1||

332.g: ਐਸੇ ਲੋਗਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
332.t: aaise logan siau kiaa kaheeaai ||
332.e: What can anyone say to such people?

332.g: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਜ ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਡਰਾਨੇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
332.t: jo prabh ke'ee bhagat te baahaj tin te sadhaa ddaraane raheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
332.e: You should always be careful around those whom God has excluded from His devotional worship. ||1||Pause||

332.g: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੇਹਿ ਚੁਰੂ ਭਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
332.t: aap na dheh churoo bhar paanee ||
332.e: They do not offer even a handful of water,

332.g: ਤਿਹ ਨਿੰਦਹਿ ਜਿਹ ਗੰਗਾ ਆਨੀ ॥੨॥
332.t: teh ni(n)dheh jeh ga(n)gaa aanee ||2||
332.e: while they slander the one who brought forth the Ganges. ||2||

332.g: ਬੈਠਤ ਉਠਤ ਕੁਟਿਲਤਾ ਚਾਲਹਿ ॥
332.t: baiThat uThat kuTilataa chaaleh ||
332.e: Sitting down or standing up, their ways are crooked and evil.

332.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਏ ਅਉਰਨ ਹੂ ਘਾਲਹਿ ॥੩॥
332.t: aap ge aauran hoo ghaaleh ||3||
332.e: They ruin themselves, and then they ruin others. ||3||

332.g: ਛਾਡਿ ਕੁਚਰਚਾ ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
332.t: chhaadd kucharachaa aan na jaaneh ||
332.e: They know nothing except evil talk.

332.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਹੂ ਕੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥੪॥
332.t: brahamaa hoo ko kahio na maaneh ||4||
332.e: They would not even obey Brahma's orders. ||4||

332.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਏ ਅਉਰਨ ਹੂ ਖੋਵਹਿ ॥
332.t: aap ge aauran hoo khoveh ||
332.e: They themselves are lost, and they mislead others as well.

332.g: ਆਗਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੈ ਸੋਵਹਿ ॥੫॥
332.t: aag lagai ma(n)dhar mai soveh ||5||
332.e: They set their own temple on fire, and then they fall asleep within it. ||5||

332.g: ਅਵਰਨ ਹਸਤ ਆਪ ਹਹਿ ਕਾਂਨੇ ॥
332.t: avaran hasat aap heh kaa(n)ne ||
332.e: They laugh at others, while they themselves are one-eyed.

332.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਲਜਾਨੇ ॥੬॥੧॥੪੪॥
332.t: tin kau dhekh kabeer lajaane ||6||1||44||
332.e: Seeing them, Kabeer is embarrassed. ||6||1||44||

332.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ
332.t: raag gauRee bairaagan kabeer jee
332.e: Raag Gauree Bairaagan, Kabeer Jee:

332.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
332.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
332.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

332.g: ਜੀਵਤ ਪਿਤਰ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ਮੂਏਂ ਸਿਰਾਧ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
332.t: jeevat pitar na maanai kouoo mooe(n) siraadh karaahee ||
332.e: He does not honor his ancestors while they are alive, but he holds feasts in their honor after they have died.

332.g: ਪਿਤਰ ਭੀ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਊਆ ਕੂਕਰ ਖਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
332.t: pitar bhee bapure kahu kiau paaveh kuooaa kookar khaahee ||1||
332.e: Tell me, how can his poor ancestors receive what the crows and the dogs have eaten up? ||1||

332.g: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
332.t: mo kau kusal bataavahu koiee ||
332.e: If only someone would tell me what real happiness is!

332.g: ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
332.t: kusal kusal karate jag binasai kusal bhee kaise hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
332.e: Speaking of happiness and joy, the world is perishing. How can happiness be found? ||1||Pause||

332.g: ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
332.t: maaTee ke kar dhevee dhevaa tis aagai jeeau dhehee ||
332.e: Making gods and goddesses out of clay, people sacrifice living beings to them.

332.g: ਐਸੇ ਪਿਤਰ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਆਪਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
332.t: aaise pitar tumaare kahe'eeh aapan kahiaa na lehee ||2||
332.e: Such are your dead ancestors, who cannot ask for what they want. ||2||

332.g: ਸਰਜੀਉ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਕਉ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
332.t: sarajeeau kaaTeh nirajeeau poojeh a(n)t kaal kau bhaaree ||
332.e: You murder living beings and worship lifeless things; at your very last moment, you shall suffer in terrible pain.

332.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਭੈ ਡੂਬੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
332.t: raam naam kee gat nahee jaanee bhai ddoobe sa(n)saaree ||3||
332.e: You do not know the value of the Lord's Name; you shall drown in the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

332.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
332.t: dhevee dhevaa poojeh ddoleh paarabraham nahee jaanaa ||
332.e: You worship gods and goddesses, but you do not know the Supreme Lord God.

332.g: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੫॥
332.t: kahat kabeer akul nahee chetiaa bikhiaa siau lapaTaanaa ||4||1||45||
332.e: Says Kabeer, you have not remembered the Lord who has no ancestors; you are clinging to your corrupt ways. ||4||1||45||

332.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
332.t: gauRee ||
332.e: Gauree:

332.g: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਐਸੇ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
332.t: jeevat marai marai fun jeevai aaise su(n)n samaiaa ||
332.e: One who remains dead while yet alive, will live even after death; thus he merges into the Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.

332.g: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
332.t: a(n)jan maeh nira(n)jan raheeaai bahuR na bhavajal paiaa ||1||
332.e: Remaining pure in the midst of impurity, he will never again fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

332.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਐਸਾ ਖੀਰੁ ਬਿਲੋਈਐ ॥
332.t: mere raam aaisaa kheer biloieeaai ||
332.e: O my Lord, this is the milk to be churned.

332.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਓਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
332.t: gurmat manooaa asathir raakhahu in bidh a(n)mrit peeoieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
332.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, hold your mind steady and stable, and in this way, drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

332.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਾਣਿ ਬਜਰ ਕਲ ਛੇਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਪਦੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
332.t: gur kai baan bajar kal chhedhee pragaTiaa padh paragaasaa ||
332.e: The Guru's arrow has pierced the hard core of this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, and the state of enlightenment has dawned.

332.g: ਸਕਤਿ ਅਧੇਰ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
332.t: sakat adher jevaRee bhram chookaa nihachal siv ghar baasaa ||2||
332.e: In the darkness of Maya, I mistook the rope for the snake, but that is over, and now I dwell in the eternal home of the Lord. ||2||

332.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੈ ਧਨਖੁ ਚਢਾਈਐ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥
332.t: tin bin baanai dhanakh chaddaieeaai ih jag bedhiaa bhaiee ||
332.e: Maya has drawn her bow without an arrow, and has pierced this world, O Siblings of Destiny.

333.g: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬੂਡੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਵੈ ਡੋਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
333.t: dheh dhis booddee pavan jhulaavai ddor rahee liv laiee ||3||
333.e: The drowning person is blown around in the ten directions by the wind, but I hold tight to the string of the Lord's Love. ||3||

333.g: ਉਨਮਨਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
333.t: aunaman manooaa su(n)n samaanaa dhubidhaa dhuramat bhaagee ||
333.e: The disturbed mind has been absorbed in the Lord; duality and evil-mindedness have run away.

333.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਨਭਉ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੬॥
333.t: kahu kabeer anabhau ik dhekhiaa raam naam liv laagee ||4||2||46||
333.e: Says Kabeer, I have seen the One Lord, the Fearless One; I am attuned to the Name of the Lord. ||4||2||46||

333.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਤਿਪਦੇ ॥
333.t: gauRee bairaagan tipadhe ||
333.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Thi-Padhay:

333.g: ਉਲਟਤ ਪਵਨ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਖਟੁ ਭੇਦੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥
333.t: aulaTat pavan chakar khaT bhedhe surat su(n)n anaraagee ||
333.e: I turned my breath inwards, and pierced through the six chakras of the body, and my awareness was centered on the Primal Void of the Absolute Lord.

333.g: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾਸੁ ਖੋਜੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
333.t: aavai na jai marai na jeevai taas khoj bairaagee ||1||
333.e: Search for the One who does not come or go, who does not die and is not born, O renunciate. ||1||

333.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
333.t: mere man man hee ulaT samaanaa ||
333.e: My mind has turned away from the world, and is absorbed in the Mind of God.

333.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਕਲਿ ਭਈ ਅਵਰੈ ਨਾਤਰੁ ਥਾ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
333.t: gur parasaadh akal bhiee avarai naatar thaa begaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
333.e: By Guru's Grace, my understanding has been changed; otherwise, I was totally ignorant. ||1||Pause||

333.g: ਨਿਵਰੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
333.t: nivarai dhoor dhoor fun nivarai jin jaisaa kar maaniaa ||
333.e: That which was near has become distant, and again, that which was distant is near, for those who realize the Lord as He is.

333.g: ਅਲਉਤੀ ਕਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਇਆ ਬਰੇਡਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
333.t: alautee kaa jaise bhiaa bareddaa jin peeaa tin jaaniaa ||2||
333.e: It is like the sugar water made from the candy; only one who drinks it knows its taste. ||2||

333.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਥਾ ਕਾਇ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ॥
333.t: teree niragun kathaa kai siau kaheeaai aaisaa koi bibekee ||
333.e: Unto whom should I speak Your speech, O Lord; it is beyond the three qualities. Is there anyone with such discerning wisdom?

333.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਪਲੀਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਝਲ ਦੇਖੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੪੭॥
333.t: kahu kabeer jin dheeaa paleetaa tin taisee jhal dhekhee ||3||3||47||
333.e: Says Kabeer, as is the fuse which you apply, so is the flash you will see. ||3||3||47||

333.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
333.t: gauRee ||
333.e: Gauree:

333.g: ਤਹ ਪਾਵਸ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਧੂਪ ਨਹੀ ਛਹੀਆ ਤਹ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
333.t: teh paavas si(n)dh dhoop nahee chhaheeaa teh utapat paralau naahee ||
333.e: There is no rainy season, ocean, sunshine or shade, no creation or destruction there.

333.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਦੋਊ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
333.t: jeevan mrit na dhukh sukh biaapai su(n)n samaadh dhouoo teh naahee ||1||
333.e: No life or death, no pain or pleasure is felt there. There is only the Primal Trance of Samaadhi, and no duality. ||1||

333.g: ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥
333.t: sahaj kee akath kathaa hai niraaree ||
333.e: The description of the state of intuitive poise is indescribable and sublime.

333.g: ਤੁਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਚਢੈ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮੁਕਾਤੀ ਹਲੁਕੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
333.t: tul nahee chaddai jai na mukaatee halukee lagai na bhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
333.e: It is not measured, and it is not exhausted. It is neither light nor heavy. ||1||Pause||

333.g: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਦੋਊ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
333.t: aradh uradh dhouoo teh naahee raat dhinas teh naahee ||
333.e: Neither lower nor upper worlds are there; neither day nor night are there.

333.g: ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਹਾ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
333.t: jal nahee pavan paavak fun naahee satigur tahaa samaahee ||2||
333.e: There is no water, wind or fire; there, the True Guru is contained. ||2||

333.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
333.t: agam agochar rahai nira(n)tar gur kirapaa te laheeaai ||
333.e: The Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord dwells there within Himself; by Guru's Grace, He is found.

333.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥੪॥੪੮॥
333.t: kahu kabeer bal jaau gur apune satasa(n)gat mil raheeaai ||3||4||48||
333.e: Says Kabeer, I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I remain in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||4||48||

333.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
333.t: gauRee ||
333.e: Gauree:

333.g: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਬੈਲ ਬਿਸਾਹੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਓ ॥
333.t: paap pu(n)n dhui bail bisaahe pavan poojee paragaasio ||
333.e: With both sin and virtue, the ox of the body is purchased; the air of the breath is the capital which has appeared.

333.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗੂਣਿ ਭਰੀ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਟਾਂਡ ਬਿਸਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
333.t: tirasanaa goon bharee ghaT bheetar in bidh Taa(n)dd bisaahio ||1||
333.e: The bag on its back is filled with desire; this is how we purchase the herd. ||1||

333.g: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
333.t: aaisaa naik raam hamaaraa ||
333.e: My Lord is such a wealthy merchant!

333.g: ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਬਨਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
333.t: sagal sa(n)saar keeo banajaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
333.e: He has made the whole world his peddler. ||1||Pause||

333.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਏ ਜਗਾਤੀ ਮਨ ਤਰੰਗ ਬਟਵਾਰਾ ॥
333.t: kaam karodh dhui bhe jagaatee man tara(n)g baTavaaraa ||
333.e: Sexual desire and anger are the tax-collectors, and the waves of the mind are the highway robbers.

333.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਹਿ ਟਾਂਡਾ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
333.t: pa(n)ch tat mil dhaan nibereh Taa(n)ddaa utario paaraa ||2||
333.e: The five elements join together and divide up their loot. This is how our herd is disposed of! ||2||

333.g: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅਬ ਐਸੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
333.t: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu ab aaisee ban aaiee ||
333.e: Says Kabeer, listen, O Saints: This is the state of affairs now!

333.g: ਘਾਟੀ ਚਢਤ ਬੈਲੁ ਇਕੁ ਥਾਕਾ ਚਲੋ ਗੋਨਿ ਛਿਟਕਾਈ ॥੩॥੫॥੪੯॥
333.t: ghaaTee chaddat bail ik thaakaa chalo gon chhiTakaiee ||3||5||49||
333.e: Going uphill, the ox has grown weary; throwing off his load, he continues on his journey. ||3||5||49||

333.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ॥
333.t: gauRee pa(n)chapadhaa ||
333.e: Gauree, Panch-Padhay:

333.g: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
333.t: pevakaRai dhin chaar hai saahuraRai jaanaa ||
333.e: For a few short days, the soul-bride stays in her parent's house; then, she must go to her in-laws.

333.g: ਅੰਧਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਏਆਣਾ ॥੧॥
333.t: a(n)dhaa lok na jaaniee moorakh eaanaa ||1||
333.e: The blind, foolish and ignorant people do not know this. ||1||

333.g: ਕਹੁ ਡਡੀਆ ਬਾਧੈ ਧਨ ਖੜੀ ॥
333.t: kahu ddaddeeaa baadhai dhan khaRee ||
333.e: Tell me, why is the bride wearing her ordinary clothes?

333.g: ਪਾਹੂ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਮੁਕਲਾਊ ਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
333.t: paahoo ghar aae mukalaauoo aae ||1|| rahaau ||
333.e: The guests have arrived at her home, and her Husband has come to take her away. ||1||Pause||

333.g: ਓਹ ਜਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਖੂਹੜੀ ਕਉਨ ਲਾਜੁ ਵਹਾਰੀ ॥
333.t: oh j dhisai khoohaRee kaun laaj vahaaree ||
333.e: Who has lowered the rope of the breath down, into the well of the world which we see?

333.g: ਲਾਜੁ ਘੜੀ ਸਿਉ ਤੂਟਿ ਪੜੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
333.t: laaj ghaRee siau tooT paRee uTh chalee panihaaree ||2||
333.e: The rope of the breath breaks away from the pitcher of the body, and the water-carrier gets up and departs. ||2||

333.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
333.t: saahib hoi dhiaal kirapaa kare apunaa kaaraj savaare ||
333.e: When the Lord and Master is kind and grants His Grace, then her affairs are all resolved.

334.g: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
334.t: taa sohaagan jaaneeaai gur sabadh beechaare ||3||
334.e: Then she is known as the happy soul-bride, if she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

334.g: ਕਿਰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
334.t: kirat kee baa(n)dhee sabh firai dhekhahu beechaaree ||
334.e: Bound by the actions she has committed, she wanders around - see this and understand.

334.g: ਏਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਆ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
334.t: es no kiaa aakheeaai kiaa kare vichaaree ||4||
334.e: What can we say to her? What can the poor soul-bride do? ||4||

334.g: ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਚਿਤ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
334.t: bhiee niraasee uTh chalee chit ba(n)dh na dheeraa ||
334.e: Disappointed and hopeless, she gets up and departs. There is no support or encouragement in her consciousness.

334.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥੫੦॥
334.t: har kee charanee laag rahu bhaj saran kabeeraa ||5||6||50||
334.e: So remain attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet, and hurry to His Sanctuary, Kabeer! ||5||6||50||

334.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
334.t: gauRee ||
334.e: Gauree :

334.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਹਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
334.t: jogee kaheh jog bhal meeThaa avar na dhoojaa bhaiee ||
334.e: The Yogi says that Yoga is good and sweet, and nothing else is, O Siblings of Destiny.

334.g: ਰੁੰਡਿਤ ਮੁੰਡਿਤ ਏਕੈ ਸਬਦੀ ਏਇ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
334.t: ru(n)ddit mu(n)ddit ekai sabadhee ei kaheh sidh paiee ||1||
334.e: Those who shave their heads, and those who amputate their limbs, and those who utter only a single word, all say that they have attained the spiritual perfection of the Siddhas. ||1||

334.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
334.t: har bin bharam bhulaane a(n)dhaa ||
334.e: Without the Lord, the blind ones are deluded by doubt.

334.g: ਜਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਉ ਆਪੁ ਛੁਟਕਾਵਨਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
334.t: jaa peh jaau aap chhuTakaavan te baadhe bahu fa(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
334.e: And those, to whom I go to find release - they themselves are bound by all sorts of chains. ||1||Pause||

334.g: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
334.t: jeh te upajee tahee samaanee ieh bidh bisaree tab hee ||
334.e: The soul is re-absorbed into that from which it originated, when one leaves this path of errors.

334.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਗੁਣੀ ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਏਹਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਬਡ ਹਮ ਹੀ ॥੨॥
334.t: pa(n)ddit gunee soor ham dhaate eh kaheh badd ham hee ||2||
334.e: The scholarly Pandits, the virtuous, the brave and the generous, all assert that they alone are great. ||2||

334.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
334.t: jiseh bujhaae soiee boojhai bin boojhe kiau raheeaai ||
334.e: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. Without understanding, what can anyone do?

334.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
334.t: satigur milai a(n)dheraa chookai in bidh maanak laheeaai ||3||
334.e: Meeting the True Guru, the darkness is dispelled, and in this way, the jewel is obtained. ||3||

334.g: ਤਜਿ ਬਾਵੇ ਦਾਹਨੇ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
334.t: taj baave dhaahane bikaaraa har padh dhiraR kar raheeaai ||
334.e: Give up the evil actions of your left and right hands, and grasp hold of the Feet of the Lord.

334.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੂੰਗੈ ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਪੂਛੇ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੧॥
334.t: kahu kabeer goo(n)gai guR khaiaa poochhe te kiaa kaheeaai ||4||7||51||
334.e: Says Kabeer, the mute has tasted the molasses, but what can he say about it if he is asked? ||4||7||51||

334.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
334.t: raag gauRee poorabee kabeer jee ||
334.e: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Kabeer Jee:

334.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
334.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
334.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

334.g: ਜਹ ਕਛੁ ਅਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
334.t: jeh kachh ahaa tahaa kichh naahee pa(n)ch tat teh naahee ||
334.e: Where something existed, now there is nothing. The five elements are no longer there.

334.g: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਬੰਦੇ ਏ ਅਵਗਨ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
334.t: eiRaa pi(n)gulaa sukhaman ba(n)dhe e avagan kat jaahee ||1||
334.e: The Ida, the Pingala and the Sushmanaa - O human being, how can the breaths through these be counted now? ||1||

334.g: ਤਾਗਾ ਤੂਟਾ ਗਗਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਬੋਲਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
334.t: taagaa tooTaa gagan binas giaa teraa bolat kahaa samaiee ||
