334.e: The string has been broken, and the Sky of the Tenth Gate has been destroyed. Where has your speech gone?

334.g: ਏਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
334.t: eh sa(n)saa mo kau anadhin biaapai mo kau ko na kahai samajhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
334.e: This cynicism afflicts me, night and day; who can explain this to me and help me understand? ||1||Pause||

334.g: ਜਹ ਬਰਭੰਡੁ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
334.t: jeh barabha(n)dd pi(n)dd teh naahee rachanahaar teh naahee ||
334.e: Where the world is - the body is not there; the mind is not there either.

334.g: ਜੋੜਨਹਾਰੋ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਇਹ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
334.t: joRanahaaro sadhaa ateetaa ieh kaheeaai kis maahee ||2||
334.e: The Joiner is forever unattached; now, within whom is the soul said to be contained? ||2||

334.g: ਜੋੜੀ ਜੁੜੈ ਨ ਤੋੜੀ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
334.t: joRee juRai na toRee tooTai jab lag hoi binaasee ||
334.e: By joining the elements, people cannot join them, and by breaking, they cannot be broken, until the body perishes.

334.g: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
334.t: kaa ko Thaakur kaa ko sevak ko kaahoo kai jaasee ||3||
334.e: Of whom is the soul the master, and of whom is it the servant? Where, and to whom does it go? ||3||

334.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਬਸੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
334.t: kahu kabeer liv laag rahee hai jahaa base dhin raatee ||
334.e: Says Kabeer, I have lovingly focused my attention on that place where the Lord dwells, day and night.

334.g: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਓਹੁ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੨॥
334.t: auaa kaa maram ohee par jaanai oh tau sadhaa abinaasee ||4||1||52||
334.e: Only He Himself truly knows the secrets of His mystery; He is eternal and indestructible. ||4||1||52||

334.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
334.t: gauRee ||
334.e: Gauree:

334.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਕੰਨੀ ਮੁੰਦਾ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
334.t: surat simirat dhui ka(n)nee mu(n)dhaa paramit baahar khi(n)thaa ||
334.e: Let contemplation and intuitive meditation be your two ear-rings, and true wisdom your patched overcoat.

334.g: ਸੁੰਨ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਕਲਪ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਪੰਥਾ ॥੧॥
334.t: su(n)n gufaa meh aasan baisan kalap bibarajit pa(n)thaa ||1||
334.e: In the cave of silence, dwell in your Yogic posture; let the subjugation of desire be your spiritual path. ||1||

334.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਮੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
334.t: mere raajan mai bairaagee jogee ||
334.e: O my King, I am a Yogi, a hermit, a renunciate.

334.g: ਮਰਤ ਨ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
334.t: marat na sog biogee ||1|| rahaau ||
334.e: I do not die or suffer pain or separation. ||1||Pause||

334.g: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਟੂਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਸਮਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
334.t: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd meh si(n)n(g)ee meraa baTooaa sabh jag bhasamaadhaaree ||
334.e: The solar systems and galaxies are my horn; the whole world is the bag to carry my ashes.

334.g: ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਲੁ ਪਲਟੀਐ ਛੂਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
334.t: taaRee laagee tirapal palaTeeaai chhooTai hoi pasaaree ||2||
334.e: Eliminating the three qualities and finding release from this world is my deep meditation. ||2||

334.g: ਮਨੁ ਪਵਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਤੂੰਬਾ ਕਰੀ ਹੈ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗ ਸਾਰਦ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
334.t: man pavan dhui too(n)baa karee hai jug jug saaradh saajee ||
334.e: My mind and breath are the two gourds of my fiddle, and the Lord of all the ages is its frame.

335.g: ਥਿਰੁ ਭਈ ਤੰਤੀ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੀ ॥੩॥
335.t: thir bhiee ta(n)tee tooTas naahee anahadh ki(n)guree baajee ||3||
335.e: The string has become steady, and it does not break; this guitar vibrates with the unstruck melody. ||3||

335.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
335.t: sun man magan bhe hai poore maiaa ddol na laagee ||
335.e: Hearing it, the mind is enraptured and becomes perfect; it does not waver, and it is not affected by Maya.

335.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਖੇਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੩॥
335.t: kahu kabeer taa kau punarap janam nahee khel gio bairaagee ||4||2||53||
335.e: Says Kabeer, the bairaagee, the renunciate, who has played such a game, is not reincarnated again into the world of form and substance. ||4||2||53||

335.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
335.t: gauRee ||
335.e: Gauree:

335.g: ਗਜ ਨਵ ਗਜ ਦਸ ਗਜ ਇਕੀਸ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਤਨਾਈ ॥
335.t: gaj nav gaj dhas gaj ikees pureeaa ek tanaiee ||
335.e: Nine yards, ten yards, and twenty-one yards - weave these into the full piece of cloth;

335.g: ਸਾਠ ਸੂਤ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਬਹਤਰਿ ਪਾਟੁ ਲਗੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
335.t: saaTh soot nav kha(n)dd bahatar paaT lago adhikaiee ||1||
335.e: take the sixty threads and add nine joints to the seventy-two on the loom. ||1||

335.g: ਗਈ ਬੁਨਾਵਨ ਮਾਹੋ ॥
335.t: giee bunaavan maaho ||
335.e: Life weaves itself into its patterns.

335.g: ਘਰ ਛੋਡਿਐ ਜਾਇ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
335.t: ghar chhoddiaai jai julaaho ||1|| rahaau ||
335.e: Leaving her home, the soul goes to the world of the weaver. ||1||Pause||

335.g: ਗਜੀ ਨ ਮਿਨੀਐ ਤੋਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਪਾਚਨੁ ਸੇਰ ਅਢਾਈ ॥
335.t: gajee na mineeaai tol na tuleeaai paachan ser addaiee ||
335.e: This cloth cannot be measured in yards or weighed with weights; its food is two and a half measures.

335.g: ਜੌ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਚਨੁ ਬੇਗਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਝਗਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਘਰਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
335.t: jau kar paachan beg na paavai jhagar karai gharahaiee ||2||
335.e: If it does not obtain food right away, it quarrels with the master of the house. ||2||

335.g: ਦਿਨ ਕੀ ਬੈਠ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਸ ਇਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਤ ਆਈ ॥
335.t: dhin kee baiTh khasam kee barakas ieh belaa kat aaiee ||
335.e: How many days will you sit here, in opposition to your Lord and Master? When will this opportunity come again?

335.g: ਛੂਟੇ ਕੂੰਡੇ ਭੀਗੈ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਚਲਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ਰੀਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
335.t: chhooTe koo(n)dde bheegai pureeaa chalio julaaho reesaiee ||3||
335.e: Leaving his pots and pans, and the bobbins wet with his tears, the weaver soul departs in jealous anger. ||3||

335.g: ਛੋਛੀ ਨਲੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਨਤਰ ਰਹੀ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥
335.t: chhochhee nalee ta(n)t nahee nikasai natar rahee urajhaiee ||
335.e: The wind-pipe is empty now; the thread of the breath does not come out any longer. The thread is tangled; it has run out.

335.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਈਹਾ ਰਹੁ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੪॥
335.t: chhodd pasaar ieehaa rahu bapuree kahu kabeer samajhaiee ||4||3||54||
335.e: So renounce the world of form and substance while you remain here, O poor soul; says Kabeer: you must understand this! ||4||3||54||

335.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
335.t: gauRee ||
335.e: Gauree:

335.g: ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਮਿਲੀ ਕਿੰਬਾ ਹੋਇ ਮਹੋਇ ॥
335.t: ek jot ekaa milee ki(n)baa hoi mahoi ||
335.e: When one light merges into another, what becomes of it then?

335.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
335.t: jit ghaT naam na uoopajai fooT marai jan soi ||1||
335.e: That person, within whose heart the Lord's Name does not well up - may that person burst and die! ||1||

335.g: ਸਾਵਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥
335.t: saaval su(n)dhar raamieeaa ||
335.e: O my dark and beautiful Lord,

335.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
335.t: meraa man laagaa toh ||1|| rahaau ||
335.e: my mind is attached to You. ||1||Pause||

335.g: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿ ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਿ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
335.t: saadh milai sidh paieeaai k eh jog k bhog ||
335.e: Meeting with the Holy, the perfection of the Siddhas is obtained. What good is Yoga or indulgence in pleasures?

335.g: ਦੁਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
335.t: dhuh mil kaaraj uoopajai raam naam sa(n)jog ||2||
335.e: When the two meet together, the business is conducted, and the link with the Lord's Name is established. ||2||

335.g: ਲੋਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਗੀਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
335.t: log jaanai ih geet hai ih tau braham beechaar ||
335.e: People believe that this is just a song, but it is a meditation on God.

335.g: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਸੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਨਸ ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
335.t: jiau kaasee upadhes hoi maanas maratee baar ||3||
335.e: It is like the instructions given to the dying man at Benares. ||3||

335.g: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
335.t: koiee gaavai ko sunai har naamaa chit lai ||
335.e: Whoever sings or listens to the Lord's Name with conscious awareness

335.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥੫੫॥
335.t: kahu kabeer sa(n)saa nahee a(n)t param gat pai ||4||1||4||55||
335.e: - says Kabeer, without a doubt, in the end, he obtains the highest status. ||4||1||4||55||

335.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
335.t: gauRee ||
335.e: Gauree:

335.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਤੇ ਡੂਬੇ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
335.t: jete jatan karat te ddoobe bhav saagar nahee taario re ||
335.e: Those who try to do things by their own efforts are drowned in the terrifying world-ocean; they cannot cross over.

335.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
335.t: karam dharam karate bahu sa(n)jam aha(n)budh man jaario re ||1||
335.e: Those who practice religious rituals and strict self-discipline - their egotistical pride shall consume their minds. ||1||

335.g: ਸਾਸ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਕੋ ਦਾਤੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
335.t: saas graas ko dhaato Thaakur so kiau manahu bisaario re ||
335.e: Your Lord and Master has given you the breath of life and food to sustain you; Oh, why have you forgotten Him?

335.g: ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
335.t: heeraa laal amol janam hai kauddee badhalai haario re ||1|| rahaau ||
335.e: Human birth is a priceless jewel, which has been squandered in exchange for a worthless shell. ||1||Pause||

335.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਭੂਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
335.t: tirasanaa tirakhaa bhookh bhram laagee hiradhai naeh beechaario re ||
335.e: The thirst of desire and the hunger of doubt afflict you; you do not contemplate the Lord in your heart.

335.g: ਉਨਮਤ ਮਾਨ ਹਿਰਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
335.t: aunamat maan hirio man maahee gur kaa sabadh na dhaario re ||2||
335.e: Intoxicated with pride, you cheat yourself; you have not enshrined the Word of the Guru's Shabad within your mind. ||2||

335.g: ਸੁਆਦ ਲੁਭਤ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ ਮਦ ਰਸ ਲੈਤ ਬਿਕਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
335.t: suaadh lubhat i(n)dhree ras prerio madh ras lait bikaario re ||
335.e: Those who are deluded by sensual pleasures, who are tempted by sexual delights and enjoy wine are corrupt.

335.g: ਕਰਮ ਭਾਗ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਾਨੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
335.t: karam bhaag sa(n)tan sa(n)gaane kaasaT loh udhaario re ||3||
335.e: But those who, through destiny and good karma, join the Society of the Saints, float over the ocean, like iron attached to wood. ||3||

335.g: ਧਾਵਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਅਬ ਦੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
335.t: dhaavat jon janam bhram thaake ab dhukh kar ham haario re ||
335.e: I have wandered in doubt and confusion, through birth and reincarnation; now, I am so tired. I am suffering in pain and wasting away.

335.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥੫੬॥
335.t: keh kabeer gur milat mahaa ras prem bhagat nisataario re ||4||1||5||56||
335.e: Says Kabeer, meeting with the Guru, I have obtained supreme joy; my love and devotion have saved me. ||4||1||5||56||

335.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
335.t: gauRee ||
335.e: Gauree:

335.g: ਕਾਲਬੂਤ ਕੀ ਹਸਤਨੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਚਲਤੁ ਰਚਿਓ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
335.t: kaalaboot kee hasatanee man bauraa re chalat rachio jagadhees ||
335.e: Like the straw figure of a female elephant, fashioned to trap the bull elephant, O crazy mind, the Lord of the Universe has staged the drama of this world.

335.g: ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਇ ਗਜ ਬਸਿ ਪਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਹਿਓ ਸੀਸ ॥੧॥
335.t: kaam suaai gaj bas pare man bauraa re a(n)kas sahio sees ||1||
335.e: Attracted by the lure of sexual desire, the elephant is captured, O crazy mind, and now the halter is placed around its neck. ||1||

336.g: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੁ ਸਮਝੁ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ॥
336.t: bikhai baach har raach samajh man bauraa re ||
336.e: So escape from corruption and immerse yourself in the Lord; take this advice, O crazy mind.

336.g: ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਰਾਮ ਜਹਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
336.t: nirabhai hoi na har bhaje man bauraa re gahio na raam jahaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
336.e: You have not meditated fearlessly on the Lord, O crazy mind; you have not embarked upon the Lord's Boat. ||1||Pause||

336.g: ਮਰਕਟ ਮੁਸਟੀ ਅਨਾਜ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਲੀਨੀ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
336.t: marakaT musaTee anaaj kee man bauraa re leenee haath pasaar ||
336.e: The monkey stretches out its hand, O crazy mind, and takes a handful of corn;

336.g: ਛੂਟਨ ਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਪਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਨਾਚਿਓ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
336.t: chhooTan ko sahasaa pariaa man bauraa re naachio ghar ghar baar ||2||
336.e: now unable to escape, O crazy mind, it is made to dance door to door. ||2||

336.g: ਜਿਉ ਨਲਨੀ ਸੂਅਟਾ ਗਹਿਓ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਮਾਯਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
336.t: jiau nalanee sooaTaa gahio man bauraa re maayaa ih biauhaar ||
336.e: Like the parrot caught in the trap, O crazy mind, you trapped by the affairs of Maya.

336.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਤਿਉ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
336.t: jaisaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa man bauraa re tiau pasario paasaar ||3||
336.e: Like the weak dye of the safflower, O crazy mind, so is the expanse of this world of form and substance. ||3||

336.g: ਨਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਘਨੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਪੂਜਨ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵ ॥
336.t: naavan kau teerath ghane man bauraa re poojan kau bahu dhev ||
336.e: There are so many holy shrines in which to bathe, O crazy mind, and so many gods to worship.

336.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੫੭॥
336.t: kahu kabeer chhooTan nahee man bauraa re chhooTan har kee sev ||4||1||6||57||
336.e: Says Kabeer, you shall not be saved like this, O crazy mind; only by serving the Lord will you find release. ||4||1||6||57||

336.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
336.t: gauRee ||
336.e: Gauree:

336.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਦਹੈ ਪਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਗਨੈ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਨੇਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
336.t: agan na dhahai pavan nahee maganai tasakar ner na aavai ||
336.e: Fire does not burn it, and the wind does not blow it away; thieves cannot get near it.

336.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਚਉਨੀ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
336.t: raam naam dhan kar sa(n)chaunee so dhan kat hee na jaavai ||1||
336.e: Accumulate the wealth of the Lord's Name; that wealth does not go anywhere. ||1||

336.g: ਹਮਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਧਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
336.t: hamaraa dhan maadhau gobi(n)dh dharaneedhar ihai saar dhan kaheeaai ||
336.e: My wealth is God, the Lord of Wealth, the Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth: this is called the most excellent wealth.

336.g: ਜੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਰਾਜਿ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
336.t: jo sukh prabh gobi(n)dh kee sevaa so sukh raaj na laheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
336.e: The peace which is obtained by serving God, the Lord of the Universe - that peace cannot be found in kingdoms or power. ||1||Pause||

336.g: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
336.t: eis dhan kaaran siv sanakaadhik khojat bhe udhaasee ||
336.e: Shiva and Sanak, in their search for this wealth, became Udaasees, and renounced the world.

336.g: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਪਰੈ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
336.t: man muka(n)dh jihabaa naarain parai na jam kee faasee ||2||
336.e: One whose mind is filled with the Lord of liberation, and whose tongue chants the Name of the Lord, shall not be caught by the noose of Death. ||2||

336.g: ਨਿਜ ਧਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਾਸੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
336.t: nij dhan giaan bhagat gur dheenee taas sumat man laagaa ||
336.e: My own wealth is the spiritual wisdom and devotion given by the Guru; my mind is held steady in perfect neutral balance.

336.g: ਜਲਤ ਅੰਭ ਥੰਭਿ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤ ਭਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
336.t: jalat a(n)bh tha(n)bh man dhaavat bharam ba(n)dhan bhau bhaagaa ||3||
336.e: It is like water for the burning soul, like an anchoring support for the wandering mind; the bondage of doubt and fear is dispelled. ||3||

336.g: ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਮਦਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
336.t: kahai kabeer madhan ke maate hiradhai dhekh beechaaree ||
336.e: Says Kabeer: O you who are intoxicated with sexual desire, reflect upon this in your heart, and see.

336.g: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਹਸਤੀ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੫੮॥
336.t: tum ghar laakh koT asavai hasatee ham ghar ek muraaree ||4||1||7||58||
336.e: Within your home there are hundreds of thousands, millions of horses and elephants; but within my home is the One Lord. ||4||1||7||58||

336.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
336.t: gauRee ||
336.e: Gauree:

336.g: ਜਿਉ ਕਪਿ ਕੇ ਕਰ ਮੁਸਟਿ ਚਨਨ ਕੀ ਲੁਬਧਿ ਨ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
336.t: jiau kap ke kar musaT chanan kee lubadh na tiaag dhio ||
336.e: Like the monkey with a handful of grain, who will not let go because of greed

336.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਲਾਲਚ ਸਿਉ ਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
336.t: jo jo karam ke'ee laalach siau te fir gareh pario ||1||
336.e: - just so, all the deeds committed in greed ultimately become a noose around one's neck. ||1||

336.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਓ ॥
336.t: bhagat bin birathe janam gio ||
336.e: Without devotional worship, human life passes away in vain.

336.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
336.t: saadhasa(n)gat bhagavaan bhajan bin kahee na sach rahio ||1|| rahaau ||
336.e: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, without vibrating and meditating on the Lord God, one does not abide in Truth. ||1||Pause||

336.g: ਜਿਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਪਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਨ ਘ੍ਰਾਉ ਲਇਓ ॥
336.t: jiau udhiaan kusam parafulit kineh na ghraau lio ||
336.e: Like the flower which blossoms in the wilderness with no one to enjoy its fragrance,

336.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲ ਹਇਓ ॥੨॥
336.t: taise bhramat anek jon meh fir fir kaal hio ||2||
336.e: so do people wander in reincarnation; over and over again, they are destroyed by Death. ||2||

336.g: ਇਆ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਜੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
336.t: eiaa dhan joban ar sut dhaaraa pekhan kau ju dhio ||
336.e: This wealth, youth, children and spouse which the Lord has given you - this is all just a passing show.

336.g: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਟਕਿ ਜੋ ਉਰਝੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿ ਲਇਓ ॥੩॥
336.t: tin hee maeh aTak jo urajhe i(n)dhree prer lio ||3||
336.e: Those who are caught and entangled in these are carried away by sensual desire. ||3||

336.g: ਅਉਧ ਅਨਲ ਤਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਠਾਟੁ ਠਇਓ ॥
336.t: aaudh anal tan tin ko ma(n)dhar chahu dhis ThaaT Thio ||
336.e: Age is the fire, and the body is the house of straw; on all four sides, this play is being played out.

336.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰਨ ਕਉ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਲਇਓ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥੫੯॥
336.t: keh kabeer bhai saagar taran kau mai satigur oT lio ||4||1||8||59||
336.e: Says Kabeer, to cross over the terriffying world-ocean, I have taken to the Shelter of the True Guru. ||4||1||8||59||

336.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
336.t: gauRee ||
336.e: Gauree:

336.g: ਪਾਨੀ ਮੈਲਾ ਮਾਟੀ ਗੋਰੀ ॥
336.t: paanee mailaa maaTee goree ||
336.e: The water of the sperm is cloudy, and the egg of the ovary is crimson.

336.g: ਇਸ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
336.t: eis maaTee kee putaree joree ||1||
336.e: From this clay, the puppet is fashioned. ||1||

336.g: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
336.t: mai naahee kachh aaeh na moraa ||
336.e: I am nothing, and nothing is mine.

336.g: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਸੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
336.t: tan dhan sabh ras gobi(n)dh toraa ||1|| rahaau ||
336.e: This body, wealth, and all delicacies are Yours, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

336.g: ਇਸ ਮਾਟੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
336.t: eis maaTee meh pavan samaiaa ||
336.e: Into this clay, the breath is infused.

337.e: By Your Power, You have set this false contrivance in motion. ||2||
Some collect hundreds of thousands of dollars,
but in the end, the pitcher of the body bursts. ||3||
Says Kabeer, that single foundation which you have laid
will be destroyed in an instant - you are so egotistical. ||4||1||9||60||
Gauree:

337.g: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਉ ਜੀਅ ਐਸੇ ਐਸੇ ॥ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸੇ ॥੧॥
337.t: raam japau jeea aaise aaise || dhraoo prahilaadh japio har jaise ||1||
337.e: Just as Dhroo and Prahlaad meditated on the Lord, so should you meditate on the Lord, O my soul. ||1||
O Lord, Merciful to the meek, I have placed my faith in You;
along with all my family, I have come aboard Your boat. ||1||Pause||

337.g: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ॥
337.t: jaa tis bhaavai taa hukam manaavai ||
337.e: When it is pleasing to Him, then He inspires us to obey the Hukam of His Command.
He causes this boat to cross over. ||2||
By Guru's Grace, such understanding is infused into me;
my comings and goings in reincarnation have ended. ||3||
Says Kabeer, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth.
In this world, in the world beyond and everywhere, He alone is the Giver. ||4||2||10||61||
Gauree 9:

337.g: ਜੋਨਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਜਉ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
337.t: jon chhaadd jau jag meh aaio ||
337.e: He leaves the womb, and comes into the world;
as soon as the air touches him, he forgets his Lord and Master. ||1||

337.g: ਜੀਅਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨਾ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
337.t: jeearaa har ke gunaa gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
337.e: O my soul, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

337.g: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
337.t: garabh jon meh uradh tap karataa ||
337.e: You were upside-down, living in the womb; you generated the intense meditative heat of 'tapas'.
Then, you escaped the fire of the belly. ||2||
After wandering through 8.4 million incarnations, you came.

337.g: ਅਬ ਕੇ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
337.t: ab ke chhuTake Thaur na Thaio ||3||
337.e: If you stumble and fall now, you shall find no home or place of rest. ||3||
Says Kabeer, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth.
He is not seen to be coming or going; He is the Knower of all. ||4||1||11||62||
Gauree Poorbee:

337.g: ਸੁਰਗ ਬਾਸੁ ਨ ਬਾਛੀਐ ਡਰੀਐ ਨ ਨਰਕਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
337.t: surag baas na baachheeaai ddareeaai na narak nivaas ||
337.e: Don't wish for a home in heaven, and don't be afraid to live in hell.

337.g: ਹੋਨਾ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
337.t: honaa hai so hoiee hai maneh na keejai aas ||1||
337.e: Whatever will be will be, so don't get your hopes up in your mind. ||1||
Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

337.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
337.t: jaa te paieeaai param nidhaan ||1|| rahaau ||
337.e: from whom the most excellent treasure is obtained. ||1||Pause||

337.g: ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਕਿਆ ਬਰਤੁ ਕਿਆ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
337.t: kiaa jap kiaa tap sa(n)jamo kiaa barat kiaa isanaan ||
337.e: What good is chanting, penance or self-mortification? What good is fasting or cleansing baths,

337.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥
337.t: jab lag jugat na jaaneeaai bhaau bhagat bhagavaan ||2||
337.e: unless you know the way to worship the Lord God with loving devotion? ||2||

337.g: ਸੰਪੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਹਰਖੀਐ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਰੋਇ ॥
337.t: sa(n)pai dhekh na harakheeaai bipat dhekh na roi ||
337.e: Don't feel so delighted at the sight of wealth, and don't weep at the sight of suffering and adversity.

337.g: ਜਿਉ ਸੰਪੈ ਤਿਉ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਬਿਧ ਨੇ ਰਚਿਆ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
337.t: jiau sa(n)pai tiau bipat hai bidh ne rachiaa so hoi ||3||
337.e: As is wealth, so is adversity; whatever the Lord proposes, comes to pass. ||3||

337.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
337.t: keh kabeer ab jaaniaa sa(n)tan ridhai majhaar ||
337.e: Says Kabeer, now I know that the Lord dwells within the hearts of His Saints;

337.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਹ ਘਟ ਬਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥੬੩॥
337.t: sevak so sevaa bhale jeh ghaT basai muraar ||4||1||12||63||
337.e: that servant performs the best service, whose heart is filled with the Lord. ||4||1||12||63||
Gauree:

337.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੋਇ ਨਹੀ ਖਿੰਚਿ ਲੇਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
337.t: re man tero koi nahee khi(n)ch lei jin bhaar ||
337.e: O my mind, even if you carry someone's burden, they don't belong to you.

337.g: ਬਿਰਖ ਬਸੇਰੋ ਪੰਖਿ ਕੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
337.t: birakh basero pa(n)kh ko taiso ih sa(n)saar ||1||
337.e: This world is like the perch of the bird on the tree. ||1||
I drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

337.g: ਜਿਹ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਰਸ ਅਉਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
337.t: jeh ras bisar ge ras aaur ||1|| rahaau ||
337.e: With the taste of this essence, I have forgotten all other tastes. ||1||Pause||

337.g: ਅਉਰ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਆ ਰੋਈਐ ਜਉ ਆਪਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਇ ॥
337.t: aaur mue kiaa roieeaai jau aapaa thir na rahai ||
337.e: Why should we weep at the death of others, when we ourselves are not permanent?

337.g: ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
337.t: jo upajai so binas hai dhukh kar rovai balai ||2||
337.e: Whoever is born shall pass away; why should we cry out in grief? ||2||

337.g: ਜਹ ਕੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹ ਰਚੀ ਪੀਵਤ ਮਰਦਨ ਲਾਗ ॥
337.t: jeh kee upajee teh rachee peevat maradhan laag ||
337.e: We are re-absorbed into the One from whom we came; drink in the Lord's essence, and remain attached to Him.

337.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਚਿਤਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੩॥੬੪॥
337.t: keh kabeer chit chetiaa raam simar bairaag ||3||2||13||64||
337.e: Says Kabeer, my consciousness is filled with thoughts of remembrance of the Lord; I have become detached from the world. ||3||2||13||64||
Raag Gauree:

337.g: ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਲੋਚਨ ਭਰੀ ਲੇ ਉਸਾਸਾ ॥
337.t: pa(n)th nihaarai kaamanee lochan bharee le usaasaa ||
337.e: The bride gazes at the path, and sighs with tearful eyes.

338.g: ਉਰ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਪਗੁ ਨਾ ਖਿਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥੧॥
338.t: aur na bheejai pag naa khisai har dharasan kee aasaa ||1||
338.e: Her heart is not happy, but she does not retrace her steps, in hopes of seeing the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

338.g: ਉਡਹੁ ਨ ਕਾਗਾ ਕਾਰੇ ॥
338.t: auddahu na kaagaa kaare ||
338.e: So fly away, black crow,

338.g: ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
338.t: beg mileejai apune raam piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
338.e: so that I may quickly meet my Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

338.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
338.t: keh kabeer jeevan padh kaaran har kee bhagat kareejai ||
338.e: Says Kabeer, to obtain the status of eternal life, worship the Lord with devotion.

338.g: ਏਕੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥੬੫॥
338.t: ek aadhaar naam naarain rasanaa raam raveejai ||2||1||14||65||
338.e: The Name of the Lord is my only Support; with my tongue, I chant the Lord's Name. ||2||1||14||65||

338.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ੧੧ ॥
338.t: raag gauRee 11 ||
338.e: Raag Gauree 11:

338.g: ਆਸ ਪਾਸ ਘਨ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਮਾਝ ਬਨਾ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਊਂ ਰੇ ॥
338.t: aas paas ghan turasee kaa biravaa maajh banaa ras gaauoo(n) re ||
338.e: All around, there are thick bushes of sweet basil, and there in the midst of the forest, the Lord is singing with joy.

338.g: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਆਰਨਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
338.t: auaa kaa saroop dhekh mohee guaaran mo kau chhodd na aau na jaahoo re ||1||
338.e: Beholding His wondrous beauty, the milk-maid was entranced, and said, ""Please don't leave me; please don't come and go!""||1||

338.g: ਤੋਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ॥
338.t: toh charan man laago saari(n)gadhar ||
338.e: My mind is attached to Your Feet, O Archer of the Universe;

338.g: ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੋ ਬਡਭਾਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
338.t: so milai jo baddabhaago ||1|| rahaau ||
338.e: he alone meets You, who is blessed by great good fortune. ||1||Pause||

338.g: ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ ਮਨ ਹਰਨ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਊ ਰੇ ॥
338.t: bi(n)dhraaban man haran manohar kirasan charaavat gaauoo re ||
338.e: In Brindaaban, where Krishna grazes his cows, he entices and fascinates my mind.

338.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਨਾਊ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥੬੬॥
338.t: jaa kaa Thaakur tuhee saari(n)gadhar moh kabeeraa naauoo re ||2||2||15||66||
338.e: You are my Lord Master, the Archer of the Universe; my name is Kabeer. ||2||2||15||66||

338.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ੧੨ ॥
338.t: gauRee poorabee 12 ||
338.e: Gauree Poorbee 12:

338.g: ਬਿਪਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਬਨ ਮਧੇ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
338.t: bipal basatr kete hai pahire kiaa ban madhe baasaa ||
338.e: Many people wear various robes, but what is the use of living in the forest?

338.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਆ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ਧੋਖੇ ਕਿਆ ਜਲਿ ਬੋਰਿਓ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧॥
338.t: kahaa bhiaa nar dhevaa dhokhe kiaa jal borio giaataa ||1||
338.e: What good does it do if a man burns incense before his gods? What good does it do to dip one's body in water? ||1||

338.g: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਜਾਹਿਗਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
338.t: jeeare jaahigaa mai jaanaa(n) ||
338.e: O soul, I know that I will have to depart.

338.g: ਅਬਿਗਤ ਸਮਝੁ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
338.t: abigat samajh iaanaa ||
338.e: You ignorant idiot: understand the Imperishable Lord.

338.g: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
338.t: jat jat dhekhau bahur na pekhau sa(n)g maiaa lapaTaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
338.e: Whatever you see, you will not see that again, but still, you cling to Maya. ||1||Pause||

338.g: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਗਲੋ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
338.t: giaanee dhiaanee bahu upadhesee ih jag sagalo dha(n)dhaa ||
338.e: The spiritual teachers, meditators and the great preachers are all engrossed in these worldly affairs.

338.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੬॥੬੭॥
338.t: keh kabeer ik raam naam bin iaa jag maiaa a(n)dhaa ||2||1||16||67||
338.e: Says Kabeer, without the Name of the One Lord, this world is blinded by Maya. ||2||1||16||67||

338.g: ਗਉੜੀ ੧੨ ॥
338.t: gauRee 12 ||
338.e: Gauree 12:

338.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਛਾਡਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਡਾਂਡੇ ॥
338.t: man re chhaaddahu bharam pragaT hoi naachahu iaa maiaa ke ddaa(n)dde ||
338.e: O people, O victims of this Maya, abandon your doubts and dance out in the open.

338.g: ਸੂਰੁ ਕਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪੈ ਸਤੀ ਕਿ ਸਾਂਚੈ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥੧॥
338.t: soor k sanamukh ran te ddarapai satee k saa(n)chai bhaa(n)dde ||1||
338.e: What sort of a hero is one who is afraid to face the battle? What sort of satee is she who, when her time comes, starts collecting her pots and pans? ||1||

338.g: ਡਗਮਗ ਛਾਡਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
338.t: ddagamag chhaadd re man bauraa ||
338.e: Stop your wavering, O crazy people!

338.g: ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਰੇ ਮਰੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਲੀਨੋ ਹਾਥਿ ਸੰਧਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
338.t: ab tau jare mare sidh paieeaai leeno haath sa(n)dhauraa ||1|| rahaau ||
338.e: Now that you have taken up the challenge of death, let yourself burn and die, and attain perfection. ||1||Pause||

338.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
338.t: kaam karodh maiaa ke leene iaa bidh jagat bigootaa ||
338.e: The world is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and Maya; in this way it is plundered and ruined.

338.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਸਗਲ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੭॥੬੮॥
338.t: keh kabeer raajaa raam na chhoddau sagal uooch te uoochaa ||2||2||17||68||
338.e: Says Kabeer, do not forsake the Lord, your Sovereign King, the Highest of the High. ||2||2||17||68||

338.g: ਗਉੜੀ ੧੩ ॥
338.t: gauRee 13 ||
338.e: Gauree 13:

338.g: ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਿਰੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
338.t: furamaan teraa sirai uoopar fir na karat beechaar ||
338.e: Your Command is upon my head, and I no longer question it.

338.g: ਤੁਹੀ ਦਰੀਆ ਤੁਹੀ ਕਰੀਆ ਤੁਝੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
338.t: tuhee dhareeaa tuhee kareeaa tujhai te nisataar ||1||
338.e: You are the river, and You are the boatman; salvation comes from You. ||1||

338.g: ਬੰਦੇ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਇਕਤੀਆਰ ॥
338.t: ba(n)dhe ba(n)dhagee ikateeaar ||
338.e: O human being, embrace the Lord's meditation,

338.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰੋਸੁ ਧਰਉ ਕਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
338.t: saahib ros dharau k piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
338.e: whether your Lord and Master is angry with you or in love with you. ||1||Pause||

338.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਫੂਲੁ ਜਈ ਹੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
338.t: naam teraa aadhaar meraa jiau fool jiee hai naar ||
338.e: Your Name is my Support, like the flower blossoming in the water.

338.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਲਾਮੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜੀਆਇ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੬੯॥
338.t: keh kabeer gulaam ghar kaa jeeaai bhaavai maar ||2||18||69||
338.e: Says Kabeer, I am the slave of Your home; I live or die as You will. ||2||18||69||

338.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
338.t: gauRee ||
338.e: Gauree:

338.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨੰਦੁ ਬਹੁ ਥਾਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
338.t: lakh chauraaseeh jeea jon meh bhramat na(n)dh bahu thaako re ||
338.e: Wandering through 8.4 million incarnations, Krishna's father Nand was totally exhausted.

338.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਲੀਓ ਹੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਬਡੋ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
338.t: bhagat het avataar leeo hai bhaag baddo bapuraa ko re ||1||
338.e: Because of his devotion, Krishna was incarnated in his home; how great was the good fortune of this poor man! ||1||

338.g: ਤੁਮੑ ਜੁ ਕਹਤ ਹਉ ਨੰਦ ਕੋ ਨੰਦਨੁ ਨੰਦ ਸੁ ਨੰਦਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
338.t: tum(h) ju kahat hau na(n)dh ko na(n)dhan na(n)dh su na(n)dhan kaa ko re ||
338.e: You say that Krishna was Nand's son, but whose son was Nand himself?

338.g: ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਨੰਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਥੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
338.t: dharan akaas dhaso dhis naahee tab ih na(n)dh kahaa tho re ||1|| rahaau ||
338.e: When there was no earth or ether or the ten directions, where was this Nand then? ||1||Pause||

339.g: ਸੰਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਰੈ ਜੋਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
339.t: sa(n)kaT nahee parai jon nahee aavai naam nira(n)jan jaa ko re ||
339.e: He does not fall into misfortune, and He does not take birth; His Name is the Immaculate Lord.

339.g: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਐਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਈ ਨ ਬਾਪੋ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੭੦॥
339.t: kabeer ko suaamee aaiso Thaakur jaa kai maiee na baapo re ||2||19||70||
339.e: Kabeer's Lord is such a Lord and Master, who has no mother or father. ||2||19||70||

339.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
339.t: gauRee ||
339.e: Gauree:

339.g: ਨਿੰਦਉ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਲੋਗੁ ਨਿੰਦਉ ॥
339.t: ni(n)dhau ni(n)dhau mo kau log ni(n)dhau ||
339.e: Slander me, slander me - go ahead, people, and slander me.

339.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਖਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
339.t: ni(n)dhaa jan kau kharee piaaree ||
339.e: Slander is pleasing to the Lord's humble servant.

339.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਾਪੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
339.t: ni(n)dhaa baap ni(n)dhaa mahataaree ||1|| rahaau ||
339.e: Slander is my father, slander is my mother. ||1||Pause||

339.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
339.t: ni(n)dhaa hoi ta baiku(n)Th jaieeaai ||
339.e: If I am slandered, I go to heaven;

339.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸਾਈਐ ॥
339.t: naam padhaarath maneh basaieeaai ||
339.e: the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within my mind.

339.g: ਰਿਦੈ ਸੁਧ ਜਉ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
339.t: ridhai sudh jau ni(n)dhaa hoi ||
339.e: If my heart is pure, and I am slandered,

339.g: ਹਮਰੇ ਕਪਰੇ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥
339.t: hamare kapare ni(n)dhak dhoi ||1||
339.e: then the slanderer washes my clothes. ||1||

339.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
339.t: ni(n)dhaa karai su hamaraa meet ||
339.e: One who slanders me is my friend;

339.g: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
339.t: ni(n)dhak maeh hamaaraa cheet ||
339.e: the slanderer is in my thoughts.

339.g: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਸੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੋਰੈ ॥
339.t: ni(n)dhak so jo ni(n)dhaa horai ||
339.e: The slanderer is the one who prevents me from being slandered.

339.g: ਹਮਰਾ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਲੋਰੈ ॥੨॥
339.t: hamaraa jeevan ni(n)dhak lorai ||2||
339.e: The slanderer wishes me long life. ||2||

339.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਮਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
339.t: ni(n)dhaa hamaree prem piaar ||
339.e: I have love and affection for the slanderer.

339.g: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਮਰਾ ਕਰੈ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
339.t: ni(n)dhaa hamaraa karai udhaar ||
339.e: Slander is my salvation.

339.g: ਜਨ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਉ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
339.t: jan kabeer kau ni(n)dhaa saar ||
339.e: Slander is the best thing for servant Kabeer.

339.g: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਡੂਬਾ ਹਮ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥੨੦॥੭੧॥
339.t: ni(n)dhak ddoobaa ham utare paar ||3||20||71||
339.e: The slanderer is drowned, while I am carried across. ||3||20||71||

339.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਤੂੰ ਐਸਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
339.t: raajaa raam too(n) aaisaa nirabhau taran taaran raam raiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
339.e: O my Sovereign Lord King, You are Fearless; You are the Carrier to carry us across, O my Lord King. ||1||Pause||

339.g: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਬ ਤੁਮ ਹਹੁ ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
339.t: jab ham hote tab tum naahee ab tum hahu ham naahee ||
339.e: When I was, then You were not; now that You are, I am not.

339.g: ਅਬ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹਹਿ ਏਕੈ ਦੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਹੀ ॥੧॥
339.t: ab ham tum ek bhe heh ekai dhekhat man pateeaahee ||1||
339.e: Now, You and I have become one; seeing this, my mind is content. ||1||

339.g: ਜਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਬ ਬਲੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਅਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲੁ ਨ ਖਟਾਈ ॥
339.t: jab budh hotee tab bal kaisaa ab budh bal na khaTaiee ||
339.e: When there was wisdom, how could there be strength? Now that there is wisdom, strength cannot prevail.

339.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਈ ਮੇਰੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਦਲੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
339.t: keh kabeer budh har liee meree budh badhalee sidh paiee ||2||21||72||
339.e: Says Kabeer, the Lord has taken away my wisdom, and I have attained spiritual perfection. ||2||21||72||

339.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
339.t: gauRee ||
339.e: Gauree:

339.g: ਖਟ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਬੀਚ ਪਾਈ ॥
339.t: khaT nem kar koThaRee baa(n)dhee basat anoop beech paiee ||
339.e: He fashioned the body chamber with six rings, and placed within it the incomparable thing.

339.g: ਕੁੰਜੀ ਕੁਲਫੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
339.t: ku(n)jee kulaf praan kar raakhe karate baar na laiee ||1||
339.e: He made the breath of life the watchman, with lock and key to protect it; the Creator did this in no time at all. ||1||

339.g: ਅਬ ਮਨ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
339.t: ab man jaagat rahu re bhaiee ||
339.e: Keep your mind awake and aware now, O Sibling of Destiny.

339.g: ਗਾਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
339.t: gaafal hoi kai janam gavaio chor musai ghar jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
339.e: You were careless, and you have wasted your life; your home is being plundered by thieves. ||1||Pause||

339.g: ਪੰਚ ਪਹਰੂਆ ਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
339.t: pa(n)ch paharooaa dhar meh rahate tin kaa nahee pateeaaraa ||
339.e: The five senses stand as guards at the gate, but now can they be trusted?

339.g: ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਚਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਲੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਉਜਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
339.t: chet suchet chit hoi rahu tau lai paragaas ujaaraa ||2||
339.e: When you are conscious in your consciousness, you shall be enlightened and illuminated. ||2||

339.g: ਨਉ ਘਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੁ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
339.t: nau ghar dhekh ju kaaman bhoolee basat anoop na paiee ||
339.e: Seeing the nine openings of the body, the soul-bride is led astray; she does not obtain that incomparable thing.

339.g: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਨਵੈ ਘਰ ਮੂਸੇ ਦਸਵੈਂ ਤਤੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥੨੨॥੭੩॥
339.t: kahat kabeer navai ghar moose dhasavai(n) tat samaiee ||3||22||73||
339.e: Says Kabeer, the nine openings of the body are being plundered; rise up to the Tenth Gate, and discover the true essence. ||3||22||73||

339.g: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
339.t: gauRee ||
339.e: Gauree:

339.g: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
339.t: maiee moh avar na jaanio aanaanaa(n) ||
339.e: O mother, I do not know any other, except Him.

339.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਜਾਸੁ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਾਸੁ ਬਸਹਿ ਮੋਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
339.t: siv sanakaadh jaas gun gaaveh taas baseh more praanaanaa(n) || rahaau ||
339.e: My breath of life resides in Him, whose praises are sung by Shiva and Sanak and so many others. ||Pause||

339.g: ਹਿਰਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੰਮਿਤ ਗਗਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
339.t: hiradhe pragaas giaan gur ga(n)mit gagan ma(n)ddal meh dhiaanaanaa(n) ||
339.e: My heart is illuminated by spiritual wisdom; meeting the Guru, I meditate in the Sky of the Tenth Gate.

339.g: ਬਿਖੈ ਰੋਗ ਭੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਾਗੇ ਮਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
339.t: bikhai rog bhai ba(n)dhan bhaage man nij ghar sukh jaanaanaa ||1||
339.e: The diseases of corruption, fear and bondage have run away; my mind has come to know peace in its own true home. ||1||

339.g: ਏਕ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਰਤਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੂਸਰ ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਆਨਾਨਾ ॥
339.t: ek sumat rat jaan maan prabh dhoosar maneh na aanaanaa ||
339.e: Imbued with a balanced single-mindedness, I know and obey God; nothing else enters my mind.

339.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਬਾਸੁ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਘਟਿਓ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
339.t: cha(n)dhan baas bhe man baasan tiaag ghaTio abhimaanaanaa ||2||
339.e: My mind has become fragrant with the scent of sandalwood; I have renounced egotistical selfishness and conceit. ||2||

339.g: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਗਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੈ ਥਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
339.t: jo jan gai dhiaai jas Thaakur taas prabhoo hai thaanaanaa(n) ||
339.e: That humble being, who sings and meditates on the Praises of his Lord and Master, is the dwelling-place of God.

339.g: ਤਿਹ ਬਡ ਭਾਗ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਮਥਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
339.t: teh badd bhaag basio man jaa kai karam pradhaan mathaanaanaa ||3||
339.e: He is blessed with great good fortune; the Lord abides in his mind. Good karma radiates from his forehead. ||3||

339.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਸਹਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥
339.t: kaaT sakat siv sahaj pragaasio ekai ek samaanaanaa ||
339.e: I have broken the bonds of Maya; the intuitive peace and poise of Shiva has dawned within me, and I am merged in oneness with the One.

340.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੭੪॥
340.t: keh kabeer gur bheT mahaa sukh bhramat rahe man maanaanaa(n) ||4||23||74||
340.e: Says Kabeer, meeting the Guru, I have found absolute peace. My mind has ceased its wanderings; I am happy. ||4||23||74||

340.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
340.t: raag gauRee poorabee baavan akharee kabeer jeeau kee
340.e: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Baawan Akhree Of Kabeer Jee:
One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

340.g: ਬਾਵਨ ਅਛਰ ਲੋਕ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
340.t: baavan achhar lok trai sabh kachh in hee maeh ||
340.e: Through these fifty-two letters, the three worlds and all things are described.

340.g: ਏ ਅਖਰ ਖਿਰਿ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਓਇ ਅਖਰ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
340.t: e akhar khir jaahige oi akhar in meh naeh ||1||
340.e: These letters shall perish; they cannot describe the Imperishable Lord. ||1||
Wherever description is possible, only there the letters get used.

340.g: ਜਹ ਅਬੋਲ ਤਹ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
340.t: jeh abol teh man na rahaavaa ||
340.e: Where the state is beyond description, there, the mind itself ceases to be a descriptor.
He is in both speech and silence.

340.g: ਜਸ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਸ ਲਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
340.t: jas oh hai tas lakhai na koiee ||2||
340.e: No one can know or describe Him as He is. ||2||

340.g: ਅਲਹ ਲਹਉ ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਕਹਉ ਤ ਕੋ ਉਪਕਾਰ ॥
340.t: aleh lahau tau kiaa kahau kahau ta ko upakaar ||
340.e: If I come to know the Lord, what can I say; what good does it do to speak?

340.g: ਬਟਕ ਬੀਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥੩॥
340.t: baTak beej meh rav rahio jaa ko teen lok bisathaar ||3||
340.e: His expanse spreads across the three worlds and He is contained within it just like the banyan tree is contained within its seed (and the seed is contained within the banyan tree). ||3||

340.g: ਅਲਹ ਲਹੰਤਾ ਭੇਦ ਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਭੇਦ ॥
340.t: aleh laha(n)taa bhedh chhai kachh kachh paio bhedh ||
340.e: One who tries to know the Unknowable Lord, his dilemma gets resolved, and bit by bit, the mystery disappears.

340.g: ਉਲਟਿ ਭੇਦ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਭੰਗ ਅਛੇਦ ॥੪॥
340.t: aulaT bhedh man bedhio paio abha(n)g achhedh ||4||
340.e: Turning away from the world, one's mind is pierced through with this mystery, and one obtains the Indestructible, Impenetrable Lord. ||4||

340.g: ਤੁਰਕ ਤਰੀਕਤਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
340.t: turak tareekat jaaneeaai hi(n)dhoo bedh puraan ||
340.e: The devout Muslim seeks guidance from the Tariqat ( Sufi scripture) ; the devout Hindu from the Vedas and Puraanas.

340.g: ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਨ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਕਛੂਅਕ ਪੜੀਐ ਗਿਆਨ ॥੫॥
340.t: man samajhaavan kaarane kachhooak paReeaai giaan ||5||
340.e: To instruct their minds, people ought to study some sort of spiritual wisdom. ||5||
I know only the One, the Universal Creator, the Primal Being.

340.g: ਲਿਖਿ ਅਰੁ ਮੇਟੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
340.t: likh ar meTai taeh na maanaa ||
340.e: I do not believe in anyone whom the Lord writes (into being) and erases.
If someone knows the One, the Universal Creator,
Knowing Him, (his elevated state) shall not perish. ||6||
KAKKA: When the rays of Divine Light come into the heart-lotus,
the moon-light of Maya cannot close the blossomed heart lotus again.

340.g: ਅਰੁ ਜੇ ਤਹਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
340.t: ar je tahaa kusam ras paavaa ||
340.e: And if one obtains the subtle fragrance of that spiritual flower,
I cannot describe the indescribable; I could speak, but what can I explain/describe? ||7||
KHAKHA: When this mind (-bird that has received a ray of the divine light) has entered the tree hollow ( refuge of the Lord)

340.g: ਖੋੜੇ ਛਾਡਿ ਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
340.t: khoRe chhaadd na dheh dhis dhaavaa ||
340.e: It does not leave this tree hollow to wander in the ten directions.
Then it (the mind bird) comes to know the source of compassion, the Lord and stays.

340.g: ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਖਿਅਉ ਅਖੈ ਪਦੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੮॥
340.t: tau hoi nikhiaau akhai padh lahai ||8||
340.e: then, it becomes (one with) the immortal Lord, and attains the state of eternal dignity. ||8||
GAGGA: One who understands the Guru's Word
does not listen to anything else.
He remains unattached like a bird and does not go anywhere,
when he grasps the Ungraspable Lord and dwells in the sky of the Tenth Gate. ||9||
GHAGHA: He dwells in each and every body.

340.g: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
340.t: ghaT fooTe ghaT kabeh na hoiee ||
340.e: Even when a body-pitcher bursts, the existence of the Lord does not diminish.

340.g: ਤਾ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ਘਾਟ ਜਉ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
340.t: taa ghaT maeh ghaaT jau paavaa ||
340.e: When someone finds the landing/port ( to cross the world-sea) within his own heart,

340.g: ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਵਘਟ ਕਤ ਧਾਵਾ ॥੧੦॥
340.t: so ghaT chhaadd avaghaT kat dhaavaa ||10||
340.e: why should he abandon that landing/port to wander around? ||10||

340.g: ਙੰਙਾ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਵਾਰੋ ਸੰਦੇਹ ॥
340.t: n(g)(n)n(g)aa nigreh saneh kar niravaaro sa(n)dheh ||
340.e: NGANGA: Restrain yourself, love the Lord, and dismiss your doubts.

340.g: ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭਾਜੀਐ ਪਰਮ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਏਹ ॥੧੧॥
340.t: naahee dhekh na bhaajeeaai param siaanap eh ||11||
340.e: (This task is hard, but) do not run away because the task seems hard and not attainable; this is the highest wisdom. ||11||
CHACHA: He created this world as if its a great painting.
Let go of this painting, and remember the Painter.
The hassle is that this painting is so wondrous.
( To save yourself from this attachment) leave (contemplation of) the painting and focus your consciousness on the Painter. ||12||
CHHACHHA: The Sovereign Lord of the Universe is here with you.

340.g: ਛਕਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਰਹਹੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
340.t: chhak k na rahahu chhaadd k na aasaa ||
340.e: Why are you so unhappy? Why don't you abandon your desires?

340.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਤਉ ਛਿਨ ਛਿਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥
340.t: re man mai tau chhin chhin samajhaavaa ||
340.e: O my mind, each and every moment I try to instruct you,
but you forsake Him, and entangle yourself with others. ||13||
JAJJA: If someone burns his body while he is still alive,
and burns away the desires of his youth, then he finds the right way.

340.g: ਅਸ ਜਰਿ ਪਰ ਜਰਿ ਜਰਿ ਜਬ ਰਹੈ ॥
340.t: as jar par jar jar jab rahai ||
340.e: When he burns his desire for his own wealth, and that of others,
then he finds the Divine Light. ||14||

341.e: JHAJHA: You are entangled in the world, and you do not know how to get untangled.
You hold back in fear, and are not approved by the Lord.
Why do you talk such nonsense, trying to convince others?
Stirring up arguments, you shall only obtain more arguments. ||15||

341.g: ਞੰਞਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੁ ਘਟ ਰਹਿਓ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
341.t: n(j)(n)n(j)aa nikaT ju ghaT rahio dhoor kahaa taj jai ||
341.e: NYANYA: He dwells near you, deep within your heart; why do you leave Him and go far away?

341.g: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਗੁ ਢੂਢਿਅਉ ਨੇਰਉ ਪਾਇਅਉ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧੬॥
341.t: jaa kaaran jag ddooddiaau nerau paiaau taeh ||16||
341.e: I searched the whole world for Him, but I found Him near myself. ||16||
TATTA: It is such a difficult path, to find Him within your own heart.

341.g: ਖੋਲਿ ਕਪਾਟ ਮਹਲਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
341.t: khol kapaaT mahal k na jaahee ||
341.e: Open the doors within, and enter the Mansion of His Presence.

341.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਅਟਲ ਟਲਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
341.t: dhekh aTal Tal kateh na jaavaa ||
341.e: Beholding the Immovable Lord, you shall not slip and go anywhere else.
You shall remain firmly attached to the Lord, and your heart will be happy. ||17||
T'HAT'HA: Keep yourself far away from this mirage.
With great difficulty, I have calmed my mind.

341.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਠਗਿ ਠਗਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਵਾ ॥
341.t: jin Thag Thagiaa sagal jag khaavaa ||
341.e: That cheater, who cheated and devoured the whole world

341.g: ਸੋ ਠਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਠਉਰ ਮਨੁ ਆਵਾ ॥੧੮॥
341.t: so Thag Thagiaa Thaur man aavaa ||18||
341.e: - I have cheated that cheater, and my mind is now at peace. ||18||
DADDA: When the Fear of God wells up, other fears depart.

341.g: ਤਾ ਡਰ ਮਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
341.t: taa ddar meh ddar rahiaa samaiee ||
341.e: Other fears are absorbed into that Fear.

341.g: ਜਉ ਡਰ ਡਰੈ ਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
341.t: jau ddar ddarai ta fir ddar laagai ||
341.e: When one rejects the Fear of God, then other fears cling to him.

341.g: ਨਿਡਰ ਹੂਆ ਡਰੁ ਉਰ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧੯॥
341.t: niddar hooaa ddar ur hoi bhaagai ||19||
341.e: But if he becomes fearless, the fears of his heart run away. ||19||
DHADHA: Why do you search in other directions?
Searching for Him like this, the breath of life runs out.
When I returned after climbing the mountain,

341.g: ਜਿਹ ਗੜੁ ਗੜਿਓ ਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੦॥
341.t: jeh gaR gaRio su gaR meh paavaa ||20||
341.e: I found Him in the fortress - the fortress which He Himself made. ||20||

341.g: ਣਾਣਾ ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ ਨਰ ਨੇਹੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
341.t: naanaa ran rootau nar nehee karai ||
341.e: NANNA: The warrior who fights on the battle-field should keep up and press on.
He should not yield, and he should not retreat.
Blessed is the coming of one
who conquers the one and renounces the many. ||21||
TATTA: The impassable world-ocean cannot be crossed over;
the body remains embroiled in the three worlds.
But when the Lord of the three worlds enters into the body,

341.g: ਤਉ ਤਤਹਿ ਤਤ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੨॥
341.t: tau tateh tat miliaa sach paavaa ||22||
341.e: then one's essence merges with the essence of reality, and the True Lord is attained. ||22||
T'HAT'HA: He is Unfathomable; His depths cannot be fathomed.

341.g: ਓਹੁ ਅਥਾਹ ਇਹੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
341.t: oh athaeh ih thir na rahaavaa ||
341.e: He is Unfathomable; this body is impermanent, and unstable.
The mortal builds his dwelling upon this tiny space;
without any pillars, he wishes to support a mansion. ||23||
DADDA: Whatever is seen shall perish.
Contemplate the One who is unseen.
When the key is inserted in the Tenth Gate,
then the Blessed Vision of the Merciful Lord's Darshan is seen. ||24||
DHADHA: When one ascends from the lower realms of the earth to the higher realms of the heavens, then everything is resolved.
The Lord dwells in both the lower and higher worlds.
Leaving the earth, the soul ascends to the heavens;

341.g: ਤਉ ਅਰਧਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੫॥
341.t: tau aradheh uradh miliaa sukh paavaa ||25||
341.e: then, the lower and higher join together, and peace is obtained. ||25||
NANNA: The days and nights go by; I am looking for the Lord.
Looking for Him, my eyes have become blood-shot.
After looking and looking,when He is finally found,
then the one who was looking merges into the One who was looked for. ||26||
PAPPA: He is limitless; His limits cannot be found.
I have attuned myself to the Supreme Light.
One who controls his five senses
rises above both sin and virtue. ||27||
FAFFA: Even without the flower, the fruit is produced.

341.g: ਤਾ ਫਲ ਫੰਕ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
341.t: taa fal fa(n)k lakhai jau koiee ||
341.e: One who looks at a slice of that fruit
and reflects on it, will not be consigned to reincarnation.

341.g: ਤਾ ਫਲ ਫੰਕ ਸਭੈ ਤਨ ਫਾਰੈ ॥੨੮॥
341.t: taa fal fa(n)k sabhai tan faarai ||28||
341.e: A slice of that fruit slices all bodies. ||28||
BABBA: When one drop blends with another drop,
then these drops cannot be separated again.
Become the Lord's slave, and hold tight to His meditation.

342.g: ਬੰਦਕ ਹੋਇ ਬੰਧ ਸੁਧਿ ਲਹੈ ॥੨੯॥
342.t: ba(n)dhak hoi ba(n)dh sudh lahai ||29||
342.e: If you turn your thoughts to the Lord, the Lord will take care of you like a relative. ||29||

342.g: ਭਭਾ ਭੇਦਹਿ ਭੇਦ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ॥
342.t: bhabhaa bhedheh bhedh milaavaa ||
342.e: BHABHA: When doubt is pierced, union is achieved.

342.g: ਅਬ ਭਉ ਭਾਨਿ ਭਰੋਸਉ ਆਵਾ ॥
342.t: ab bhau bhaan bharosau aavaa ||
342.e: I have shattered my fear, and now I have come to have faith.

342.g: ਜੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
342.t: jo baahar so bheetar jaaniaa ||
342.e: I thought that He was outside of me, but now I know that He is within me.

342.g: ਭਇਆ ਭੇਦੁ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥੩੦॥
342.t: bhiaa bhedh bhoopat pahichaaniaa ||30||
342.e: When I came to understand this mystery, then I recognized the Lord. ||30||

342.g: ਮਮਾ ਮੂਲ ਗਹਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
342.t: mamaa mool gahiaa man maanai ||
342.e: MAMMA: Clinging to the source, the mind is satisfied.

342.g: ਮਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
342.t: maramee hoi su man kau jaanai ||
342.e: One who knows this mystery understands his own mind.

342.g: ਮਤ ਕੋਈ ਮਨ ਮਿਲਤਾ ਬਿਲਮਾਵੈ ॥
342.t: mat koiee man milataa bilamaavai ||
342.e: Let no one delay in uniting his mind.

342.g: ਮਗਨ ਭਇਆ ਤੇ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੧॥
342.t: magan bhiaa te so sach paavai ||31||
342.e: Those who obtain the True Lord are immersed in delight. ||31||

342.g: ਮਮਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
342.t: mamaa man siau kaaj hai man saadhe sidh hoi ||
342.e: MAMMA: The mortal's business is with his own mind; one who disciplines his mind attains perfection.

342.g: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਮਨ ਸਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
342.t: man hee man siau kahai kabeeraa man saa miliaa na koi ||32||
342.e: Only the mind can deal with the mind; says Kabeer, I have not met anything like the mind. ||32||

342.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਕਤੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਉ ॥
342.t: eih man sakatee ih man seeau ||
342.e: This mind is Shakti; this mind is Shiva.

342.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
342.t: eih man pa(n)ch tat ko jeeau ||
342.e: This mind is the life of the five elements.

342.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲੇ ਜਉ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
342.t: eih man le jau unaman rahai ||
342.e: When this mind is channeled, and guided to enlightenment,

342.g: ਤਉ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਕੀ ਬਾਤੈ ਕਹੈ ॥੩੩॥
342.t: tau teen lok kee baatai kahai ||33||
342.e: it can describe the secrets of the three worlds. ||33||

342.g: ਯਯਾ ਜਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਸਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਗਾਉ ॥
342.t: yayaa jau jaaneh tau dhuramat han kar bas kaiaa gaau ||
342.e: YAYYA: If you know anything, then destroy your evil-mindedness, and subjugate the body-village.

342.g: ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ ਭਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਰਉ ਥਾਰਉ ਨਾਉ ॥੩੪॥
342.t: ran rootau bhaajai nahee soorau thaarau naau ||34||
342.e: When you are engaged in the battle, don't run away; then, you shall be known as a spiritual hero. ||34||

342.g: ਰਾਰਾ ਰਸੁ ਨਿਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
342.t: raaraa ras niras kar jaaniaa ||
342.e: RARRA: I have found tastes to be tasteless.

342.g: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਸ ਸੁ ਰਸੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਆ ॥
342.t: hoi niras su ras pahichaaniaa ||
342.e: Becoming tasteless, I have realized that taste.

342.g: ਇਹ ਰਸ ਛਾਡੇ ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਾ ॥
342.t: eeh ras chhaadde uh ras aavaa ||
342.e: Abandoning these tastes, I have found that taste.

342.g: ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਇਹ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੩੫॥
342.t: auh ras peeaa ieh ras nahee bhaavaa ||35||
342.e: Drinking in that taste, this taste is no longer pleasing. ||35||

342.g: ਲਲਾ ਐਸੇ ਲਿਵ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
342.t: lalaa aaise liv man laavai ||
342.e: LALLA: Embrace such love for the Lord in your mind,

342.g: ਅਨਤ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
342.t: anat na jai param sach paavai ||
342.e: that you shall not have to go to any other; you shall attain the supreme truth.

342.g: ਅਰੁ ਜਉ ਤਹਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
342.t: ar jau tahaa prem liv laavai ||
342.e: And if you embrace love and affection for Him there,

342.g: ਤਉ ਅਲਹ ਲਹੈ ਲਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩੬॥
342.t: tau aleh lahai leh charan samaavai ||36||
342.e: then you shall obtain the Lord; obtaining Him, you shall be absorbed in His Feet. ||36||

342.g: ਵਵਾ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਬਿਸਨ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰਿ ॥
342.t: vavaa baar baar bisan samhaar ||
342.e: WAWA: Time and time again, dwell upon the Lord.

342.g: ਬਿਸਨ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਾਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
342.t: bisan sa(n)mhaar na aavai haar ||
342.e: Dwelling upon the Lord, defeat shall not come to you.

342.g: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜੇ ਬਿਸਨਤਨਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
342.t: bal bal je bisanatanaa jas gaavai ||
342.e: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those, who sing the praises of the Saints, the sons of the Lord.

342.g: ਵਿਸਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੭॥
342.t: visan mile sabh hee sach paavai ||37||
342.e: Meeting the Lord, total Truth is obtained. ||37||

342.g: ਵਾਵਾ ਵਾਹੀ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਵਾ ਜਾਨੇ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
342.t: vaavaa vaahee jaaneeaai vaa jaane ih hoi ||
342.e: WAWA: Know Him. By knowing Him, this mortal becomes Him.

342.g: ਇਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਜਬ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਬ ਮਿਲਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੮॥
342.t: eih ar oh jab milai tab milat na jaanai koi ||38||
342.e: When this soul and that Lord are blended, then, having been blended, they cannot be known separately. ||38||

342.g: ਸਸਾ ਸੋ ਨੀਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੋਧਹੁ ॥
342.t: sasaa so neekaa kar sodhahu ||
342.e: SASSA: Discipline your mind with sublime perfection.

342.g: ਘਟ ਪਰਚਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਨਿਰੋਧਹੁ ॥
342.t: ghaT parachaa kee baat nirodhahu ||
342.e: Refrain from that talk which attracts the heart.

342.g: ਘਟ ਪਰਚੈ ਜਉ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
342.t: ghaT parachai jau upajai bhaau ||
342.e: The heart is attracted, when love wells up.

342.g: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਰਾਉ ॥੩੯॥
342.t: poor rahiaa teh tirabhavan raau ||39||
342.e: The King of the three worlds is perfectly pervading and permeating there. ||39||

342.g: ਖਖਾ ਖੋਜਿ ਪਰੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥ ਜੋ ਖੋਜੈ ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
342.t: khakhaa khoj parai jau koiee || jo khojai so bahur na hoiee ||
342.e: KHAKHA: Anyone who seeks Him, and by seeking Him, finds Him, shall not be born again.

342.g: ਖੋਜ ਬੂਝਿ ਜਉ ਕਰੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
342.t: khoj boojh jau karai beechaaraa ||
342.e: When someone seeks Him, and comes to understand and contemplate Him,

342.g: ਤਉ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪੦॥
342.t: tau bhavajal tarat na laavai baaraa ||40||
342.e: then he crosses over the terrifying world-ocean in an instant. ||40||

342.g: ਸਸਾ ਸੋ ਸਹ ਸੇਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
342.t: sasaa so seh sej savaarai ||
342.e: SASSA: The bed of the soul-bride is adorned by her Husband Lord;

342.g: ਸੋਈ ਸਹੀ ਸੰਦੇਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
342.t: soiee sahee sa(n)dheh nivaarai ||
342.e: her skepticism is dispelled.

342.g: ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਛਾਡਿ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
342.t: alap sukh chhaadd param sukh paavaa ||
342.e: Renouncing the shallow pleasures of the world, she obtains the supreme delight.

342.g: ਤਬ ਇਹ ਤ੍ਰੀਅ ਓੁਹੁ ਕੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵਾ ॥੪੧॥
342.t: tab ieh treea ouh ka(n)t kahaavaa ||41||
342.e: Then, she is the soul-bride; He is called her Husband Lord. ||41||

342.g: ਹਾਹਾ ਹੋਤ ਹੋਇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
342.t: haahaa hot hoi nahee jaanaa ||
342.e: HAHA: He exists, but He is not known to exist.

342.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਤਬਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
342.t: jab hee hoi tabeh man maanaa ||
342.e: When He is known to exist, then the mind is pleased and appeased.

342.g: ਹੈ ਤਉ ਸਹੀ ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
342.t: hai tau sahee lakhai jau koiee ||
342.e: Of course the Lord exists, if one could only understand Him.

342.g: ਤਬ ਓਹੀ ਉਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪੨॥
342.t: tab ohee uh eh na hoiee ||42||
342.e: Then, He alone exists, and not this mortal being. ||42||

342.g: ਲਿੰਉ ਲਿੰਉ ਕਰਤ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
342.t: li(n)au li(n)au karat firai sabh log ||
342.e: Everyone goes around saying, ""I'll take this, and I'll take that.""

342.g: ਤਾ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
342.t: taa kaaran biaapai bahu sog ||
342.e: Because of that, they suffer in terrible pain.

342.g: ਲਖਿਮੀ ਬਰ ਸਿਉ ਜਉ ਲਿਉ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
342.t: lakhimee bar siau jau liau laavai ||
342.e: When someone comes to love the Lord of Lakhshmi,

342.g: ਸੋਗੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪੩॥
342.t: sog miTai sabh hee sukh paavai ||43||
342.e: his sorrow departs, and he obtains total peace. ||43||

342.g: ਖਖਾ ਖਿਰਤ ਖਪਤ ਗਏ ਕੇਤੇ ॥
342.t: khakhaa khirat khapat ge kete ||
342.e: KHAKHA: Many have wasted their lives, and then perished.

342.g: ਖਿਰਤ ਖਪਤ ਅਜਹੂੰ ਨਹ ਚੇਤੇ ॥
342.t: khirat khapat ajahoo(n) neh chete ||
342.e: Wasting away, they do not remember the Lord, even now.

342.g: ਅਬ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿ ਜਉ ਮਨਾ ਰਹੈ ॥
342.t: ab jag jaan jau manaa rahai ||
342.e: But if someone, even now, comes to know the transitory nature of the world and restrain his mind,

342.g: ਜਹ ਕਾ ਬਿਛੁਰਾ ਤਹ ਥਿਰੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੪੪॥
342.t: jeh kaa bichhuraa teh thir lahai ||44||
342.e: he shall find his permanent home, from which he was separated. ||44||

343.e: The fifty-two letters have been joined together.
But people cannot recognize the One Word of God.
Kabeer speaks the Shabad, the Word of Truth.
One who is a Pandit, a religious scholar, must remain fearless.
It is the business of the scholarly person to join letters.
The spiritual person contemplates the essence of reality.

343.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜੀਅ ਜੈਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
343.t: jaa kai jeea jaisee budh hoiee ||
343.e: According to the wisdom within the mind,
says Kabeer, so does one come to understand. ||45||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

343.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਥਿਤੰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੰੀ ॥
343.t: raag gauRee thita(n)ee kabeer jee ka(n)ee ||
343.e: Raag Gauree, T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days Of Kabeer Jee:
Shalok:
There are fifteen lunar days, and seven days of the week.
Says Kabeer, it is neither here nor there.
When the Siddhas and seekers come to know the Lord's mystery,
they themselves become the Creator; they themselves become the Divine Lord. ||1||
T'hitee:
On the day of the new moon, give up your hopes.
Remember the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
You shall attain the Gate of Liberation while yet alive.
You shall come to know the Shabad, the Word of the Fearless Lord, and the essence of your own inner being. ||1||
One who enshrines love for the Lotus Feet of the Lord of the Universe

343.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
343.t: sa(n)t prasaadh bhe man niramal har keeratan meh anadhin jaagaa ||1|| rahaau ||
343.e: - by the Grace of the Saints, her mind becomes pure; night and day, she remains awake and aware, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||Pause||
On the first day of the lunar cycle, contemplate the Beloved Lord.
He is playing within the heart; He has no body - He is Infinite.
The pain of death never consumes that person
who remains absorbed in the Primal Lord God. ||2||
On the second day of the lunar cycle, know that there are two beings within the fiber of the body.
Maya and God are blended with everything.

343.g: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਢੈ ਨ ਘਟਤਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
343.t: naa oh baddai na ghaTataa jai ||
343.e: God does not increase or decrease.
He is unknowable and immaculate; He does not change. ||3||
On the third day of the lunar cycle, one who maintains his equilibrium amidst the three modes
finds the source of ecstasy and the highest status.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, faith wells up.
Outwardly, and deep within, God's Light is always radiant. ||4||
On the fourth day of the lunar cycle, restrain your fickle mind,

343.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਹਹੁ ॥
343.t: kaam karodh sa(n)g kabahu na bahahu ||
343.e: and do not ever associate with sexual desire or anger.
On land and sea, He Himself is in Himself.
He Himself meditates and chants His Chant. ||5||
On the fifth day of the lunar cycle, the five elements expand outward.
Men are occupied in the pursuit of gold and women.
How rare are those who drink in the pure essence of the Lord's Love.

343.g: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
343.t: jaraa maran dhukh fer na hoi ||6||
343.e: They shall never again suffer the pains of old age and death. ||6||

343.g: ਛਠਿ ਖਟੁ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਛਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇ ॥
343.t: chhaTh khaT chakar chhahoo(n) dhis dhai ||
343.e: On the sixth day of the lunar cycle, the six chakras run in six directions.
Without enlightenment, the body does not remain steady.
So erase your duality and hold tight to forgiveness,

343.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਸੂਲ ਨ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੭॥
343.t: karam dharam kee sool na sahahu ||7||
343.e: and you will not have to endure the torture of karma or religious rituals. ||7||
On the seventh day of the lunar cycle, know the Word as True,
and you shall be accepted by the Lord, the Supreme Soul.
Your doubts shall be eradicated, and your pains eliminated,
and in the ocean of the celestial void, you shall find peace. ||8||
On the eighth day of the lunar cycle, the body is made of the eight ingredients.

343.g: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਅਕੁਲ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
343.t: taa meh akul mahaa nidh raiaa ||
343.e: Within it is the Unknowable Lord, the King of the supreme treasure.
The Guru, who knows this spiritual wisdom, reveals the secret of this mystery.
Turning away from the world, He abides in the Unbreakable and Impenetrable Lord. ||9||
On the ninth day of the lunar cycle, discipline the nine gates of the body.
Keep your pulsating desires restrained.
Forget all your greed and emotional attachment;

344.g: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਅਮਰ ਫਲ ਖਾਹੁ ॥੧੦॥
344.t: jug jug jeevahu amar fal khaahu ||10||
344.e: you shall live throughout the ages, eating the fruit of immortality. ||10||
On the tenth day of the lunar cycle, there is ecstasy in all directions.
Doubt is dispelled, and the Lord of the Universe is met.
He is the Embodiment of light, the incomparable essence.

344.g: ਅਮਲ ਨ ਮਲ ਨ ਛਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਧੂਪ ॥੧੧॥
344.t: amal na mal na chhaeh nahee dhoop ||11||
344.e: He is stainless, without stain, beyond both sunshine and shade. ||11||
On the eleventh day of the lunar cycle, if you run in the direction of the One,

344.g: ਤਉ ਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਕਟ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
344.t: tau jonee sa(n)kaT bahur na aavai ||
344.e: you will not have to suffer the pains of reincarnation again.
Your body will become cool, immaculate and pure.
The Lord was said to be far away, but He is found near at hand. ||12||
On the twelfth day of the lunar cycle, twelve suns rise.
Day and night, the celestial bugles vibrate the unstruck melody.
Then, one beholds the Father of the three worlds.
This is wonderful! The human being has become God! ||13||
On the thirteenth day of the lunar cycle, the thirteen holy books proclaim
that you must recognize the Lord in the nether regions of the underworld as well as the heavens.
There is no high or low, no honor or dishonor.
The Lord is pervading and permeating all. ||14||
On the fourteenth day of the lunar cycle, in the fourteen worlds
and on each and every hair, the Lord abides.
Center yourself and meditate on truth and contentment.
Speak the speech of God's spiritual wisdom. ||15||
On the day of the full moon, the full moon fills the heavens.
Its power is diffused through its gentle light.

344.g: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਥੀਰ ॥
344.t: aadh a(n)t madh hoi rahiaa theer ||
344.e: In the beginning, in the end, and in the middle, God remains firm and steady.
Kabeer is immersed in the ocean of peace. ||16||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

344.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਵਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ੭ ॥
344.t: raag gauRee vaar kabeer jeeau ke 7 ||
344.e: Raag Gauree, The Seven Days Of The Week Of Kabeer Jee:

344.g: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
344.t: baar baar har ke gun gaavau ||
344.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord each and every day.

344.g: ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
344.t: gur gam bhedhu su har kaa paavau ||1|| rahaau ||
344.e: Meeting with the Guru, you shall come to know the mystery of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
On Sunday, begin the devotional worship of the Lord,
and restrain the desires within the temple of the body.
When your attention is focused day and night upon that imperishable place,

344.g: ਤਉ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੇਣੁ ਸਹਜ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਇ ॥੧॥
344.t: tau anahadh ben sahaj meh bai ||1||
344.e: then the celestial flutes play the unstruck melody in tranquil peace and poise. ||1||
On Monday, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down from the moon.
Tasting it, all poisons are removed in an instant.
Restrained by Gurbani, the mind remains indoors;
drinking in this Nectar, it is intoxicated. ||2||
On Tuesday, understand reality;
you must know the way the five thieves work.
Those who leave their own home to go out wandering
shall feel the terrible wrath of the Lord, their King. ||3||
On Wednesday, one's understanding is enlightened.

344.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਾਸ ॥
344.t: hiradhai kamal meh har kaa baas ||
344.e: The Lord comes to dwell in the lotus of the heart.

344.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੋਊ ਏਕ ਸਮ ਧਰੈ ॥
344.t: gur mil dhouoo ek sam dharai ||
344.e: Meeting the Guru, one comes to look alike upon pleasure and pain,
and the inverted lotus is turned upright. ||4||
On Thursday, wash off your corruption.
Forsake the trinity, and attach yourself to the One God.
At the confluence of the three rivers of knowledge, right action and devotion, there,
why not wash away your sinful mistakes? ||5||

344.g: ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਇਹ ਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਚੜੈ ॥
344.t: sukirat sahaarai su ieh brat chaRai ||
344.e: On Friday, keep up and complete your fast;
day and night, you must fight against your own self.
If you restrain your five senses,

344.g: ਤਉ ਦੂਜੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਪੈਸੈ ਕਬੈ ॥੬॥
344.t: tau dhoojee dhirasaT na paisai kabai ||6||
344.e: then you shall not cast your glance on another. ||6||

344.g: ਥਾਵਰ ਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੀ ਵਟੀ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਇ ॥
344.t: thaavar thir kar raakhai soi || jot dhee vaTee ghaT meh joi ||
344.e: On Saturday, keep the candle of God's Light steady within your heart;
you will be enlightened, inwardly and outwardly.

344.g: ਤਬ ਹੂਆ ਸਗਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
344.t: tab hooaa sagal karam kaa naas ||7||
344.e: All your karma will be erased. ||7||

345.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਨ ॥
345.t: jab lag ghaT meh dhoojee aan ||
345.e: Know that as long as you place your hopes in others,

345.g: ਤਉ ਲਉ ਮਹਲਿ ਨ ਲਾਭੈ ਜਾਨ ॥
345.t: tau lau mahal na laabhai jaan ||
345.e: you shall not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

345.g: ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
345.t: ramat raam siau laago ra(n)g ||
345.e: When you embrace love for the Lord,

345.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਬ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅੰਗ ॥੮॥੧॥
345.t: keh kabeer tab niramal a(n)g ||8||1||
345.e: says Kabeer, then, you shall become pure in your very fiber. ||8||1||

345.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
345.t: raag gauRee chetee baanee naamadheau jeeau kee
345.e: Raag Gauree Chaytee, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

345.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
345.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
345.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

345.g: ਦੇਵਾ ਪਾਹਨ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
345.t: dhevaa paahan taareeale ||
345.e: God makes even stones float.

345.g: ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਜਨ ਕਸ ਨ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
345.t: raam kahat jan kas na tare ||1|| rahaau ||
345.e: So why shouldn't Your humble slave also float across, chanting Your Name, O Lord? ||1||Pause||

345.g: ਤਾਰੀਲੇ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੂਪ ਕੁਬਿਜਾ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
345.t: taareele ganikaa bin roop kubijaa biaadh ajaamal taareeale ||
345.e: You saved the prostitute, and the ugly hunch-back; You helped the hunter and Ajaamal swim across as well.

345.g: ਚਰਨ ਬਧਿਕ ਜਨ ਤੇਊ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ॥
345.t: charan badhik jan teuoo mukat bhe ||
345.e: The hunter who shot Krishna in the foot - even he was liberated.

345.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੇ ॥੧॥
345.t: hau bal bal jin raam kahe ||1||
345.e: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who chant the Lord's Name. ||1||

345.g: ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਦੀਏ ॥
345.t: dhaasee sut jan bidhar sudhaamaa ugrasain kau raaj dhe'ee ||
345.e: You saved Bidur, the son of the slave-girl, and Sudama; You restored Ugrasain to his throne.

345.g: ਜਪ ਹੀਨ ਤਪ ਹੀਨ ਕੁਲ ਹੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੀਨ ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਊ ਤਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
345.t: jap heen tap heen kul heen karam heen naame ke suaamee teuoo tare ||2||1||
345.e: Without meditation, without penance, without a good family, without good deeds, Naam Dayv's Lord and Master saved them all. ||2||1||

345.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ
345.t: raag gauRee ravidhaas jee ke padhe gauRee guaareree
345.e: Raag Gauree, Padhay Of Ravi Daas Jee, Gauree Gwaarayree:

345.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
345.t: ikOankaar satinaam karataa purakh guraprasaadh ||
345.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

345.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੋਚ ਸੋਚ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
345.t: meree sa(n)gat poch soch dhin raatee ||
345.e: The company I keep is wretched and low, and I am anxious day and night;

345.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੁਟਿਲਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਕੁਭਾਂਤੀ ॥੧॥
345.t: meraa karam kuTilataa janam kubhaa(n)tee ||1||
345.e: my actions are crooked, and I am of lowly birth. ||1||

345.g: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਸਈਆ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਜੀਵਨਾ ॥
345.t: raam gusieeaa jeea ke jeevanaa ||
345.e: O Lord, Master of the earth, Life of the soul,

345.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
345.t: moh na bisaarahu mai jan teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
345.e: please do not forget me! I am Your humble servant. ||1||Pause||

345.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਹੁ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
345.t: meree harahu bipat jan karahu subhaiee ||
345.e: Take away my pains, and bless Your humble servant with Your Sublime Love.

345.g: ਚਰਣ ਨ ਛਾਡਉ ਸਰੀਰ ਕਲ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
345.t: charan na chhaaddau sareer kal jaiee ||2||
345.e: I shall not leave Your Feet, even though my body may perish. ||2||

345.g: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਪਰਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਭਾ ॥
345.t: kahu ravidhaas parau teree saabhaa ||
345.e: Says Ravi Daas, I seek the protection of Your Sanctuary;

345.g: ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਲਾਂਬਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
345.t: beg milahu jan kar na bilaa(n)baa ||3||1||
345.e: please, meet Your humble servant - do not delay! ||3||1||

345.g: ਬੇਗਮ ਪੁਰਾ ਸਹਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
345.t: begam puraa sahar ko naau ||
345.e: Baygumpura, 'the city without sorrow', is the name of the town.

345.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਅੰਦੋਹੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
345.t: dhookh a(n)dhoh nahee teh Thaau ||
345.e: There is no suffering or anxiety there.

345.g: ਨਾਂ ਤਸਵੀਸ ਖਿਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
345.t: naa(n) tasavees khiraaj na maal ||
345.e: There are no troubles or taxes on commodities there.

345.g: ਖਉਫੁ ਨ ਖਤਾ ਨ ਤਰਸੁ ਜਵਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
345.t: khauf na khataa na taras javaal ||1||
345.e: There is no fear, blemish or downfall there. ||1||

345.g: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੂਬ ਵਤਨ ਗਹ ਪਾਈ ॥
345.t: ab moh khoob vatan geh paiee ||
345.e: Now, I have found this most excellent city.

345.g: ਊਹਾਂ ਖੈਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
345.t: uoohaa(n) khair sadhaa mere bhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
345.e: There is lasting peace and safety there, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

345.g: ਕਾਇਮੁ ਦਾਇਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ॥
345.t: kaim dhaim sadhaa paatisaahee ||
345.e: God's Kingdom is steady, stable and eternal.

345.g: ਦੋਮ ਨ ਸੇਮ ਏਕ ਸੋ ਆਹੀ ॥
345.t: dhom na sem ek so aahee ||
345.e: There is no second or third status; all are equal there.

345.g: ਆਬਾਦਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਸਹੂਰ ॥
345.t: aabaadhaan sadhaa masahoor ||
345.e: That city is populous and eternally famous.

345.g: ਊਹਾਂ ਗਨੀ ਬਸਹਿ ਮਾਮੂਰ ॥੨॥
345.t: uoohaa(n) ganee baseh maamoor ||2||
345.e: Those who live there are wealthy and contented. ||2||

345.g: ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੈਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
345.t: tiau tiau sail kareh jiau bhaavai ||
345.e: They stroll about freely, just as they please.

345.g: ਮਹਰਮ ਮਹਲ ਨ ਕੋ ਅਟਕਾਵੈ ॥
345.t: maharam mahal na ko aTakaavai ||
345.e: They know the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and no one blocks their way.

345.g: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਖਲਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥
345.t: keh ravidhaas khalaas chamaaraa ||
345.e: Says Ravi Daas, the emancipated shoe-maker:

345.g: ਜੋ ਹਮ ਸਹਰੀ ਸੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
345.t: jo ham saharee su meet hamaaraa ||3||2||
345.e: whoever is a citizen there, is a friend of mine. ||3||2||

345.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
345.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
345.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

345.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
345.t: gauRee bairaagan ravidhaas jeeau ||
345.e: Gauree Bairaagan, Ravi Daas Jee:

345.g: ਘਟ ਅਵਘਟ ਡੂਗਰ ਘਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਹਮਾਰ ॥
345.t: ghaT avaghaT ddoogar ghanaa ik niragun bail hamaar ||
345.e: The path to God is very treacherous and mountainous, and all I have is this worthless ox.

345.g: ਰਮਈਏ ਸਿਉ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
345.t: ramie'ee siau ik benatee meree poo(n)jee raakh muraar ||1||
345.e: I offer this one prayer to the Lord, to preserve my capital. ||1||

345.g: ਕੋ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਟਾਂਡਾ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
345.t: ko banajaaro raam ko meraa Taa(n)ddaa laadhiaa jai re ||1|| rahaau ||
345.e: Is there any merchant of the Lord to join me? My cargo is loaded, and now I am leaving. ||1||Pause||

346.g: ਹਉ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਸਹਜ ਕਰਉ ਬੵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
346.t: hau banajaaro raam ko sahaj karau bayeaapaar ||
346.e: I am the merchant of the Lord; I deal in spiritual wisdom.

346.g: ਮੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
346.t: mai raam naam dhan laadhiaa bikh laadhee sa(n)saar ||2||
346.e: I have loaded the Wealth of the Lord's Name; the world has loaded poison. ||2||

346.g: ਉਰਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਨੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਲ ਪਤਾਲੁ ॥
346.t: auravaar paar ke dhaaneeaa likh leh aal pataal ||
346.e: O you who know this world and the world beyond: write whatever nonsense you please about me.

346.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਤਜੀਲੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
346.t: moh jam dda(n)dd na laagiee tajeele sarab ja(n)jaal ||3||
346.e: The club of the Messenger of Death shall not strike me, since I have cast off all entanglements. ||3||

346.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
346.t: jaisaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa taisaa ih sa(n)saar ||
346.e: Love of this world is like the pale, temporary color of the safflower.

346.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਮਈਏ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
346.t: mere ramie'ee ra(n)g majeeTh kaa kahu ravidhaas chamaar ||4||1||
346.e: The color of my Lord's Love, however, is permanent, like the dye of the madder plant. So says Ravi Daas, the tanner. ||4||1||

346.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ
346.t: gauRee poorabee ravidhaas jeeau
346.e: Gauree Poorbee, Ravi Daas Jee:

346.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
346.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
346.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

346.g: ਕੂਪੁ ਭਰਿਓ ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਦਿਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਬਿਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਬੂਝ ॥
346.t: koop bhario jaise dhaadhiraa kachh dhes bidhes na boojh ||
346.e: The frog in the deep well knows nothing of its own country or other lands;

346.g: ਐਸੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਆਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝ ॥੧॥
346.t: aaise meraa man bikhiaa bimohiaa kachh aaraa paar na soojh ||1||
346.e: just so, my mind, infatuated with corruption, understands nothing about this world or the next. ||1||

346.g: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
346.t: sagal bhavan ke naikaa ik chhin dharas dhikhai jee ||1|| rahaau ||
346.e: O Lord of all worlds: reveal to me, even for an instant, the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

346.g: ਮਲਿਨ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਮਾਧਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
346.t: malin bhiee mat maadhavaa teree gat lakhee na jai ||
346.e: My intellect is polluted; I cannot understand Your state, O Lord.

346.g: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਈ ਮੈ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
346.t: karahu kirapaa bhram chookiee mai sumat dheh samajhai ||2||
346.e: Take pity on me, dispel my doubts, and teach me true wisdom. ||2||

346.g: ਜੋਗੀਸਰ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਅ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਨੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
346.t: jogeesar paaveh nahee tua gun kathan apaar ||
346.e: Even the great Yogis cannot describe Your Glorious Virtues; they are beyond words.

346.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਕਾਰਣੈ ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੩॥੧॥
346.t: prem bhagat kai kaaranai kahu ravidhaas chamaar ||3||1||
346.e: I am dedicated to Your loving devotional worship, says Ravi Daas the tanner. ||3||1||

346.g: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ
346.t: gauRee bairaagan
346.e: Gauree Bairaagan:

346.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
346.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
346.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

346.g: ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਤੁ ਤੇਤਾ ਜਗੀ ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਪੂਜਾਚਾਰ ॥
346.t: satajug sat tetaa jagee dhuaapar poojaachaar ||
346.e: In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, was Truth; in the Silver Age of Trayta Yuga, charitable feasts; in the Brass Age of Dwaapar Yuga, there was worship.

346.g: ਤੀਨੌ ਜੁਗ ਤੀਨੌ ਦਿੜੇ ਕਲਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
346.t: teenau jug teenau dhiRe kal keval naam adhaar ||1||
346.e: In those three ages, people held to these three ways. But in the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the Lord is your only Support. ||1||

346.g: ਪਾਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਇਬੋ ਰੇ ॥
346.t: paar kaise paibo re ||
346.e: How can I swim across?

346.g: ਮੋ ਸਉ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
346.t: mo sau kouoo na kahai samajhai ||
346.e: No one has explained to me,

346.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
346.t: jaa te aavaa gavan bilai ||1|| rahaau ||
346.e: so that I might understand how I can escape reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

346.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਰੂਪੀਐ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
346.t: bahu bidh dharam niroopeeaai karataa dheesai sabh loi ||
346.e: So many forms of religion have been described; the whole world is practicing them.

346.g: ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜਿਹ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
346.t: kavan karam te chhooTeeaai jeh saadhe sabh sidh hoi ||2||
346.e: What actions will bring emancipation, and total perfection? ||2||

346.g: ਕਰਮ ਅਕਰਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਸੰਕਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
346.t: karam akaram beechaareeaai sa(n)kaa sun bedh puraan ||
346.e: One may distinguish between good and evil actions, and listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas,

346.g: ਸੰਸਾ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਿਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
346.t: sa(n)saa sadh hiradhai basai kaun hirai abhimaan ||3||
346.e: but doubt still persists. Skepticism continually dwells in the heart, so who can eradicate egotistical pride? ||3||

346.g: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਉਦਕਿ ਪਖਾਰੀਐ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
346.t: baahar udhak pakhaareeaai ghaT bheetar bibidh bikaar ||
346.e: Outwardly, he washes with water, but deep within, his heart is tarnished by all sorts of vices.

346.g: ਸੁਧ ਕਵਨ ਪਰ ਹੋਇਬੋ ਸੁਚ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੪॥
346.t: sudh kavan par hoibo such ku(n)char bidh biauhaar ||4||
346.e: So how can he become pure? His method of purification is like that of an elephant, covering himself with dust right after his bath! ||4||

346.g: ਰਵਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਰਜਨੀ ਜਥਾ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਨਤ ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
346.t: rav pragaas rajanee jathaa gat jaanat sabh sa(n)saar ||
346.e: With the rising of the sun, the night is brought to its end; the whole world knows this.

346.g: ਪਾਰਸ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਾਬੋ ਛੁਏ ਕਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੫॥
346.t: paaras maano taabo chhue kanak hot nahee baar ||5||
346.e: It is believed that with the touch of the Philosopher's Stone, copper is immediately transformed into gold. ||5||

346.g: ਪਰਮ ਪਰਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
346.t: param paras gur bheTeeaai poorab likhat lilaaT ||
346.e: When one meets the Supreme Philosopher's Stone, the Guru, if such pre-ordained destiny is written on one's forehead,

346.g: ਉਨਮਨ ਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਛੁਟਕਤ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ॥੬॥
346.t: aunaman man man hee mile chhuTakat bajar kapaaT ||6||
346.e: then the soul blends with the Supreme Soul, and the stubborn doors are opened wide. ||6||
