346.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
346.t: bhagat jugat mat sat karee bhram ba(n)dhan kaaT bikaar ||
346.e: Through the way of devotion, the intellect is imbued with Truth; doubts, entanglements and vices are cut away.

346.g: ਸੋਈ ਬਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਏਕ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੭॥
346.t: soiee bas ras man mile gun niragun ek bichaar ||7||
346.e: The mind is restrained, and one attains joy, contemplating the One Lord, who is both with and without qualities. ||7||

346.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੀਏ ਟਾਰੀ ਨ ਟਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਫਾਸ ॥
346.t: anik jatan nigreh ke'ee Taaree na Tarai bhram faas ||
346.e: I have tried many methods, but by turning it away, the noose of doubt is not turned away.

346.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੮॥੧॥
346.t: prem bhagat nahee uoopajai taa te ravidhaas udhaas ||8||1||
346.e: Love and devotion have not welled up within me, and so Ravi Daas is sad and depressed. ||8||1||

347.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
347.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
347.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

347.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ॥
347.t: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa so dhar ||
347.e: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla, First House, So Dar ~ That Gate:

347.g: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
347.t: so dhar teraa kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab sam(h)aale ||
347.e: What is that Gate, and what is that Home, in which You sit and take care of all?

347.g: ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
347.t: vaaje tere naadh anek asa(n)khaa kete tere vaavanahaare ||
347.e: Countless musical instruments of so many various kinds vibrate there for You; so many are the musicians there for You.

347.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
347.t: kete tere raag paree siau kahe'eeh kete tere gaavanahaare ||
347.e: There are so many Ragas there for You, along with their accompanying harmonies; so many minstrels sing to You.

347.g: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
347.t: gaavani(h) tudhano paun paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam dhuaare ||
347.e: The winds sing to You, as do water and fire; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

347.g: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
347.t: gaavani(h) tudhano chit gupat likh jaanan likh likh dharam veechaare ||
347.e: Chitar and Gupat, the recording angels of the conscious and the subconscious, sing to You; they know, and they write, and on the basis of what they write, the Lord of Dharma passes judgement.

347.g: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
347.t: gaavani(h) tudhano ieesar brahamaa dhevee sohan tere sadhaa savaare ||
347.e: Shiva and Brahma and the Goddess Parvaati, so beautiful and ever adorned by You, sing to You.

347.g: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
347.t: gaavani(h) tudhano i(n)dhr i(n)dhraasan baiThe dhevatiaa dhar naale ||
347.e: The Indras, seated upon their celestial thrones, with the deities at Your Gate, sing to You.

347.g: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
347.t: gaavani(h) tudhano sidh samaadhee a(n)dhar gaavani(h) tudhano saadh beechaare ||
347.e: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing to You, and the Holy Saints, in their contemplative meditation, sing to You.

347.g: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
347.t: gaavani(h) tudhano jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaavan tudhano veer karaare ||
347.e: The celibates, the truthful and the patient beings sing to You, and the mighty warriors sing to You.

347.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜੇ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਬੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
347.t: gaavan tudhano pa(n)ddit paRe rakheesur jug jug bedhaa naale ||
347.e: The scholarly Pandits sing to You, along with the holy Rishis and the readers of the Vedas throughout the ages.

347.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
347.t: gaavan tudhano mohaneeaa man mohan surag machh piaale ||
347.e: The Mohinis, the heavenly beauties who entice the heart in paradise, in this world and in the nether regions, sing to You.

347.g: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੇਤੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
347.t: gaavani(h) tudhano ratan upaae tere jete aThasaTh teerath naale ||
347.e: The fourteen priceless jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, sing to You.

347.g: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
347.t: gaavani(h) tudhano jodh mahaabal sooraa gaavani(h) tudhano khaanee chaare ||
347.e: The mighty warriors and the divine heroes sing to You, and the four sources of creation sing to You.

347.g: ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
347.t: gaavani(h) tudhano kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal brahama(n)ddaa kar kar rakhe tere dhaare ||
347.e: The continents, the worlds and the solar systems, created and installed by Your Hand, sing to You.

347.g: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿੑ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿੑ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
347.t: seiee tudhano gaavani(h) jo tudh bhaavani(h) rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
347.e: They alone sing to You, who are pleasing to Your Will, and who are imbued with the nectar of Your devotional worship.

347.g: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
347.t: hor kete tudhano gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa beechaare ||
347.e: So many others sing to You, they do not come into my mind; how can Nanak think of them?

347.g: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
347.t: soiee soiee sadhaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naiee ||
347.e: That Lord and Master - He is True, forever True; He is True, and True is His Name.

347.g: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
347.t: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaiee ||
347.e: He who created the creation is True, and He shall always be True; He shall not depart, even when the creation departs.

347.g: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
347.t: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee jinasee maiaa jin upaiee ||
347.e: He created the world of Maya with its various colors and species.

347.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
347.t: kar kar dhekhai keetaa apanaa jiau tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||
347.e: Having created the creation, He Himself watches over it, as it pleases His Greatness.

347.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
347.t: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee fir hukam na karanaa jaiee ||
347.e: Whatever pleases Him, that is what He does. No one can issue any commands to Him.

348.g: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥੧॥
348.t: so paatisaahu saahaa pat saahib naanak rahan rajaiee ||1||1||
348.e: He is the King, the King of Kings, the Emperor of Kings! Nanak lives in surrender to His Will. ||1||1||

348.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
348.t: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
348.e: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

348.g: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
348.t: so purakh nira(n)jan har purakh nira(n)jan har agamaa agam apaaraa ||
348.e: That Lord is Immaculate; the Lord God is Immaculate. The Lord is Unapproachable, Unfathomable and Incomparable.

348.g: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
348.t: sabh dhiaaveh sabh dhiaaveh tudh jee har sache sirajanahaaraa ||
348.e: All meditate, all meditate on You, O Dear Lord, O True Creator.

348.g: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
348.t: sabh jeea tumaare jee too(n) jeeaa kaa dhaataaraa ||
348.e: All beings are Yours; You are the Giver of all beings.

348.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
348.t: har dhiaavahu sa(n)tahu jee sabh dhookh visaaranahaaraa ||
348.e: So meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He is the One who takes away all pain.

348.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
348.t: har aape Thaakur har aape sevak jee kiaa naanak ja(n)t vichaaraa ||1||
348.e: The Lord Himself is the Master, and He Himself is His own servant. O Nanak, how insignificant are mortal beings! ||1||

348.g: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
348.t: too(n) ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar jee har eko purakh samaanaa ||
348.e: You are totally pervading within each and every heart; O Lord, You are the One Primal Being, All-permeating.

348.g: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
348.t: eik dhaate ik bhekhaaree jee sabh tere choj viddaanaa ||
348.e: Some are givers, and some are beggars; all of this is Your wondrous play!

348.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
348.t: too(n) aape dhaataa aape bhugataa jee hau tudh bin avar na jaanaa ||
348.e: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know of no other than You.

348.g: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
348.t: too(n) paarabraham bea(n)t bea(n)t jee tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa ||
348.e: You are the Supreme Lord God, Infinite and Eternal; what Glorious Praises of Yours should I speak and chant?

348.g: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
348.t: jo seveh jo seveh tudh jee jan naanak tin(h) kurabaanaa ||2||
348.e: Unto those who serve, unto those who serve You, slave Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||

348.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
348.t: har dhiaaveh har dhiaaveh tudh jee se jan jug meh sukh vaasee ||
348.e: Those who meditate on the Lord, those who meditate on You, O Dear Lord, those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.

348.g: ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਟੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
348.t: se mukat se mukat bhe jin(h) har dhiaaiaa jeeau tin TooTee jam kee faasee ||
348.e: They are liberated, they are liberated, who meditate on the Lord; the noose of Death is cut away from them.

348.g: ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ ॥
348.t: jin nirabhau jin(h) har nirabhau dhiaaiaa jeeau tin kaa bhau sabh gavaasee ||
348.e: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord, all their fears are dispelled.

348.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
348.t: jin(h) seviaa jin(h) seviaa meraa har jeeau te har har roop samaasee ||
348.e: Those who have served, those who have served my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.

348.g: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
348.t: se dha(n)n se dha(n)n jin har dhiaaiaa jeeau jan naanak tin bal jaasee ||3||
348.e: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who have meditated on the Dear Lord; slave Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||

348.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਜੀ ਭਰੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
348.t: teree bhagat teree bhagat bha(n)ddaar jee bhare bea(n)t bea(n)taa ||
348.e: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure, overflowing, infinite and endless.

348.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
348.t: tere bhagat tere bhagat salaahan tudh jee har anik anek ana(n)taa ||
348.e: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, O Dear Lord, in many and various ways.

348.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
348.t: teree anik teree anik kareh har poojaa jee tap taapeh japeh bea(n)taa ||
348.e: For You, so many, for You, so very many, O Dear Lord, perform worship and adoration; they practice penance and endlessly chant in meditation.

348.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੜਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੰਤਾ ॥
348.t: tere anek tere anek paReh bahu si(n)mirat saasat jee kar kiriaa khaT karam kara(n)taa ||
348.e: For You, many - for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras; they perform religious rituals and the six ceremonies.

348.g: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
348.t: se bhagat se bhagat bhale jan naanak jee jo bhaaveh mere har bhagava(n)taa ||4||
348.e: Those devotees, those devotees are good, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Lord God. ||4||

348.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
348.t: too(n) aadh purakh apara(n)par karataa jee tudh jevadd avar na koiee ||
348.e: You are the Primal Being, the Unrivalled Creator Lord; there is no other as Great as You.

348.g: ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
348.t: too(n) jug jug eko sadhaa sadhaa too(n) eko jee too(n) nihachal karataa soiee ||
348.e: You are the One, age after age; forever and ever, You are One and the same. You are the Eternal, Unchanging Creator.

348.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
348.t: tudh aape bhaavai soiee varatai jee too(n) aape kareh su hoiee ||
348.e: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. Whatever You Yourself do, happens.

348.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
348.t: tudh aape sirasaT sabh upaiee jee tudh aape siraj sabh goiee ||
348.e: You Yourself created the entire Universe, and having done so, You Yourself shall destroy it all.

348.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ॥੫॥੨॥
348.t: jan naanak gun gaavai karate ke jee jo sabhasai kaa jaanoiee ||5||2||
348.e: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Creator, the Knower of all. ||5||2||

348.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
348.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
348.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

348.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
348.t: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa chaupadhe ghar doojaa ||
348.e: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla, Chaupadhay, Second House:

348.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭ ਕੋਈ ॥
348.t: sun vaddaa aakhai sabh koiee ||
348.e: Hearing, everyone calls You Great,

348.g: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਡੀਠਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
348.t: kevadd vaddaa ddeeThaa hoiee ||
348.e: but only one who has seen You, knows just how Great You are.

349.e: No one can measure Your Worth, or describe You.
Those who describe You, remain absorbed in You. ||1||

349.g: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
349.t: vadde mere saahibaa gahir ga(n)bheeraa gunee gaheeraa ||
349.e: O my Great Lord and Master of Unfathomable Depth, You are the Ocean of Excellence.

349.g: ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
349.t: koiee na jaanai teraa ketaa kevadd cheeraa ||1|| rahaau ||
349.e: No one knows the greatness of Your expanse. ||1||Pause||
All the contemplators met together and practiced contemplation;
all the appraisers met together and tried to appraise You.
The theologians, the meditators and the teachers of teachers

349.g: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
349.t: kahan na jaiee teree til vaddiaaiee ||2||
349.e: could not express even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||

349.g: ਸਭਿ ਸਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
349.t: sabh sat sabh tap sabh cha(n)giaaieeaa ||
349.e: All Truth, all austerities, all goodness,
and the greatness of the Siddhas, the beings of perfect spiritual powers

349.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
349.t: tudh vin sidhee kinai na paieeaa ||
349.e: without You, none has attained such spiritual powers.
They are obtained by Your Grace; their flow cannot be blocked. ||3||
What can the helpless speaker do?
Your bounties are overflowing with Your Praises.

349.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
349.t: jis too(n) dheh tisai kiaa chaaraa ||
349.e: And the one, unto whom You give - why should he think of any other?
O Nanak, the True Lord is the Embellisher. ||4||1||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Chanting the Name, I live; forgetting it, I die.
It is so difficult to chant the True Name.
If someone feels hunger for the True Name,
then that hunger shall consume his pains. ||1||
So how could I ever forget Him, O my Mother?
True is the Master, and True is His Name. ||1||Pause||

349.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥ ਆਖਿ ਥਕੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
349.t: saache naam kee til vaddiaaiee || aakh thake keemat nahee paiee ||
349.e: People have grown weary of trying to appraise the greatness of the True Name, but they have not been able to appraise even an iota of it.

349.g: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
349.t: je sabh mil kai aakhan paeh ||
349.e: Even if they were all to meet together and recount them,

349.g: ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
349.t: vaddaa na hovai ghaaT na jai ||2||
349.e: You would not be made any greater or lesser. ||2||

349.g: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
349.t: naa oh marai na hovai sog ||
349.e: He does not die - there is no reason to mourn.
He continues to give, but His Provisions are never exhausted.
This Glorious Virtue is His alone - no one else is like Him;

349.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
349.t: naa ko hoaa naa ko hoi ||3||
349.e: there has never been anyone like Him, and there never shall be. ||3||
As Great as You Yourself are, so Great are Your Gifts.

349.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
349.t: jin dhin kar kai keetee raat ||
349.e: It is You who created day and night as well.
Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.
O Nanak, without the Name, people are wretched outcasts. ||4||2||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

349.g: ਜੇ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਂਗਤੁ ਕੂਕ ਕਰੇ ਮਹਲੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
349.t: je dhar maa(n)gat kook kare mahalee khasam sune ||
349.e: If a beggar cries out at the door, the Master hears it in His Mansion.

349.g: ਭਾਵੈ ਧੀਰਕ ਭਾਵੈ ਧਕੇ ਏਕ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
349.t: bhaavai dheerak bhaavai dhake ek vaddaiee dhei ||1||
349.e: Whether He receives him or pushes him away, it is the Gift of the Lord's Greatness. ||1||

349.g: ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਤੀ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
349.t: jaanahu jot na poochhahu jaatee aagai jaat na he ||1|| rahaau ||
349.e: Recognize the Lord's Light within all, and do not consider social class or status; there are no classes or castes in the world hereafter. ||1||Pause||
He Himself acts, and He Himself inspires us to act.
He Himself considers our complaints.
Since You, O Creator Lord, are the Doer,
why should I submit to the world? ||2||
You Yourself created and You Yourself give.
You Yourself eliminate evil-mindedness;
by Guru's Grace, You come to abide in our minds,
and then, pain and darkness are dispelled from within. ||3||
He Himself infuses love for the Truth.
Unto others, the Truth is not bestowed.

349.g: ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਲੇਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
349.t: je kisai dhei vakhaanai naanak aagai poochh na lei ||4||3||
349.e: If He bestows it upon someone, says Nanak, then, in the world hereafter, that person is not called to account. ||4||3||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
The urges of the heart are like cymbals and ankle-bells;
the drum of the world resounds with the beat.
Naarad dances to the tune of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;
where can the celibates and the men of truth place their feet? ||1||
Nanak is a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The world is blind; our Lord and Master is All-seeing. ||1||Pause||
The disciple feeds on the Guru;
out of love for bread, he comes to dwell in his home.

350.e: If one were to live and eat for hundreds of years,
that day alone would be auspicious, when he recognizes his Lord and Master. ||2||
Beholding the sight of the petitioner, compassion is not aroused.

350.g: ਲਏ ਦਿਤੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
350.t: le dhite vin rahai na koi ||
350.e: No one lives without give and take.
The king administers justice only if his palm is greased.
No one is moved by the Name of God. ||3||
O Nanak, they are human beings in form and name only;
by their deeds they are dogs - this is the Command of the Lord's Court.
By Guru's Grace, if one sees himself as a guest in this world,
then he gains honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||4||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

350.g: ਜੇਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਤੇਤੀ ਜੇਤਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
350.t: jetaa sabadh surat dhun tetee jetaa roop kaiaa teree ||
350.e: As much as the Shabad is in the mind, so much is Your melody; as much as the form of the universe is, so much is Your body, Lord.

350.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਸਨਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹਉ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
350.t: too(n) aape rasanaa aape basanaa avar na dhoojaa kahau maiee ||1||
350.e: You Yourself are the tongue, and You Yourself are the nose. Do not speak of any other, O my mother. ||1||
My Lord and Master is One;

350.g: ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
350.t: eko hai bhaiee eko hai ||1|| rahaau ||
350.e: He is the One and Only; O Siblings of Destiny, He is the One alone. ||1||Pause||

350.g: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
350.t: aape maare aape chhoddai aape levai dhei ||
350.e: He Himself kills, and He Himself emancipates; He Himself gives and takes.

350.g: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
350.t: aape vekhai aape vigasai aape nadhar karei ||2||
350.e: He Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices; He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2||

350.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
350.t: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaiee ||
350.e: Whatever He is to do, that is what He is doing. No one else can do anything.

350.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
350.t: jaisaa varatai taiso kaheeaai sabh teree vaddiaaiee ||3||
350.e: As He projects Himself, so do we describe Him; this is all Your Glorious Greatness, Lord. ||3||

350.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਲਾ ਪੀਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
350.t: kal kalavaalee maiaa madh meeThaa man matavaalaa peevat rahai ||
350.e: The Dark Age of Kali Yuga is the bottle of wine; Maya is the sweet wine, and the intoxicated mind continues to drink it in.

350.g: ਆਪੇ ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤੀਂ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਏਵ ਕਹੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
350.t: aape roop kare bahu bhaa(n)tee(n) naanak bapuRaa ev kahai ||4||5||
350.e: He Himself assumes all sorts of forms; thus poor Nanak speaks. ||4||5||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Make your intellect your instrument, and love your tambourine;
thus bliss and lasting pleasure shall be produced in your mind.
This is devotional worship, and this is the practice of penance.

350.g: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥
350.t: eit ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||1||
350.e: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||1||
Know that the perfect beat is the Praise of the Lord;

350.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਨਚਣਾ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
350.t: hor nachanaa khuseeaa man maeh ||1|| rahaau ||
350.e: other dances produce only temporary pleasure in the mind. ||1||Pause||
Play the two cymbals of truth and contentment.
Let your ankle bells be the lasting Vision of the Lord.
Let your harmony and music be the elimination of duality.

350.g: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
350.t: eit ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||2||
350.e: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||2||
Let the fear of God within your heart and mind be your spinning dance,
and keep up, whether sitting or standing.
To roll around in the dust is to know that the body is only ashes.

350.g: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
350.t: eit ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh paau ||3||
350.e: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||3||
Keep the company of the disciples, the students who love the teachings.
As Gurmukh, listen to the True Name.
O Nanak, chant it, over and over again.

350.g: ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪੈਰ ॥੪॥੬॥
350.t: eit ra(n)g naachahu rakh rakh pair ||4||6||
350.e: So dance in this love, and keep the beat with your feet. ||4||6||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

350.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਜਲ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
350.t: paun upai dharee sabh dharatee jal aganee kaa ba(n)dh keeaa ||
350.e: He created the air, and He supports the whole world; he bound water and fire together.

350.g: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਦਹਸਿਰਿ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਕਟਾਇਆ ਰਾਵਣੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
350.t: a(n)dhulai dhahasir moo(n)dd kaTaiaa raavan maar kiaa vaddaa bhiaa ||1||
350.e: The blind, ten-headed Raavan had his heads cut off, but what greatness was obtained by killing him? ||1||
What Glories of Yours can be chanted?

350.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
350.t: too(n) sarabe poor rahiaa liv lai ||1|| rahaau ||
350.e: You are totally pervading everywhere; You love and cherish all. ||1||Pause||

350.g: ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹਥਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਾਲੀ ਨਥਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
350.t: jeea upai jugat hath keenee kaalee nath kiaa vaddaa bhiaa ||
350.e: You created all beings, and You hold the world in Your Hands; what greatness is it to put a ring in the nose of the black cobra, as Krishna did?

350.g: ਕਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜੋਰੂ ਕਉਣ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
350.t: kis too(n) purakh joroo kaun kaheeaai sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa ||2||
350.e: Whose Husband are You? Who is Your wife? You are subtly diffused and pervading in all. ||2||

350.g: ਨਾਲਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਰਦਾਤਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
350.t: naal kuTa(n)b saath varadhaataa brahamaa bhaalan sirasaT giaa ||
350.e: Brahma, the bestower of blessings, entered the stem of the lotus, with his relatives, to find the extent of the universe.

350.g: ਆਗੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕੰਸੁ ਛੇਦਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੩॥
350.t: aagai a(n)t na paio taa kaa ka(n)s chhedh kiaa vaddaa bhiaa ||3||
350.e: Proceeding on, he could not find its limits; what glory was obtained by killing Kansa, the king? ||3||

350.g: ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੇ ਖੀਰੁ ਮਥਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਭਖਲਾਏ ਜਿ ਅਸੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
350.t: ratan upai dhare kheer mathiaa hor bhakhalaae j asee keeaa ||
350.e: The jewels were produced and brought forth by churning the ocean of milk. The other gods proclaimed ""We are the ones who did this!""

351.g: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਛਪੈ ਕਿਉ ਛਪਿਆ ਏਕੀ ਏਕੀ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥
351.t: kahai naanak chhapai kiau chhapiaa ekee ekee va(n)dd dheeaa ||4||7||
351.e: Says Nanak, by hiding, how can the Lord be hidden? He has given each their share, one by one. ||4||7||

351.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
351.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
351.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

351.g: ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਬੇਲਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
351.t: karam karatoot bel bisathaaree raam naam fal hooaa ||
351.e: The vine of good actions and character has spread out, and it bears the fruit of the Lord's Name.

351.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਕੀਆ ॥੧॥
351.t: tis roop na rekh anaahadh vaajai sabadh nira(n)jan keeaa ||1||
351.e: The Name has no form or outline; it vibrates with the unstruck Sound Current; through the Word of the Shabad, the Immaculate Lord is revealed. ||1||

351.g: ਕਰੇ ਵਖਿਆਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
351.t: kare vakhiaan jaanai je koiee ||
351.e: One can speak on this only when he knows it.

351.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
351.t: a(n)mrit peevai soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
351.e: He alone drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

351.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਪੀਆ ਸੇ ਮਸਤ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਤੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਫਾਹੇ ॥
351.t: jin(h) peeaa se masat bhe hai tooTe ba(n)dhan faahe ||
351.e: Those who drink it in are enraptured; their bonds and shackles are cut away.

351.g: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਤਾ ਛੋਡੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲਾਹੇ ॥੨॥
351.t: jotee jot samaanee bheetar taa chhodde maiaa ke laahe ||2||
351.e: When one's light blends into the Divine Light, then the desire for Maya is ended. ||2||

351.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
351.t: sarab jot roop teraa dhekhiaa sagal bhavan teree maiaa ||
351.e: Among all lights, I behold Your Form; all the worlds are Your Maya.

351.g: ਰਾਰੈ ਰੂਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
351.t: raarai roop niraalam baiThaa nadhar kare vich chhaiaa ||3||
351.e: Among the tumults and forms, He sits in serene detachment; He bestows His Glance of Grace upon those who are engrossed in the illusion. ||3||

351.g: ਬੀਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
351.t: beenaa sabadh vajaavai jogee dharasan roop apaaraa ||
351.e: The Yogi who plays on the instrument of the Shabad gains the Blessed Vision of the Infinitely Beautiful Lord.

351.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
351.t: sabadh anaahadh so sahu raataa naanak kahai vichaaraa ||4||8||
351.e: He, the Lord, is immersed in the Unstruck Shabad of the Word, says Nanak, the humble and meek. ||4||8||

351.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
351.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
351.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

351.g: ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਾ ਕੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
351.t: mai gun galaa ke sir bhaar ||
351.e: My virtue is that I carry the load of my words upon my head.

351.g: ਗਲੀ ਗਲਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ॥
351.t: galee galaa sirajanahaar ||
351.e: The real words are the Words of the Creator Lord.

351.g: ਖਾਣਾ ਪੀਣਾ ਹਸਣਾ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
351.t: khaanaa peenaa hasanaa baadh ||
351.e: How useless are eating, drinking and laughing,

351.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਯਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
351.t: jab lag ridhai na aaveh yaadh ||1||
351.e: if the Lord is not cherished in the heart! ||1||

351.g: ਤਉ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਕੇਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
351.t: tau paravaeh kehee kiaa keejai ||
351.e: Why should someone care for anything else,

351.g: ਜਨਮਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਜੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
351.t: janam janam kichh leejee leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
351.e: if throughout his life, he gathers in that which is truly worth gathering? ||1||Pause||

351.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਮਤਾਗਲੁ ਮਤਾ ॥
351.t: man kee mat mataagal mataa ||
351.e: The intellect of the mind is like a drunken elephant.

351.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਖਤੋ ਖਤਾ ॥
351.t: jo kichh boleeaai sabh khato khataa ||
351.e: Whatever one utters is totally false, the most false of the false.

351.g: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਲੈ ਕੀਚੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
351.t: kiaa muh lai keechai aradhaas ||
351.e: So what face should we put on to offer our prayer,

351.g: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਾਖੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
351.t: paap pu(n)n dhui saakhee paas ||2||
351.e: when both virtue and vice are close at hand as witnesses? ||2||

351.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
351.t: jaisaa too(n) kareh taisaa ko hoi ||
351.e: As You make us, so we become.

351.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
351.t: tujh bin dhoojaa naahee koi ||
351.e: Without You, there is no other at all.

351.g: ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਹੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
351.t: jehee too(n) mat dheh tehee ko paavai ||
351.e: As is the understanding which You bestow, so do we receive.

351.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
351.t: tudh aape bhaavai tivai chalaavai ||3||
351.e: As it pleases Your Will, so do You lead us. ||3||

351.g: ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਪਰੀਆ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥
351.t: raag ratan pareeaa paravaar ||
351.e: The divine crystalline harmonies, their consorts, and their celestial families

351.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਰ ॥
351.t: tis vich upajai a(n)mrit saar ||
351.e: from them, the essence of Ambrosial Nectar is produced.

351.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
351.t: naanak karate kaa ih dhan maal ||
351.e: O Nanak, this is the wealth and property of the Creator Lord.

351.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੯॥
351.t: je ko boojhai eh beechaar ||4||9||
351.e: If only this essential reality were understood! ||4||9||

351.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
351.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
351.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

351.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
351.t: kar kirapaa apanai ghar aaiaa taa mil sakheeaa kaaj rachaiaa ||
351.e: When by His Grace He came to my home, then my companions met together to celebrate my marriage.

351.g: ਖੇਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਹੁ ਵੀਆਹਣ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
351.t: khel dhekh man anadh bhiaa sahu veeaahan aaiaa ||1||
351.e: Beholding this play, my mind became blissful; my Husband Lord has come to marry me. ||1||

351.g: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
351.t: gaavahu gaavahu kaamanee bibek beechaar ||
351.e: So sing - yes, sing the songs of wisdom and reflection, O brides.

351.g: ਹਮਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
351.t: hamarai ghar aaiaa jagajeevan bhataar ||1|| rahaau ||
351.e: My spouse, the Life of the world, has come into my home. ||1||Pause||

351.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਮਰਾ ਵੀਆਹੁ ਜਿ ਹੋਆ ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
351.t: guroo dhuaarai hamaraa veeaahu j hoaa jaa(n) sahu miliaa taa(n) jaaniaa ||
351.e: When I was married within the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, I met my Husband Lord, and I came to know Him.

351.g: ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਹੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
351.t: tih lokaa meh sabadh raviaa hai aap giaa man maaniaa ||2||
351.e: The Word of His Shabad is pervading the three worlds; when my ego was quieted, my mind became happy. ||2||

351.g: ਆਪਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਹੋਰਨਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
351.t: aapanaa kaaraj aap savaare horan kaaraj na hoiee ||
351.e: He Himself arranges His own affairs; His affairs cannot be arranged by anyone else.

351.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
351.t: jit kaaraj sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam hai gurmukh boojhai koiee ||3||
351.e: By the affair of this marriage, truth, contentment, mercy and faith are produced; but how rare is that Gurmukh who understands it! ||3||

351.g: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
351.t: bhanat naanak sabhanaa kaa pir eko soi ||
351.e: Says Nanak, that Lord alone is the Husband of all.

351.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
351.t: jis no nadhar kare saa sohaagan hoi ||4||10||
351.e: She, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace, becomes the happy soul-bride. ||4||10||

351.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
351.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
351.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

351.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਬਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
351.t: girahu ban samasar sahaj subhai ||
351.e: Home and forest are the same, for one who dwells in the balance of intuitive peace and poise.

351.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਤੁ ਭਈ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਠਾਇ ॥
351.t: dhuramat gat bhiee keerat Thai ||
351.e: His evil-mindedness departs, and the Praises of God take its place.

351.g: ਸਚ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਾਚਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਂਉ ॥
351.t: sach pauRee saachau mukh naa(n)au ||
351.e: To chant the True Name with one's mouth is the true ladder.

352.e: Serving the True Guru, one finds one's own place within the self. ||1||
To conquer the mind is the knowledge of the six Shaastras.
The Divine Light of the Lord God is perfectly pervading. ||1||Pause||
Excessive thirst for Maya makes people wear all sorts of religious robes.
The pain of corruption destroys the body's peace.
Sexual desire and anger steal the wealth of the self within.
But by abandoning duality, one is emancipated through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
In the Lord's Praise and adoration is intuitive peace, poise and bliss.
The Love of the Lord God is one's family and friends.
He Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Forgiver.

352.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
352.t: tan man har peh aagai ji(n)dh ||3||
352.e: My body and mind belong to the Lord; my life is at His Command. ||3||
Falsehood and corruption cause terrible suffering.
All the religious robes and social classes look just like dust.
Whoever is born, continues to come and go.
O Nanak, only the Naam and the Lord's Command are eternal and everlasting. ||4||11||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
In the pool is the one incomparably beautiful lotus.
It blossoms continually; its form is pure and fragrant.
The swans pick up the bright jewels.
They take on the essence of the All-powerful Lord of the Universe. ||1||
Whoever is seen, is subject to birth and death.

352.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
352.t: bin jal saravar kamal na dheesai ||1|| rahaau ||
352.e: In the pool without water, the lotus is not seen. ||1||Pause||
How rare are those who know and understand this secret.
The Vedas continually speak of the three branches.
One who merges into the knowledge of the Lord as absolute and related,
serves the True Guru and obtains the supreme status. ||2||
One who is imbued with the Love of the Lord and dwells continually upon Him is liberated.
He is the king of kings, and blossoms forth continually.
That one whom You preserve, by bestowing Your Mercy, O Lord,
even the sinking stone - You float that one across. ||3||

352.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
352.t: tirabhavan meh jot tirabhavan meh jaaniaa ||
352.e: Your Light is pervading the three worlds; I know that You are permeating the three worlds.

352.g: ਉਲਟ ਭਈ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥
352.t: aulaT bhiee ghar ghar meh aaniaa ||
352.e: When my mind turned away from Maya, I came to dwell in my own home.

352.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
352.t: ahinis bhagat kare liv lai || naanak tin kai laagai pai ||4||12||
352.e: Nanak falls at the feet of that person who immerses himself in the Lord's Love, and performs devotional worship night and day. ||4||12||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Receiving the True Teachings from the Guru, arguments depart.
But through excessive cleverness, one is only plastered with dirt.
The filth of attachment is removed by the True Name of the Lord.
By Guru's Grace, one remains lovingly attached to the Lord. ||1||
He is the Presence Ever-present; offer your prayers to Him.

352.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
352.t: dhukh sukh saach karate prabh paas ||1|| rahaau ||
352.e: Pain and pleasure are in the Hands of God, the True Creator. ||1||Pause||
One who practices falsehood comes and goes.
By speaking and talking, His limits cannot be found.

352.g: ਕਿਆ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
352.t: kiaa dhekhaa soojh boojh na paavai ||
352.e: Whatever one sees, is not understood.

352.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
352.t: bin naavai man tirapat na aavai ||2||
352.e: Without the Name, satisfaction does not enter into the mind. ||2||
Whoever is born is afflicted by disease,
tortured by the pain of egotism and Maya.

352.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਬਾਚੇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
352.t: se jan baache jo prabh raakhe ||
352.e: They alone are saved, who are protected by God.
Serving the True Guru, they drink in the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||
The unstable mind is restrained by tasting this Nectar.
Serving the True Guru, one comes to cherish the Ambrosial Nectar of the Shabad.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, the state of liberation is obtained.
O Nanak, self-conceit is eradicated from within. ||4||13||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

352.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
352.t: jo tin keeaa so sach theeaa ||
352.e: Whatever He has done, has proved to be true.
The True Guru bestows the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.
With the Naam in the heart, the mind is not separated from the Lord.
Night and day, one dwells with the Beloved. ||1||
O Lord, please keep me in the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

353.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
353.t: gur parasaadhee har ras paiaa naam padhaarath nau nidh paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
353.e: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord; I have received the wealth of the Naam and the nine treasures. ||1||Pause||

353.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
353.t: karam dharam sach saachaa naau ||
353.e: Those whose karma and Dharma - whose actions and faith - are in the True Name of the True Lord

353.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
353.t: taa kai sadh balihaarai jaau ||
353.e: I am forever a sacrifice to them.

353.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
353.t: jo har raate se jan paravaan ||
353.e: Those who are imbued with the Lord are accepted and respected.

353.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
353.t: tin kee sa(n)gat param nidhaan ||2||
353.e: In their company, the supreme wealth is obtained. ||2||

353.g: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
353.t: har var jin paiaa dhan naaree ||
353.e: Blessed is that bride, who has obtained the Lord as her Husband.

353.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
353.t: har siau raatee sabadh veechaaree ||
353.e: She is imbued with the Lord, and she reflects upon the Word of His Shabad.

353.g: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
353.t: aap tarai sa(n)gat kul taarai ||
353.e: She saves herself, and saves her family and friends as well.

353.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
353.t: satigur sev tat veechaarai ||3||
353.e: She serves the True Guru, and contemplates the essence of reality. ||3||

353.g: ਹਮਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
353.t: hamaree jaat pat sach naau ||
353.e: The True Name is my social status and honor.

353.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਤ ਭਾਉ ॥
353.t: karam dharam sa(n)jam sat bhaau ||
353.e: The love of the Truth is my karma and Dharma - my faith and my actions, and my self-control.

353.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
353.t: naanak bakhase poochh na hoi ||
353.e: O Nanak, one who is forgiven by the Lord is not called to account.

353.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਮੇਟੇ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
353.t: dhoojaa meTe eko soi ||4||14||
353.e: The One Lord erases duality. ||4||14||

353.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
353.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
353.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

353.g: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਆਈ ॥
353.t: eik aaveh ik jaaveh aaiee ||
353.e: Some come, and after they come, they go.

353.g: ਇਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
353.t: eik har raate raheh samaiee ||
353.e: Some are imbued with the Lord; they remain absorbed in Him.

353.g: ਇਕਿ ਧਰਨਿ ਗਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
353.t: eik dharan gagan meh Thaur na paaveh ||
353.e: Some find no place of rest at all, on the earth or in the sky.

353.g: ਸੇ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
353.t: se karamaheen har naam na dhiaaveh ||1||
353.e: Those who do not meditate on the Name of the Lord are the most unfortunate. ||1||

353.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
353.t: gur poore te gat mit paiee ||
353.e: From the Perfect Guru, the way to salvation is obtained.

353.g: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਵਤ ਅਤਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
353.t: eih sa(n)saar bikh vat at bhaujal gur sabadhee har paar la(n)ghaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
353.e: This world is a terrifying ocean of poison; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord helps us cross over. ||1||Pause||

353.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ॥
353.t: jin(h) kau aap le prabh mel ||
353.e: Those, whom God unites with Himself,

353.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਪੇਲਿ ॥
353.t: tin kau kaal na saakai pel ||
353.e: cannot be crushed by death.

353.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰਹਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
353.t: gurmukh niramal raheh piaare ||
353.e: The beloved Gurmukhs remain immaculately pure,

353.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
353.t: jiau jal a(n)bh uoopar kamal niraare ||2||
353.e: like the lotus in the water, which remains untouched. ||2||

353.g: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
353.t: buraa bhalaa kahu kis no kaheeaai ||
353.e: Tell me: who should we call good or bad?

353.g: ਦੀਸੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
353.t: dheesai braham gurmukh sach laheeaai ||
353.e: Behold the Lord God; the truth is revealed to the Gurmukh.

353.g: ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਉ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
353.t: akath kathau gurmat veechaar ||
353.e: I speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, contemplating the Guru's Teachings.

353.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
353.t: mil gur sa(n)gat paavau paar ||3||
353.e: I join the Sangat, the Guru's Congregation, and I find God's limits. ||3||

353.g: ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਦ ॥
353.t: saasat bedh si(n)mirat bahu bhedh ||
353.e: The Shaastras, the Vedas, the Simritees and all their many secrets;

353.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰੇਦ ॥
353.t: aThasaTh majan har ras redh ||
353.e: bathing at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage - all this is found by enshrining the sublime essence of the Lord in the heart.

353.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
353.t: gurmukh niramal mail na laagai ||
353.e: The Gurmukhs are immaculately pure; no filth sticks to them.

353.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
353.t: naanak hiradhai naam vadde dhur bhaagai ||4||15||
353.e: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides in the heart, by the greatest pre-ordained destiny. ||4||15||

353.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
353.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
353.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

353.g: ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
353.t: niv niv pai lagau gur apune aatam raam nihaariaa ||
353.e: Bowing down, again and again, I fall at the Feet of my Guru; through Him, I have seen the Lord, the Divine Self, within.

353.g: ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
353.t: karat beechaar hiradhai har raviaa hiradhai dhekh beechaariaa ||1||
353.e: Through contemplation and meditation, the Lord dwells within the heart; see this, and understand. ||1||

353.g: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
353.t: bolahu raam kare nisataaraa ||
353.e: So speak the Lord's Name, which shall emancipate you.

353.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
353.t: gur parasaadh ratan har laabhai miTai agiaan hoi ujeeaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
353.e: By Guru's Grace, the jewel of the Lord is found; ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Light shines forth. ||1||Pause||

353.g: ਰਵਨੀ ਰਵੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
353.t: ravanee ravai ba(n)dhan nahee tooTeh vich haumai bharam na jaiee ||
353.e: By merely saying it with the tongue, one's bonds are not broken, and egotism and doubt do not depart from within.

353.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੂਟੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
353.t: satigur milai ta haumai tooTai taa ko lekhai paiee ||2||
353.e: But when one meets the True Guru, egotism departs, and then, one realizes his destiny. ||2||

353.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
353.t: har har naam bhagat pria preetam sukh saagar ur dhaare ||
353.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet and dear to His devotees; it is the ocean of peace - enshrine it within the heart.

353.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
353.t: bhagat vachhal jagajeevan dhaataa mat gurmat har nisataare ||3||
353.e: The Lover of His devotees, the Life of the World, the Lord bestows the Guru's Teachings upon the intellect, and one is emancipated. ||3||

353.g: ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
353.t: man siau joojh marai prabh paae manasaa maneh samaae ||
353.e: One who dies fighting against his own stubborn mind finds God, and the desires of the mind are quieted.

353.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
353.t: naanak kirapaa kare jagajeevan sahaj bhai liv laae ||4||16||
353.e: O Nanak, if the Life of the World bestows His Mercy, one is intuitively attuned to the Love of the Lord. ||4||16||

353.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
353.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
353.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

353.g: ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
353.t: kis kau kaheh sunaaveh kis kau kis samajhaaveh samajh rahe ||
353.e: Unto whom do they speak? Unto whom do they preach? Who understands? Let them understand themselves.

353.g: ਕਿਸੈ ਪੜਾਵਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਗੁਣਿ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
353.t: kisai paRaaveh paR gun boojhe satigur sabadh sa(n)tokh rahe ||1||
353.e: Who do they teach? Through study, they come to realize the Lord's Glorious Virtues. Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, they come to dwell in contentment. ||1||

354.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, realize that He is pervading in all bodies;

354.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
354.t: har bhaj mere man gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||1|| rahaau ||
354.e: O my soul, vibrate on the Profound, Unfathomable Lord. ||1||Pause||
Loving devotion to the Lord brings endless waves of joy and delight.
One who dwells with the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day, is sanctified.
The birth into the world of the faithless cynic is totally useless.
The humble devotee of the Lord remains unattached. ||2||
The body which sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord is sanctified.
The soul remains conscious of the Lord, absorbed in His Love.
The Lord is the Infinite Primal Being, beyond the beyond, the priceless jewel.
My mind is totally content, imbued with my Beloved. ||3||
Those who speak and babble on and on, are truly dead.

354.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ॥
354.t: so prabh dhoor naahee prabh too(n) hai ||
354.e: God is not far away - O God, You are right here.
I have seen that the whole world is engrossed in Maya.
O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||17||
Aasaa, First Mehla, Thi-Thukay:
One is a beggar, living on charity;
another is a king, absorbed in himself.
One receives honor, and another dishonor.
The Lord destroys and creates; He is enshrined in His meditation.
There is no other as great as You.
So whom should I present to You? Who is good enough? ||1||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my only Support.
You are the Great Giver, the Doer, the Creator. ||1||Pause||
I have not walked on Your Path; I have followed the crooked path.
In the Court of the Lord, I find no place to sit.

354.g: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
354.t: man kaa a(n)dhulaa maiaa kaa ba(n)dh ||
354.e: I am mentally blind, in the bondage of Maya.
The wall of my body is breaking down, wearing away, growing weaker.
You have such high hopes of eating and living
- your breaths and morsels of food are already counted! ||2||
Night and day they are blind - please, bless them with Your Light.
They are drowning in the terrifying world-ocean, crying out in pain.

354.g: ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਜੋ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
354.t: kaheh suneh jo maaneh naau || hau balihaarai taa kai jaau ||
354.e: I am a sacrifice to those who chant, hear and believe in the Name.
Nanak utters this one prayer;
soul and body, all belong to You, Lord. ||3||

354.g: ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
354.t: jaa(n) too(n) dheh japee teraa naau ||
354.e: When You bless me, I chant Your Name.
Thus I find my seat in the Court of the Lord.

354.g: ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
354.t: jaa(n) tudh bhaavai taa dhuramat jai ||
354.e: When it pleases You, evil-mindedness departs,
and the jewel of spiritual wisdom comes to dwell in the mind.
When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then one comes to meet the True Guru.
Prays Nanak, carry us across the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||18||
Aasaa, First Mehla, Panch-Padhay:

354.g: ਦੁਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੇਨੁ ਪੰਖ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
354.t: dhudh bin dhen pa(n)kh bin pa(n)khee jal bin utabhuj kaam naahee ||
354.e: A cow without milk; a bird without wings; a garden without water - all are totally useless.

354.g: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਸਲਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਅੰਧੀ ਕੋਠੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
354.t: kiaa sulataan salaam vihoonaa a(n)dhee koThee teraa naam naahee ||1||
354.e: What is an emperor, without respect? The chamber of the soul is so dark, without the Name of the Lord. ||1||
How could I ever forget You? It would be so painful!

354.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
354.t: dhukh laagai too(n) visar naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
354.e: I would suffer such pain - please do not let me forget you. ||1||Pause||

354.g: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਭ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੰਨੀ ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
354.t: akhee a(n)dh jeebh ras naahee ka(n)nee pavan na vaajai ||
354.e: The eyes grow blind, the tongue does not taste, and the ears do not hear any sound.

354.g: ਚਰਣੀ ਚਲੈ ਪਜੂਤਾ ਆਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
354.t: charanee chalai pajootaa aagai vin sevaa fal laage ||2||
354.e: He walks on his feet only when supported by someone else; without serving the Lord, such are the fruits of life. ||2||

354.g: ਅਖਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਾਗ ਭੁਇ ਚੋਖੀ ਸਿੰਚਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇਹੀ ॥
354.t: akhar birakh baag bhui chokhee si(n)chit bhaau karehee ||
354.e: The Word is the tree; the garden of the heart is the farm; tend it, and irrigate it with the Lord's Love.

354.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੩॥
354.t: sabhanaa fal laagai naam eko bin karamaa kaise lehee ||3||
354.e: All these trees bear the fruit of the Name of the One Lord; but without the karma of good actions, how can anyone obtain it? ||3||

354.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਫਲੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
354.t: jete jeea tete sabh tere vin sevaa fal kisai naahee ||
354.e: As many living beings are there are, they are all Yours. Without selfless service, no one obtains any reward.

354.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਰਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
354.t: dhukh sukh bhaanaa teraa hovai vin naavai jeeau rahai naahee ||4||
354.e: Pain and pleasure come by Your Will; without the Name, the soul does not even exist. ||4||

354.g: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਜਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
354.t: mat vich maran jeevan hor kaisaa jaa jeevaa taa(n) jugat naahee ||
354.e: To die in the Teachings is to live. Otherwise, what is life? That is not the way.

355.g: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਜੀਆ ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੫॥੧੯॥
355.t: kahai naanak jeevaale jeeaa jeh bhaavai teh raakh tuhee ||5||19||
355.e: Says Nanak, He grants life to the living beings; O Lord, please keep me according to Your Will. ||5||19||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Let the body be the Brahmin, and let the mind be the loin-cloth;
let spiritual wisdom be the sacred thread, and meditation the ceremonial ring.
I seek the Name of the Lord and His Praise as my cleansing bath.
By Guru's Grace, I am absorbed into God. ||1||
O Pandit, O religious scholar, contemplate God in such a way

355.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਚਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਪੜਉ ਨਾਮੇ ਚਜੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
355.t: naame such naamo paRau naame chaj aachaar ||1|| rahaau ||
355.e: that His Name may sanctify you, that His Name may be your study, and His Name your wisdom and way of life. ||1||Pause||

355.g: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਨੇਊ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
355.t: baahar janeuoo jichar jot hai naal ||
355.e: The outer sacred thread is worthwhile only as long as the Divine Light is within.
So make the remembrance of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, your loin-cloth and the ceremonial mark on your forehead.
Here and hereafter, the Name alone shall stand by you.

355.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
355.t: vin naavai hor karam na bhaal ||2||
355.e: Do not seek any other actions, except the Name. ||2||
Worship the Lord in loving adoration, and burn your desire for Maya.
Behold only the One Lord, and do not seek out any other.
Become aware of reality, in the Sky of the Tenth Gate;
read aloud the Lord's Word, and contemplate it. ||3||
With the diet of His Love, doubt and fear depart.
With the Lord as your night watchman, no thief will dare to break in.
Let the knowledge of the One God be the ceremonial mark on your forehead.
Let the realization that God is within you be your discrimination. ||4||
Through ritual actions, God cannot be won over;
by reciting sacred scriptures, His value cannot be estimated.

355.g: ਅਸਟ ਦਸੀ ਚਹੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
355.t: asaT dhasee chahu bhedh na paiaa ||
355.e: The eighteen Puraanas and the four Vedas do not know His mystery.
O Nanak, the True Guru has shown me the Lord God. ||5||20||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
He alone is the selfless servant, slave and humble devotee,
who as Gurmukh, becomes the slave of his Lord and Master.

355.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
355.t: jin sir saajee tin fun goiee ||
355.e: He, who created the Universe, shall ultimately destroy it.

355.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
355.t: tis bin dhoojaa avar na koiee ||1||
355.e: Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||

355.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
355.t: saach naam gur sabadh veechaar || gurmukh saache saachai dharabaar ||1|| rahaau ||
355.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh reflects upon the True Name; in the True Court, he is found to be true. ||1||Pause||
The true supplication, the true prayer
- within the Mansion of His Sublime Presence, the True Lord Master hears and applauds these.
He summons the truthful to His Heavenly Throne
and bestows glorious greatness upon them; that which He wills, comes to pass. ||2||
The Power is Yours; You are my only Support.
The Word of the Guru's Shabad is my true password.
One who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, goes to Him openly.
With the password of truth, his way is not blocked. ||3||
The Pandit reads and expounds on the Vedas,
but he does not know the secret of the thing within himself.

355.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
355.t: gur bin sojhee boojh na hoi ||
355.e: Without the Guru, understanding and realization are not obtained;
but still God is True, pervading everywhere. ||4||
What should I say, or speak or describe?
Only You Yourself know, O Lord of total wonder.
Nanak takes the Support of the Door of the One God.
There, at the True Door, the Gurmukhs sustain themselves. ||5||21||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

355.g: ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
355.t: kaachee gaagar dheh dhuhelee upajai binasai dhukh paiee ||
355.e: The clay pitcher of the body is miserable; it suffers in pain through birth and death.

355.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
355.t: eih jag saagar dhutar kiau tareeaai bin har gur paar na paiee ||1||
355.e: How can this terrifying world-ocean be crossed over? Without the Lord - Guru, it cannot be crossed. ||1||

355.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਰੇ ॥
355.t: tujh bin avar na koiee mere piaare tujh bin avar na koi hare ||
355.e: Without You, there is no other at all, O my Beloved; without you, there is no other at all.

355.g: ਸਰਬੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਰੂਪੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
355.t: sarabee ra(n)gee roopee too(n)hai tis bakhase jis nadhar kare ||1|| rahaau ||
355.e: You are in all colors and forms; he alone is forgiven, upon whom You bestow Your Glance of Grace. ||1||Pause||

355.g: ਸਾਸੁ ਬੁਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਣ ਨ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਰੀ ॥
355.t: saas buree ghar vaas na dhevai pir siau milan na dhei buree ||
355.e: Maya, my mother-in-law, is evil; she does not let me live in my own home. The vicious one does not let me meet with my Husband Lord.

355.g: ਸਖੀ ਸਾਜਨੀ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੨॥
355.t: sakhee saajanee ke hau charan sarevau har gur kirapaa te nadhar dharee ||2||
355.e: I serve at the feet of my companions and friends; the Lord has showered me with His Mercy, through Guru's Grace. ||2||

356.g: ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
356.t: aap beechaar maar man dhekhiaa tum saa meet na avar koiee ||
356.e: Reflecting upon my self, and conquering my mind, I have seen that there is no other friend like You.

356.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
356.t: jiau too(n) raakheh tiv hee rahanaa dhukh sukh dheveh kareh soiee ||3||
356.e: As You keep me, so do I live. You are the Giver of peace and pleasure. Whatever You do, comes to pass. ||3||

356.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਦੋਊ ਬਿਨਾਸਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਭਈ ॥
356.t: aasaa manasaa dhouoo binaasat tirahu gun aas niraas bhiee ||
356.e: Hope and desire have both been dispelled; I have renounced my longing for the three qualities.

356.g: ਤੁਰੀਆਵਸਥਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲਹੀ ॥੪॥
356.t: tureeaavasathaa gurmukh paieeaai sa(n)t sabhaa kee oT lahee ||4||
356.e: The Gurmukh obtains the state of ecstasy, taking to the Shelter of the Saints' Congregation. ||4||

356.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
356.t: giaan dhiaan sagale sabh jap tap jis har hiradhai alakh abhevaa ||
356.e: All wisdom and meditation, all chanting and penance, come to one whose heart is filled with the Invisible, Inscrutable Lord.

356.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੫॥੨੨॥
356.t: naanak raam naam man raataa gurmat paae sahaj sevaa ||5||22||
356.e: O Nanak, one whose mind is imbued with the Lord's Name, finds the Guru's Teachings, and intuitively serves. ||5||22||
Aasaa, First Mehla, Panch-Padhay:
Your attachment to your family, your attachment to all your affairs
- renounce all your attachments, for they are all corrupt. ||1||

356.g: ਮੋਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਬੀਰ ॥
356.t: moh ar bharam tajahu tum(h) beer ||
356.e: Renounce your attachments and doubts, O brother,

356.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਰਵੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
356.t: saach naam ridhe ravai sareer ||1|| rahaau ||
356.e: and dwell upon the True Name within your heart and body. ||1||Pause||

356.g: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
356.t: sach naam jaa nav nidh paiee ||
356.e: When one receives the nine treasures of the True Name,
his children do not weep, and his mother does not grieve. ||2||
In this attachment, the world is drowning.
Few are the Gurmukhs who swim across. ||3||
In this attachment, people are reincarnated over and over again.
Attached to emotional attachment, they go to the city of Death. ||4||

356.g: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
356.t: gur dheekhiaa le jap tap kamaeh ||
356.e: You have received the Guru's Teachings - now practice meditation and penance.

356.g: ਨਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੂਟੈ ਨਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
356.t: naa moh tooTai naa thai paeh ||5||
356.e: If attachment is not broken, no one is approved. ||5||

356.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
356.t: nadhar kare taa eh moh jai ||
356.e: But if He bestows His Glance of Grace, then this attachment departs.
O Nanak, then one remains merged in the Lord. ||6||23||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
He Himself does everything, the True, Invisible, Infinite Lord.
I am a sinner, You are the Forgiver. ||1||
By Your Will, everything comes to pass.
One who acts in stubborn-mindedness is ruined in the end. ||1||Pause||
The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is engrossed in falsehood.
Without the meditative remembrance of the Lord, it suffers in sin. ||2||
Renounce evil-mindedness, and you shall reap the rewards.
Whoever is born, comes through the Unknowable and Mysterious Lord. ||3||
Such is my Friend and Companion;
meeting with the Guru, the Lord, devotion was implanted within me. ||4||
In all other transactions, one suffers loss.
The Name of the Lord is pleasing to Nanak's mind. ||5||24||
Aasaa, First Mehla, Chau-Padhay:
Contemplate and reflect upon knowledge, and you will become a benefactor to others.

356.g: ਜਾਂ ਪੰਚ ਰਾਸੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
356.t: jaa(n) pa(n)ch raasee taa(n) teerath vaasee ||1||
356.e: When you conquer the five passions, then you shall come to dwell at the sacred shrine of pilgrimage. ||1||
You shall hear the vibrations of the tinkling bells, when your mind is held steady.

356.g: ਤਉ ਜਮੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ਆਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
356.t: tau jam kahaa kare mo siau aagai ||1|| rahaau ||
356.e: So what can the Messenger of Death do to me hereafter? ||1||Pause||
When you abandon hope and desire, then you become a true Sannyaasi.

356.g: ਜਾਂ ਜਤੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਇਆ ਭੋਗੀ ॥੨॥
356.t: jaa(n) jat jogee taa(n) kaiaa bhogee ||2||
356.e: When the Yogi practices abstinence, then he enjoys his body. ||2||
Through compassion, the naked hermit reflects upon his inner self.
He slays his own self, instead of slaying others. ||3||
You, O Lord, are the One, but You have so many Forms.
Nanak does not know Your wondrous plays. ||4||25||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

356.g: ਏਕ ਨ ਭਰੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਿ ਧੋਵਾ ॥
356.t: ek na bhareeaa gun kar dhovaa ||
356.e: I am not stained by only one sin, that could be washed clean by virtue.

356.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਵਾ ॥੧॥
356.t: meraa sahu jaagai hau nis bhar sovaa ||1||
356.e: My Husband Lord is awake, while I sleep through the entire night of my life. ||1||
In this way, how can I become dear to my Husband Lord?

356.g: ਸਹੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਉ ਨਿਸ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
356.t: sahu jaagai hau nis bhar sovaa ||1|| rahaau ||
356.e: My Husband Lord remains awake, while I sleep through the entire night of my life. ||1||Pause||

357.e: With hope and desire, I approach His Bed,

357.g: ਆਗੈ ਸਹ ਭਾਵਾ ਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
357.t: aagai seh bhaavaa k na bhaavaa ||2||
357.e: but I do not know whether He will be pleased with me or not. ||2||

357.g: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
357.t: kiaa jaanaa kiaa hoigaa ree maiee ||
357.e: How do I know what will happen to me, O my mother?

357.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
357.t: har dharasan bin rahan na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
357.e: Without the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I cannot survive. ||1||Pause||

357.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਸ ਨ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥
357.t: prem na chaakhiaa meree tis na bujhaanee ||
357.e: I have not tasted His Love, and my thirst is not quenched.
My beautiful youth has run away, and now I, the soul-bride, repent and regret. ||3||
Even now, I am held by hope and desire.
I am depressed; I have no hope at all. ||1||Pause||
She overcomes her egotism, and adorns herself;
the Husband Lord now ravishes and enjoys the soul-bride on His Bed. ||4||
Then, O Nanak, the bride becomes pleasing to the Mind of her Husband Lord;

357.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਅਪਣੇ ਖਸਮ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੨੬॥
357.t: chhodd vaddaiee apane khasam samaavai ||1|| rahaau ||26||
357.e: she sheds her self-conceit, and is absorbed in her Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||26||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
In this world of my father's house, I, the soul-bride, have been very childish;

357.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
357.t: tis seh kee mai saar na jaanee ||1||
357.e: I did not realize the value of my Husband Lord. ||1||

357.g: ਸਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
357.t: sahu meraa ek dhoojaa nahee koiee ||
357.e: My Husband is the One; there is no other like Him.
If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then I shall meet Him. ||1||Pause||
In the next world of my in-law's house, I, the the soul-bride, shall realize Truth;
I shall come to know the celestial peace of my Husband Lord. ||2||
By Guru's Grace, such wisdom comes to me,
so that the soul-bride becomes pleasing to the Mind of the Husband Lord. ||3||

357.g: ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
357.t: kahat naanak bhai bhaav kaa kare seegaar ||
357.e: Says Nanak, she who adorns herself with the Love and the Fear of God,
enjoys her Husband Lord forever on His Bed. ||4||27||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

357.g: ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
357.t: n kis kaa poot na kis kee maiee ||
357.e: No one is anyone else's son, and no one is anyone else's mother.
Through false attachments, people wander around in doubt. ||1||
O My Lord and Master, I am created by You.

357.g: ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
357.t: jaa(n) too(n) dheh japee naau teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
357.e: If You give it to me, I will chant Your Name. ||1||Pause||
That person who is filled with all sorts of sins may pray at the Lord's Door,
but he is forgiven only when the Lord so wills. ||2||
By Guru's Grace, evil-mindedness is destroyed.
Wherever I look, there I find the One Lord. ||3||
Says Nanak, if one comes to such an understanding,
then he is absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||4||28||
Aasaa, First Mehla, Dho-Padhay:

357.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਰਵਰੜੈ ਭਈਲੇ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
357.t: tit saravaraRai bhieele nivaasaa paanee paavak tineh keeaa ||
357.e: In that pool of the world, the people have their homes; there, the Lord has created water and fire.

357.g: ਪੰਕਜੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
357.t: pa(n)kaj moh pag nahee chaalai ham dhekhaa teh ddoobeeale ||1||
357.e: In the mud of earthly attachment, their feet have become mired, and I have seen them drowning there. ||1||

357.g: ਮਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
357.t: man ek na chetas mooR manaa ||
357.e: O foolish people, why don't you remember the One Lord?

357.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
357.t: har bisarat tere gun galiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
357.e: Forgetting the Lord, your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||

357.g: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
357.t: naa hau jatee satee nahee paRiaa moorakh mugadhaa janam bhiaa ||
357.e: I am not a celibate, nor am I truthful, nor a scholar; I was born foolish and ignorant.

357.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੯॥
357.t: pranavat naanak tin(h) kee saranaa jin(h) too(n) naahee veesariaa ||2||29||
357.e: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who do not forget You, Lord. ||2||29||
Aasaa, First Mehla:

357.g: ਛਿਅ ਘਰ ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰ ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
357.t: chhia ghar chhia gur chhia upadhes ||
357.e: There are six systems of philosophy, six teachers, and six doctrines;
but the Teacher of teachers is the One Lord, who appears in so many forms. ||1||
That system, where the Praises of the Creator are sung

357.g: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
357.t: so ghar raakh vaddaiee toh ||1|| rahaau ||
357.e: - follow that system; in it rests greatness. ||1||Pause||

357.g: ਵਿਸੁਏ ਚਸਿਆ ਘੜੀਆ ਪਹਰਾ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਭਇਆ ॥ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
357.t: visue chasiaa ghaReeaa paharaa thitee vaaree maahu bhiaa || sooraj eko rut anek ||
357.e: As the seconds, minutes, hours, days, weekdays months and seasons all originate from the one sun,
O Nanak, so do all forms originate from the One Creator. ||2||30||

358.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
358.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
358.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

358.g: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
358.t: aasaa ghar teejaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
358.e: Aasaa, Third House, First Mehla:

358.g: ਲਖ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਵਾਜੇ ਨੇਜੇ ਲਖ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
358.t: lakh lasakar lakh vaaje neje lakh uTh kareh salaam ||
358.e: You may have thousands of armies, thousands of marching bands and lances, and thousands of men to rise and salute you.

358.g: ਲਖਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਖ ਉਠਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
358.t: lakhaa upar furamais teree lakh uTh raakheh maan ||
358.e: Your rule may extend over thousands of miles, and thousands of men may rise to honor you.

358.g: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਰਾਫਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
358.t: jaa(n) pat lekhai naa pavai taa(n) sabh niraafal kaam ||1||
358.e: But, if your honor is of no account to the Lord, then all of your ostentatious show is useless. ||1||

358.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
358.t: har ke naam binaa jag dha(n)dhaa ||
358.e: Without the Name of the Lord, the world is in turmoil.

358.g: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਭੋਲਾ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਅੰਧੋ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
358.t: je bahutaa samajhaieeaai bholaa bhee so a(n)dho a(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
358.e: Even though the fool may be taught again and again, he remains the blindest of the blind. ||1||Pause||

358.g: ਲਖ ਖਟੀਅਹਿ ਲਖ ਸੰਜੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਜਹਿ ਲਖ ਆਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
358.t: lakh khaTe'eeh lakh sa(n)je'eeh khaajeh lakh aaveh lakh jaeh ||
358.e: You may earn thousands, collect thousands, and spend thousands of dollars; thousands may come, and thousands may go.

358.g: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਅ ਕਿਥੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
358.t: jaa(n) pat lekhai naa pavai taa(n) jeea kithai fir paeh ||2||
358.e: But, if your honor is of no account to the Lord, then where will you go to find a safe haven? ||2||

358.g: ਲਖ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ਲਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
358.t: lakh saasat samajhaavanee lakh pa(n)ddit paReh puraan ||
358.e: Thousands of Shaastras may be explained to the mortal, and thousands of Pandits may read the Puraanas to him;

358.g: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੇ ਕੁਪਰਵਾਣ ॥੩॥
358.t: jaa(n) pat lekhai naa pavai taa(n) sabhe kuparavaan ||3||
358.e: but, if his honor is of no account to the Lord, then all of this is unacceptable. ||3||

358.g: ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
358.t: sach naam pat uoopajai karam naam karataar ||
358.e: Honor comes from the True Name, the Name of the Merciful Creator.

358.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
358.t: ahinis hiradhai je vasai naanak nadharee paar ||4||1||31||
358.e: If it abides in the heart, day and night, O Nanak, then the mortal shall swim across, by His Grace. ||4||1||31||

358.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
358.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
358.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

358.g: ਦੀਵਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
358.t: dheevaa meraa ek naam dhukh vich paiaa tel ||
358.e: The One Name is my lamp; I have put the oil of suffering into it.

358.g: ਉਨਿ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਖਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੧॥
358.t: aun chaanan oh sokhiaa chookaa jam siau mel ||1||
358.e: Its flame has dried up this oil, and I have escaped my meeting with the Messenger of Death. ||1||

358.g: ਲੋਕਾ ਮਤ ਕੋ ਫਕੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
358.t: lokaa mat ko fakaR pai ||
358.e: O people, do not make fun of me.

358.g: ਲਖ ਮੜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਏਕਠੇ ਏਕ ਰਤੀ ਲੇ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
358.t: lakh maRiaa kar ekaThe ek ratee le bhaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
358.e: Thousands of wooden logs, piled up together, need only a tiny flame to burn. ||1||Pause||

358.g: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਤਲਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੇਸਉ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
358.t: pi(n)dd patal meree kesau kiriaa sach naam karataar ||
358.e: The Lord is my festive dish, of rice balls on leafy plates; the True Name of the Creator Lord is my funeral ceremony.

358.g: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
358.t: aaithai othai aagai paachhai eh meraa aadhaar ||2||
358.e: Here and hereafter, in the past and in the future, this is my support. ||2||

358.g: ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਨਾਵੈ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਉ ॥
358.t: ga(n)g banaaras sifat tumaaree naavai aatam raau ||
358.e: The Lord's Praise is my River Ganges and my city of Benares; my soul takes its sacred cleansing bath there.

358.g: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥੩॥
358.t: sachaa naavan taa(n) theeaai jaa(n) ahinis laagai bhaau ||3||
358.e: That becomes my true cleansing bath, if night and day, I enshrine love for You. ||3||

358.g: ਇਕ ਲੋਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਛਮਿਛਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਵਟਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
358.t: eik lokee hor chhamichharee braahaman vaT pi(n)dd khai ||
358.e: The rice balls are offered to the gods and the dead ancestors, but it is the Brahmins who eat them!

358.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਕਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨਿਖੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
358.t: naanak pi(n)dd bakhasees kaa kabahoo(n) nikhooTas naeh ||4||2||32||
358.e: O Nanak, the rice balls of the Lord are a gift which is never exhausted. ||4||2||32||

358.g: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਮਹਲਾ ੧
358.t: aasaa ghar chauthhaa mahalaa pehilaa
358.e: Aasaa, Fourth House, First Mehla:

358.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
358.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
358.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

358.g: ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ ॥
358.t: dhevatiaa dharasan kai taiee dhookh bhookh teerath ke'ee ||
358.e: The Gods, yearning for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, suffered through pain and hunger at the sacred shrines.

358.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਵੇ ਭੇਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
358.t: jogee jatee jugat meh rahate kar kar bhagave bhekh bhe ||1||
358.e: The yogis and the celibates live their disciplined lifestyle, while others wear saffron robes and become hermits. ||1||

358.g: ਤਉ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ॥
358.t: tau kaaran saahibaa ra(n)g rate ||
358.e: For Your sake, O Lord Master, they are imbued with love.

358.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕੇਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
358.t: tere naam anekaa roop ana(n)taa kahan na jaahee tere gun kete ||1|| rahaau ||
358.e: Your Names are so many, and Your Forms are endless. No one can tell how may Glorious Virtues You have. ||1||Pause||

358.g: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਲਾਇਤਿ ਦੇਸ ਗਏ ॥
358.t: dhar ghar mahalaa hasatee ghoRe chhodd vilait dhes ge ||
358.e: Leaving behind hearth and home, palaces, elephants, horses and native lands, mortals have journeyed to foreign lands.

358.g: ਪੀਰ ਪੇਕਾਂਬਰ ਸਾਲਿਕ ਸਾਦਿਕ ਛੋਡੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ॥੨॥
358.t: peer pekaa(n)bar saalik saadhik chhoddee dhuneeaa thai pe ||2||
358.e: The spiritual leaders, prophets, seers and men of faith renounced the world, and became acceptable. ||2||

358.g: ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਕਾਪੜ ਛੋਡੇ ਚਮੜ ਲੀਏ ॥
358.t: saadh sahaj sukh ras kas tajeeale kaapaR chhodde chamaR le'ee ||
358.e: Renouncing tasty delicacies, comfort, happiness and pleasures, some have abandoned their clothes and now wear skins.

358.g: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਦਰਦਵੰਦ ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਭਏ ॥੩॥
358.t: dhukhe'ee dharadhava(n)dh dhar terai naam rate dharaves bhe ||3||
358.e: Those who suffer in pain, imbued with Your Name, have become beggars at Your Door. ||3||

358.g: ਖਲੜੀ ਖਪਰੀ ਲਕੜੀ ਚਮੜੀ ਸਿਖਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਧੋਤੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ॥
358.t: khalaRee khaparee lakaRee chamaRee sikhaa soot dhotee keen(h)ee ||
358.e: Some wear skins, and carry begging bowls, bearing wooden staffs, and sitting on deer skins. Others raise their hair in tufts and wear sacred threads and loin-cloths.

358.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹਉ ਸਾਂਗੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੈਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੩॥
358.t: too(n) saahib hau saa(n)gee teraa pranavai naanak jaat kaisee ||4||1||33||
358.e: You are the Lord Master, I am just Your puppet. Prays Nanak, what is my social status to be? ||4||1||33||

359.g: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਮਹਲਾ ੧
359.t: aasaa ghar panjavaa mahalaa pehilaa
359.e: Aasaa, Fifth House, First Mehla:

359.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
359.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
359.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

359.g: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਗੁਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸੇ ॥
359.t: bheetar pa(n)ch gupat man vaase ||
359.e: The five evil passions dwell hidden within the mind.

359.g: ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
359.t: thir na raheh jaise bhaveh udhaase ||1||
359.e: They do not remain still, but move around like wanderers. ||1||

359.g: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ॥
359.t: man meraa dhiaal setee thir na rahai ||
359.e: My soul does not stay held by the Merciful Lord.

359.g: ਲੋਭੀ ਕਪਟੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਧਿਕ ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
359.t: lobhee kapaTee paapee paakha(n)ddee maiaa adhik lagai ||1|| rahaau ||
359.e: It is greedy, deceitful, sinful and hypocritical, and totally attached to Maya. ||1||Pause||

359.g: ਫੂਲ ਮਾਲਾ ਗਲਿ ਪਹਿਰਉਗੀ ਹਾਰੋ ॥
359.t: fool maalaa gal pahiraugee haaro ||
359.e: I will decorate my neck with garlands of flowers.

359.g: ਮਿਲੈਗਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਤਬ ਕਰਉਗੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
359.t: milaigaa preetam tab karaugee seegaaro ||2||
359.e: When I meet my Beloved, then I will put on my decorations. ||2||

359.g: ਪੰਚ ਸਖੀ ਹਮ ਏਕੁ ਭਤਾਰੋ ॥
359.t: pa(n)ch sakhee ham ek bhataaro ||
359.e: I have five companions and one Spouse.

359.g: ਪੇਡਿ ਲਗੀ ਹੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
359.t: pedd lagee hai jeeaRaa chaalanahaaro ||3||
359.e: It is ordained from the very beginning, that the soul must ultimately depart. ||3||

359.g: ਪੰਚ ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੁਦਨੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ॥
359.t: pa(n)ch sakhee mil rudhan karehaa ||
359.e: The five companions will lament together.

359.g: ਸਾਹੁ ਪਜੂਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
359.t: saahu pajootaa pranavat naanak lekhaa dhehaa ||4||1||34||
359.e: When the soul is trapped, prays Nanak, it is called to account. ||4||1||34||

359.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
359.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
359.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

359.g: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
359.t: aasaa ghar chhayvaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
359.e: Aasaa, Sixth House, First Mehla:

359.g: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਜੇ ਗਹਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਉਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੂਤ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
359.t: man motee je gahanaa hovai paun hovai soot dhaaree ||
359.e: If the pearl of the mind is strung like a jewel on the thread of the breath,

359.g: ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਰਾਵੈ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
359.t: khimaa seegaar kaaman tan pahirai raavai laal piaaree ||1||
359.e: and the soul-bride adorns her body with compassion, then the Beloved Lord will enjoy His lovely bride. ||1||

359.g: ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮੋਹੀ ॥
359.t: laal bahu gun kaaman mohee ||
359.e: O my Love, I am fascinated by Your many glories;

359.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅਵਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
359.t: tere gun hoh na avaree ||1|| rahaau ||
359.e: Your Glorious Virtues are not found in any other. ||1||Pause||

359.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਲੇ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੰਤੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
359.t: har har haar ka(n)Th le pahirai dhaamodhar dha(n)t leiee ||
359.e: If the bride wears the garland of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, around her neck, and if she uses the toothbrush of the Lord;

359.g: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੰਗਨ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਧਰੇਈ ॥੨॥
359.t: kar kar karataa ka(n)gan pahirai in bidh chit dhareiee ||2||
359.e: and if she fashions and wears the bracelet of the Creator Lord around her wrist, then she shall hold her consciousness steady. ||2||

359.g: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਕਰ ਮੁੰਦਰੀ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਟੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
359.t: madhusoodhan kar mu(n)dharee pahirai paramesar paT leiee ||
359.e: She should make the Lord, the Slayer of demons, her ring, and take the Transcendent Lord as her silken clothes.

359.g: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੜੀ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰਮਾ ਦੇਈ ॥੩॥
359.t: dheeraj dhaRee ba(n)dhaavai kaaman sreera(n)g suramaa dheiee ||3||
359.e: The soul-bride should weave patience into the braids of her hair, and apply the lotion of the Lord, the Great Lover. ||3||

359.g: ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਜੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਾਲੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
359.t: man ma(n)dhar je dheepak jaale kaiaa sej kareiee ||
359.e: If she lights the lamp in the mansion of her mind, and makes her body the bed of the Lord,

359.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਾਉ ਜਬ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਵੈ ਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੫॥
359.t: giaan raau jab sejai aavai ta naanak bhog kareiee ||4||1||35||
359.e: then, when the King of spiritual wisdom comes to her bed, He shall take her, and enjoy her. ||4||1||35||

359.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
359.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
359.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

359.g: ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
359.t: keetaa hovai kare karaiaa tis kiaa kaheeaai bhaiee ||
359.e: The created being acts as he is made to act; what can be said to him, O Siblings of Destiny?

359.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
359.t: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa keete kiaa chaturaiee ||1||
359.e: Whatever the Lord is to do, He is doing; what cleverness could be used to affect Him? ||1||

359.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
359.t: teraa hukam bhalaa tudh bhaavai ||
359.e: The Order of Your Will is so sweet, O Lord; this is pleasing to You.

359.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
359.t: naanak taa kau milai vaddaiee saache naam samaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
359.e: O Nanak, he alone is honored with greatness, who is absorbed in the True Name. ||1||Pause||

359.g: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
359.t: kirat piaa paravaanaa likhiaa baahuR hukam na hoiee ||
359.e: The deeds are done according to pre-ordained destiny; no one can turn back this Order.

359.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤੈਸਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
359.t: jaisaa likhiaa taisaa paRiaa meT na sakai koiee ||2||
359.e: As it is written, so it comes to pass; no one can erase it. ||2||

359.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ॥
359.t: je ko dharageh bahutaa bolai naau pavai baajaaree ||
359.e: He who talks on and on in the Lord's Court is known as a joker.

359.g: ਸਤਰੰਜ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਚੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
359.t: satara(n)j baajee pakai naahee kachee aavai saaree ||3||
359.e: He is not successful in the game of chess, and his chessmen do not reach their goal. ||3||

359.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
359.t: naa ko paRiaa pa(n)ddit beenaa naa ko moorakh ma(n)dhaa ||
359.e: By himself, no one is literate, learned or wise; no one is ignorant or evil.

359.g: ਬੰਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੬॥
359.t: ba(n)dhee a(n)dhar sifat karaae taa kau kaheeaai ba(n)dhaa ||4||2||36||
359.e: When, as a slave, one praises the Lord, only then is he known as a human being. ||4||2||36||

359.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
359.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
359.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

359.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਹਢਾਵਉ ॥
359.t: gur kaa sabadh manai meh mu(n)dhraa khi(n)thaa khimaa haddaavau ||
359.e: Let the Word of the Guru's Shabad be the ear-rings in your mind, and wear the patched coat of tolerance.

359.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਉ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
