359.t: jo kichh karai bhalaa kar maanau sahaj jog nidh paavau ||1||
359.e: Whatever the Lord does, look upon that as good; thus you shall obtain the treasure of Sehj Yoga. ||1||

360.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਗੀ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੰ ॥
360.t: baabaa jugataa jeeau jugeh jug jogee param ta(n)t meh joga(n) ||
360.e: O father, the soul which is united in union as a Yogi, remains united in the supreme essence throughout the ages.

360.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
360.t: a(n)mrit naam nira(n)jan paiaa giaan kaiaa ras bhoga(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
360.e: One who has obtained the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord - his body enjoys the pleasure of spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

360.g: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਉ ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
360.t: siv nagaree meh aasan baisau kalap tiaagee baadha(n) ||
360.e: In the Lord's City, he sits in his Yogic posture, and he forsakes his desires and conflicts.

360.g: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਦੰ ॥੨॥
360.t: si(n)n(g)ee sabadh sadhaa dhun sohai ahinis poorai naadha(n) ||2||
360.e: The sound of the horn ever rings out its beautiful melody, and day and night, he is filled with the sound current of the Naad. ||2||

360.g: ਪਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ ॥
360.t: pat veechaar giaan mat dda(n)ddaa varatamaan bibhoota(n) ||
360.e: My cup is reflective meditation, and spiritual wisdom is my walking stick; to dwell in the Lord's Presence is the ashes I apply to my body.

360.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਤੀਤੰ ॥੩॥
360.t: har keerat raharaas hamaaree gurmukh pa(n)th ateeta(n) ||3||
360.e: The Praise of the Lord is my occupation; and to live as Gurmukh is my pure religion. ||3||

360.g: ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੰਮਿਆ ਨਾਨਾ ਵਰਨ ਅਨੇਕੰ ॥
360.t: sagalee jot hamaaree sa(n)miaa naanaa varan aneka(n) ||
360.e: My arm-rest is to see the Lord's Light in all, although their forms and colors are so numerous.

360.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਏਕੰ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੭॥
360.t: kahu naanak sun bharathar jogee paarabraham liv eka(n) ||4||3||37||
360.e: Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: love only the Supreme Lord God. ||4||3||37||

360.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
360.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
360.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

360.g: ਗੁੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਵੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
360.t: guR kar giaan dhiaan kar dhaavai kar karanee kas paieeaai ||
360.e: Make spiritual wisdom your molasses, and meditation your scented flowers; let good deeds be the herbs.

360.g: ਭਾਠੀ ਭਵਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਾ ਪੋਚਾ ਇਤੁ ਰਸਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਚੁਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
360.t: bhaaThee bhavan prem kaa pochaa it ras amiau chuaaieeaai ||1||
360.e: Let devotional faith be the distilling fire, and your love the ceramic cup. Thus the sweet nectar of life is distilled. ||1||

360.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜ ਰੰਗ ਰਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
360.t: baabaa man matavaaro naam ras peevai sahaj ra(n)g rach rahiaa ||
360.e: O Baba, the mind is intoxicated with the Naam, drinking in its Nectar. It remains absorbed in the Lord's Love.

360.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਗਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
360.t: ahinis banee prem liv laagee sabadh anaahadh gahiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
360.e: Night and day, remaining attached to the Love of the Lord, the celestial music of the Shabad resounds. ||1||Pause||

360.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪੀਆਏ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
360.t: pooraa saach piaalaa sahaje tiseh peeaae jaa kau nadhar kare ||
360.e: The Perfect Lord naturally gives the cup of Truth, to the one upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace.

360.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਦਿ ਛੂਛੈ ਭਾਉ ਧਰੇ ॥੨॥
360.t: a(n)mirat kaa vaapaaree hovai kiaa madh chhoochhai bhaau dhare ||2||
360.e: One who trades in this Nectar - how could he ever love the wine of the world? ||2||

360.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੀਵਤ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
360.t: gur kee saakhee a(n)mirat baanee peevat hee paravaan bhiaa ||
360.e: The Teachings of the Guru, the Ambrosial Bani - drinking them in, one becomes acceptable and renowned.

360.g: ਦਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੈ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਆ ॥੩॥
360.t: dhar dharasan kaa preetam hovai mukat baiku(n)Thai karai kiaa ||3||
360.e: Unto the one who loves the Lord's Court, and the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, of what use is liberation or paradise? ||3||

360.g: ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਾ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
360.t: sifatee rataa sadh bairaagee jooaai janam na haarai ||
360.e: Imbued with the Lord's Praises, one is forever a Bairaagee, a renunciate, and one's life is not lost in the gamble.

360.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਖੀਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੮॥
360.t: kahu naanak sun bharathar jogee kheevaa a(n)mirat dhaarai ||4||4||38||
360.e: Says Nanak, listen, O Bharthari Yogi: drink in the intoxicating nectar of the Lord. ||4||4||38||

360.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
360.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
360.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

360.g: ਖੁਰਾਸਾਨ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਹਿੰਦੁਸਤਾਨੁ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥
360.t: khuraasaan khasamaanaa keeaa hi(n)dhusataan ddaraiaa ||
360.e: Having attacked Khuraasaan, Baabar terrified Hindustan.

360.g: ਆਪੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਗਲੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
360.t: aapai dhos na dheiee karataa jam kar mugal chaRaiaa ||
360.e: The Creator Himself does not take the blame, but has sent the Mugal as the messenger of death.

360.g: ਏਤੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਈ ਕਰਲਾਣੇ ਤੈਂ ਕੀ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
360.t: etee maar piee karalaane tai(n) kee dharadh na aaiaa ||1||
360.e: There was so much slaughter that the people screamed. Didn't You feel compassion, Lord? ||1||

360.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
360.t: karataa too(n) sabhanaa kaa soiee ||
360.e: O Creator Lord, You are the Master of all.

360.g: ਜੇ ਸਕਤਾ ਸਕਤੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
360.t: je sakataa sakate kau maare taa man ros na hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
360.e: If some powerful man strikes out against another man, then no one feels any grief in their mind. ||1||Pause||

360.g: ਸਕਤਾ ਸੀਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਪੈ ਵਗੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਸਾ ਪੁਰਸਾਈ ॥
360.t: sakataa seeh maare pai vagai khasamai saa purasaiee ||
360.e: But if a powerful tiger attacks a flock of sheep and kills them, then its master must answer for it.

360.g: ਰਤਨ ਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਵਿਗੋਏ ਕੁਤਂੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
360.t: ratan vigaaR vigoe kuta(n)ee muiaa saar na kaiee ||
360.e: This priceless country has been laid waste and defiled by dogs, and no one pays any attention to the dead.

360.g: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
360.t: aape joR vichhoRe aape vekh teree vaddiaaiee ||2||
360.e: You Yourself unite, and You Yourself separate; I gaze upon Your Glorious Greatness. ||2||

360.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਏ ਵਡਾ ਸਾਦ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
360.t: je ko naau dharaae vaddaa saadh kare man bhaane ||
360.e: One may give himself a great name, and revel in the pleasures of the mind,

360.g: ਖਸਮੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਕੀੜਾ ਆਵੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਚੁਗੈ ਦਾਣੇ ॥
360.t: khasamai nadharee keeRaa aavai jete chugai dhaane ||
360.e: but in the Eyes of the Lord and Master, he is just a worm, for all the corn that he eats.

360.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥੩॥੫॥੩੯॥
360.t: mar mar jeevai taa kichh paae naanak naam vakhaane ||3||5||39||
360.e: Only one who dies to his ego while yet alive, obtains the blessings, O Nanak, by chanting the Lord's Name. ||3||5||39||

360.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੩
360.t: raag aasaa ghar doojaa mahalaa teejaa
360.e: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Third Mehla:

360.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
360.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
360.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

360.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ॥
360.t: har dharasan paavai vaddabhaag ||
360.e: The Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is obtained by great good fortune.

360.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
360.t: gur kai sabadh sachai bairaag ||
360.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, true detachment is obtained.

360.g: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
360.t: khaT dharasan varatai varataaraa ||
360.e: The six systems of philosophy are pervasive,

361.e: but the Guru's system is profound and unequalled. ||1||

361.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
361.t: gur kai dharasan mukat gat hoi ||
361.e: The Guru's system is the way to liberation.

361.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
361.t: saachaa aap vasai man soi ||1|| rahaau ||
361.e: The True Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||
Through the Guru's system, the world is saved,
if it is embraced with love and affection.
How rare is that person who truly loves the Guru's Way.

361.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
361.t: gur kai dharasan sadhaa sukh hoi ||2||
361.e: Through the Guru's system, everlasting peace is obtained. ||2||
Through the Guru's system, the Door of Salvation is obtained.
Serving the True Guru, one's family is saved.
There is no salvation for those who have no Guru.
Beguiled by worthless sins, they are struck down. ||3||

361.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
361.t: gur kai sabadh sukh saa(n)t sareer ||
361.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the body finds peace and tranquility.

361.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
361.t: gurmukh taa kau lagai na peer ||
361.e: The Gurmukh is not afflicted by pain.
The Messenger of Death does not come near him.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord. ||4||1||40||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, eradicates his self-conceit from within.
He serves the True Guru, with no iota of self-interest.
The Fearless Lord, the Great Giver, ever abides in his mind.
The True Bani of the Word is obtained only by good destiny. ||1||
So gather merits, and let your demerits depart from within you.

361.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
361.t: poore gur kai sabadh samaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
361.e: You shall be absorbed into the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

361.g: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
361.t: gunaa kaa gaahak hovai so gun jaanai ||
361.e: One who purchases merits, knows the value of these merits.
He chants the Ambrosial Nectar of the Word, and the Name of the Lord.
Through the True Bani of the Word, he becomes pure.
Through merit, the Name is obtained. ||2||
The invaluable merits cannot be acquired.
The pure mind is absorbed into the True Word of the Shabad.
How very fortunate are those who meditate on the Naam,
and ever enshrine in their minds the Lord, the Giver of merit. ||3||

361.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
361.t: jo gun sa(n)grahai tin(h) balihaarai jaau ||
361.e: I am a sacrifice to those who gather merits.
At the Gate of Truth, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True One.
He Himself spontaneously bestows His gifts.
O Nanak, the value of the Lord cannot be described. ||4||2||41||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
Great is the greatness of the True Guru;
He merges in His Merger, those who have been separated for so long.
He Himself merges the merged in His Merger.
He Himself knows His own worth. ||1||

361.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
361.t: har kee keemat kin bidh hoi ||
361.e: How can anyone appraise the Lord's worth?

361.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
361.t: har apara(n)par agam agochar gur kai sabadh milai jan koi ||1|| rahaau ||
361.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one may merge with the Infinite, Unapproachable and Incomprehensible Lord. ||1||Pause||
Few are the Gurmukhs who know His worth.
How rare are those who receive the Lord's Grace.
Through the Sublime Bani of His Word, one becomes sublime.
The Gurmukh chants the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
Without the Name, the body suffers in pain;
but when one meets the True Guru, then that pain is removed.
Without meeting the Guru, the mortal earns only pain.
The self-willed manmukh receives only more punishment. ||3||

361.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਅਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
361.t: har kaa naam meeThaa at ras hoi ||
361.e: The essence of the Lord's Name is so very sweet;
he alone drinks it, whom the Lord causes to drink it.

361.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
361.t: gur kirapaa te har ras paae ||
361.e: By Guru's Grace, the essence of the Lord is obtained.
O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, salvation is attained. ||4||3||42||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
My God is True, deep and profound.
Serving Him, the body acquires peace and tranquility.
Through the Word of the Shabad, His humble servants easily swim across.

361.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਮ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
361.t: tin kai ham sadh laageh pai ||1||
361.e: I fall at their feet forever and ever. ||1||

362.g: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
362.t: jo man raate har ra(n)g lai ||
362.e: Those being whose minds are imbued and drenched with the Lord's Love

362.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
362.t: tin kaa janam maran dhukh laathaa te har dharageh mile subhai ||1|| rahaau ||
362.e: - their pains of birth and death are taken away. They are automatically ushered into the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
One who has tasted the Shabad, obtains the true flavor.
The Name of the Lord abides within his mind.
The Lord God is Eternal and All-pervading.
He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away. ||2||
Everyone talks and speaks through speech;
the Lord Himself forgives, and unites us with Himself.
By merely speaking and talking, He is not obtained.
By Guru's Grace, He comes to abide in the mind. ||3||
The Gurmukh eradicates his self-conceit from within.
He is imbued with the Lord's Love, having discarded worldly attachment.
He contemplates the utterly Immaculate Word of the Guru's Shabad.
O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is our Salvation. ||4||4||43||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
Attached to the love of duality, one only incurs pain.
Without the Word of the Shabad, one's life is wasted away in vain.
Serving the True Guru, understanding is obtained,
and then, one is not attached to the love of duality. ||1||
Those who hold fast to their roots, become acceptable.

362.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
362.t: anadhin raam naam jap hiradhai gur sabadhee har eko jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
362.e: Night and day, they meditate within their hearts on the Lord's Name; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they know the One Lord. ||1||Pause||
One who is attached to the branch, does not receive the fruits.
For blind actions, blind punishment is received.
The blind, self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest.

362.g: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੨॥
362.t: bisaTaa kaa keeRaa bisaTaa maeh pachai ||2||
362.e: He is a maggot in manure, and in manure he shall rot away. ||2||

362.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
362.t: gur kee sevaa sadhaa sukh paae ||
362.e: Serving the Guru, everlasting peace is obtained.
Joining the True Congregation, the Sat Sangat, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.
One who contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
saves himself, and his family as well. ||3||
Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, the Naam resounds;
O Nanak, through the Word of the Shabad, one finds the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within the home of the heart.

362.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
362.t: gurmat sat sar har jal naiaa ||
362.e: Under Guru's Instruction, bathe in the Pool of Truth, in the Water of the Lord;
thus the filth of evil-mindedness and sin shall all be washed away. ||4||5||44||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
The self-willed manmukhs are dying; they are wasting away in death.
In the love of duality, they murder their own souls.
Crying out, ""Mine, mine!"", they are ruined.

362.g: ਆਤਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
362.t: aatam na cheen(h)ai bharamai vich sootaa ||1||
362.e: They do not remember their souls; they are asleep in superstition. ||1||
He alone dies a real death, who dies in the Word of the Shabad.

362.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮ ਜਾਣਾਈ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
362.t: ausatat ni(n)dhaa gur sam jaanaiee is jug meh laahaa har jap lai jai ||1|| rahaau ||
362.e: The Guru has inspired me to realize, that praise and slander are one and the same; in this world, the profit is obtained by chanting the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are dissolved within the womb.
Useless is the birth of those who are lured by duality.
Without the Naam, all are burning in pain.
The Perfect True Guru has given me this understanding. ||2||
The fickle mind is struck down so many times.
Having lost this opportunity, no place of rest shall be found.
Cast into the womb of reincarnation, the mortal lives in manure;
in such a home, the self-willed manmukh takes up residence. ||3||

362.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
362.t: apune satigur kau sadhaa bal jaiee ||
362.e: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru;
the light of the Gurmukh blends with the Divine Light of the Lord.
Through the Immaculate Bani of the Word, the mortal dwells within the home of his own inner self.
O Nanak, he conquers his ego, and remains forever detached. ||4||6||45||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
The Lord's slave sets aside his own social status.

363.e: He dedicates his mind and body to the True Guru, and seeks His Sanctuary.
His greatest greatness is that the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is in his heart.
The Beloved Lord God is his constant companion. ||1||
He alone is the Lord's slave, who remains dead while yet alive.

363.g: ਸੋਗੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
363.t: sog harakh dhui sam kar jaanai gur parasaadhee sabadh udharai ||1|| rahaau ||
363.e: He looks upon pleasure and pain alike; by Guru's Grace, he is saved through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
He does his deeds according to the Lord's Primal Command.

363.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
363.t: bin sabadhai ko thai na paiee ||
363.e: Without the Shabad, no one is approved.
Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, the Naam abides within the mind.
He Himself gives His gifts, without hesitation. ||2||
The self-willed manmukh wanders around the world in doubt.
Without any capital, he makes false transactions.

363.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਵਖਰੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
363.t: vin raasee vakhar palai na pai ||
363.e: Without any capital, he does not obtain any merchandise.
The mistaken manmukh wastes away his life. ||3||
One who serves the True Guru is the Lord's slave.
His social status is exalted, and his reputation is exalted.

363.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
363.t: gur pauRee sabh dhoo uoochaa hoi ||
363.e: Climbing the Guru's Ladder, he becomes the most exalted of all.
O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained. ||4||7||46||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
The self-willed manmukh practices falsehood, only falsehood.

363.g: ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
363.t: khasamai kaa mahal kadhe na paavai ||
363.e: He never attains the Mansion of the Lord Presence.
Attached to duality, he wanders, deluded by doubt.
Entangled in worldly attachments, he comes and goes. ||1||
Behold, the decorations of the discarded bride!

363.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤਿ ਧਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਝੂਠੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾੳ ॥
363.t: putr kalat dhan maiaa chit laae jhooTh moh paakha(n)dd vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
363.e: Her consciousness is attached to children, spouse, wealth, and Maya, falsehood, emotional attachment, hypocrisy and corruption. ||1||Pause||
She who is pleasing to God is forever a happy soul-bride.
She makes the Word of the Guru's Shabad her decoration.
Her bed is so comfortable; she enjoys her Lord, night and day.
Meeting her Beloved, the obtains eternal peace. ||2||

363.g: ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
363.t: saa sohaagan saachee jis saach piaar ||
363.e: She is a true, virtuous soul-bride, who enshrines love for the True Lord.

363.g: ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
363.t: apanaa pir raakhai sadhaa ur dhaar ||
363.e: She keeps her Husband Lord always clasped to her heart.
She sees Him near at hand, ever-present.
My God is all-pervading everywhere. ||3||
Social status and beauty will not go with you hereafter.
As are the deeds done here, so does one become.
Through the Word of the Shabad, one becomes the highest of the high.
O Nanak, he is absorbed in the True Lord. ||4||8||47||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
The Lord's humble servant is imbued with devotional love, effortlessly and spontaneously.

363.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
363.t: gur kai bhai saachai saach samai ||
363.e: Through awe and fear of the Guru, he is truly absorbed in the True One.

363.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
363.t: bin gur poore bhagat na hoi ||
363.e: Without the Perfect Guru, devotional love is not obtained.
The self-willed manmukhs lose their honor, and cry out in pain. ||1||

363.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
363.t: mere man har jap sadhaa dhiaai ||
363.e: O my mind, chant the Lord's Name, and meditate on Him forever.

363.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
363.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh hovai dhin raatee jo ichhai soiee fal pai ||1|| rahaau ||
363.e: You shall always be in ecstasy, day and night, and you shall obtain the fruits of your desires. ||1||Pause||
Through the Perfect Guru, the Perfect Lord is obtained,
and the Shabad, the True Name, is enshrined in the mind.
One who bathes in the Pool of Ambrosial Nectar becomes immaculately pure within.
He becomes forever sanctified, and is absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||
He sees the Lord God ever-present.
By Guru's Grace, he sees the Lord permeating and pervading everywhere.
Wherever I go, there I see Him.

363.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
363.t: gur bin dhaataa avar na koi ||3||
363.e: Without the Guru, there is no other Giver. ||3||
The Guru is the ocean, the perfect treasure,
the most precious jewel and priceless ruby.
By Guru's Grace, the Great Giver blesses us;
O Nanak, the Forgiving Lord forgives us. ||4||9||48||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
The Guru is the Ocean; the True Guru is the Embodiment of Truth.
Through perfect good destiny, one serves the Guru.

364.e: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself inspires to understand.
By Guru's Grace, one serves Him. ||1||
With the jewel of spiritual wisdom, total understanding is obtained.

364.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
364.t: gur parasaadh agiaan binaasai anadhin jaagai vekhai sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
364.e: By Guru's Grace, ignorance is dispelled; one then remains wakeful, night and day, and beholds the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, attachment and pride are burnt away.
From the Perfect Guru, true understanding is obtained.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one realizes the Lord's Presence within.

364.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
364.t: aavan jaan rahai thir naam samaane ||2||
364.e: Then, one's coming and going cease, and one becomes stable, absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
The world is tied to birth and death.
The unconscious, self-willed manmukh is enveloped in the darkness of Maya and emotional attachment.
He slanders others, and practices utter falsehood.

364.g: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
364.t: visaTaa kaa keeRaa visaTaa maeh samaavai ||3||
364.e: He is a maggot in manure, and into manure he is absorbed. ||3||
Joining the True Congregation, the Sat Sangat, total understanding is obtained.

364.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ॥
364.t: gur kaa sabadh har bhagat dhiraRaae ||
364.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, devotional love for the Lord is implanted.
One who surrenders to the Lord's Will is peaceful forever.
O Nanak, he is absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||10||49||
Aasaa, Third Mehla, Panch-Padhay:
One who dies in the Word of the Shabad, finds eternal bliss.
He is united with the True Guru, the Guru, the Lord God.

364.g: ਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
364.t: naa fir marai na aavai jai ||
364.e: He does not die any more, and he does not come or go.
Through the Perfect Guru, he merges with the True Lord. ||1||

364.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
364.t: jin(h) kau naam likhiaa dhur lekh ||
364.e: One who has the Naam, the Name of the Lord, written in his pre-ordained destiny,

364.g: ਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
364.t: te anadhin naam sadhaa dhiaaveh gur poore te bhagat visekh ||1|| rahaau ||
364.e: night and day, meditates forever on the Naam; he obtains the wondrous blessing of devotional love from the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

364.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
364.t: jin(h) kau har prabh le milai ||
364.e: Those, whom the Lord God has blended with Himself

364.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
364.t: tin(h) kee gahan gat kahee na jai ||
364.e: their sublime state cannot be described.
The Perfect True Guru has given the Glorious Greatness,
of the most exalted order, and I am absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||2||

364.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
364.t: jo kichh kare su aape aap ||
364.e: Whatever the Lord does, He does all by Himself.
In an instant, He establishes, and disestablishes.

364.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਘਾਲੇ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
364.t: keh keh kahanaa aakh sunaae || je sau ghaale thai na paae ||3||
364.e: By merely speaking, talking, shouting and preaching about the Lord, even hundreds of times, the mortal is not approved. ||3||

364.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
364.t: jin(h) kai potai pu(n)n tin(h)aa guroo milaae ||
364.e: The Guru meets with those, who take virtue as their treasure;
they listen to the True Word of the Guru's Bani, the Shabad.

364.g: ਜਹਾਂ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਤਹਾਂ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
364.t: jahaa(n) sabadh vasai tahaa(n) dhukh jaae ||
364.e: Pain departs, from that place where the Shabad abides.
By the jewel of spiritual wisdom, one is easily absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||

364.g: ਨਾਵੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
364.t: naavai jevadd hor dhan naahee koi ||
364.e: No other wealth is as great as the Naam.
It is bestowed only by the True Lord.
Through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, it abides in the mind.
O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, peace is obtained. ||5||11||50||
Aasaa, Third Mehla:
One may dance and play numerous instruments;

364.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਬੋਲਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
364.t: eih man a(n)dhaa bolaa hai kis aakh sunaae ||
364.e: but this mind is blind and deaf, so for whose benefit is this speaking and preaching?
Deep within is the fire of greed, and the dust-storm of doubt.
The lamp of knowledge is not burning, and understanding is not obtained. ||1||
The Gurmukh has the light of devotional worship within his heart.

364.g: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
364.t: aap pachhaan milai prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
364.e: Understanding his own self, he meets God. ||1||Pause||
The Gurmukh's dance is to embrace love for the Lord;
to the beat of the drum, he sheds his ego from within.
My God is True; He Himself is the Knower of all.

364.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
364.t: gur kai sabadh a(n)tar braham pachhaan ||2||
364.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Creator Lord within yourself. ||2||
The Gurmukh is filled with devotional love for the Beloved Lord.
He intuitively reflects upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
For the Gurmukh, loving devotional worship is the way to the True Lord.
But the dances and the worship of the hypocrites bring only pain. ||3||

365.g: ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਨੁ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ॥
365.t: ehaa bhagat jan jeevat marai ||
365.e: True Devotion is to remain dead while yet alive.

365.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
365.t: gur parasaadhee bhavajal tarai ||
365.e: By Guru's Grace, one crosses over the terrible world-ocean.

365.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥
365.t: gur kai bachan bhagat thai pai ||
365.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, one's devotion is accepted,

365.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
365.t: har jeeau aap vasai man aai ||4||
365.e: and then, the Dear Lord Himself comes to dwell in the mind. ||4||

365.g: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
365.t: har kirapaa kare satiguroo milaae ||
365.e: When the Lord bestows His Mercy, He leads us to meet the True Guru.

365.g: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
365.t: nihachal bhagat har siau chit laae ||
365.e: Then, one's devotion becomes steady, and the consciousness is centered upon the Lord.

365.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
365.t: bhagat rate tin(h) sachee soi ||
365.e: Those who are imbued with Devotion have truthful reputations.

365.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੨॥੫੧॥
365.t: naanak naam rate sukh hoi ||5||12||51||
365.e: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, peace is obtained. ||5||12||51||

365.g: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩
365.t: aasaa ghar atthvaa kaafee mahalaa teejaa
365.e: Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Third Mehla:

365.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
365.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
365.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

365.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
365.t: har kai bhaanai satigur milai sach sojhee hoiee ||
365.e: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, one meets the True Guru, and true understanding is obtained.

365.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
365.t: gur parasaadhee man vasai har boojhai soiee ||1||
365.e: By Guru's Grace, the Lord abides in the mind, and one comes to understand the Lord. ||1||

365.g: ਮੈ ਸਹੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
365.t: mai sahu dhaataa ek hai avar naahee koiee ||
365.e: My Husband Lord, the Great Giver, is One. There is no other at all.

365.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
365.t: gur kirapaa te man vasai taa sadhaa sukh hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
365.e: By Guru's merciful favor, He abides in the mind, and then, a lasting peace ensues. ||1||Pause||

365.g: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
365.t: eis jug meh nirabhau har naam hai paieeaai gur veechaar ||
365.e: In this age, the Lord's Name is fearless; it is obtained by meditative reflection upon the Guru.

365.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
365.t: bin naavai jam kai vas hai manmukh a(n)dh gavaar ||2||
365.e: Without the Name, the blind, foolish, self-willed manmukh is under Death's power. ||2||

365.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
365.t: har kai bhaanai jan sevaa karai boojhai sach soiee ||
365.e: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, the humble being performs His service, and understands the True Lord.

365.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
365.t: har kai bhaanai saalaaheeaai bhaanai ma(n)niaai sukh hoiee ||3||
365.e: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, He is to be praised; surrendering to His Will, peace ensues. ||3||

365.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਈ ॥
365.t: har kai bhaanai janam padhaarath paiaa mat uootam hoiee ||
365.e: By the Pleasure of the Lord's Will, the prize of this human birth is obtained, and the intellect is exalted.

365.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੫੨॥
365.t: naanak naam salaeh too(n) gurmukh gat hoiee ||4||39||13||52||
365.e: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, you shall be emancipated. ||4||39||13||52||

365.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨
365.t: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa
365.e: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla, Second House:

365.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
365.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
365.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

365.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
365.t: too(n) karataa sachiaar maiddaa saa(n)iee ||
365.e: You are the True Creator, my Lord Master.

365.g: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
365.t: jo tau bhaavai soiee theesee jo too(n) dheh soiee hau paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
365.e: That which is pleasing to Your Will, comes to pass. Whatever You give, that is what I receive. ||1||Pause||

365.g: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
365.t: sabh teree too(n) sabhanee dhiaaiaa ||
365.e: All are Yours; all meditate on You.

365.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
365.t: jis no kirapaa kareh tin naam ratan paiaa ||
365.e: He alone, whom You bless with Your Mercy, obtains the jewel of the Naam.

365.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
365.t: gurmukh laadhaa manmukh gavaiaa ||
365.e: The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.

365.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
365.t: tudh aap vichhoRiaa aap milaiaa ||1||
365.e: You Yourself separate the mortals, and You Yourself unite them. ||1||

365.g: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
365.t: too(n) dhareeaau sabh tujh hee maeh ||
365.e: You are the River - all are within You.

365.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
365.t: tujh bin dhoojaa koiee naeh ||
365.e: Other than You, there is no one at all.

365.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
365.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh teraa khel ||
365.e: All beings and creatures are your play-things.

365.g: ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
365.t: vijog mil vichhuRiaa sa(n)jogee mel ||2||
365.e: The united ones are separated, and the separated ones are re-united. ||2||

365.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
365.t: jis no too jaanaieh soiee jan jaanai ||
365.e: That humble being, whom You inspire to understand, understands;

365.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
365.t: har gun sadh hee aakh vakhaanai ||
365.e: he continually speaks and chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

365.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
365.t: jin har seviaa tin sukh paiaa ||
365.e: One who serves the Lord, obtains peace.

365.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
365.t: sahaje hee har naam samaiaa ||3||
365.e: He is easily absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||3||

365.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
365.t: too aape karataa teraa keeaa sabh hoi ||
365.e: You Yourself are the Creator; by Your doing, all things come to be.

365.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
365.t: tudh bin dhoojaa avar na koi ||
365.e: Without You, there is no other at all.

365.g: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
365.t: too kar kar vekheh jaaneh soi ||
365.e: You watch over the creation, and understand it.

365.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੩॥
365.t: jan naanak gurmukh paragaT hoi ||4||1||53||
365.e: O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed to the Gurmukh. ||4||1||53||

366.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
366.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
366.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

366.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
366.t: raag aasaa ghar doojaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
366.e: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fourth Mehla:

366.g: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
366.t: kis hee dhaRaa keeaa mitr sut naal bhaiee ||
366.e: Some form alliances with friends, children and siblings.

366.g: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਕੁੜਮ ਸਕੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਵਾਈ ॥
366.t: kis hee dhaRaa keeaa kuRam sake naal javaiee ||
366.e: Some form alliances with in-laws and relatives.

366.g: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਈ ॥
366.t: kis hee dhaRaa keeaa sikadhaar chaudharee naal aapanai suaaiee ||
366.e: Some form alliances with chiefs and leaders for their own selfish motives.

366.g: ਹਮਾਰਾ ਧੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
366.t: hamaaraa dhaRaa har rahiaa samaiee ||1||
366.e: My alliance is with the Lord, who is pervading everywhere. ||1||

366.g: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
366.t: ham har siau dhaRaa keeaa meree har Tek ||
366.e: I have formed my alliance with the Lord; the Lord is my only support.

366.g: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਖੁ ਧੜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
366.t: mai har bin pakh dhaRaa avar na koiee hau har gun gaavaa asa(n)kh anek ||1|| rahaau ||
366.e: Other than the Lord, I have no other faction or alliance; I sing of the countless and endless Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

366.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਧੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
366.t: jin(h) siau dhaRe kareh se jaeh ||
366.e: Those with whom you form alliances, shall perish.

366.g: ਝੂਠੁ ਧੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਹਿ ॥
366.t: jhooTh dhaRe kar pachhotaeh ||
366.e: Making false alliances, the mortals repent and regret in the end.

366.g: ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
366.t: thir na raheh man khoT kamaeh ||
366.e: Those who practice falsehood shall not last.

366.g: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
366.t: ham har siau dhaRaa keeaa jis kaa koiee samarath naeh ||2||
366.e: I have formed my alliance with the Lord; there is no one more powerful than Him. ||2||

366.g: ਏਹ ਸਭਿ ਧੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
366.t: eh sabh dhaRe maiaa moh pasaaree ||
366.e: All these alliances are mere extensions of the love of Maya.

366.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਲੂਝਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
366.t: maiaa kau loojheh gaavaaree ||
366.e: Only fools argue over Maya.

366.g: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
366.t: janam mareh jooaai baajee haaree ||
366.e: They are born, and they die, and they lose the game of life in the gamble.

366.g: ਹਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਜਿ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
366.t: hamarai har dhaRaa j halat palat sabh savaaree ||3||
366.e: My alliance is with the Lord, who embellishes all, in this world and the next. ||3||

366.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਧੜੇ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਝਗੜਾਏ ॥
366.t: kalijug meh dhaRe pa(n)ch chor jhagaRaae ||
366.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the five thieves instigate alliances and conflicts.

366.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
366.t: kaam karodh lobh moh abhimaan vadhaae ||
366.e: Sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit have increased.

366.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
366.t: jis no kirapaa kare tis satasa(n)g milaae ||
366.e: One who is blessed by the Lord's Grace, joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

366.g: ਹਮਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਧੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੪॥
366.t: hamaraa har dhaRaa jin eh dhaRe sabh gavaae ||4||
366.e: My alliance is with the Lord, who has destroyed all these alliances. ||4||

366.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਧੜੇ ਬਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
366.t: mithiaa dhoojaa bhaau dhaRe beh paavai ||
366.e: In the false love of duality, people sit and form alliances.

366.g: ਪਰਾਇਆ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਅਟਕਲੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ ॥
366.t: paraiaa chhidhr aTakalai aapanaa aha(n)kaar vadhaavai ||
366.e: They complain about other peoples' faults, while their own self-conceit only increases.

366.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
366.t: jaisaa beejai taisaa khaavai ||
366.e: As they plant, so shall they harvest.

366.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੫॥੨॥੫੪॥
366.t: jan naanak kaa har dhaRaa dharam sabh sirasaT jin aavai ||5||2||54||
366.e: Servant Nanak has joined the Lord's alliance of Dharma, which shall conquer the whole world. ||5||2||54||

366.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
366.t: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
366.e: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

366.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
366.t: hiradhai sun sun man a(n)mrit bhaiaa ||
366.e: Constantly listening to the Ambrosial Gurbani in the heart, it becomes pleasing to the mind.

366.g: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
366.t: gurbaanee har alakh lakhaiaa ||1||
366.e: Through Gurbani, the Incomprehensible Lord is comprehended. ||1||

366.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਭੈਨਾ ॥
366.t: gurmukh naam sunahu meree bhainaa ||
366.e: As Gurmukh, listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my sisters.

366.g: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
366.t: eko rav rahiaa ghaT a(n)tar mukh bolahu gur a(n)mirat bainaa ||1|| rahaau ||
366.e: The One Lord is pervading and permeating deep within the heart; with your mouth, recite the Ambrosial Hymns of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

366.g: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
366.t: mai man tan prem mahaa bairaag ||
366.e: My mind and body are filled with divine love, and great sadness.

366.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
366.t: satigur purakh paiaa vaddabhaag ||2||
366.e: By great good fortune, I have obtained the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||2||

366.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
366.t: dhoojai bhai bhaveh bikh maiaa ||
366.e: In the love of duality, the mortals wander through poisonous Maya.

366.g: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
366.t: bhaagaheen nahee satigur paiaa ||3||
366.e: The unfortunate ones do not meet the True Guru. ||3||

366.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
366.t: a(n)mrit har ras har aap peeaaiaa ||
366.e: The Lord Himself inspires us to drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Elixir.

366.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੫॥
366.t: gur poorai naanak har paiaa ||4||3||55||
366.e: Through the Perfect Guru, O Nanak, the Lord is obtained. ||4||3||55||

366.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
366.t: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
366.e: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

366.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
366.t: merai man tan prem naam aadhaar ||
366.e: The Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of my mind and body.

366.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਮੋ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
366.t: naam japee naamo sukh saar ||1||
366.e: I chant the Naam; the Naam is the essence of peace. ||1||

366.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
366.t: naam japahu mere saajan sainaa ||
366.e: So chant the Naam, O my friends and companions.

366.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
366.t: naam binaa mai avar na koiee vaddai bhaag gurmukh har lainaa ||1|| rahaau ||
366.e: Without the Naam, there is nothing else for me. By great good fortune, as Gurmukh, I have received the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

366.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
366.t: naam binaa nahee jeeviaa jai ||
366.e: Without the Naam, I cannot live.

366.g: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
366.t: vaddai bhaag gurmukh har pai ||2||
366.e: By great good fortune, the Gurmukhs obtain the Naam. ||2||

366.g: ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਕਾਲਖ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
366.t: naamaheen kaalakh mukh maiaa ||
366.e: Those who lack the Naam have their faces rubbed in the dirt of Maya.

366.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
366.t: naam binaa dhirag dhirag jeevaiaa ||3||
366.e: Without the Naam, cursed, cursed are their lives. ||3||

367.g: ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਗ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
367.t: vaddaa vaddaa har bhaag kar paiaa ||
367.e: The Great Lord is obtained by great good destiny.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh is blessed with the Naam. ||4||4||56||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:
I sing His Glorious Praises, and through the Word of His Bani, I speak His Glorious Praises.
As Gurmukh, I chant and recite the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

367.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
367.t: jap jap naam man bhiaa ana(n)dhaa ||
367.e: Chanting and meditating on the Naam, my mind becomes blissful.

367.g: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
367.t: sat sat satigur naam dhiRaiaa ras gaae gun paramaana(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
367.e: The True Guru has implanted the True Name of the True Lord within me; I sing His Glorious Praises, and taste the supreme ecstasy. ||1||Pause||

367.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਗਾ ॥
367.t: har gun gaavai har jan logaa ||
367.e: The humble servants of the Lord sing the Lord's Glorious Praises.
By great good fortune, the detached, absolute Lord is obtained. ||2||
Those without virtue are stained by Maya's filth.
Lacking virtue, the egotistical die, and suffer reincarnation. ||3||
The ocean of the body yields pearls of virtue.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh churns this ocean, and discovers this essence. ||4||5||57||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:
I listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Naam is pleasing to my mind.
By great good fortune, the Gurmukh obtains the Lord. ||1||
Chant the Naam, as Gurmukh, and be exalted.

367.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਧਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
367.t: naam binaa mai dhar nahee kaiee naam raviaa sabh saas giraasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
367.e: Without the Naam, I have no other support; the Naam is woven into all my breaths and morsels of food. ||1||Pause||
The Naam illuminates my mind; listening to it, my mind is pleased.

367.g: ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
367.t: jo naam sunaavai so meraa meet sakhaiee ||2||
367.e: One who speaks the Naam - he alone is my friend and companion. ||2||
Without the Naam, the fools depart naked.

367.g: ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
367.t: pach pach mue bikh dhekh pata(n)gaa ||3||
367.e: They burn away to death, chasing the poison of Maya, like the moth chasing the flame. ||3||
He Himself establishes, and, having established, disestablishes.
O Nanak, the Lord Himself bestows the Naam. ||4||6||58||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:
The vine of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, has taken root in the Gurmukh.
It bears the fruit of the Lord; its taste is so tasty! ||1||

367.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
367.t: har har naam jap anat tara(n)gaa ||
367.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in endless waves of joy.

367.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
367.t: jap jap naam gurmat saalaahee maariaa kaal jamaka(n)kar bhuia(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
367.e: Chant and repeat the Naam; through the Guru's Teachings praise the Lord, and slay the horrible serpent of the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||

367.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
367.t: har har gur meh bhagat rakhaiee ||
367.e: The Lord has implanted His devotional worship in the Guru.

367.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਸਿਖ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
367.t: gur tuThaa sikh dhevai mere bhaiee ||2||
367.e: When the Guru is pleased, He bestows it upon His Sikh, O my siblings of Destiny. ||2||

367.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
367.t: haumai karam kichh bidh nahee jaanai ||
367.e: One who acts in ego, knows nothing about the Way.

367.g: ਜਿਉ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਨਾਇ ਖਾਕੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
367.t: jiau ku(n)char nai khaak sir chhaanai ||3||
367.e: He acts like an elephant, who takes a bath, and then throws dust on his head. ||3||

367.g: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ॥
367.t: je vadd bhaag hoveh vadd uooche ||
367.e: If one's destiny is great and exalted,
O Nanak, one chants the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate, True Lord. ||4||7||59||
Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

367.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
367.t: har har naam kee man bhookh lagaiee ||
367.e: My mind suffers hunger for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

367.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਨਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
367.t: naam suniaai man tirapatai mere bhaiee ||1||
367.e: Hearing the Naam, my mind is satisfied, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||
Chant the Naam, O my friends, O GurSikhs.

367.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
367.t: naam japahu naame sukh paavahu naam rakhahu gurmat man cheetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
367.e: Chant the Naam, and through the Naam, obtain peace; through the Guru's Teachings, enshrine the Naam in your heart and mind. ||1||Pause||
Hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind is in bliss.
Reaping the profit of the Naam, through the Guru's Teachings, my soul has blossomed forth. ||2||
Without the Naam, the mortal is a leper, blinded by emotional attachment.

367.g: ਸਭ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ ਦੁਖੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੩॥
367.t: sabh nihafal karam ke'ee dhukh dha(n)dhaa ||3||
367.e: All his actions are fruitless; they lead only to painful entanglements. ||3||

367.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਪੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
367.t: har har har jas japai vaddabhaagee ||
367.e: The very fortunate ones chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, one embraces love for the Naam. ||4||8||60||

368.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
368.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
368.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

368.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਕੇ ੩ ॥
368.t: mahalaa chauthhaa raag aasaa ghar chhayvaa ke 3 ||
368.e: Fourth Mehla, Raag Aasaa, 3 Of Sixth House :

368.g: ਹਥਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਥੋਥਰ ਵਾਜੈ ਬੇਨ ॥
368.t: hath kar ta(n)t vajaavai jogee thothar vaajai ben ||
368.e: You may pluck the strings with your hand, O Yogi, but your playing of the harp is in vain.

368.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੇਨ ॥੧॥
368.t: gurmat har gun bolahu jogee ih manooaa har ra(n)g bhen ||1||
368.e: Under Guru's Instruction, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Yogi, and this mind of yours shall be imbued with the Lord's Love. ||1||

368.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
368.t: jogee har dheh matee upadhes ||
368.e: O Yogi, give your intellect the Teachings of the Lord.

368.g: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਹਮ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
368.t: jug jug har har eko varatai tis aagai ham aadhes ||1|| rahaau ||
368.e: The Lord, the One Lord, is pervading throughout all the ages; I humbly bow down to Him. ||1||Pause||

368.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਗ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲ ॥
368.t: gaaveh raag bhaat bahu boleh ih manooaa khelai khel ||
368.e: You sing in so many Ragas and harmonies, and you talk so much, but this mind of yours is only playing a game.

368.g: ਜੋਵਹਿ ਕੂਪ ਸਿੰਚਨ ਕਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਉਠਿ ਬੈਲ ਗਏ ਚਰਿ ਬੇਲ ॥੨॥
368.t: joveh koop si(n)chan kau basudhaa uTh bail ge char bel ||2||
368.e: You work the well and irrigate the fields, but the oxen have already left to graze in the jungle. ||2||

368.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਮੈ ਹਰਿਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
368.t: kaiaa nagar meh karam har bovahu har jaamai hariaa khet ||
368.e: In the field of the body, plant the Lord's Name, and the Lord will sprout there, like a lush green field.

368.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜੇਤੁ ॥੩॥
368.t: manooaa asathir bail man jovahu har si(n)chahu gurmat jet ||3||
368.e: O mortal, hook up your unstable mind like an ox, and irrigate your fields with the Lord's Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||3||

368.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਜੋ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਚੇਲ ॥
368.t: jogee ja(n)gam sirasaT sabh tumaree jo dheh matee tit chel ||
368.e: The Yogis, the wandering Jangams, and all the world is Yours, O Lord. According to the wisdom which You give them, so do they follow their ways.

368.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੇਲ ॥੪॥੯॥੬੧॥
368.t: jan naanak ke prabh a(n)tarajaamee har laavahu manooaa pel ||4||9||61||
368.e: O Lord God of servant Nanak, O Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, please link my mind to You. ||4||9||61||

368.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
368.t: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
368.e: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

368.g: ਕਬ ਕੋ ਭਾਲੈ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਤਾਲਾ ਕਬ ਕੋ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਰਬਾਬੁ ॥
368.t: kab ko bhaalai ghu(n)gharoo taalaa kab ko bajaavai rabaab ||
368.e: How long must one search for angle bells and cymbals, and how long must one play the guitar?

368.g: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਉ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਮਾਰਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
368.t: aavat jaat baar khin laagai hau tab lag samaarau naam ||1||
368.e: In the brief instant between coming and going, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

368.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
368.t: merai man aaisee bhagat ban aaiee ||
368.e: Such is the devotional love which has been produced in my mind.

368.g: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
368.t: hau har bin khin pal reh na sakau jaise jal bin meen mar jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
368.e: Without the Lord, I cannot live even for an instant, like the fish which dies without water. ||1||Pause||

368.g: ਕਬ ਕੋਊ ਮੇਲੈ ਪੰਚ ਸਤ ਗਾਇਣ ਕਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਗ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਠਾਵੈ ॥
368.t: kab kouoo melai pa(n)ch sat gain kab ko raag dhun uThaavai ||
368.e: How long must one tune the five strings, and assemble the seven singers, and how long will they raise their voices in song?

368.g: ਮੇਲਤ ਚੁਨਤ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
368.t: melat chunat khin pal chasaa laagai tab lag meraa man raam gun gaavai ||2||
368.e: In the time it takes to select and assemble these musicians, a moment elapses, and my mind sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

368.g: ਕਬ ਕੋ ਨਾਚੈ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰੈ ਕਬ ਕੋ ਹਾਥ ਪਸਾਰੈ ॥
368.t: kab ko naachai paav pasaarai kab ko haath pasaarai ||
368.e: How long must one dance and stretch out one's feet, and how long must one reach out with one's hands?

368.g: ਹਾਥ ਪਾਵ ਪਸਾਰਤ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
368.t: haath paav pasaarat bilam til laagai tab lag meraa man raam sam(h)aarai ||3||
368.e: Stretching out one's hands and feet, there is a moment's delay; and then, my mind meditates on the Lord. ||3||

368.g: ਕਬ ਕੋਊ ਲੋਗਨ ਕਉ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ ਲੋਕਿ ਪਤੀਣੈ ਨਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
368.t: kab kouoo logan kau pateeaavai lok pateenai naa pat hoi ||
368.e: How long must one satisfy the people, in order to obtain honor?

368.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੨॥
368.t: jan naanak har hiradhai sadh dhiaavahu taa jai jai kare sabh koi ||4||10||62||
368.e: O servant Nanak, meditate forever in your heart on the Lord, and then everyone will congratulate you. ||4||10||62||

368.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
368.t: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
368.e: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

368.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
368.t: satasa(n)gat mileeaai har saadhoo mil sa(n)gat har gun gai ||
368.e: Join the Sat Sangat, the Lord's True Congregation; joining the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

368.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
368.t: giaan ratan baliaa ghaT chaanan agiaan a(n)dheraa jai ||1||
368.e: With the sparkling jewel of spiritual wisdom, the heart is illumined, and ignorance is dispelled. ||1||

368.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
368.t: har jan naachahu har har dhiaai ||
368.e: O humble servant of the Lord, let your dancing be meditation on the Lord, Har, Har.

368.g: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਮ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
368.t: aaise sa(n)t mileh mere bhaiee ham jan ke dhoveh pai ||1|| rahaau ||
368.e: If only I cold meet such Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny; I would wash the feet of such servants. ||1||Pause||

368.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
368.t: har har naam japahu man mere anadhin har liv lai ||
368.e: Meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my mind; night and day, center your consciousness on the Lord.

368.g: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
368.t: jo ichhahu soiee fal paavahu fir bhookh na laagai aai ||2||
368.e: You shall have the fruits of your desires, and you shall never feel hunger again. ||2||

368.g: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
368.t: aape har apara(n)par karataa har aape bol bulai ||
368.e: The Infinite Lord Himself is the Creator; the Lord Himself speaks, and causes us to speak.

368.g: ਸੇਈ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
368.t: seiee sa(n)t bhale tudh bhaaveh jin(h) kee pat paaveh thai ||3||
368.e: The Saints are good, who are pleasing to Your Will; their honor is approved by You. ||3||

368.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਰਾਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਿਉ ਆਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
368.t: naanak aakh na raajai har gun jiau aakhai tiau sukh pai ||
368.e: Nanak is not satisfied by chanting the Lord's Glorious Praises; the more he chants them, the more he is at peace.

368.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਵਣਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੬੩॥
368.t: bhagat bha(n)ddaar dhe'ee har apune gun gaahak vanaj lai jai ||4||11||63||
368.e: The Lord Himself has bestowed the treasure of devotional love; His customers purchase virtues, and carry them home. ||4||11||63||

369.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
369.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
369.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

369.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੮ ਕੇ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
369.t: raag aasaa ghar atthvaa ke kaafee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
369.e: Raag Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Fourth Mehla:

369.g: ਆਇਆ ਮਰਣੁ ਧੁਰਾਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
369.t: aaiaa maran dhuraahu haumai roieeaai ||
369.e: Death is ordained from the very beginning, and yet ego makes us cry.

369.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਈਐ ॥੧॥
369.t: gurmukh naam dhiaai asathir hoieeaai ||1||
369.e: Meditating on the Naam, as Gurmukh, one becomes stable and steady. ||1||

369.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
369.t: gur poore saabaas chalan jaaniaa ||
369.e: Blessed is the Perfect Guru, through whom the way of Death is known.

369.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
369.t: laahaa naamu su saar sabadh samaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
369.e: The sublime people earn the profit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they are absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

369.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਡੇਹ ਸਿ ਆਏ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
369.t: poorab likhe ddeh s aae maiaa ||
369.e: The days of one's life are pre-ordained; they will come to their end, O mother.

369.g: ਚਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿੑ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
369.t: chalan aj k kali(h) dhurahu furamaiaa ||2||
369.e: One must depart, today or tomorrow, according to the Lord's Primal Order. ||2||

369.g: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
369.t: birathaa janam tinaa jin(h)ee naam visaariaa ||
369.e: Useless are the lives of those, who have forgotten the Naam.

369.g: ਜੂਐ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਜਗਿ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
369.t: jooaai khelan jag k ih man haariaa ||3||
369.e: They play the game of chance in this world, and lose their mind to vices. ||3||

369.g: ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
369.t: jeevan maran sukh hoi jin(h)aa gur paiaa ||
369.e: Those who have found the Guru are at peace, in life and in death.

369.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੪॥
369.t: naanak sache sach sach samaiaa ||4||12||64||
369.e: O Nanak, the true ones are truly absorbed into the True Lord. ||4||12||64||

369.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
369.t: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
369.e: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

369.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
369.t: janam padhaarath pai naam dhiaaiaa ||
369.e: Having obtained the treasure of this human birth, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

369.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
369.t: gur parasaadhee bujh sach samaiaa ||1||
369.e: By Guru's Grace, I understand, and I am absorbed into the True Lord. ||1||

369.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
369.t: jin(h) dhur likhiaa lekh tin(h)ee naam kamaiaa ||
369.e: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny practice the Naam.

369.g: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
369.t: dhar sachai sachiaar mahal bulaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
369.e: The True Lord summons the truthful to the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||

369.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
369.t: a(n)tar naam nidhaan gurmukh paieeaai ||
369.e: Deep within is the treasure of the Naam; it is obtained by the Gurmukh.

369.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
369.t: anadhin naam dhiaai har gun gaieeaai ||2||
369.e: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

369.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
369.t: a(n)tar vasat anek manmukh nahee paieeaai ||
369.e: Deep within are infinite substances, but the self-willed manmukh does not find them.

369.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
369.t: haumai garabai garab aap khuaaieeaai ||3||
369.e: In egotism and pride, the mortal's proud self consumes him. ||3||

369.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
369.t: naanak aape aap aap khuaaieeaai ||
369.e: O Nanak, his identity consumes his identical identity.

369.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੬੫॥
369.t: gurmat man paragaas sachaa paieeaai ||4||13||65||
369.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the mind is illumined, and meets the True Lord. ||4||13||65||

369.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੬ ਕੇ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸੁਧੰਗ
369.t: raag aasaavaree ghar solavaa ke 2 mahalaa chauthhaa sudha(n)g
369.e: Raag Aasaavaree, 2 Of Sixteenth House, Fourth Mehla, Sudhang:

369.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
369.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
369.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

369.g: ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
369.t: hau anadhin har naam keeratan karau ||
369.e: Night and day, I sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Name of the Lord.

369.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
369.t: satigur mo kau har naam bataiaa hau har bin khin pal reh na sakau ||1|| rahaau ||
369.e: The True Guru has revealed to me the Name of the Lord; without the Lord, I cannot live, for a moment, even an instant. ||1||Pause||

369.g: ਹਮਰੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ॥
369.t: hamarai sravan simaran har keeratan hau har bin reh na sakau hau ik khin ||
369.e: My ears hear the Lord's Kirtan, and I contemplate Him; without the Lord, I cannot live, even for an instant.

369.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਹੰਸੁ ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ॥੧॥
369.t: jaise ha(n)s saravar bin reh na sakai taise har jan kiau rahai har sevaa bin ||1||
369.e: As the swan cannot live without the lake, how can the Lord's slave live without serving Him? ||1||

369.g: ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੋਹ ਅਪਮਾਨ ॥
369.t: kinahoo(n) preet laiee dhoojaa bhaau ridh dhaar kinahoo(n) preet laiee moh apamaan ||
369.e: Some enshrine love for duality in their hearts, and some pledge love for worldly attachments and ego.

369.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੬੬॥
369.t: har jan preet laiee har nirabaan padh naanak simarat har har bhagavaan ||2||14||66||
369.e: The Lord's servant embraces love for the Lord and the state of Nirvaanaa; Nanak contemplates the Lord, the Lord God. ||2||14||66||

369.g: ਆਸਾਵਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
369.t: aasaavaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
369.e: Aasaavaree, Fourth Mehla:

369.g: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
369.t: maiee moro preetam raam bataavahu ree maiee ||
369.e: O mother, my mother, tell me about my Beloved Lord.

369.g: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਹਲੁ ਬੇਲਿ ਰੀਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
369.t: hau har bin khin pal reh na sakau jaise karahal bel reejhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
369.e: Without the Lord, I cannot live for a moment, even an instant; I love Him, like the camel loves the vine. ||1||Pause||

369.g: ਹਮਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੀਤ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
369.t: hamaraa man bairaag birakat bhio har dharasan meet kai taiee ||
369.e: My mind has become sad and distant, longing for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my Friend.

369.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
369.t: jaise al kamalaa bin reh na sakai taise moh har bin rahan na jaiee ||1||
369.e: As the bumblebee cannot live without the lotus, I cannot live without the Lord. ||1||

370.g: ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
370.t: raakh saran jagadheesur piaare moh saradhaa poor har gusaiee ||
370.e: Keep me under Your Protection, O Beloved Master of the Universe; fulfill my faith, O Lord of the World.

370.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੧੩॥੧੫॥੬੭॥
370.t: jan naanak kai man anadh hot hai har dharasan nimakh dhikhaiee ||2||39||13||15||67||
370.e: Servant Nanak's mind is filled with bliss, when he beholds the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, even for an instant. ||2||39||13||15||67||

370.t: raag aasaa ghar doojaa mahalaa panjavaa
370.e: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

370.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
370.t: jin laiee preet soiee fir khaiaa ||
370.e: One who loves her, is ultimately devoured.

370.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਬੈਠਾਲੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
370.t: jin sukh baiThaalee tis bhau bahut dhikhaiaa ||
370.e: One who seats her in comfort, is totally terrified by her.
Siblings, friends and family, beholding her, argue.
But she has come under my control, by Guru's Grace. ||1||
Beholding her, all are bewitched:

370.g: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਨੁਖਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਭਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹਨਿ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
370.t: saadhik sidh suradhev manukhaa bin saadhoo sabh dhrohan dhrohe ||1|| rahaau ||
370.e: the strivers, the Siddhas, the demi-gods, angels and mortals. All, except the Saadhus, are deceived by her deception. ||1||Pause||

370.g: ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
370.t: eik fireh udhaasee tin(h) kaam viaapai ||
370.e: Some wander around as renunciates, but they are engrossed in sexual desire.

370.g: ਇਕਿ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਪੈ ॥
370.t: eik sa(n)cheh girahee tin(h) hoi na aapai ||
370.e: Some grow rich as householders, but she does not belong to them.

370.g: ਇਕਿ ਸਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਲਪਾਵੈ ॥
370.t: eik satee kahaaveh tin(h) bahut kalapaavai ||
370.e: Some call themselves men of charity, and she torments them terribly.

370.g: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਲਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
370.t: ham har raakhe lag satigur paavai ||2||
370.e: The Lord has saved me, by attaching me to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||
She leads astray the penitents who practice penance.
The scholarly Pandits are all seduced by greed.
The world of the three qualities is enticed, and the heavens are enticed.

370.g: ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਰਾਖੇ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੩॥
370.t: ham satigur raakhe dhe kar haath ||3||
370.e: The True Guru has saved me, by giving me His Hand. ||3||
She is the slave of those who are spiritually wise.
With her palms pressed together, she serves them and offers her prayer:

370.g: ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
370.t: jo too(n) kaheh su kaar kamaavaa ||
370.e: "Whatever you wish, that is what I shall do."

370.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
370.t: jan naanak gurmukh neR na aavaa ||4||1||
370.e: O servant Nanak, she does not draw near to the Gurmukh. ||4||1||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
I have been separated from my Beloved by Maya (my mother-in-law).
Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are dying of grief.

370.g: ਘਰ ਕੇ ਜਿਠੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
370.t: ghar ke jiThere kee chookee kaan ||
370.e: I am no longer swayed by the fear of Death (my elder brother-in-law).
I am protected by my All-knowing, Wise Husband Lord. ||1||

370.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
370.t: sunahu lokaa mai prem ras paiaa ||
370.e: Listen, O people: I have tasted the elixir of love.

370.g: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਵੈਰੀ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
370.t: dhurajan maare vairee sa(n)ghaare satigur mo kau har naam dhivaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
370.e: The evil ones are dead, and my enemies are destroyed. The True Guru has given me the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
First, I renounced my egotistical love of myself.
Second, I renounced the ways of the world.

370.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
370.t: trai gun tiaag dhurajan meet samaane ||
370.e: Renouncing the three qualities, I look alike upon friend and enemy.
And then, the fourth state of bliss was revealed to me by the Holy One. ||2||
In the cave of celestial bliss, I have obtained a seat.
The Lord of Light plays the unstruck melody of bliss.
I am in ecstasy, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

370.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
370.t: pria siau raatee dhan sohaagan naar ||3||
370.e: Imbued with my Beloved Husband Lord, I am the blessed, happy soul-bride. ||3||
Servant Nanak chants the wisdom of God;

370.g: ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
370.t: jo sune kamaavai su utarai paar ||
370.e: one who listens and practices it, is carried across and saved.

370.g: ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
370.t: janam na marai na aavai na jai ||
370.e: He is not born, and he does not die; he does not come or go.
He remains blended with the Lord. ||4||2||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The bride shows such special devotion, and has such an agreeable disposition.
Her beauty is incomparable, and her character is perfect.

370.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ॥
370.t: jit gireh vasai so girahu sobhaava(n)taa ||
370.e: The house in which she dwells is such a praiseworthy house.
But rare are those who, as Gurmukh, attain that state||1||

370.g: ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਮ ਪਾਈ ॥
370.t: sukaranee kaaman gur mil ham paiee ||
370.e: As the soul-bride of pure actions, I have met with the Guru.

371.e: In worship, marriage and in the next world, such a soul-bride looks beautiful. ||1||Pause||
As long as she lived with her father,
her Husband wandered around in sadness.
I served and surrendered to the Lord, the True Being;

371.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਆਣੀ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
371.t: gur aanee ghar meh taa sarab sukh paiaa ||2||
371.e: the Guru brought my bride to my home, and I obtained total happiness. ||2||

371.g: ਬਤੀਹ ਸੁਲਖਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਪੂਤ ॥ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ॥
371.t: bateeh sulakhanee sach sa(n)tat poot || aagiaakaaree sughaR saroop ||
371.e: She is blessed with all sublime attributes, and her generations are unblemished.
Her Husband, her Lord and Master, fulfills her heart's desires.
Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are now totally content. ||3||
She is the most noble of all the family.
She counsels and advises her hope and desire.

371.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਆਇ ॥
371.t: dha(n)nu su girahu jit pragaTee aai ||
371.e: How blessed is that household, in which she has appeared.
O servant Nanak, she passes her time in perfect peace and comfort. ||4||3||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

371.g: ਮਤਾ ਕਰਉ ਸੋ ਪਕਨਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ॥
371.t: mataa karau so pakan na dheiee ||
371.e: Whatever I resolve, she does not allow it to come to pass.
She stands blocking the way of goodness and self-discipline.
She wears many disguises, and assumes many forms,

371.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਸਨਿ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਵਖਿ ਵਖਿ ਭਰਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
371.t: gireh basan na dheiee vakh vakh bharamaavai ||1||
371.e: and she does not allow me to dwell in my own home. She forces me to wander around in different directions. ||1||

371.g: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਿ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ॥
371.t: ghar kee naik ghar vaas na dhevai ||
371.e: She has become the mistress of my home, and she does not allow me to live in it.
If I try, she fights with me. ||1||Pause||
In the beginning, she was sent as a helper,

371.g: ਨਉ ਖੰਡ ਜੀਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰ ॥
371.t: nau kha(n)dd jeete sabh thaan thana(n)tar ||
371.e: but she has overwhelmed the nine continents, all places and interspaces.

371.g: ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੋਗ ਸੰਨਿਆਸ ॥
371.t: taT teerath na chhoddai jog sa(n)niaas ||
371.e: She has not spared even the river banks, the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the Yogis and Sannyaasees,
or those who tirelessly read the Simritees and study the Vedas. ||2||
Wherever I sit, she sits there with me.
She has imposed her power upon the whole world.

371.g: ਹੋਛੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
371.t: hochhee saran piaa rahan na paiee ||
371.e: Seeking meager protection, I am not protected from her.

371.g: ਕਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
371.t: kahu meetaa hau kai peh jaiee ||3||
371.e: Tell me, O my friend: unto whom should I turn for protection? ||3||
I heard of His Teachings, and so I have come to the True Guru.

371.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
371.t: gur har har naam moh ma(n)tr dhiraRaiaa ||
371.e: The Guru has implanted the Mantra of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, within me.

371.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
371.t: nij ghar vasiaa gun gai ana(n)taa ||
371.e: And now, I dwell in the home of my own inner self; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.
I have met God, O Nanak, and I have become care-free. ||4||
My home is now my own, and she is now my mistress.

371.g: ਇਹ ਆਮਰਿ ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
371.t: eeh aamar ham gur ke'ee dharabaaree ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||4||4||
371.e: She is now my servant, and the Guru has made me intimate with the Lord. ||1||Second Pause||4||4||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
First, they advised me to send a letter.
Second, they advised me to send two men.
Third, they advised me to make the effort and do something.

371.g: ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
371.t: mai sabh kichh chhodd prabh tuhee dhiaaiaa ||1||
371.e: But I have renounced everything, and I meditate only on You, God. ||1||
Now, I am totally blissful, carefree and at ease.

371.g: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਤ ਮੁਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
371.t: dhusaman dhoot mue sukh paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
371.e: The enemies and evil-doers have perished, and I have obtained peace. ||1||Pause||
The True Guru has imparted the Teachings to me.

371.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
371.t: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh har kaa dhes ||
371.e: My soul, body and everything belong to the Lord.

371.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੀ ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
371.t: jo kichh karee su teraa taan ||
371.e: Whatever I do, is by Your Almighty Power.
You are my only Support, You are my only Court. ||2||

371.g: ਤੁਧਨੋ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈਂ ਧਰਿ ॥
371.t: tudhano chhodd jaieeaai prabh kai(n) dhar ||
371.e: If I were to renounce You, God, unto whom could I turn?
There is no other, comparable to You.

371.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
371.t: tere sevak kau kis kee kaan ||
371.e: Who else is Your servant to serve?
The faithless cynics are deluded; they wander around in the wilderness. ||3||
Your Glorious Greatness cannot be described.

371.g: ਜਹ ਕਹ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
371.t: jeh keh raakh laih gal lai ||
371.e: Wherever I am, you save me, hugging me close in Your embrace.
Nanak, Your slave, has entered Your Sanctuary.
God has preserved his honor, and congratulations are pouring in. ||4||5||

372.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Having wandered through foreign lands, I have come here to do business.
I heard of the incomparable and profitable merchandise.
I have gathered in my pockets my capital of virtue, and I have brought it here with me.
Beholding the jewel, this mind is fascinated. ||1||
I have come to the door of the Trader.
Please display the merchandise, so that the business may be transacted. ||1||Pause||
The Trader has sent me to the Banker.
The jewel is priceless, and the capital is priceless.
O my gentle brother, mediator and friend
- I have obtained the merchandise, and my consciousness is now steady and stable. ||2||

372.g: ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਤਸਕਰ ਪਉਣ ਨ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
372.t: bhau nahee tasakar paun na paanee ||
372.e: I have no fear of thieves, of wind or water.
I have easily made my purchase, and I easily take it away.

372.g: ਸਤ ਕੈ ਖਟਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
372.t: sat kai khaTiaai dhukh nahee paiaa ||
372.e: I have earned Truth, and I shall have no pain.
I have brought this merchandise home, safe and sound. ||3||
I have earned the profit, and I am happy.
Blessed is the Banker, the Perfect Bestower.

372.g: ਇਹੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
372.t: eih saudhaa gurmukh kinai viralai paiaa ||
372.e: How rare is the Gurmukh who obtains this merchandise;
Nanak has brought this profitable merchandise home. ||4||6||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

372.g: ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
372.t: gun avagan mero kachh na beechaaro ||
372.e: He does not consider my merits or demerits.
He does not look at my beauty, color or decorations.

372.g: ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
372.t: chaj achaar kichh bidh nahee jaanee ||
372.e: I do not know the ways of wisdom and good conduct.
But taking me by the arm, my Husband Lord has led me to His Bed. ||1||

372.g: ਸੁਨਿਬੋ ਸਖੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕੀਅਲੋ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
372.t: sunibo sakhee ka(n)t hamaaro keealo khasamaanaa ||
372.e: Hear, O my companions, my Husband, my Lord Master, possesses me.

372.g: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਅਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
372.t: kar masatak dhaar raakhio kar apunaa kiaa jaanai ih lok ajaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
372.e: Placing His Hand upon my forehead, He protects me as His Own. What do these ignorant people know? ||1||Pause||
My married life now appears so beauteous;

372.g: ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜੋਹਿਓ ॥
372.t: ka(n)t milio mero sabh dhukh johio ||
372.e: my Husband Lord has met me, and He sees all my pains.
Within the courtyard of my heart, the glory of the moon shines.
Night and day, I have fun with my Beloved. ||2||
My clothes are dyed the deep crimson color of the poppy.
All the ornaments and garlands around my neck adorn me.

372.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪੇਖੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
372.t: pria pekhee dhirasaT paae sagal nidhaan ||
372.e: Gazing upon my Beloved with my eyes, I have obtained all treasures;
I have shaken off the power of the evil demons. ||3||
I have obtained eternal bliss, and I constantly celebrate.

372.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ॥
372.t: nau nidh naam gireh meh tirapataane ||
372.e: With the nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied in my own home.
Says Nanak, when the happy soul-bride is adorned by her Beloved,
she is forever happy with her Husband Lord. ||4||7||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
They give you donations and worship you.
You take from them, and then deny that they have given anything to you.

372.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
372.t: jit dhar tum(h) hai braahaman jaanaa ||
372.e: That door, through which you must ultimately go, O Brahmin
- at that door, you will come to regret and repent. ||1||
Such Brahmins shall drown, O Siblings of Destiny;
they think of doing evil to the innocent. ||1||Pause||
Within them is greed, and they wander around like mad dogs.
They slander others and carry loads of sin upon their heads.
Intoxicated by Maya, they do not think of the Lord.
Deluded by doubt, they wander off on many paths. ||2||
Outwardly, they wear various religious robes,
but within, they are enveloped by poison.
They instruct others, but do not understand themselves.
Such Brahmins will never be emancipated. ||3||
O foolish Brahmin, reflect upon God.
He watches and hears, and is always with you.
Says Nanak, if this is your destiny,
renounce your pride, and grasp the Guru's Feet. ||4||8||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

373.g: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਭਏ ਗਤੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
373.t: dhookh rog bhe gat tan te man niramal har har gun gai ||
373.e: Pain and disease have left my body, and my mind has become pure; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har.

373.g: ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਬ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
373.t: bhe ana(n)dh mil saadhoo sa(n)g ab meraa man kat hee na jai ||1||
373.e: I am in bliss, meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and now, my mind does not go wandering. ||1||
My burning desires are quenched, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, O mother.

373.g: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਓ ਤਾਪ ਸਭ ਸਹਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
373.t: binas gio taap sabh sahasaa gur seetal milio sahaj subhai ||1|| rahaau ||
373.e: The fever of doubt has been totally eliminated; meeting the Guru, I am cooled and soothed, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

373.g: ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹੇ ਏਕੁ ਇਕੁ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਆਇ ਬਸੇ ਅਬ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਥਾਇ ॥
373.t: dhaavat rahe ek ik boojhiaa aai base ab nihachal thai ||
373.e: My wandering has ended, since I have realized the One and Only Lord; now, I have come to dwell in the eternal place.

373.g: ਜਗਤੁ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੨॥
373.t: jagat udhaaran sa(n)t tumaare dharasan pekhat rahe aghai ||2||
373.e: Your Saints are the Saving Grace of the world; beholding the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, I remain satisfied. ||2||

373.g: ਜਨਮ ਦੋਖ ਪਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਾਛੈ ਅਬ ਪਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਇ ॥
373.t: janam dhokh pare mere paachhai ab pakare nihachal saadhoo pai ||
373.e: I have left behind the sins of countless incarnations, now that I have grasped the feet of the eternal Holy Guru.
My mind sings the celestial melody of bliss,

373.g: ਅਬ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
373.t: ab taa kau fun kaal na khai ||3||
373.e: and death shall no longer consume it. ||3||

373.g: ਕਰਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
373.t: karan kaaran samarath hamaare sukhadhaiee mere har har rai ||
373.e: My Lord, the Cause of all causes, is All-powerful, the Giver of peace; He is my Lord, my Lord King.

373.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥
373.t: naam teraa jap jeevai naanak ot pot merai sa(n)g sahai ||4||9||
373.e: Nanak lives by chanting Your Name, O Lord; You are my helper, with me, through and through. ||4||9||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The slanderer cries out and bewails.

373.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
373.t: paarabraham paramesar bisariaa apanaa keetaa paavai ni(n)dhak ||1|| rahaau ||
373.e: He has forgotten the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord; the slanderer reaps the rewards of his own actions. ||1||Pause||

373.g: ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਲਏ ਸਿਧਾਵੈ ॥
373.t: je koiee us kaa sa(n)gee hovai naale le sidhaavai ||
373.e: If someone is his companion, then he shall be taken along with him.

373.g: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਅਜਗਰੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਏ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
373.t: anahodhaa ajagar bhaar uThaae ni(n)dhak aganee maeh jalaavai ||1||
373.e: Like the dragon, the slanderer carries his huge, useless loads, and burns in his own fire. ||1||

373.g: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਤੀਤੈ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
373.t: paramesar kai dhuaarai j hoi biteetai su naanak aakh sunaavai ||
373.e: Nanak proclaims and announces what happens at the Door of the Transcendent Lord.

373.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਬਿਗਸਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
373.t: bhagat janaa kau sadhaa ana(n)dh hai har keeratan gai bigasaavai ||2||10||
373.e: The humble devotees of the Lord are forever in bliss; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, they blossom forth. ||2||10||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Even though I totally decorated myself,

373.g: ਤਉ ਭੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
373.t: tau bhee meraa man na pateeaaraa ||
373.e: still, my mind was not satisfied.
I applied various scented oils to my body,

373.g: ਓਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
373.t: oh sukh til samaan nahee paavau ||
373.e: and yet, I did not obtain even a tiny bit of pleasure from this.
Within my mind, I hold such a desire,
that I may live only to behold my Beloved, O my mother. ||1||

373.g: ਮਾਈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਧੀਰੈ ॥
373.t: maiee kahaa karau ih man na dheerai ||
373.e: O mother, what should I do? This mind cannot rest.
It is bewitched by the tender love of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||
Garments, ornaments, and such exquisite pleasures

373.g: ਓਇ ਭੀ ਜਾਨਉ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
373.t: oi bhee jaanau kitai na lekhai ||
373.e: I look upon these as of no account.
Likewise, honor, fame, dignity and greatness,
obedience by the whole world,
and a household as beautiful as a jewel.
If I am pleasing to God's Will, then I shall be blessed, and forever in bliss. ||2||
With foods and delicacies of so many different kinds,
and such abundant pleasures and entertainments,
power and property and absolute command

373.g: ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਜਾਇਸਿ ॥
373.t: man nahee dhraapai tirasanaa na jais ||
373.e: with these, the mind is not satisfied, and its thirst is not quenched.

373.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਇਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
373.t: bin milabe ih dhin na bihaavai ||
373.e: Without meeting Him, this day does not pass.

373.g: ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
373.t: milai prabhoo taa sabh sukh paavai ||3||
373.e: Meeting God, I find peace. ||3||
By searching and seeking, I have heard this news,
that without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, no one swims across.

373.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
373.t: jis masatak bhaag tin satigur paiaa ||
373.e: One who has this good destiny written upon his forehead, finds the True Guru.
His hopes are fulfilled, and his mind is satisfied.
