When one meets God, then his thirst is quenched.
Nanak has found the Lord, within his mind and body. ||4||11||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Panch-Padhay:

374.e: First, your social status is high.
Second, you are honored in society.
Third, your home is beautiful.
But you are so ugly, with self-conceit in your mind. ||1||
O beautiful, attractive, wise and clever woman:

374.g: ਅਤਿ ਗਰਬੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਕੀ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
374.t: at garabai moh faakee too(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
374.e: you have been trapped by your pride and attachment. ||1||Pause||
Your kitchen is so clean.
You take your bath, and worship, and apply the crimson mark upon your forehead;
with your mouth you speak wisdom, but you are destroyed by pride.
The dog of greed has ruined you in every way. ||2||
You wear your robes and enjoy pleasures;
you practice good conduct to impress people;
you apply scented oils of sandalwood and musk,
but your constant companion is the demon of anger. ||3||
Other people may be your water-carriers;
in this world, you may be a ruler.
Gold, silver and wealth may be yours,
but the goodness of your conduct has been destroyed by sexual promiscuity. ||4||

374.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
374.t: jaa kau dhirasaT miaa har rai ||
374.e: That soul, upon whom the Lord has bestowed His Glance of Grace,
is delivered from bondage.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord's sublime essence is obtained.
Says Nanak, how fruitful is that body. ||5||

374.g: ਸਭਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਬਨੇ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ॥
374.t: sabh roop sabh sukh bane suhaagan ||
374.e: All graces and all comforts shall come to you, as the happy soul-bride;

374.g: ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਬਿਚਖਨਿ ਤੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥
374.t: at su(n)dhar bichakhan too(n) ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||12||
374.e: you shall be supremely beautiful and wise. ||1||Second Pause||12||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Ek-Thukay 2 :
One who is seen to be alive, shall surely die.
But he who is dead shall remain ever-lasting. ||1||
Those who die while yet alive, shall through this death, live on.

374.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
374.t: har har naam avakhadh mukh paiaa gur sabadhee ras a(n)mrit peeve ||1|| rahaau ||
374.e: They place the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, as medicine in their mouths, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||
The clay pot of the body shall be broken.

374.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
374.t: jis chhooTai tirakuTee tis nij ghar vaasaa ||2||
374.e: One who has eliminated the three qualities dwells in the home of his inner self. ||2||
One who climbs high, shall fall into the nether regions of the underworld.

374.g: ਧਰਨਿ ਪੜੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਕਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
374.t: dharan paRai tis lagai na kaalaa ||3||
374.e: One who lies upon the ground, shall not be touched by death. ||3||

374.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਫਿਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
374.t: bhramat fire tin kichhoo na paiaa ||
374.e: Those who continue to wander around, achieve nothing.

374.g: ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
374.t: se asathir jin gur sabadh kamaiaa ||4||
374.e: Those who practice the Guru's Teachings, become steady and stable. ||4||

374.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
374.t: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh har kaa maal ||
374.e: This body and soul all belong to the Lord.
O Nanak, meeting the Guru, I am enraptured. ||5||13||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The puppet of the body has been fashioned with great skill.
Know for sure that it shall turn to dust. ||1||
Remember your origins, O thoughtless fool.

374.g: ਇਤਨੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
374.t: eitane kau tum(h) kiaa garabe ||1|| rahaau ||
374.e: Why are you so proud of yourself? ||1||Pause||
You are a guest, given three meals a day;
other things are entrusted to you. ||2||
you are just excrement, bones and blood, wrapped up in skin
- this is what you are taking such pride in! ||3||

374.g: ਏਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਪਾਕ ॥
374.t: ek vasat boojheh taa hoveh paak ||
374.e: If you could understand even one thing, then you would be pure.
Without understanding, you shall be forever impure. ||4||
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;

374.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥੫॥੧੪॥
374.t: jis te paieeaai har purakh sujaan ||5||14||
374.e: through Him, I obtain the Lord, the All-knowing Primal Being. ||5||14||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Ek-Thukay, Chau-Padhay:

374.g: ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
374.t: eik ghaRee dhinas mo kau bahut dhihaare ||
374.e: One moment, one day, is for me many days.

374.g: ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਿਲਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
374.t: man na rahai kaise milau piaare ||1||
374.e: My mind cannot survive - how can I meet my Beloved? ||1||

374.g: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
374.t: eik pal dhinas mo kau kabahu na bihaavai ||
374.e: I cannot endure one day, even one instant without Him.

375.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਘਨੇਰੀ ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
375.t: dharasan kee man aas ghaneree koiee aaisaa sa(n)t mo kau pireh milaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
375.e: My mind's desire for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is so great. Is there any Saint who can lead me to meet my Beloved? ||1||Pause||
The four watches of the day are like the four ages.

375.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਭਈ ਤਬ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
375.t: rain bhiee tab a(n)t na jaane ||2||
375.e: And when night comes, I think that it shall never end. ||2||
The five demons have joined together, to separate me from my Husband Lord.
Wandering and rambling, I cry out and wring my hands. ||3||

375.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
375.t: jan naanak kau har dharas dhikhaiaa ||
375.e: The Lord has revealed the Blessed Vision of His Darshan to servant Nanak;
realizing his own self, he has obtained supreme peace. ||4||15||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
In the Lord's service, are the greatest treasures.
Serving the Lord, the Ambrosial Naam comes into one's mouth. ||1||
The Lord is my Companion; He is with me, as my Help and Support.

375.g: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਤਹ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ਜਮੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਡਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
375.t: dhukh sukh simaree teh maujoodh jam bapuraa mo kau kahaa ddaraiee ||1|| rahaau ||
375.e: In pain and pleasure, whenever I remember Him, He is present. How can the poor Messenger of Death frighten me now? ||1||Pause||

375.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
375.t: har meree oT mai har kaa taan ||
375.e: The Lord is my Support; the Lord is my Power.

375.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
375.t: har meraa sakhaa man maeh dheebaan ||2||
375.e: The Lord is my Friend; He is my mind's advisor. ||2||

375.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
375.t: har meree poo(n)jee meraa har vesaahu ||
375.e: The Lord is my capital; the Lord is my credit.

375.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
375.t: gurmukh dhan khaTee har meraa saahu ||3||
375.e: As Gurmukh, I earn the wealth, with the Lord as my Banker. ||3||

375.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
375.t: gur kirapaa te ieh mat aavai ||
375.e: By Guru's Grace, this wisdom has come.

375.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
375.t: jan naanak har kai a(n)k samaavai ||4||16||
375.e: Servant Nanak has merged into the Being of the Lord. ||4||16||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

375.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
375.t: prabh hoi kirapaal ta ih man laiee ||
375.e: When God shows His Mercy, then this mind is focused on Him.
Serving the True Guru, all rewards are obtained. ||1||

375.g: ਮਨ ਕਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਰਹਿਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
375.t: man kiau bairaag karahigaa satigur meraa pooraa ||
375.e: O my mind, why are you so sad? My True Guru is Perfect.

375.g: ਮਨਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
375.t: manasaa kaa dhaataa sabh sukh nidhaan a(n)mirat sar sadh hee bharapooraa ||1|| rahaau ||
375.e: He is the Giver of blessings, the treasure of all comforts; His Ambrosial Pool of Nectar is always overflowing. ||1||Pause||
One who enshrines His Lotus Feet within the heart,
meets the Beloved Lord; the Divine Light is revealed to him. ||2||
The five companions have met together to sing the songs of joy.
The unstruck melody, the sound current of the Naad, vibrates and resounds. ||3||

375.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
375.t: gur naanak tuThaa miliaa har rai ||
375.e: O Nanak, when the Guru is totally pleased, one meets the Lord, the King.
Then, the night of one's life passes in peace and natural ease. ||4||17||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Showing His Mercy, the Lord has revealed Himself to me.
Meeting the True Guru, I have received the perfect wealth. ||1||
Gather such a wealth of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

375.g: ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਲੈ ਜਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ ਸੰਗੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
375.t: bhaeh na jaalai jal nahee ddoobai sa(n)g chhodd kar katahu na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
375.e: It cannot be burned by fire, and water cannot drown it; it does not forsake society, or go anywhere else. ||1||Pause||

375.g: ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਿਖੁਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
375.t: toT na aavai nikhuT na jai ||
375.e: It does not run short, and it does not run out.
Eating and consuming it, the mind remains satisfied. ||2||

375.g: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਾਣਾ ॥
375.t: so sach saahu jis ghar har dhan sa(n)chaanaa ||
375.e: He is the true banker, who gathers the wealth of the Lord within his own home.

375.g: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਸਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
375.t: eis dhan te sabh jag varasaanaa ||3||
375.e: With this wealth, the whole world profits. ||3||

375.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ॥
375.t: tin har dhan paiaa jis purab likhe kaa lahanaa ||
375.e: He alone receives the Lord's wealth, who is pre-ordained to receive it.

375.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੪॥੧੮॥
375.t: jan naanak a(n)t vaar naam gahanaa ||4||18||
375.e: O servant Nanak, at that very last moment, the Naam shall be your only decoration. ||4||18||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Just like the farmer, He plants His crop,
and, whether it is ripe or unripe, He cuts it down. ||1||
Just so, you must know this well, that whoever is born, shall die.

375.g: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਗਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
375.t: govi(n)dh bhagat asathir hai theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
375.e: Only the devotee of the Lord of the Universe becomes stable and permanent. ||1||Pause||
The day shall certainly be followed by the night.
And when the night passes, the morning shall again dawn. ||2||
In the love of Maya, the unfortunate ones remain in sleep.
By Guru's Grace, a rare few remain awake and aware. ||3||

376.e: Says Nanak, sing continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Your face shall be radiant, and your consciousness shall be immaculately pure. ||4||19||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The nine treasures are Yours - all treasures are Yours.
The Fulfiller of desires saves mortals in the end. ||1||

376.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੋ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਤਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
376.t: too(n) mero piaaro taa kaisee bhookhaa ||
376.e: You are my Beloved, so what hunger can I have?

376.g: ਤੂੰ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਦੂਖਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
376.t: too(n) man vasiaa lagai na dhookhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
376.e: When You dwell within my mind, pain does not touch me. ||1||Pause||
Whatever You do, is acceptable to me.
O True Lord and Master, True is Your Order. ||2||

376.g: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
376.t: jaa tudh bhaavai taa har gun gaau ||
376.e: When it is pleasing to Your Will, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

376.g: ਤੇਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੩॥
376.t: terai ghar sadhaa sadhaa hai niaau ||3||
376.e: Within Your Home, there is justice, forever and ever. ||3||
O True Lord and Master, You are unknowable and mysterious.
Nanak is committed to Your service. ||4||20||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

376.g: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
376.t: nikaT jeea kai sadh hee sa(n)gaa ||
376.e: He is near at hand; He is the eternal Companion of the soul.
His Creative Power is all-pervading, in form and color. ||1||

376.g: ਕਰ੍ਹੈ ਨ ਝੁਰੈ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੋਵਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
376.t: karhai na jhurai naa man rovanahaaraa ||
376.e: My mind does not worry; it does not grieve, or cry out.

376.g: ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
376.t: avinaasee avigat agochar sadhaa salaamat khasam hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
376.e: Imperishable, Unshakable, Unapproachable and forever safe and sound is my Husband Lord. ||1||Pause||

376.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਰੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
376.t: tere dhaasare kau kis kee kaan ||
376.e: Unto whom does Your servant pay homage?
His King preserves his honor. ||2||
That slave, whom God has released from the restrictions of social status

376.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਲਉਡੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਤਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
376.t: tis laudde kau kis kee taat ||3||
376.e: - who can now hold him in bondage? ||3||
The Lord is absolutely independent, and totally care-free;
O servant Nanak, chant His Glorious Praises. ||4||21||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

376.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਛੈ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
376.t: har ras chhodd hochhai ras maataa ||
376.e: Forsaking the Lord's sublime essence, the mortal is intoxicated with false essences.

376.g: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
376.t: ghar meh vasat baahar uTh jaataa ||1||
376.e: The substance is within the home of the self, but the mortal goes out to find it. ||1||

376.g: ਸੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਥਾ ॥
376.t: sunee na jaiee sach a(n)mirat kaathaa ||
376.e: He cannot hear the true ambrosial discourse.

376.g: ਰਾਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਝੂਠੀ ਲਗਿ ਗਾਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
376.t: raar karat jhooThee lag gaathaa ||1|| rahaau ||
376.e: Attached to false scriptures, he is engaged in argument. ||1||Pause||
He takes his wages from his Lord and Master, but he serves another.
With such sins, the mortal is engrossed. ||2||

376.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਕ ਜੋ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੀ ॥
376.t: tis siau look jo sadh hee sa(n)gee ||
376.e: He tries to hide from the One who is always with him.

376.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੰਗੀ ॥੩॥
376.t: kaam na aavai so fir fir ma(n)gee ||3||
376.e: He begs from Him, again and again. ||3||
Says Nanak, God is merciful to the meek.
As it pleases Him, He cherishes us. ||4||22||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

376.g: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
376.t: jeea praan dhan har ko naam ||
376.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my soul, my life, my wealth.
Here and hereafter, it is with me, to help me. ||1||

376.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੋਰਾ ॥
376.t: bin har naam avar sabh thoraa ||
376.e: Without the Lord's Name, everything else is useless.

376.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
376.t: tirapat aghaavai har dharasan man moraa ||1|| rahaau ||
376.e: My mind is satisfied and satiated by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||Pause||
Gurbani is the jewel, the treasure of devotion.
Singing, hearing and acting upon it, one is enraptured. ||2||
My mind is attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet.
The True Guru, in His Pleasure, has given this gift. ||3||
Unto Nanak, the Guru has revealed these instructions:
recognize the Imperishable Lord God in each and every heart. ||4||23||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The All-pervading Lord has established joys and celebrations.
He Himself embellishes His own works. ||1||
Perfect is the Creation of the Perfect Lord Master.

376.g: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਸੋਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
376.t: bharipur dhaar rahee sobh jaa kee ||1|| rahaau ||
376.e: His magnificent greatness is totally all-pervading. ||1||Pause||

376.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥
376.t: naam nidhaan jaa kee niramal soi ||
376.e: His Name is the treasure; His reputation is immaculate.
He Himself is the Creator; there is no other. ||2||

376.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
376.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh taa kai haath ||
376.e: All beings and creatures are in His Hands.

376.g: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੩॥
376.t: rav rahiaa prabh sabh kai saath ||3||
376.e: God is pervading in all, and is always with them. ||3||

377.e: The Perfect Guru has fashioned His perfect fashion.
O Nanak, the Lord's devotees are blessed with glorious greatness. ||4||24||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

377.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ॥
377.t: gur kai sabadh banaavahu ih man ||
377.e: I have shaped this mind in the mold of the Guru's Word.

377.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ॥੧॥
377.t: gur kaa dharasan sa(n)chahu har dhan ||1||
377.e: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I have gathered the wealth of the Lord. ||1||

377.g: ਊਤਮ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੂੰ ਆਉ ॥
377.t: uootam mat merai ridhai too(n) aau ||
377.e: O sublime understanding, come, enter into my mind,

377.g: ਧਿਆਵਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
377.t: dhiaavau gaavau gun govi(n)dhaa at preetam moh laagai naau ||1|| rahaau ||
377.e: that I may meditate and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and love so dearly the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
I am satisfied and satiated by the True Name.
My cleansing bath at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage is the dust of the Saints. ||2||
I recognize that the One Creator is contained in all.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my understanding is refined. ||3||
I have become the servant of all; I have renounced my ego and pride.
The Guru has given this gift to Nanak. ||4||25||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
My intellect has been enlightened, and my understanding is perfect.
Thus my evil-mindedness, which kept me far from Him, has been removed. ||1||
Such are the Teachings which I have received from the Guru;

377.g: ਬੂਡਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
377.t: booddat ghor a(n)dh koop meh nikasio mere bhaiee re ||1|| rahaau ||
377.e: while I was drowning in the pitch black well, I was saved, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

377.g: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਾਹ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥ ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥੨॥
377.t: mahaa agaeh agan kaa saagar || gur bohith taare ratanaagar ||2||
377.e: The Guru is the boat to cross over the totally unfathomable ocean of fire; He is treasure of jewels. ||2||
This ocean of Maya is dark and treacherous.
The Perfect Guru has revealed the way to cross over it. ||3||

377.g: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਕਛੁ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
377.t: jaap taap kachh ukat na moree ||
377.e: I do not have the ability to chant or practice intense meditation.
Guru Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||4||26||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Thi-Padhay:

377.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
377.t: har ras peevat sadh hee raataa ||
377.e: One who drinks in the Lord's sublime essence is forever imbued with it,

377.g: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
377.t: aan rasaa khin meh leh jaataa ||
377.e: while other essences wear off in an instant.

377.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
377.t: har ras ke maate man sadhaa ana(n)dh ||
377.e: Intoxicated with the Lord's sublime essence, the mind is forever in ecstasy.
Other essences bring only anxiety. ||1||
One who drinks in the Lord's sublime essence, is intoxicated and enraptured;

377.g: ਆਨ ਰਸਾ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਛੇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
377.t: aan rasaa sabh hochhe re ||1|| rahaau ||
377.e: all other essences have no effect. ||1||Pause||

377.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
377.t: har ras kee keemat kahee na jai ||
377.e: The value of the Lord's sublime essence cannot be described.
The Lord's sublime essence permeates the homes of the Holy.
One may spend thousands and millions, but it cannot be purchased.
He alone obtains it, who is so pre-ordained. ||2||
Tasting it, Nanak is wonder-struck.
Through the Guru, Nanak has obtained this taste.

377.g: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
377.t: e'eet uoot kat chhodd na jai ||
377.e: Here and hereafter, it does not leave him.
Nanak is imbued and enraptured with the Lord's subtle essence. ||3||27||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

377.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ਛੁਟਕੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
377.t: kaam karodh lobh moh miTaavai chhuTakai dhuramat apunee dhaaree ||
377.e: If she renounces and eliminates her sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment, and her evil-mindedness and self-conceit as well;

377.g: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
377.t: hoi nimaanee sev kamaaveh taa preetam hoveh man piaaree ||1||
377.e: and if, becoming humble, she serves Him, then she becomes dear to her Beloved's Heart. ||1||
Listen, O beautiful soul-bride: By the Word of the Holy Saint, you shall be saved.

377.g: ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਮਿਟੈ ਤੇਰੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖਮਨਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
377.t: dhookh bhookh miTai tero sahasaa sukh paaveh too(n) sukhaman naaree ||1|| rahaau ||
377.e: Your pain, hunger and doubt shall vanish, and you shall obtain peace, O happy soul-bride. ||1||Pause||

377.g: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਸ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
377.t: charan pakhaar karau gur sevaa aatam sudh bikh tiaas nivaaree ||
377.e: Washing the Guru's feet, and serving Him, the soul is sanctified, and the thirst for sin is quenched.

377.g: ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਿ ਦਾਸਰੀ ਤਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
377.t: dhaasan kee hoi dhaas dhaasaree taa paaveh sobhaa har dhuaaree ||2||
377.e: If you become the slave of the slave of the Lord's slaves, then you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

377.g: ਇਹੀ ਅਚਾਰ ਇਹੀ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
377.t: eihee achaar ihee biauhaaraa aagiaa maan bhagat hoi tum(h)aaree ||
377.e: This is right conduct, and this is the correct lifestyle, to obey the Command of the Lord's Will; this is your devotional worship.

377.g: ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥੨੮॥
377.t: jo ih ma(n)tr kamaavai naanak so bhaujal paar utaaree ||3||28||
377.e: One who practices this Mantra, O Nanak, swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||28||

378.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay:
You have been blessed with this human body.

378.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
378.t: gobi(n)dh milan kee ieh teree bareeaa ||
378.e: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.

378.g: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
378.t: avar kaaj terai kitai na kaam ||
378.e: Other efforts are of no use to you.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Make the effort, and cross over the terrifying world ocean.

378.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
378.t: janam birathaa jaat ra(n)g maiaa kai ||1|| rahaau ||
378.e: This human life is passing away in vain, in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||

378.g: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
378.t: jap tap sa(n)jam dharam na kamaiaa ||
378.e: I have not practiced meditation, penance, self-restraint or righteous living;

378.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
378.t: sevaa saadh na jaaniaa har raiaa ||
378.e: I have not served the Holy Saints, and I do not know the Lord, my King.
Says Nanak, my actions are vile and despicable;
O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary - please, preserve my honor. ||2||29||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

378.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
378.t: tujh bin avar naahee mai dhoojaa too(n) mere man maahee ||
378.e: Without You, there is no other for me; You alone are in my mind.

378.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਜੀਅ ਡਰਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
378.t: too(n) saajan sa(n)gee prabh meraa kaahe jeea ddaraahee ||1||
378.e: You are my Friend and Companion, God; why should my soul be afraid? ||1||
You are my support, You are my hope.

378.g: ਬੈਠਤ ਊਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
378.t: baiThat uooThat sovat jaagat visar naahee too(n) saas giraasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
378.e: While sitting down or standing up, while sleeping or waking, with every breath and morsel of food, I never forget You. ||1||Pause||

378.g: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਵਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
378.t: raakh raakh saran prabh apanee agan saagar vikaraalaa ||
378.e: Protect me, please protect me, O God; I have come to Your Sanctuary; the ocean of fire is so horrible.

378.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥
378.t: naanak ke sukhadhaate satigur ham tumare baal gupaalaa ||2||30||
378.e: The True Guru is the Giver of peace to Nanak; I am Your child, O Lord of the World. ||2||30||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The Lord God has saved me, His slave.

378.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਾਪੁ ਮੁਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
378.t: preetam siau mero man maaniaa taap muaa bikh khai ||1|| rahaau ||
378.e: My mind has surrendered to my Beloved; my fever has taken poison and died. ||1||Pause||

378.g: ਪਾਲਾ ਤਾਊ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
378.t: paalaa taauoo kachhoo na biaapai raam naam gun gai ||
378.e: Cold and heat do not touch me at all, when I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

378.g: ਡਾਕੀ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
378.t: ddaakee ko chit kachhoo na laagai charan kamal saranai ||1||
378.e: My consciousness is not affected by the witch, Maya; I take to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||

378.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਹੋਏ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
378.t: sa(n)t prasaadh bhe kirapaalaa hoe aap sahai ||
378.e: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord has shown His Mercy to me; He Himself is my Help and Support.

378.g: ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥੩੧॥
378.t: gun nidhaan nit gaavai naanak sahasaa dhukh miTai ||2||31||
378.e: Nanak ever sings the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of excellence; his doubts and pains are eliminated. ||2||31||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
I have taken the medicine of the Name of the Lord.
I have found peace, and the seat of pain has been removed. ||1||
The fever has been broken, by the Teachings of the Perfect Guru.

378.g: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
378.t: anadh bhiaa sabh miTe visoore ||1|| rahaau ||
378.e: I am in ecstasy, and all of my sorrows have been dispelled. ||1||Pause||
All beings and creatures obtain peace,
O Nanak, meditating on the Supreme Lord God. ||2||32||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
That time, which the mortal does not wish for, eventually comes.
Without the Lord's Command, how can understanding be understood? ||1||
The body is consumed by water, fire and earth.

378.g: ਓਹੁ ਨ ਬਾਲਾ ਬੂਢਾ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
378.t: oh na baalaa booddaa bhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
378.e: But the soul is neither young nor old, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
Servant Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Holy.
By Guru's Grace, he has shaken off the fear of death. ||2||33||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Forever and ever, the soul is illumined;
in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, it dwells at the Feet of the Lord. ||1||

378.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਤਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
378.t: raam naam nit jap man mere ||
378.e: Chant the Lord's Name each and every day, O my mind.

378.g: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਮਨ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
378.t: seetal saa(n)t sadhaa sukh paaveh kilavikh jaeh sabhe man tere ||1|| rahaau ||
378.e: You shall find lasting peace, contentment and tranquility, and all your sins shall depart. ||1||Pause||

378.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ॥
378.t: kahu naanak jaa ke pooran karam ||
378.e: Says Nanak, one who is blessed with perfect good karma,
meets the True Guru, and obtains the Perfect Supreme Lord God. ||2||34||
Thirty-four Shabads in Second House. ||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

378.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
378.t: jaa kaa har suaamee prabh belee ||
378.e: She who has the Lord God as her Friend

379.g: ਪੀੜ ਗਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
379.t: peeR giee fir nahee dhuhelee ||1|| rahaau ||
379.e: her pain is dispelled, and she shall not become sad again. ||1||Pause||

379.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ॥
379.t: kar kirapaa charan sa(n)g melee ||
379.e: Showing His Mercy, He joins her with His Feet,

379.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥
379.t: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh suhelee ||1||
379.e: and she attains celestial peace, joy and comfort. ||1||

379.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਅਤੋਲੀ ॥
379.t: saadhasa(n)g gun gai atolee ||
379.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, she sings the Glorious Praises of the Immeasurable Lord.

379.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਈ ਅਮੋਲੀ ॥੨॥੩੫॥
379.t: har simarat naanak bhiee amolee ||2||35||
379.e: Remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak, she becomes invaluable. ||2||35||

379.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
379.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
379.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

379.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਏ ਖੇਲਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
379.t: kaam karodh maiaa madh matasar e khelat sabh jooaai haare ||
379.e: Sexual desire, anger, intoxication with Maya and jealousy - I have lost all of these in the game of chance.

379.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਇਹ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
379.t: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam sach ieh apunai gireh bheetar vaare ||1||
379.e: Purity, contentment, compassion, faith and truthfulness - I have ushered these into the home of my self. ||1||

379.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਚੂਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਰੇ ॥
379.t: janam maran chooke sabh bhaare ||
379.e: All the loads of birth and death have been removed.

379.g: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
379.t: milat sa(n)g bhio man niramal gur poorai lai khin meh taare ||1|| rahaau ||
379.e: Joining the Saints' Society, my mind has become pure; the Perfect Guru has saved me in an instant. ||1||Pause||

379.g: ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
379.t: sabh kee ren hoi rahai manooaa sagale dheeseh meet piaare ||
379.e: My mind has become the dust of all, and everyone seems a sweet friend to me.

379.g: ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਰਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
379.t: sabh madhe raviaa meraa Thaakur dhaan dhet sabh jeea sam(h)aare ||2||
379.e: My Lord and Master is contained in all. He gives His Gifts to all beings, and cherishes them. ||2||

379.g: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਇਕੁ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਹੈ ਸਗਲਾ ਪਾਸਾਰੇ ॥
379.t: eko ek aap ik ekai ekai hai sagalaa paasaare ||
379.e: He Himself is the One and only; from the One, the One and only, came the expanse of the entire creation.

379.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
379.t: jap jap hoe sagal saadh jan ek naam dhiaai bahut udhaare ||3||
379.e: Chanting and meditating, all the humble beings have become Holy; meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, so many have been saved. ||3||

379.g: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੇ ॥
379.t: gahir ga(n)bheer bia(n)t gusaiee a(n)t nahee kichh paaraavaare ||
379.e: The Lord of the Universe is deep, profound and infinite; He has no end or limitation.

379.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩੬॥
379.t: tum(h)ree kirapaa te gun gaavai naanak dhiaai dhiaai prabh kau namasakaare ||4||36||
379.e: By Your Grace, Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises; meditating, meditating, he humbly bows to God. ||4||36||

379.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
379.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
379.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

379.g: ਤੂ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
379.t: too bia(n)t avigat agochar ih sabh teraa aakaar ||
379.e: You are Infinite, Eternal and Incomprehensible; all this is Your Creation.

379.g: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਹ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਜਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
379.t: kiaa ham ja(n)t kareh chaturaiee jaa(n) sabh kichh tujhai majhaar ||1||
379.e: What clever games can we play, when everything is contained in You? ||1||

379.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਬਾਲਿਕ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲੀਲਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
379.t: mere satigur apane baalik raakhahu leelaa dhaar ||
379.e: O my True Guru, protect me, Your child, through the power of Your play.

379.g: ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
379.t: dheh sumat sadhaa gun gaavaa mere Thaakur agam apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
379.e: Grant me the good sense to ever sing Your Glorious Praises, O my Inaccessible and Infinite Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

379.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਨਨਿ ਜਠਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਓਹੁ ਰਹਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
379.t: jaise janan jaThar meh praanee oh rahataa naam adhaar ||
379.e: The mortal is preserved in the womb of his mother, by the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord;

379.g: ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ਨਾ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
379.t: anadh karai saas saas sam(h)aarai naa pohai aganaar ||2||
379.e: he makes merry, and with each and every breath he remembers the Lord, and the fire does not touch him. ||2||

379.g: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
379.t: par dhan par dhaaraa par ni(n)dhaa in siau preet nivaar ||
379.e: Others' wealth, others' wives, and the slander of others - renounce your craving for these.

379.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੇਵੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
379.t: charan kamal sevee ridh a(n)tar gur poore kai aadhaar ||3||
379.e: Serve the Lord's Lotus Feet within your heart, and hold to the Support of the Perfect Guru. ||3||

379.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਸੰਗਾਰਿ ॥
379.t: girahu ma(n)dhar mahalaa jo dheeseh naa koiee sa(n)gaar ||
379.e: Houses, mansions and palaces which you see - none of these shall go with you.

379.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੩੭॥
379.t: jab lag jeeveh kalee kaal meh jan naanak naam sam(h)aar ||4||37||
379.e: As long as you live in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O servant Nanak, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||37||

379.g: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
379.t: aasaa ghar teejaa mahalaa panjavaa
379.e: Aasaa, Third House, Fifth Mehla:

379.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
379.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
379.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

379.g: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਕ ਜੋਬਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਰੂਪਵੰਤੁ ਜੋੁਆਨੀ ॥
379.t: raaj milak joban gireh sobhaa roopava(n)t juoaanee ||
379.e: Power, property, youth, household, fame and the beauty of youth;

379.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਹਸਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਲਾਲ ਲਾਖ ਬੈ ਆਨੀ ॥
379.t: bahut dharab hasatee ar ghoRe laal laakh bai aanee ||
379.e: great wealth, elephants, horses and jewels, purchased with tens of thousands of dollars;

379.g: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
379.t: aagai dharageh kaam na aavai chhodd chalai abhimaanee ||1||
379.e: hereafter, these shall be of no avail in the Court of the Lord; the proud must depart, leaving them behind. ||1||

379.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
379.t: kaahe ek binaa chit laieeaai ||
379.e: Why center your consciousness on any other than the Lord?

379.g: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
379.t: uooThat baiThat sovat jaagat sadhaa sadhaa har dhiaaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
379.e: Sitting down, standing up, sleeping and waking, forever and ever, meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

379.g: ਮਹਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਆਖਾੜੇ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਤੇ ਪਵਾੜੇ ॥
379.t: mahaa bachitr su(n)dhar aakhaaRe ran meh jite pavaaRe ||
379.e: He may have the most wondrous and beautiful arenas, and be victorious on the field of battle.

380.g: ਹਉ ਮਾਰਉ ਹਉ ਬੰਧਉ ਛੋਡਉ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਏਵ ਬਬਾੜੇ ॥
380.t: hau maarau hau ba(n)dhau chhoddau mukh te ev babaaRe ||
380.e: He may proclaim, ""I can kill anyone, I can capture anyone, and I can release anyone.""

380.g: ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਏਕ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ॥੨॥
380.t: aaiaa hukam paarabraham kaa chhodd chaliaa ek dhihaaRe ||2||
380.e: But when the Order comes from the Supreme Lord God, he departs and leaves in a day. ||2||

380.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
380.t: karam dharam jugat bahu karataa karanaihaar na jaanai ||
380.e: He may perform all sorts of religious rituals and good actions, but he does not know the Creator Lord, the Doer of all.

380.g: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਤੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
380.t: aupadhes karai aap na kamaavai tat sabadh na pachhaanai ||
380.e: He teaches, but does not practice what he preaches; he does not realize the essential reality of the Word of the Shabad.

380.g: ਨਾਂਗਾ ਆਇਆ ਨਾਂਗੋ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਿਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਖਾਕੁ ਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
380.t: naa(n)gaa aaiaa naa(n)go jaasee jiau hasatee khaak chhaanai ||3||
380.e: Naked he came, and naked he shall depart; he is like an elephant, throwing dust on himself. ||3||

380.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
380.t: sa(n)t sajan sunahu sabh meetaa jhooThaa eh pasaaraa ||
380.e: O Saints, and friends, listen to me: all this world is false.

380.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
380.t: meree meree kar kar ddoobe khap khap mue gavaaraa ||
380.e: Continually claiming, ""Mine, mine"", the mortals are drowned; the fools waste away and die.

380.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੮॥
380.t: gur mil naanak naam dhiaaiaa saach naam nisataaraa ||4||1||38||
380.e: Meeting the Guru, O Nanak, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the True Name, I am emancipated. ||4||1||38||

380.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
380.t: raag aasaa ghar panjavaa mahalaa panjavaa
380.e: Raag Aasaa, Fifth House, Fifth Mehla:

380.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
380.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
380.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

380.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤ ਧੰਧ ਅੰਧ ॥
380.t: bhram meh soiee sagal jagat dha(n)dh a(n)dh ||
380.e: The whole world is asleep in doubt; it is blinded by worldly entanglements.

380.g: ਕੋਊ ਜਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ॥੧॥
380.t: kouoo jaagai har jan ||1||
380.e: How rare is that humble servant of the Lord who is awake and aware. ||1||

380.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਗਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
380.t: mahaa mohanee magan pria preet praan ||
380.e: The mortal is intoxicated with the great enticement of Maya, which is dearer to him than life.

380.g: ਕੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ॥੨॥
380.t: kouoo tiaagai viralaa ||2||
380.e: How rare is the one who renounces it. ||2||

380.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਨੂਪ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ॥
380.t: charan kamal aanoop har sa(n)t ma(n)t ||
380.e: The Lord's Lotus Feet are incomparably beautiful; so is the Mantra of the Saint.

380.g: ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਧੂ ॥੩॥
380.t: kouoo laagai saadhoo ||3||
380.e: How rare is that holy person who is attached to them. ||3||

380.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
380.t: naanak saadhoo sa(n)g jaage giaan ra(n)g ||
380.e: O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the love of divine knowledge is awakened;

380.t: vaddabhaage kirapaa ||4||1||39||
380.e: the Lord's Mercy is bestowed upon those who are blessed with such good destiny. ||4||1||39||

380.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
380.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
380.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

380.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
380.t: raag aasaa ghar chhayvaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
380.e: Raag Aasaa, Sixth House, Fifth Mehla:

380.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
380.t: jo tudh bhaavai so paravaanaa sookh sahaj man soiee ||
380.e: Whatever pleases You is acceptable to me; that alone brings peace and ease to my mind.

380.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
380.t: karan kaaran samarath apaaraa avar naahee re koiee ||1||
380.e: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes, All-powerful and Infinite; there is none other than You. ||1||

380.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
380.t: tere jan rasak rasak gun gaaveh ||
380.e: Your humble servants sing Your Glorious Praises with enthusiasm and love.

380.g: ਮਸਲਤਿ ਮਤਾ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
380.t: masalat mataa siaanap jan kee jo too(n) kareh karaaveh ||1|| rahaau ||
380.e: That alone is good advice, wisdom and cleverness for Your humble servant, which You do or cause to be done. ||1||Pause||

380.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
380.t: a(n)mrit naam tumaaraa piaare saadhasa(n)g ras paiaa ||
380.e: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O Beloved Lord; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained its sublime essence.

380.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
380.t: tirapat aghai seiee jan poore sukh nidhaan har gaiaa ||2||
380.e: Those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled, singing the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of peace. ||2||

380.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
380.t: jaa kau Tek tum(h)aaree suaamee taa kau naahee chi(n)taa ||
380.e: One who has Your Support, O Lord Master, is not afflicted by anxiety.

380.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਈ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਭਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
380.t: jaa kau dhiaa tumaaree hoiee se saeh bhale bhagava(n)taa ||3||
380.e: One who is blessed by Your Kind Mercy, is the best, the most fortunate king. ||3||

380.g: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਜਬ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
380.t: bharam moh dhroh sabh nikase jab kaa dharasan paiaa ||
380.e: Doubt, attachment, and deceit have all disappeared, since I obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

380.g: ਵਰਤਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੦॥
380.t: varatan naam naanak sach keenaa har naame ra(n)g samaiaa ||4||1||40||
380.e: Dealing in the Naam, O Nanak, we become truthful, and in the Love of the Lord's Name, we are absorbed. ||4||1 | 40||

380.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
380.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
380.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

380.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਰਾਈ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
380.t: janam janam kee mal dhovai paraiee aapanaa keetaa paavai ||
380.e: He washes off the filth of other peoples' incarnations, but he obtains the rewards of his own actions.

380.g: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਚਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
380.t: e'eehaa sukh nahee dharageh ddoiee jam pur jai pachaavai ||1||
380.e: He has no peace in this world, and he has no place in the Court of the Lord. In the City of Death, he is tortured. ||1||

380.g: ਨਿੰਦਕਿ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
380.t: ni(n)dhak ahilaa janam gavaiaa ||
380.e: The slanderer loses his life in vain.

380.g: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤੈ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
380.t: pahuch na saakai kaahoo baatai aagai Thaur na paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
380.e: He cannot succeed in anything, and in the world hereafter, he finds no place at all. ||1||Pause||

380.g: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
380.t: kirat piaa ni(n)dhak bapure kaa kiaa oh karai bichaaraa ||
380.e: Such is the fate of the wretched slanderer - what can the poor creature do?

380.g: ਤਹਾ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ਜਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਓਹੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
380.t: tahaa bigootaa jeh koi na raakhai oh kis peh kare pukaaraa ||2||
380.e: He is ruined there, where no one can protect him; with whom should he lodge his complaint? ||2||

381.g: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
381.t: ni(n)dhak kee gat katahoo(n) naahee khasamai evai bhaanaa ||
381.e: The slanderer shall never attain emancipation; this is the Will of the Lord and Master.

381.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
381.t: jo jo ni(n)dh kare sa(n)tan kee tiau sa(n)tan sukh maanaa ||3||
381.e: The more the Saints are slandered, the more they dwell in peace. ||3||

381.g: ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
381.t: sa(n)taa Tek tumaaree suaamee too(n) sa(n)tan kaa sahaiee ||
381.e: The Saints have Your Support, O Lord and Master; You are the Saints' Help and Support.

381.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੧॥
381.t: kahu naanak sa(n)t har raakhe ni(n)dhak dhe'ee ruRaiee ||4||2||41||
381.e: Says Nanak, the Saints are saved by the Lord; the slanderers are drowned in the deep. ||4||2||41||

381.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
381.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
381.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

381.g: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਧੋਇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਠਉਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਖੋਏ ॥
381.t: baahar dhoi a(n)tar man mailaa dhui Thaur apune khoe ||
381.e: He washes outwardly, but within, his mind is filthy; thus he loses his place in both worlds.

381.g: ਈਹਾ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਸਿ ਮੁਸਿ ਰੋਏ ॥੧॥
381.t: e'eehaa kaam karodh moh viaapiaa aagai mus mus roe ||1||
381.e: Here, he is engrossed in sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment; hereafter, he shall sigh and weep. ||1||

381.g: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਾ ॥
381.t: govi(n)dh bhajan kee mat hai horaa ||
381.e: The way to vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe is different.

381.g: ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਰਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੁਨਈ ਡੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
381.t: varamee maaree saap na mariee naam na suniee ddoraa ||1|| rahaau ||
381.e: Destroying the snake-hole, the snake is not killed; the deaf person does not hear the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

381.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
381.t: maiaa kee kirat chhodd gavaiee bhagatee saar na jaanai ||
381.e: He renounces the affairs of Maya, but he does not appreciate the value of devotional worship.

381.g: ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਕਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਤੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
381.t: bedh saasatr kau tarakan laagaa tat jog na pachhaanai ||2||
381.e: He finds fault with the Vedas and the Shaastras, and does not know the essence of Yoga. ||2||

381.g: ਉਘਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਜੈਸਾ ਖੋਟਾ ਢਬੂਆ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
381.t: aughar giaa jaisaa khoTaa ddabooaa nadhar saraafaa aaiaa ||
381.e: He stands exposed, like a counterfeit coin, when inspected by the Lord, the Assayer.

381.g: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਾ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
381.t: a(n)tarajaamee sabh kichh jaanai us te kahaa chhapaiaa ||3||
381.e: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything; how can we hide anything from Him? ||3||

381.g: ਕੂੜਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਬੰਚਿ ਨਿੰਮੁਨੀਆਦਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਤਤਕਾਲੇ ॥
381.t: kooR kapaT ba(n)ch ni(n)muneeaadhaa binas giaa tatakaale ||
381.e: Through falsehood, fraud and deceit, the mortal collapses in an instant - he has no foundation at all.

381.g: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਅਪਨੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੨॥
381.t: sat sat sat naanak kahiaa apanai hiradhai dhekh samaale ||4||3||42||
381.e: Truly, truly, truly, Nanak speaks; look within your own heart, and realize this. ||4||3||42||

381.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
381.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
381.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

381.g: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
381.t: audham karat hovai man niramal naachai aap nivaare ||
381.e: Making the effort, the mind becomes pure; in this dance, the self is silenced.

381.g: ਪੰਚ ਜਨਾ ਲੇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
381.t: pa(n)ch janaa le vasagat raakhai man meh eka(n)kaare ||1||
381.e: The five passions are kept under control, and the One Lord dwells in the mind. ||1||

381.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
381.t: teraa jan nirat kare gun gaavai ||
381.e: Your humble servant dances and sings Your Glorious Praises.

381.g: ਰਬਾਬੁ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਤਾਲ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
381.t: rabaab pakhaavaj taal ghu(n)gharoo anahadh sabadh vajaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
381.e: He plays upon the guitar, tambourine and cymbals, and the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds. ||1||Pause||

381.g: ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਅਵਰ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ॥
381.t: prathame man parabodhai apanaa paachhai avar reejhaavai ||
381.e: First, he instructs his own mind, and then, he leads others.

381.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
381.t: raam naam jap hiradhai jaapai mukh te sagal sunaavai ||2||
381.e: He chants the Lord's Name and meditates on it in his heart; with his mouth, he announces it to all. ||2||

381.g: ਕਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰੈ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
381.t: kar sa(n)g saadhoo charan pakhaarai sa(n)t dhoor tan laavai ||
381.e: He joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and washes their feet; he applies the dust of the Saints to his body

381.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
381.t: man tan arap dhare gur aagai sat padhaarath paavai ||3||
381.e: He surrenders his mind and body, and places them before the Guru; thus, he obtains the true wealth. ||3||

381.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਪੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ਸਰਧਾ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
381.t: jo jo sunai pekhai lai saradhaa taa kaa janam maran dhukh bhaagai ||
381.e: Whoever listens to, and beholds the Guru with faith, shall see his pains of birth and death taken away.

381.g: ਐਸੀ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੪੩॥
381.t: aaisee nirat narak nivaarai naanak gurmukh jaagai ||4||4||43||
381.e: Such a dance eliminates hell; O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains wakeful. ||4||4||43||

381.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
381.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
381.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

381.g: ਅਧਮ ਚੰਡਾਲੀ ਭਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣੀ ਸੂਦੀ ਤੇ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
381.t: adham cha(n)ddaalee bhiee brahamanee soodhee te sresaTaiee re ||
381.e:
The lowly outcaste becomes a Brahmin, and the untouchable sweeper becomes pure and sublime.
The castes mentioned here refer to stages of spiritual evolution.

381.g: ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਸਖਨੀ ਲਹਬਰ ਬੂਝੀ ਖਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
381.t: paataalee aakaasee sakhanee lahabar boojhee khaiee re ||1||
381.e: The burning desire of the nether regions and the etheric realms is finally quenched and extinguished. ||1||

381.g: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਖਾਈ ਮੂਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਈ ਰੇ ॥
381.t: ghar kee bilaiee avar sikhaiee moosaa dhekh ddaraiee re ||
381.e:
The house-cat has been taught otherwise, and is hesitant upon seeing the mouse.

The house cat is symbolic of the mind in this body and the mouse is symbolic of material gains.

381.g: ਅਜ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੇਹਰਿ ਕੂਕਰ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
381.t: aj kai vas gur keeno kehar kookar tineh lagaiee re ||1|| rahaau ||
381.e:
The Guru has put the tiger under the control of the goat, and now, the dog eats grass. ||1||Pause||
Tiger is symbolic of Ego, goat is symbolic of humility. Dog represents the dark attributes (tamo gun) and grass represents the harmonious attributes (sato gun).

381.g: ਬਾਝੁ ਥੂਨੀਆ ਛਪਰਾ ਥਾਮਿੑਆ ਨੀਘਰਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
381.t: baajh thooneeaa chhaparaa thaami(h)aa neeghariaa ghar paiaa re ||
381.e:
Without pillars, the roof is supported, and the homeless wandering mind has found a home.

Pillars represent material rewards, roof represents the stability of mind.

381.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜੜੀਏ ਲੈ ਜੜਿਓ ਜੜਾਵਾ ਥੇਵਾ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
381.t: bin jaRe'e lai jaRio jaRaavaa thevaa acharaj laiaa re ||2||
381.e: Without any jeweler, the jewelry has been set, and the wonderful stone of naam shines forth. ||2||

381.g: ਦਾਦੀ ਦਾਦਿ ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ਚੂਪੀ ਨਿਰਨਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥
381.t: dhaadhee dhaadh na pahuchanahaaraa choopee niranau paiaa re ||
381.e: The claimant who keeps on complaining does not find justice, but by becoming calm he understands the justice in creation.

381.g: ਮਾਲਿ ਦੁਲੀਚੈ ਬੈਠੀ ਲੇ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਨੈਨ ਦਿਖਾਲਨੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
381.t: maal dhuleechai baiThee le mritak nain dhikhaalan dhaiaa re ||3||
381.e:
The ego that used to sit on costly carpets has died and the tendency to glare at others has gone away. ||3||
costly carpets is symbolism for place of consequence.

382.g: ਸੋਈ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਮੈ ਜਾਨਾ ਜਾਨਣਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਛਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
382.t: soiee ajaan kahai mai jaanaa jaananahaar na chhaanaa re ||
382.e: One who claims to know, is ignorant; The one who understands, cannot remain hidden.

382.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਆਇਆ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੪੪॥
382.t: kahu naanak gur amiau peeaaiaa rasak rasak bigasaanaa re ||4||5||44||
382.e: Says Nanak, the Guru has given me the Ambrosial Nectar to drink in; savoring it and relishing it, I blossom forth in bliss. ||4||5||44||

382.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
382.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
382.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

382.g: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ਅਉਗਨ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿਆ ॥
382.t: ba(n)dhan kaaT bisaare aaugan apanaa biradh sam(h)aariaa ||
382.e: He has cut away my bonds, and overlooked my shortcomings, and so He has confirmed His nature.

382.g: ਹੋਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਨਿਆਈ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
382.t: hoe kirapaal maat pit niaaiee baarik jiau pratipaariaa ||1||
382.e: Becoming merciful to me, like a mother or a father, he has come to cherish me as His own child. ||1||

382.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਾਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ॥
382.t: gursikh raakhe gur gopaal ||
382.e: The GurSikhs are preserved by the Guru, by the Lord of the Universe.

382.g: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਮਹਾ ਭਵਜਲ ਤੇ ਅਪਨੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
382.t: kaadd le'ee mahaa bhavajal te apanee nadhar nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
382.e: He rescues them from the terrible world ocean, casting His Glance of Grace upon them. ||1||Pause||

382.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
382.t: jaa kai simaran jam te chhuTeeaai halat palat sukh paieeaai ||
382.e: Meditating in remembrance on Him, we escape from the Messenger of Death; here and hereafter, we obtain peace.

382.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
382.t: saas giraas japahu jap rasanaa neet neet gun gaieeaai ||2||
382.e: With every breath and morsel of food, meditate, and chant with your tongue, continually, each and every day; sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

382.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
382.t: bhagat prem param padh paiaa saadhasa(n)g dhukh naaThe ||
382.e: Through loving devotional worship, the supreme status is obtained, and in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sorrows are dispelled.

382.g: ਛਿਜੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਗਾਠੇ ॥੩॥
382.t: chhijai na jai kichh bhau na biaape har dhan niramal gaaThe ||3||
382.e: I am not worn down, I do not die, and nothing strikes fear in me, since I have the wealth of the Lord's Immaculate Name in my purse. ||3||

382.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
382.t: a(n)t kaal prabh bhe sahaiee it ut raakhanahaare ||
382.e: At the very last moment, God becomes the mortal's Help and Support; here and hereafter, He is the Savior Lord.

382.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੀਤ ਹੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੪੫॥
382.t: praan meet heet dhan merai naanak sadh balihaare ||4||6||45||
382.e: He is my breath of life, my friend, support and wealth; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||6||45||

382.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
382.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
382.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

382.g: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
382.t: jaa too(n) saahib taa bhau kehaa hau tudh bin kis saalaahee ||
382.e: Since You are my Lord and Master, what is there for me to fear? Other than You, who else should I praise?

382.g: ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਮੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
382.t: ek too(n) taa sabh kichh hai mai tudh bin dhoojaa naahee ||1||
382.e: You are the One and only, and so do all things exist; without You, there is nothing at all for me. ||1||

382.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
382.t: baabaa bikh dhekhiaa sa(n)saar ||
382.e: O Father, I have seen that the world is poison.

382.g: ਰਖਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
382.t: rakhiaa karahu gusaiee mere mai naam teraa aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
382.e: Save me, O Lord of the Universe! Your Name is my only Support. ||1||Pause||

382.g: ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਭਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
382.t: jaaneh birathaa sabhaa man kee hor kis peh aakh sunaieeaai ||
382.e: You know completely the condition of my mind; who else could I go to tell of it?

382.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
382.t: vin naavai sabh jag bauraiaa naam milai sukh paieeaai ||2||
382.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the whole world has gone crazy; obtaining the Naam, it finds peace. ||2||

382.g: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ਜਿ ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
382.t: kiaa kaheeaai kis aakh sunaieeaai j kahanaa su prabh jee paas ||
382.e: What shall I say? Unto whom shall I speak? What I have to say, I say to God.

382.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ॥੩॥
382.t: sabh kichh keetaa teraa varatai sadhaa sadhaa teree aas ||3||
382.e: Everything which exists was created by You. You are my hope, forever and ever. ||3||

382.g: ਜੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
382.t: je dheh vaddiaaiee taa teree vaddiaaiee it ut tujheh dhiaau ||
382.e: If you bestow greatness, then it is Your greatness; here and hereafter, I meditate on You.

382.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੬॥
382.t: naanak ke prabh sadhaa sukhadhaate mai taan teraa ik naau ||4||7||46||
382.e: The Lord God of Nanak is forever the Giver of peace; Your Name is my only strength. ||4||7||46||

382.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
382.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
382.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

382.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਜਨਹਿ ਪੀਓ ॥
382.t: a(n)mrit naam tum(h)aaraa Thaakur eh mahaa ras janeh peeo ||
382.e: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O Lord Master; Your humble servant drinks in this supreme elixir.

382.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਚੂਕੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਰੇ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ ਭਰਮੁ ਬੀਓ ॥੧॥
382.t: janam janam chooke bhai bhaare dhurat binaasio bharam beeo ||1||
382.e: The fearful load of sins from countless incarnations has vanished; doubt and duality are also dispelled. ||1||

382.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਤ ਮੈ ਜੀਓ ॥
382.t: dharasan pekhat mai jeeo ||
382.e: I live by beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

382.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਰੁ ਥੀਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
382.t: sun kar bachan tum(h)aare satigur man tan meraa Thaar theeo ||1|| rahaau ||
382.e: Listening to Your Words, O True Guru, my mind and body are cooled and soothed. ||1||Pause||

382.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਭਇਓ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਏਹੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਓ ॥
382.t: tum(h)ree kirapaa te bhio saadhasa(n)g eh kaaj tum(h) aap keeo ||
382.e: By Your Grace, I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; You Yourself have caused this to happen.

382.g: ਦਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਭਈ ਖੀਓ ॥੨॥
382.t: dhiR kar charan gahe prabh tum(h)re sahaje bikhiaa bhiee kheeo ||2||
382.e: Holding fast to Your Feet, O God, the poison is easily neutralized. ||2||

382.g: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਏਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਲੀਓ ॥
382.t: sukh nidhaan naam prabh tumaraa eh abinaasee ma(n)tr leeo ||
382.e: Your Name, O God, is the treasure of peace; I have received this everlasting Mantra.

382.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੈਰੁ ਗੀਓ ॥੩॥
382.t: kar kirapaa moh satigur dheenaa taap sa(n)taap meraa bair geeo ||3||
382.e: Showing His Mercy, the True Guru has given it to me, and my fever and pain and hatred are annulled. ||3||

382.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਓ ॥
382.t: dha(n)nu su maanas dhehee paiee jit prabh apanai mel leeo ||
382.e: Blessed is the attainment of this human body, by which God blends Himself with me.

382.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਕਲਿਜੁਗੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੀਓ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੭॥
382.t: dha(n)nu su kalijug saadhasa(n)g keeratan gaieeaai naanak naam adhaar heeo ||4||8||47||
382.e: Blessed, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.O Nanak, the Naam is my only Support. ||4||8||47||

383.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
383.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
383.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

383.g: ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੂਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
383.t: aagai hee te sabh kichh hooaa avar k jaanai giaanaa ||
383.e: Everything is pre-ordained; what else can be known through study?

383.g: ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
383.t: bhool chook apanaa baarik bakhasiaa paarabraham bhagavaanaa ||1||
383.e: The errant child has been forgiven by the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

383.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
383.t: satigur meraa sadhaa dhiaalaa moh dheen kau raakh leeaa ||
383.e: My True Guru is always merciful; He has saved me, the meek one.

383.g: ਕਾਟਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
383.t: kaaTiaa rog mahaa sukh paiaa har a(n)mrit mukh naam dheeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
383.e: He has cured me of my disease, and I have obtained the greatest peace; He has placed the Ambrosial Name of the Lord in my mouth. ||1||Pause||

383.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਪ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥
383.t: anik paap mere parahariaa ba(n)dhan kaaTe mukat bhe ||
383.e: He has washed away my countless sins; He has cut away my bonds, and I am liberated.

383.g: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਘੋਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ॥੨॥
383.t: a(n)dh koop mahaa ghor te baeh pakar gur kaadd le'ee ||2||
383.e: He has taken me by the arm, and pulled me out of the terrible, deep dark pit. ||2||

383.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਰਾਖੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
383.t: nirabhau bhe sagal bhau miTiaa raakhe raakhanahaare ||
383.e: I have become fearless, and all my fears have been erased. The Savior Lord has saved me.

383.g: ਐਸੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
383.t: aaisee dhaat teree prabh mere kaaraj sagal savaare ||3||
383.e: Such is Your generosity, O my God, that You have resolved all my affairs. ||3||

383.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
383.t: gun nidhaan saahib man melaa ||
383.e: My mind has met with my Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence.

383.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੮॥
383.t: saran piaa naanak suohelaa ||4||9||48||
383.e: Taking to His Sanctuary, Nanak has become blissful. ||4||9||48||

383.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
383.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
383.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

383.g: ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੂ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
383.t: too(n) visareh taa(n) sabh ko laagoo cheet aaveh taa(n) sevaa ||
383.e: If I forget You, then everyone becomes my enemy. When You come to mind, then they serve me.

383.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
383.t: avar na kouoo dhoojaa soojhai saache alakh abhevaa ||1||
383.e: I do not know any other at all, O True, Invisible, Inscrutable Lord. ||1||

383.g: ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਲੋਗਨ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥
383.t: cheet aavai taa(n) sadhaa dhiaalaa logan kiaa vechaare ||
383.e: When You come to mind, You are always merciful to me; what can the poor people do to me?

383.g: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
383.t: buraa bhalaa kahu kis no kaheeaai sagale jeea tum(h)aare ||1|| rahaau ||
383.e: Tell me, who should I call good or bad, since all beings are Yours? ||1||Pause||

383.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ॥
383.t: teree Tek teraa aadhaaraa haath dhei too(n) raakheh ||
383.e: You are my Shelter, You are my Support; giving me Your hand, You protect me.

383.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਿਪੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਭਾਖੈ ॥੨॥
383.t: jis jan uoopar teree kirapaa tis kau bip na kouoo bhaakhai ||2||
383.e: That humble being, upon whom You bestow Your Grace, is not touched by slander or suffering. ||2||

383.g: ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਓਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
383.t: oho sukh ohaa vaddiaaiee jo prabh jee man bhaanee ||
383.e: That is peace, and that is greatness, which is pleasing to the mind of the Dear Lord God.

383.g: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
383.t: too(n) dhaanaa too(n) sadh miharavaanaa naam milai ra(n)g maanee ||3||
383.e: You are all-knowing, You are forever compassionate; obtaining Your Name, I revel in it and make merry. ||3||

383.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
383.t: tudh aagai aradhaas hamaaree jeeau pi(n)dd sabh teraa ||
383.e: I offer my prayer before You: my body and soul are all Yours.

383.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੯॥
383.t: kahu naanak sabh teree vaddiaaiee koiee naau na jaanai meraa ||4||10||49||
383.e: Says Nanak, this is all Your greatness; no one even knows my name. ||4||10||49||

383.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
383.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
383.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

383.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
383.t: kar kirapaa prabh a(n)tarajaamee saadhasa(n)g har paieeaai ||
383.e: Show Your Mercy, O God, O Searcher of hearts, that in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I might obtain You, Lord.

383.g: ਖੋਲਿ ਕਿਵਾਰ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
383.t: khol kivaar dhikhaale dharasan punarap janam na aaieeaai ||1||
383.e: When You open Your Door, and reveal the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the mortal is not relegated to reincarnation again. ||1||

383.g: ਮਿਲਉ ਪਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਉ ਰੇ ॥
383.t: milau pareetam suaamee apune sagale dhookh harau re ||
383.e: Meeting with my Beloved Lord and Master, all my pains are taken away.

383.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਿਨਿੑ ਰਿਦੈ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
383.t: paarabraham jini(h) ridhai araadhiaa taa kai sa(n)g tarau re ||1|| rahaau ||
383.e: I am saved and carried across, in the company of those who remember the Supreme Lord God in their hearts. ||1||Pause||

383.g: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਪਾਵਕ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਏ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥
383.t: mahaa udhiaan paavak saagar bhe harakh sog meh basanaa ||
383.e: This world is a great wilderness, an ocean of fire, in which mortals abide, in pleasure and pain.

383.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
383.t: satigur bheT bhiaa man niramal jap a(n)mrit har rasanaa ||2||
383.e: Meeting with the True Guru, the mortal becomes immaculately pure; with his tongue, he chants the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||2||

383.g: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੋਮਲ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
383.t: tan dhan thaap keeo sabh apanaa komal ba(n)dhan baa(n)dhiaa ||
383.e: He preserves his body and wealth, and takes everything as his own; such are the subtle bonds which bind him.

383.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥੩॥
383.t: gur parasaadh bhe jan mukate har har naam araadhiaa ||3||
383.e: By Guru's Grace, the mortal becomes liberated, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

383.g: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
383.t: raakh le'ee prabh raakhanahaarai jo prabh apune bhaane ||
383.e: God, the Savior, has saved those, who are pleasing to the Will of God.

383.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੦॥
383.t: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tum(h)raa dhaate naanak sadh kurabaane ||4||11||50||
383.e: The soul and body are all Yours, O Great Giver; O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice. ||4||11||50||

383.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
383.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
383.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

383.g: ਮੋਹ ਮਲਨ ਨੀਦ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਭਇਓ ਰੀ ॥
383.t: moh malan needh te chhuTakee kaun anugrahu bhio ree ||
383.e: You have avoided the slumber of attachment and impurity - by whose favor has this happened?

383.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
383.t: mahaa mohanee tudh na viaapai teraa aalas kahaa gio ree ||1|| rahaau ||
383.e: The great enticer does not affect you. Where has your laziness gone? ||1||Pause||

384.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਾਖਰੋ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਉਨ ਛੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
384.t: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar gaakharo sa(n)jam kaun chhuTio ree ||
384.e: How have you escaped from the treachery of sexual desire, anger and egotism?

384.g: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਸੁਰ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ ਸਗਲੋ ਭਵਨੁ ਲੁਟਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
384.t: sur nar dhev asur trai guneeaa sagalo bhavan luTio ree ||1||
384.e: The holy beings, angels and demons of the three qualities, and all the worlds have been plundered. ||1||

384.g: ਦਾਵਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਜਾਲੇ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿਆ ਬੂਟੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
384.t: dhaavaa agan bahut tiran jaale koiee hariaa booT rahio ree ||
384.e: The forest fire has burnt down so much of the grass; how rare are the plants which have remained green.

384.g: ਐਸੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
384.t: aaiso samarath varan na saakau taa kee upamaa jaat na kahio ree ||2||
384.e: He is so All-powerful, that I cannot even describe Him; no one can chant His Praises. ||2||

384.g: ਕਾਜਰ ਕੋਠ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਨ ਕਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਰਨੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥
384.t: kaajar koTh meh bhiee na kaaree niramal baran banio ree ||
384.e: In the store-room of the lamp-black, I did not turn black; my color remained immaculate and pure.

384.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਅਚਰਜ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
384.t: mahaa ma(n)tr gur hiradhai basio acharaj naam sunio ree ||3||
384.e: The Guru has implanted the Maha Mantra, the Great Mantra, within my heart, and I have heard the wondrous Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

384.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਦਰਿ ਅਵਲੋਕਨ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
384.t: kar kirapaa prabh nadhar avalokan apunai charan lagaiee ||
384.e: Showing His Mercy, God has looked upon me with favor, and He has attached me to His feet.

384.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੫੧॥
384.t: prem bhagat naanak sukh paiaa saadhoo sa(n)g samaiee ||4||12||51||
384.e: Through loving devotional worship, O Nanak, I have obtained peace; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am absorbed into the Lord. ||4||12||51||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

384.t: raag aasaa ghar satvaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
384.e: Raag Aasaa, Seventh House, Fifth Mehla:
That red dress looks so beautiful on your body.
Your Husband Lord is pleased, and His heart is enticed. ||1||
Whose handiwork is this red beauty of yours?

384.g: ਕਵਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਤੂੰ ਭਈ ਗੁਲਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
384.t: kavan ra(n)g too(n) bhiee gulaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
384.e: Whose love has rendered the poppy so red? ||1||Pause||
You are so beautiful; you are the happy soul-bride.

384.g: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
384.t: tum ghar laalan tum ghar bhaag ||2||
384.e: Your Beloved is in your home; good fortune is in your home. ||2||
You are pure and chaste, you are most distinguished.

384.g: ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਨੀ ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ॥੩॥
384.t: too(n) preetam bhaanee tuhee sur giaan ||3||
384.e: You are pleasing to Your Beloved, and you have sublime understanding. ||3||
I am pleasing to my Beloved, and so I am imbued with the deep red color.
Says Nanak, I have been totally blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace. ||4||

384.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਰੀ ਸਖੀ ਇਹ ਹਮਰੀ ਘਾਲ ॥
384.t: sun ree sakhee ieh hamaree ghaal ||
384.e: Listen, O companions: this is my only work;

384.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ਸਵਾਰਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੫੨॥
384.t: prabh aap seegaar savaaranahaar ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||1||52||
384.e: God Himself is the One who embellishes and adorns. ||1||Second Pause||1||52||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
I suffered in pain, when I thought He was far away;
but now, He is Ever-present, and I receive His instructions. ||1||
My pride is gone, O friends and companions;

384.g: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
384.t: bharam giaa gur pir sa(n)g meree ||1|| rahaau ||
384.e: my doubt is dispelled, and the Guru has united me with my Beloved. ||1||Pause||
My Beloved has drawn me near to Him, and seated me on His Bed;
I have escaped the clutches of others. ||2||
In the mansion of my heart, shines the Light of the Shabad.
My Husband Lord is blissful and playful. ||3||

384.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
384.t: masatak bhaag mai pir ghar aaiaa ||
384.e: According to the destiny written upon my forehead, my Husband Lord has come home to me.
Servant Nanak has obtained the eternal marriage. ||4||2||53||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
My mind is attached to the True Name.
My dealings with other people are only superficial. ||1||
Outwardly, I am on good terms with all;

384.g: ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਉਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
384.t: alipat rahau jaise jal meh kaulaa ||1|| rahaau ||
384.e: but I remain detached, like the lotus upon the water. ||1||Pause||

384.g: ਮੁਖ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
384.t: mukh kee baat sagal siau karataa ||
384.e: By word of mouth, I talk with everyone;
but I keep God clasped to my heart. ||2||
I may appear utterly terrible,

384.g: ਸਗਲ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
384.t: sagal charan kee ih man raalaa ||3||
384.e: but my mind is the dust of all men's feet.
Servant Nanak has found the Perfect Guru.

385.e: Inwardly and outwardly, He has shown me the One Lord. ||4||3||54||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The mortal revels in joy, in the vigor of youth;
but without the Name, he mingles with dust. ||1||
He may wear ear-rings and fine clothes,
and have a comfortable bed, and his mind may be so proud. ||1||Pause||
He may have elephants to ride, and golden umbrellas over his head;

385.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਲੇ ਧਰਨਿ ਗਡਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
385.t: har bhagat binaa le dharan gaddaleeaa ||2||
385.e: but without devotional worship to the Lord, he is buried beneath the dirt. ||2||
He may enjoy many women, of exquisite beauty;

385.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਆਦ ਫਿਕਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
385.t: har ras bin sabh suaadh fikareeaa ||3||
385.e: but without the sublime essence of the Lord, all tastes are tasteless. ||3||
Deluded by Maya, the mortal is led into sin and corruption.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the All-powerful, Compassionate Lord. ||4||4||55||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
There is a garden, in which so many plants have grown.
They bear the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam as their fruit. ||1||
Consider this, O wise one,
by which you may attain the state of Nirvaanaa.

385.g: ਆਸਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਿਖੂਆ ਕੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ ਬੀਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
385.t: aas paas bikhooaa ke ku(n)Taa beech a(n)mrit hai bhaiee re ||1|| rahaau ||
385.e: All around this garden are pools of poison, but within it is the Ambrosial Nectar, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||
There is only one gardener who tends it.

385.g: ਖਬਰਿ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਤ ਪਤ ਡਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
385.t: khabar karat hai paat pat ddaalee ||2||
385.e: He takes care of every leaf and branch. ||2||
He brings all sorts of plants and plants them there.
They all bear fruit - none is without fruit. ||3||

385.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
385.t: a(n)mirat fal naam jin gur te paiaa ||
385.e: One who receives the Ambrosial Fruit of the Naam from the Guru
- O Nanak, such a servant crosses over the ocean of Maya. ||4||5||56||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The pleasures of royalty are derived from Your Name.
I attain Yoga, singing the Kirtan of Your Praises. ||1||
All comforts are obtained in Your Shelter.

385.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਪਰਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਖੋਲੑੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
385.t: bhram ke paradhe satigur khol(h)e ||1|| rahaau ||
385.e: The True Guru has removed the veil of doubt. ||1||Pause||
Understanding the Command of the Lord's Will, I revel in pleasure and joy.
Serving the True Guru, I obtain the supreme state of Nirvaanaa. ||2||

385.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
385.t: jin too(n) jaataa so girasat udhaasee paravaan ||
385.e: One who recognizes You is recognized as a householder, and as a renunciate.
Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he dwells in Nirvaanaa. ||3||
One who has obtained the treasure of the Naam

385.g: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੭॥
385.t: bhanat naanak taa kaa poor khajaanaa ||4||6||57||
385.e: - prays Nanak, his treasure-house is filled to overflowing. ||4||6||57||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

385.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਜਾਉ ਤ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
385.t: teerath jaau ta hau hau karate ||
385.e: Journeying to sacred shrines of pilgrimage, I see the mortals acting in ego.
If I ask the Pandits, I find them tainted by Maya. ||1||
Show me that place, O friend,

385.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
385.t: jaa kai har har keeratan neetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
385.e: where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are forever sung. ||1||Pause||
The Shaastras and the Vedas speak of sin and virtue;
they say that mortals are reincarnated into heaven and hell, over and over again. ||2||
In the householder's life, there is anxiety, and in the life of the renunciate, there is egotism.
Performing religious rituals, the soul is entangled. ||3||

385.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
385.t: prabh kirapaa te man vas aaiaa ||
385.e: By God's Grace, the mind is brought under control;
O Nanak, the Gurmukh crosses over the ocean of Maya. ||4||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

385.g: ਇਹੁ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥੫੮॥
385.t: eih asathaan guroo te paieeaai ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||7||58||
385.e: This place is found through the Guru. ||1||Second Pause||7||58||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

385.g: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਖਾ ॥
385.t: ghar meh sookh baahar fun sookhaa ||
385.e: Within my home there is peace, and outwardly there is peace as well.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains are erased. ||1||

385.g: ਸਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਂਵੈਂ ॥
385.t: sagal sookh jaa(n) too(n) chit aa(n)vai(n) ||
385.e: There is total peace, when You come into my mind.

386.g: ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
386.t: so naam japai jo jan tudh bhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
386.e: He alone is pleasing to Your Will, who chants the Naam. ||1||Pause||

386.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
386.t: tan man seetal jap naam teraa ||
386.e: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, chanting the Name of the Lord.

386.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਢਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
386.t: har har japat ddahai dhukh dderaa ||2||
386.e: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, the house of pain is demolished. ||2||
He alone, who understands the Command of the Lord's Will, is approved.
The True Shabad of the Word of God is his trademark and insignia. ||3||
The Perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me.

386.g: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੯॥
386.t: bhanat naanak merai man sukh paiaa ||4||8||59||
386.e: Prays Nanak, my mind has found peace. ||4||8||59||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Wherever You send me, there I go.

386.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾੲਂੀ ॥੧॥
386.t: jo tum dheh soiee sukh paae(n)ee ||1||
386.e: Whatever You give me, brings me peace. ||1||
I am forever the chaylaa, the humble disciple, of the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World.

386.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾੲਂੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
386.t: tum(h)ree kirapaa te tirapat aghaae(n)ee ||1|| rahaau ||
386.e: By Your Grace, I am satisfied and satiated. ||1||Pause||
Whatever You give me, I wear and eat.
By Your Grace, O God, my life passes peacefully. ||2||
Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on You.
I recognize none as equal to You. ||3||
Says Nanak, this is my continual meditation:
that I may be emancipated, clinging to the Feet of the Saints. ||4||9||60||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
While standing up, and sitting down, and even while asleep, meditate on the Lord.
Walking on the Way, sing the Praises of the Lord. ||1||
With your ears, listen to the Ambrosial Sermon.

386.g: ਜਾਸੁ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਮਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਥਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
386.t: jaas sunee man hoi ana(n)dhaa dhookh rog man sagale lathaa ||1|| rahaau ||
386.e: Listening to it, your mind shall be filled with bliss, and the troubles and diseases of your mind shall all depart. ||1||Pause||
While you work at your job, on the road and at the beach, meditate and chant.
By Guru's Grace, drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord. ||2||
The humble being who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night,

386.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
386.t: so jan jam kee vaaT na paieeaai ||3||
386.e: does not have to go with the Messenger of Death. ||3||
One who does not forget the Lord, twenty-four hours a day, is emancipated;

386.g: ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੬੧॥
386.t: gat hovai naanak tis lag paiee ||4||10||61||
386.e: O Nanak, I fall at his feet. ||4||10||61||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Remembering Him in meditation, one abides in peace;
one becomes happy, and suffering is ended. ||1||

386.g: ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
386.t: anadh karahu prabh ke gun gaavahu ||
386.e: Celebrate, make merry, and sing God's Glories.

386.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
386.t: satigur apanaa sadh sadhaa manaavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
386.e: Forever and ever, surrender to the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
Act in accordance with the Shabad, the True Word of the True Guru.

386.g: ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
386.t: thir ghar baiThe prabh apanaa paavahu ||2||
386.e: Remain steady and stable within the home of your own self, and find God. ||2||

386.g: ਪਰ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਚੀਤ ॥
386.t: par kaa buraa na raakhahu cheet ||
386.e: Do not harbor evil intentions against others in your mind,

386.g: ਤੁਮ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
386.t: tum kau dhukh nahee bhaiee meet ||3||
386.e: and you shall not be troubled, O Siblings of Destiny, O friends. ||3||

386.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥
386.t: har har ta(n)t ma(n)t gur dheen(h)aa ||
386.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the Tantric exercise, and the Mantra, given by the Guru.
Nanak knows this peace alone, night and day. ||4||11||62||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

386.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨੀਚ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
386.t: jis neech kau koiee na jaanai ||
386.e: That wretched being, whom no one knows

386.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਉਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
386.t: naam japat uh chahu ku(n)T maanai ||1||
386.e: - chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is honored in the four directions. ||1||
I beg for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please, give it to me, O Beloved!

386.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
386.t: tumaree sevaa kaun kaun na taare ||1|| rahaau ||
386.e: Serving You, who, who has not been saved? ||1||Pause||

386.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
386.t: jaa kai nikaT na aavai koiee ||
386.e: That person, whom no one wants to be near

386.g: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਆ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਈ ॥੨॥
386.t: sagal sirasaT uaa ke charan mal dhoiee ||2||
386.e: - the whole world comes to wash the dirt of his feet. ||2||

386.g: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਕਾਮ ॥
386.t: jo praanee kaahoo na aavat kaam ||
386.e: That mortal, who is of no use to anyone at all

386.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
386.t: sa(n)t prasaadh taa ko japeeaai naam ||3||
386.e: - by the Grace of the Saints, he meditates on the Naam. ||3||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the sleeping mind awakens.
Then, O Nanak, God seems sweet. ||4||12||63||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
With my eyes, I behold the One and Only Lord.
Forever and ever, I contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

387.e: I sing the Praises of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

387.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
387.t: sa(n)t prataap saadh kai sa(n)ge har har naam dhiaavau re ||1|| rahaau ||
387.e: By the graceful favor of the Saints, I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

387.g: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਈ ॥
387.t: sagal samagree jaa kai soot paroiee ||
387.e: Everything is strung on His string.
He is contained in each and every heart. ||2||
He creates and destroys in an instant.
He Himself remains unattached, and without attributes. ||3||
He is the Creator, the Cause of causes, the Searcher of hearts.
Nanak's Lord and Master celebrates in bliss. ||4||13||64||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
My wandering through millions of births has ended.
I have won, and not lost, this human body, so difficult to obtain. ||1||
My sins have been erased, and my sufferings and pains are gone.

387.g: ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
387.t: bhe puneet sa(n)tan kee dhoor ||1|| rahaau ||
387.e: I have been sanctified by the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||Pause||
The Saints of God have the ability to save us;
they meet with those of us who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||2||
My mind is filled with bliss, since the Guru gave me the Mantra of the Lord's Name.
My thirst has been quenched, and my mind has become steady and stable. ||3||
The wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is for me the nine treasures, and the spiritual powers of the Siddhas.
O Nanak, I have obtained understanding from the Guru. ||4||14||65||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
My thirst, and the darkness of ignorance have been removed.
Serving the Holy Saints, countless sins are obliterated. ||1||
I have obtained celestial peace and immense joy.

387.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
387.t: gur sevaa te bhe man niramal har har har har naam sunaa ||1|| rahaau ||
387.e: Serving the Guru, my mind has become immaculately pure, and I have heard the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
The stubborn foolishness of my mind is gone;
God's Will has become sweet to me. ||2||
