I have grasped the Feet of the Perfect Guru,
and the sins of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||3||
The jewel of this life has become fruitful.
Says Nanak, God has shown mercy to me. ||4||15||66||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
I contemplate, forever and ever, the True Guru;

387.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੇਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਝਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
387.t: gur ke charan kes sa(n)g jhaare ||1||
387.e: with my hair, I dust the feet of the Guru. ||1||
Be wakeful, O my awakening mind!

387.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਕਾਮਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
387.t: bin har avar na aavas kaamaa jhooThaa moh mithiaa pasaare ||1|| rahaau ||
387.e: Without the Lord, nothing else shall be of use to you; false is emotional attachment, and useless are worldly entanglements. ||1||Pause||

387.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
387.t: gur kee baanee siau ra(n)g lai ||
387.e: Embrace love for the Word of the Guru's Bani.
When the Guru shows His Mercy, pain is destroyed. ||2||
Without the Guru, there is no other place of rest.
The Guru is the Giver, the Guru gives the Name. ||3||
The Guru is the Supreme Lord God; He Himself is the Transcendent Lord.
Twenty-four hours a day, O Nanak, meditate on the Guru. ||4||16||67||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
He Himself is the tree, and the branches extending out.
He Himself preserves His own crop. ||1||
Wherever I look, I see that One Lord alone.

387.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
387.t: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar aape soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
387.e: Deep within each and every heart, He Himself is contained. ||1||Pause||
He Himself is the sun, and the rays emanating from it.
He is concealed, and He is revealed. ||2||
He is said to be of the highest attributes, and without attributes.
Both converge onto His single point. ||3||

387.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
387.t: kahu naanak gur bhram bhau khoiaa ||
387.e: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt and fear.
With my eyes, I perceive the Lord, the embodiment of bliss, to be everywhere. ||4||17||68||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
I know nothing of arguments or cleverness.

388.e: Day and night, I chant Your Name. ||1||
I am worthless; I have no virtue at all.
God is the Creator, the Cause of all causes. ||1||Pause||
I am foolish, stupid, ignorant and thoughtless;

388.g: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
388.t: naam tere kee aas man dhaaree ||2||
388.e: Your Name is my mind's only hope. ||2||

388.g: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
388.t: jap tap sa(n)jam karam na saadhaa ||
388.e: I have not practiced chanting, deep meditation, self-discipline or good actions;
but within my mind, I have worshipped God's Name. ||3||

388.g: ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
388.t: kichhoo na jaanaa mat meree thoree ||
388.e: I know nothing, and my intellect is inadequate.
Prays Nanak, O God, You are my only Support. ||4||18||69||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

388.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਖਰ ਦੁਇ ਇਹ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
388.t: har har akhar dhui ieh maalaa ||
388.e: These two words, Har, Har, make up my maalaa.
Continually chanting and reciting this rosary, God has become merciful to me, His humble servant. ||1||
I offer my prayer to the True Guru.

388.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
388.t: kar kirapaa raakhahu saranaiee mo kau dheh hare har japanee ||1|| rahaau ||
388.e: Shower Your Mercy upon me, and keep me safe in Your Sanctuary; please, give me the maalaa, the rosary of Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
One who enshrines this rosary of the Lord's Name within his heart,
is freed of the pains of birth and death. ||2||

388.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
388.t: hiradhai samaalai mukh har har bolai ||
388.e: The humble being who contemplates the Lord within his heart, and chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har, with his mouth,

388.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੩॥
388.t: so jan it ut kateh na ddolai ||3||
388.e: never wavers, here or hereafter. ||3||
Says Nanak, one who is imbued with the Name,

388.t: har maalaa taa kai sa(n)g jai ||4||19||70||
388.e: goes to the next world with the maalaa of the Lord's Name. ||4||19||70||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

388.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
388.t: jis kaa sabh kichh tis kaa hoi ||
388.e: All things belong to Him - let yourself belong to Him as well.

388.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
388.t: tis jan lep na biaapai koi ||1||
388.e: No stain clings to such a humble being. ||1||

388.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
388.t: har kaa sevak sadh hee mukataa ||
388.e: The Lord's servant is liberated forever.

388.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
388.t: jo kichh karai soiee bhal jan kai at niramal dhaas kee jugataa ||1|| rahaau ||
388.e: Whatever He does, is pleasing to His servant; the way of life of His slave is immaculately pure. ||1||Pause||
One who renounces everything, and enters the Lord's Sanctuary
- how can Maya cling to him? ||2||

388.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
388.t: naam nidhaan jaa ke man maeh ||
388.e: With the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his mind,
he suffers no anxiety, even in dreams. ||3||
Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Guru.
My doubts and attachments have been totally obliterated. ||4||20||71||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
When my God is totally pleased with me,

388.g: ਤਾਂ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
388.t: taa(n) dhookh bharam kahu kaise neraa ||1||
388.e: then, tell me, how can suffering or doubt draw near me? ||1||
Continually listening to Your Glory, I live.

388.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਉ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
388.t: moh niragun kau leh udhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
388.e: I am worthless - save me, O Lord! ||1||Pause||
My suffering has been ended, and my anxiety is forgotten.
I have obtained my reward, chanting the Mantra of the True Guru. ||2||
He is True, and True is His glory.
Remembering, remembering Him in meditation, keep Him clasped to your heart. ||3||
Says Nanak, what action is there left to do,

388.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
388.t: jaa kai man vasiaa har naamaa ||4||21||72||
388.e: by one whose mind is filled with the Lord's Name? ||4||21||72||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Sexual desire, anger, and egotism lead to ruin.

388.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥
388.t: har simaran kar har jan chhooTe ||1||
388.e: Meditating on the Lord, the Lord's humble servants are redeemed. ||1||
The mortals are asleep, intoxicated with the wine of Maya.

388.g: ਜਾਗਤ ਭਗਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
388.t: jaagat bhagat simarat har raate ||1|| rahaau ||
388.e: The devotees remain awake, imbued with the Lord's meditation. ||1||Pause||
In emotional attachment and doubt, the mortals wander through countless incarnations.
The devotees remain ever-stable, meditating on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||2||
Bound to household and possessions, the mortals are lost in the deep, dark pit.
The Saints are liberated, knowing the Lord to be near at hand. ||3||
Says Nanak, one who has taken to God's Sanctuary,
obtains peace in this world, and salvation in the world hereafter. ||4||22||73||

389.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

389.g: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਰੰਗੁ ਹਮ ਮੀਨ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
389.t: too meraa tara(n)g ham meen tumaare ||
389.e: You are my waves, and I am Your fish.

389.g: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
389.t: too meraa Thaakur ham terai dhuaare ||1||
389.e: You are my Lord and Master; I wait at Your Door. ||1||

389.g: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਹਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
389.t: too(n) meraa karataa hau sevak teraa ||
389.e: You are my Creator, and I am Your servant.

389.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
389.t: saran gahee prabh gunee gaheraa ||1|| rahaau ||
389.e: I have taken to Your Sanctuary, O God, most profound and excellent. ||1||Pause||
You are my life, You are my Support.
Beholding You, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

389.g: ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਤੂ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
389.t: too meree gat pat too paravaan ||
389.e: You are my salvation and honor; You make me acceptable.
You are All-powerful, You are my strength. ||3||
Night and day, I chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the treasure of excellence.
This is Nanak's prayer to God. ||4||23||74||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The mourner practices falsehood;
he laughs with glee, while mourning for others. ||1||

389.g: ਕੋ ਮੂਆ ਕਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਨੁ ॥
389.t: ko mooaa kaa kai ghar gaavan ||
389.e: Someone has died, while there is singing in someone else's house.

389.g: ਕੋ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੋ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਪਾਵਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
389.t: ko rovai ko has has paavan ||1|| rahaau ||
389.e: One mourns and bewails, while another laughs with glee. ||1||Pause||
From childhood to old age,
the mortal does not attain his goals, and he comes to regret in the end. ||2||
The world is under the influence of the three qualities.
The mortal is reincarnated, again and again, into heaven and hell. ||3||
Says Nanak, one who is attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
becomes acceptable, and his life becomes fruitful. ||4||24||75||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

389.g: ਸੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
389.t: soi rahee prabh khabar na jaanee ||
389.e: She remains asleep, and does not know the news of God.
The day dawns, and then, she regrets. ||1||

389.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਧਰਉ ਰੀ ॥
389.t: pria prem sahaj man anadh dharau ree ||
389.e: Loving the Beloved, the mind is filled with celestial bliss.

389.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਲਾਲਸਾ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
389.t: prabh milabe kee laalasaa taa te aalas kahaa karau ree ||1|| rahaau ||
389.e: You yearn to meet with God, so why do you delay? ||1||Pause||
He came and poured His Ambrosial Nectar into your hands,
but it slipped through your fingers, and fell onto the ground. ||2||
You are burdened with desire, emotional attachment and egotism;
it is not the fault of God the Creator. ||3||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the darkness of doubt is dispelled.
O Nanak, the Creator Lord blends us with Himself. ||4||25||76||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
I long for the Lotus Feet of my Beloved Lord.
The wretched Messenger of Death has run away from me. ||1||
You enter into my mind, by Your Kind Mercy.

389.g: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
389.t: simarat naam sagal rog khiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
389.e: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, all diseases are destroyed. ||1||Pause||
Death gives so much pain to others,

389.g: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
389.t: pahuch na saakeh jan tere kau ||2||
389.e: but it cannot even come near Your slave. ||2||

389.g: ਦਰਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
389.t: dharas tere kee piaas man laagee ||
389.e: My mind thirsts for Your Vision;
in peaceful ease and bliss, I dwell in detachment. ||3||
Hear this prayer of Nanak:
please, infuse Your Name into his heart. ||4||26||77||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
My mind is satisfied, and my entanglements have been dissolved.
God has become merciful to me. ||1||
By the Grace of the Saints, everything has turned out well.

389.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸੋ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
389.t: jaa kai gireh sabh kichh hai pooran so bheTiaa nirabhai dhanee ||1|| rahaau ||
389.e: His House is overflowing with all things; I have met Him, the Fearless Master. ||1||Pause||
By the Kind Mercy of the Holy Saints, the Naam has been implanted within me.
The most dreadful desires have been eliminated. ||2||
My Master has given me a gift;
the fire has been extinguished, and my mind is now at peace. ||3||

389.g: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਭਾਲ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
389.t: miT giee bhaal man sahaj samaanaa ||
389.e: My search has ended, and my mind is absorbed in celestial bliss.

390.e: Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||27||78||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

390.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
390.t: Thaakur siau jaa kee ban aaiee ||
390.e: Those who are attuned to their Lord and Master
are satisfied and fulfilled with the perfect food. ||1||

390.g: ਕਛੂ ਨ ਥੋਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ॥
390.t: kachhoo na thoraa har bhagatan kau ||
390.e: The Lord's devotees never run short of anything.

390.g: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
390.t: khaat kharachat bilachhat dhevan kau ||1|| rahaau ||
390.e: They have plenty to eat, spend, enjoy and give. ||1||Pause||
One who has the Unfathomable Lord of the Universe as his Master
- how can any mere mortal stand up to him? ||2||

390.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਈ ॥
390.t: jaa kee sevaa dhas asaT sidhaiee ||
390.e: One who is served by the eighteen supernatural powers of the Siddhas

390.g: ਪਲਕ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
390.t: palak dhisaT taa kee laagahu paiee ||3||
390.e: - grasp his feet, even for an instant. ||3||

390.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
390.t: jaa kau dhiaa karahu mere suaamee ||
390.e: That one, upon whom You have showered Your Mercy, O my Lord Master
- says Nanak, he does not lack anything. ||4||28||79||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
When I meditate on my True Guru,

390.g: ਤਬ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
390.t: tab merai man mahaa sukh paiaa ||1||
390.e: my mind becomes supremely peaceful. ||1||
The record of my account is erased, and my doubts are dispelled.

390.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
390.t: naam rate jan bhe bhagava(n)taa ||1|| rahaau ||
390.e: Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, His humble servant is blessed with good fortune. ||1||Pause||
When I remember my Lord and Master,
my fears are dispelled, O my friend. ||2||

390.g: ਜਉ ਮੈ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
390.t: jau mai oT gahee prabh teree ||
390.e: When I took to Your Protection, O God,
my desires were fulfilled. ||3||
Gazing upon the wonder of Your play, my mind has become encouraged.
Servant Nanak relies on You alone. ||4||29||80||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Night and day, the mouse of time gnaws away at the rope of life.
Falling into the well, the mortal eats the sweet treats of Maya. ||1||
Thinking and planning, the night of the life is passing away.

390.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
390.t: anik ra(n)g maiaa ke chitavat kabahoo na simarai saari(n)gapaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
390.e: Thinking of the many pleasures of Maya, the mortal never remembers the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ||1||Pause||

390.g: ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ॥
390.t: dhrum kee chhaiaa nihachal girahu baa(n)dhiaa ||
390.e: Believing the shade of the tree to be permanent, he builds his house beneath it.

390.g: ਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਫਾਂਸਿ ਸਕਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਂਧਿਆ ॥੨॥
390.t: kaal kai faa(n)s sakat sar saa(n)dhiaa ||2||
390.e: But the noose of death is around his neck, and Shakti, the power of Maya, has aimed her arrows at him. ||2||
The sandy shore is being washed away by the waves,

390.g: ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਮੂੜਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
390.t: so thaan mooR nihachal kar paiaa ||3||
390.e: but the fool still believes that place to be permanent. ||3||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Name of the Lord, the King.
Nanak lives by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||30||81||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Thukay 9:

390.g: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਕਰਤੀ ਕੇਲ ॥
390.t: aun kai sa(n)g too karatee kel ||
390.e: With that, you are engaged in playful sport;

390.g: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲ ॥
390.t: aun kai sa(n)g ham tum sa(n)g mel ||
390.e: with that, I am joined to you.

390.g: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
390.t: aun(h) kai sa(n)g tum sabh kouoo lorai ||
390.e: With that, everyone longs for you;

390.g: ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋਊ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
390.t: os binaa kouoo mukh nahee jorai ||1||
390.e: without it, no one would even look at your face. ||1||
Where is that detached soul now contained?

390.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਦੁਹੇਰੀ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
390.t: tis bin tuhee dhuheree ree ||1|| rahaau ||
390.e: Without it, you are miserable. ||1||Pause||

390.g: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਹਰਿ ॥
390.t: aun(h) kai sa(n)g too gireh meh maahar ||
390.e: With that, you are the woman of the house;

390.g: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਾਹਰਿ ॥
390.t: aun(h) kai sa(n)g too hoiee hai jaahar ||
390.e: with that, you are respected.

390.g: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੂ ਰਖੀ ਪਪੋਲਿ ॥
390.t: aun(h) kai sa(n)g too rakhee papol ||
390.e: With that, you are caressed;
without it, you are reduced to dust. ||2||

390.g: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
390.t: aun(h) kai sa(n)g teraa maan mahat ||
390.e: With that, you have honor and respect;

390.g: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਾਕੁ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
390.t: aun(h) kai sa(n)g tum saak jagat ||
390.e: with that, you have relatives in the world.

390.g: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
390.t: aun(h) kai sa(n)g teree sabh bidh thaaTee ||
390.e: With that, you are adorned in every way;

390.g: ਓਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੩॥
390.t: os binaa too(n) hoiee hai maaTee ||3||
390.e: without it, you are reduced to dust. ||3||
That detached soul is neither born, nor dies.
It acts according to the Command of the Lord's Will.
O Nanak, having fashioned the body, the Lord unites the soul with it, and separates them again;
He alone knows His All-powerful creative nature. ||4||31||82||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

391.g: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰਤਾ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਡਰਿਆ ॥
391.t: naa oh marataa naa ham ddariaa ||
391.e: He does not die, so I do not fear.

391.g: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੜਿਆ ॥
391.t: naa oh binasai naa ham kaRiaa ||
391.e: He does not perish, so I do not grieve.

391.g: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਭੂਖੇ ॥
391.t: naa oh niradhan naa ham bhookhe ||
391.e: He is not poor, so I do not hunger.

391.g: ਨਾ ਓਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੇ ॥੧॥
391.t: naa os dhookh na ham kau dhookhe ||1||
391.e: He is not in pain, so I do not suffer. ||1||
There is no other Destroyer than Him.
He is my very life, the Giver of life. ||1||Pause||

391.g: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
391.t: naa us ba(n)dhan naa ham baadhe ||
391.e: He is not bound, so I am not in bondage.

391.g: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਧਾਧੇ ॥
391.t: naa us dha(n)dhaa naa ham dhaadhe ||
391.e: He has no occupation, so I have no entanglements.

391.g: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
391.t: naa us mail na ham kau mailaa ||
391.e: He has no impurities, so I have no impurities.

391.g: ਓਸੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਤ ਹਮ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
391.t: os ana(n)dh ta ham sadh kelaa ||2||
391.e: He is in ecstasy, so I am always happy. ||2||

391.g: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੋਚੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸੋਚਾ ॥
391.t: naa us soch na ham kau sochaa ||
391.e: He has no anxiety, so I have no cares.

391.g: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਪੋਚਾ ॥
391.t: naa us lep na ham kau pochaa ||
391.e: He has no stain, so I have no pollution.

391.g: ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
391.t: naa us bhookh na ham kau tirasanaa ||
391.e: He has no hunger, so I have no thirst.

391.g: ਜਾ ਉਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਾਂ ਹਮ ਜਚਨਾ ॥੩॥
391.t: jaa uh niramal taa(n) ham jachanaa ||3||
391.e: Since He is immaculately pure, I correspond to Him. ||3||
I am nothing; He is the One and only.
Before and after, He alone exists.
O Nanak, the Guru has taken away my doubts and mistakes;

391.g: ਹਮ ਓਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਏ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੮੩॥
391.t: ham oi mil hoe ik ra(n)gaa ||4||32||83||
391.e: He and I, joining together, are of the same color. ||4||32||83||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Serve Him in many different ways;
Dedicate your soul, your breath of life and your wealth to Him.
Carry water for Him, and wave the fan over Him - renounce your ego.
Make yourself a sacrifice to Him, time and time again. ||1||
She alone is the happy soul-bride, who is pleasing to God.

391.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
391.t: tis kai sa(n)g milau meree maiee ||1|| rahaau ||
391.e: In her company, I may meet Him, O my mother. ||1||Pause||
I am the water-carrier of the slaves of His slaves.

391.g: ਉਨੑ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
391.t: aun(h) kee ren basai jeea naal ||
391.e: I treasure in my soul the dust of their feet.
By that good destiny inscribed upon my forehead, I obtain their society.
Through His Love, the Lord Master meets me. ||2||
I dedicate all to Him - chanting and meditation, austerity and religious observances.
I offer all to Him - good actions, righteous conduct and incense burning.
Renouncing pride and attachment, I become the dust of the feet of the Saints.

391.g: ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਨ ॥੩॥
391.t: aun(h) kai sa(n)g dhekhau prabh nain ||3||
391.e: In their society, I behold God with my eyes. ||3||
Each and every moment, I contemplate and adore Him.
Day and night, I serve Him like this.
The Lord of the Universe, the Cherisher of the World, has become merciful;
in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, He forgives us. ||4||33||84||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

391.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
391.t: prabh kee preet sadhaa sukh hoi ||
391.e: In the Love of God, eternal peace is obtained.

391.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
391.t: prabh kee preet dhukh lagai na koi ||
391.e: In the Love of God, one is not touched by pain.

391.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
391.t: prabh kee preet haumai mal khoi ||
391.e: In the Love of God, the filth of ego is washed away.

391.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
391.t: prabh kee preet sadh niramal hoi ||1||
391.e: In the Love of God, one becomes forever immaculate. ||1||
Listen, O friend: show such love and affection to God,

391.g: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
391.t: jeea praan ghaT ghaT aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
391.e: the Support of the soul, the breath of life, of each and every heart. ||1||Pause||

391.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
391.t: prabh kee preet bhe sagal nidhaan ||
391.e: In the Love of God, all treasures are obtained.

391.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
391.t: prabh kee preet ridhai niramal naam ||
391.e: In the Love of God, the Immaculate Naam fills the heart.
In the Love of God, one is eternally embellished.

391.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਭ ਮਿਟੀ ਹੈ ਚਿੰਤ ॥੨॥
391.t: prabh kee preet sabh miTee hai chi(n)t ||2||
391.e: In the Love of God, all anxiety is ended. ||2||

391.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
391.t: prabh kee preet ih bhavajal tarai ||
391.e: In the Love of God, one crosses over this terrible world-ocean.

391.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਡਰੈ ॥
391.t: prabh kee preet jam te nahee ddarai ||
391.e: In the Love of God, one does not fear death.
In the Love of God, all are saved.
The Love of God shall go along with you. ||3||
By himself, no one is united, and no one goes astray.
One who is blessed by God's Mercy, joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to You.
O God, You are the Support and the Strength of the Saints. ||4||34||85||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Becoming a king, the mortal wields his royal authority;
oppressing the people, he gathers wealth.

392.e: Gathering it and collecting it, he fills his bags.

392.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑੀ ॥੧॥
392.t: prabh us te ddaar avar kau dheen(h)ee ||1||
392.e: But God takes it away from him, and gives it to another. ||1||
The mortal is like an unbaked clay pot in water;

392.g: ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਉਆਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
392.t: garab garab uaahoo meh pareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
392.e: indulging in pride and egotism, he crumbles down and dissolves. ||1||Pause||
Being fearless, he becomes unrestrained.
He does not think of the Creator, who is ever with him.
He raises armies, and collects arms.

392.g: ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਫੂਕ ਤ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਸੁਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
392.t: nikasiaa fook ta hoi gio suaahaa ||2||
392.e: But when the breath leaves him, he turns to ashes. ||2||
He has lofty palaces, mansions and queens,
elephants and pairs of horses, delighting the mind;
he is blessed with a great family of sons and daughters.
But, engrossed in attachment, the blind fool wastes away to death. ||3||
The One who created him destroys him.
Enjoyments and pleasures are like just a dream.
He alone is liberated, and possesses regal power and wealth,
O Nanak, whom the Lord Master blesses with His Mercy. ||4||35||86||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The mortal is in love with this,
but the more he has, the more he longs for more.
It hangs around his neck, and does not leave him.
But falling at the feet of the True Guru, he is saved. ||1||
I have renounced and discarded Maya, the Enticer of the world.
I have met the Absolute Lord, and congratulations are pouring in. ||1||Pause||
She is so beautiful, she captivates the mind.

392.g: ਬਾਟਿ ਘਾਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਨਿ ਬਨਿ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
392.t: baaT ghaaT gireh ban ban johai ||
392.e: On the road, and the beach, at home, in the forest and in the wilderness, she touches us.

392.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
392.t: man tan laagai hoi kai meeThee ||
392.e: She seems so sweet to the mind and body.
But by Guru's Grace, I have seen her to be deceptive. ||2||
Her courtiers are also great deceivers.
They do not spare even their fathers or mothers.
They have enslaved their companions.

392.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
392.t: gur kirapaa te mai sagale saadhe ||3||
392.e: By Guru's Grace, I have subjugated them all. ||3||
Now, my mind is filled with bliss;
my fear is gone, and the noose is cut away.
Says Nanak, when I met the True Guru,
I came to dwell within my home in absolute peace. ||4||36||87||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Twenty-four hours a day, he knows the Lord to be near at hand;
he surrenders to the Sweet Will of God.
The One Name is the Support of the Saints;

392.g: ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
392.t: hoi rahe sabh kee pag chhaar ||1||
392.e: they remain the dust of the feet of all. ||1||
Listen, to the way of life of the Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny;

392.g: ਉਆ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
392.t: auaa kee mahimaa kathan na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
392.e: their praises cannot be described. ||1||Pause||
Their occupation is the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The Kirtan, the Praise of the Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is their rest.

392.g: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
392.t: mitr satr jaa kai ek samaanai ||
392.e: Friends and enemies are one and the same to them.

392.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
392.t: prabh apune bin avar na jaanai ||2||
392.e: They know of no other than God. ||2||
They erase millions upon millions of sins.

392.g: ਦੁਖ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਨ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
392.t: dhukh dhoor karan jeea ke dhaataaraa ||
392.e: They dispel suffering; they are givers of the life of the soul.
They are so brave; they are men of their word.
The Saints have enticed Maya herself. ||3||
Their company is cherished even by the gods and the angels.

392.g: ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸੁ ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
392.t: amogh dharas safal jaa kee sev ||
392.e: Blessed is their Darshan, and fruitful is their service.
With his palms pressed together, Nanak offers his prayer:
O Lord, Treasure of Excellence, please bless me with the service of the Saints. ||4||37||88||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
All peace and comforts are in the meditation of the One Name.

392.g: ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
392.t: sagal dharam har ke gun gaam ||
392.e: All righteous actions of Dharma are in the singing of the Lord's Glorious Praises.
The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is so very pure and sacred.

393.e: Meeting with them, love for God is embraced. ||1||
By Guru's Grace, bliss is obtained.

393.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
393.t: jis simarat man hoi pragaasaa taa kee gat mit kahan na jaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
393.e: Meditating upon Him in remembrance, the mind is illumined; his state and condition cannot be described. ||1||Pause||
Fasts, religious vows, cleansing baths, and worship to Him;
listening to the Vedas, Puraanas, and Shaastras.

393.g: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
393.t: mahaa puneet jaa kaa niramal thaan ||
393.e: Extremely pure is he, and immaculate is his place,

393.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
393.t: saadhasa(n)gat jaa kai har har naam ||2||
393.e: who meditates upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Saadh Sangat. ||2||
That humble being becomes renowned all over the world.

393.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ॥
393.t: patit puneet taa kee pag ren ||
393.e: Even sinners are purified, by the dust of his feet.

393.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
393.t: jaa kau bheTio har har rai ||
393.e: One who has met the Lord, the Lord our King,

393.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
393.t: taa kee gat mit kathan na jai ||3||
393.e: his condition and state cannot be described. ||3||
Twenty-four hours a day, with palms pressed together, I meditate;
I yearn to obtain the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those Holy Saints.
Merge me, the poor one, with You, O Lord;
Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||38||89||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Twenty-four hours a day, he takes his cleansing bath in water;
he makes continual offerings to the Lord; he is a true man of wisdom.
He never leaves anything uselessly.
Again and again, he falls at the Lord's Feet. ||1||
Such is the Saalagraam, the stone idol, which I serve;
such is my worship, flower-offerings and divine adoration as well. ||1||Pause||

393.g: ਘੰਟਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ॥
393.t: gha(n)Taa jaa kaa suneeaai chahu ku(n)T ||
393.e: His bell resounds to the four corners of the world.
His seat is forever in heaven.

393.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਚਵਰੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਝੂਲੈ ॥
393.t: jaa kaa chavar sabh uoopar jhoolai ||
393.e: His chauri, his fly-brush, waves over all.
His incense is ever-fragrant. ||2||

393.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੰਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
393.t: ghaT ghaT sa(n)paT hai re jaa kaa ||
393.e: He is treasured in each and every heart.
The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is His Eternal Court.
His Aartee, his lamp-lit worship service, is the Kirtan of His Praises, which brings lasting bliss.
His Greatness is so beautiful, and ever limitless. ||3||
He alone obtains it, who is so pre-ordained;
he takes to the Sanctuary of the Saints' Feet.
I hold in my hands the Saalagraam of the Lord.
Says Nanak, the Guru has given me this Gift. ||4||39||90||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Panch-Pada:
That highway, upon which the water-carrier is plundered
- that way is far removed from the Saints. ||1||
The True Guru has spoken the Truth.

393.g: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਬੀਥੀ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
393.t: naam tere kee mukate beethee jam kaa maarag dhoor rahiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
393.e: Your Name, O Lord, is the Way to Salvation; the road of the Messenger of Death is far away. ||1||Pause||
That place, where the greedy toll-collector dwells

393.g: ਦੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਉਹ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਬਾਟ ॥੨॥
393.t: dhoor rahee uh jan te baaT ||2||
393.e: - that path remains far removed from the Lord's humble servant. ||2||
There, where so very many caravans of men are caught,
the Holy Saints remain with the Supreme Lord. ||3||
Chitra and Gupat, the recording angels of the conscious and the unconscious, write the accounts of all mortal beings,

393.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੪॥
393.t: bhagat janaa kau dhirasaT na pekhaa ||4||
393.e: but they cannot even see the Lord's humble devotees. ||4||
Says Nanak, one whose True Guru is Perfect
- the unblown bugles of ecstasy vibrate for him. ||5||40||91||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla, Du-Pada 1:
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Naam is learned;
all desires and tasks are fulfilled.

393.g: ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ॥
393.t: bujh giee tirasanaa har jaseh aghaane ||
393.e: My thirst has been quenched, and I am satiated with the Lord's Praise.
I live by chanting and meditating upon the Lord, the Sustainer of the earth. ||1||
I have entered the Sanctuary of the Creator, the Cause of all causes.

393.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
393.t: gur parasaadh sahaj ghar paiaa miTiaa a(n)dheraa cha(n)dh chaRiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
393.e: By Guru's Grace, I have entered the home of celestial bliss. Darkness is dispelled, and the moon of wisdom has risen. ||1||Pause||

394.e: My treasure-house is overflowing with rubies and jewels;
I meditate on the Formless Lord, and so they never run short.
How rare is that humble being, who drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Word of the Shabad.

394.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੪੧॥੯੨॥
394.t: naanak taa kee param gat hoi ||2||41||92||
394.e: O Nanak, he attains the state of highest dignity. ||2||41||92||
Aasaa, Seventh House, Fifth Mehla:

394.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
394.t: har kaa naam ridhai nit dhiaaiee ||
394.e: Meditate continually on the Name of the Lord within your heart.
Thus you shall save all your companions and associates. ||1||

394.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
394.t: gur merai sa(n)g sadhaa hai naale ||
394.e: My Guru is always with me, near at hand.

394.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
394.t: simar simar tis sadhaa sam(h)aale ||1|| rahaau ||
394.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I cherish Him forever. ||1||Pause||
Your actions seem so sweet to me.
Nanak begs for the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||42||93||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The world is saved by the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
The Name of the Lord is the Support of the mind. ||1||
The Saints worship and adore the Lotus Feet of the Divine Guru;

394.g: ਪੂਜਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
394.t: poojeh sa(n)t har preet piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
394.e: they love the Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||
She who has such good destiny written upon her forehead,

394.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ॥੨॥੪੩॥੯੪॥
394.t: kahu naanak taa kaa thir sohaag ||2||43||94||
394.e: says Nanak, is blessed with the eternal happy marriage with the Lord. ||2||43||94||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The Order of my Husband Lord seems so sweet to me.
My Husband Lord has driven out the one who was my rival.
My Beloved Husband has decorated me, His happy soul-bride.
He has quieted the burning thirst of my mind. ||1||
It is good that I submitted to the Will of my Beloved Lord.

394.g: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
394.t: sookh sahaj is ghar kaa jaaniaa || rahaau ||
394.e: I have realized celestial peace and poise within this home of mine. ||Pause||
I am the hand-maiden, the attendant of my Beloved Lord.
He is eternal and imperishable, inaccessible and infinite.
Holding the fan, sitting at His Feet, I wave it over my Beloved.
The five demons who tortured me have run away. ||2||
I am not from a noble family, and I am not beautiful.
What do I know? Why am I pleasing to my Beloved?
I am a poor orphan, destitute and dishonored.
My Husband took me in, and made me His queen. ||3||
When I saw my Beloved's face before me,
I became so happy and peaceful; my married life was blessed.
Says Nanak, my desires are fulfilled.
The True Guru has united me with God, the treasure of excellence. ||4||1||95||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
A frown creases her forehead, and her look is evil.
Her speech is bitter, and her tongue is rude.
She is always hungry, and she believes her Husband to be far away. ||1||
Such is Maya, the woman, which the One Lord has created.

394.g: ਉਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
394.t: aun sabh jag khaiaa ham gur raakhe mere bhaiee || rahaau ||
394.e: She is devouring the whole world, but the Guru has saved me, O my Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||
Administering her poisons, she has overcome the whole world.
She has bewitched Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.
Only those Gurmukhs who are attuned to the Naam are blessed. ||2||
Performing fasts, religious observances and atonements, the mortals have grown weary.
They wander over the entire planet, on pilgrimages to the banks of sacred rivers.

394.g: ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
394.t: se ubare j satigur kee saranaa ||3||
394.e: But they alone are saved, who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||3||
Attached to Maya, the whole world is in bondage.
The foolish self-willed manmukhs are consumed by their egotism.

394.g: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੯੬॥
394.t: gur naanak baeh pakar ham raakhaa ||4||2||96||
394.e: Taking me by the arm, Guru Nanak has saved me. ||4||2||96||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Everything is painful, when one forgets the Lord Master.
Here and hereafter, such a mortal is useless. ||1||
The Saints are satisfied, meditating on the Lord, Har, Har.

395.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
395.t: kar kirapaa apunai nai laae sarab sookh prabh tumaree rajai || rahaau ||
395.e: Bestowing Your Mercy, God, You attach us to Your Name; all peace comes by Your Will. ||Pause||

395.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਤ ਦੂਰਿ ॥ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮਰਤਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
395.t: sa(n)g hovat kau jaanat dhoor || so jan marataa nit nit jhoor ||2||
395.e: The Lord is Ever-present; one who deems Him to be far away, dies again and again, repenting. ||2||

395.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
395.t: jin sabh kichh dheeaa tis chitavat naeh ||
395.e: The mortals do not remember the One, who has given them everything.

395.g: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
395.t: mahaa bikhiaa meh dhin rain jaeh ||3||
395.e: Engrossed in such terrible corruption, their days and nights waste away. ||3||
Says Nanak, meditate in remembrance of the One Lord God.
Salvation is obtained, in the Shelter of the Perfect Guru. ||4||3||97||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

395.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
395.t: naam japat man tan sabh hariaa ||
395.e: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are totally rejuvenated.
All sins and sorrows are washed away. ||1||
How blessed is that day, O my Siblings of Destiny,

395.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
395.t: har gun gai param gat paiee || rahaau ||
395.e: when the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung, and the supreme status is obtained. ||Pause||
Worshipping the feet of the Holy Saints,
troubles and hatred are eliminated from the mind. ||2||
Meeting with the Perfect Guru, conflict is ended,
and the five demons are totally subdued. ||3||

395.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
395.t: jis man vasiaa har kaa naam ||
395.e: One whose mind is filled with the Name of the Lord,
O Nanak - I am a sacrifice to him. ||4||4||98||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
O singer, sing of the One,
who is the Support of the soul, the body and the breath of life.

395.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
395.t: jaa kee sevaa sarab sukh paaveh ||
395.e: Serving Him, all peace is obtained.

395.g: ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਹਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
395.t: avar kaahoo peh bahuR na jaaveh ||1||
395.e: You shall no longer go to any other. ||1||

395.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਅਨੰਦੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
395.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh ana(n)dhee saahib gun nidhaan nit nit jaapeeaai ||
395.e: My Blissful Lord Master is forever in bliss; meditate continually and forever, on the Lord, the treasure of excellence.

395.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
395.t: balihaaree tis sa(n)t piaare jis prasaadh prabh man vaaseeaai || rahaau ||
395.e: I am a sacrifice to the Beloved Saints; by their kind favor, God comes to dwell in the mind. ||Pause||
His gifts are never exhausted.
In His subtle way, He easily absorbs all.

395.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
395.t: jaa kee bakhas na meTai koiee ||
395.e: His benevolence cannot be erased.
So enshrine that True Lord within your mind. ||2||

395.g: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ॥
395.t: sagal samagree gireh jaa kai pooran ||
395.e: His house is filled with all sorts of articles;

395.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਝੂਰਨ ॥
395.t: prabh ke sevak dhookh na jhooran ||
395.e: God's servants never suffer pain.
Holding to His Support, the state of fearless dignity is obtained.

395.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
395.t: saas saas so gun nidh gaieeaai ||3||
395.e: With each and every breath, sing of the Lord, the treasure of excellence. ||3||
He is not far from us, wherever we go.

395.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
395.t: nadhar kare taa har har paieeaai ||
395.e: When He shows His Mercy, we obtain the Lord, Har, Har.
I offer this prayer to the Perfect Guru.
Nanak begs for the treasure of the Lord's Name. ||4||5||99||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
First, the pains of the body vanish;
then, the mind becomes totally peaceful.
In His Mercy, the Guru bestows the Lord's Name.

395.g: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
395.t: bal bal tis satigur kau jaau ||1||
395.e: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to that True Guru. ||1||
I have obtained the Perfect Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny.

395.g: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
395.t: rog sog sabh dhookh binaase satigur kee saranaiee || rahaau ||
395.e: All illness, sorrows and sufferings are dispelled, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||Pause||
The feet of the Guru abide within my heart;
I have received all the fruits of my heart's desires.
The fire is extinguished, and I am totally peaceful.
Showering His Mercy, the Guru has given this gift. ||2||
The Guru has given shelter to the shelterless.
The Guru has given honor to the dishonored.
Shattering his bonds, the Guru has saved His servant.
I taste with my tongue the Ambrosial Bani of His Word. ||3||
By great good fortune, I worship the Guru's feet.
Forsaking everything, I have obtained God's Sanctuary.

396.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੦੦॥
396.t: gur naanak jaa kau bhiaa dhiaalaa || so jan hoaa sadhaa nihaalaa ||4||6||100||
396.e: That humble being, O Nanak, unto whom the Guru grants His Mercy, is forever enraptured. ||4||6||100||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
The True Guru has truly given a child.
The long-lived one has been born to this destiny.
He came to acquire a home in the womb,
and his mother's heart is so very glad. ||1||
A son is born - a devotee of the Lord of the Universe.

396.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰ ਕਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
396.t: pragaTiaa sabh meh likhiaa dhur kaa || rahaau ||
396.e: This pre-ordained destiny has been revealed to all. ||Pause||

396.g: ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
396.t: dhasee maasee hukam baalak janam leeaa ||
396.e: In the tenth month, by the Lord's Order, the baby has been born.
Sorrow is dispelled, and great joy has ensued.
The companions blissfully sing the songs of the Guru's Bani.
This is pleasing to the Lord Master. ||2||
The vine has grown, and shall last for many generations.
The Power of the Dharma has been firmly established by the Lord.
That which my mind wishes for, the True Guru has granted.
I have become carefree, and I fix my attention on the One Lord. ||3||

396.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
396.t: jiau baalak pitaa uoopar kare bahu maan ||
396.e: As the child places so much faith in his father,
I speak as it pleases the Guru to have me speak.
This is not a hidden secret;
Guru Nanak, greatly pleased, has bestowed this gift. ||4||7||101||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:
Giving His Hand, the Perfect Guru has protected the child.
The glory of His servant has become manifest. ||1||

396.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਪੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
396.t: gur gur japee guroo gur dhiaaiee ||
396.e: I contemplate the Guru, the Guru; I meditate on the Guru, the Guru.

396.g: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
396.t: jeea kee aradhaas guroo peh paiee || rahaau ||
396.e: I offer my heart-felt prayer to the Guru, and it is answered. ||Pause||
I have taken to the Sanctuary of the True Divine Guru.
The service of His servant has been fulfilled. ||2||
He has preserved my soul, body, youth and breath of life.
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||3||8||102||

396.t: aasaa ghar atthvaa kaafee mahalaa panjavaa
396.e: Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

396.g: ਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
396.t: mai ba(n)dhaa bai khareedh sach saahib meraa ||
396.e: I am Your purchased slave, O True Lord Master.

396.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
396.t: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis dhaa sabh kichh hai teraa ||1||
396.e: My soul and body, and all of this, everything is Yours. ||1||

396.g: ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
396.t: maan nimaane too(n) dhanee teraa bharavaasaa ||
396.e: You are the honor of the dishonored. O Master, in You I place my trust.

396.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਨ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
396.t: bin saache an Tek hai so jaanahu kaachaa ||1|| rahaau ||
396.e: Without the True One, any other support is false - know this well. ||1||Pause||

396.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
396.t: teraa hukam apaar hai koiee a(n)t na paae ||
396.e: Your Command is infinite; no one can find its limit.

396.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਸੀ ਸੋ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
396.t: jis gur pooraa bheTasee so chalai rajaae ||2||
396.e: One who meets with the Perfect Guru, walks in the Way of the Lord's Will. ||2||

396.g: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
396.t: chaturaiee siaanapaa kitai kaam na aaieeaai ||
396.e: Cunning and cleverness are of no use.

396.g: ਤੁਠਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
396.t: tuThaa saahib jo dhevai soiee sukh paieeaai ||3||
396.e: That which the Lord Master gives, by the Pleasure of His Will - that is pleasing to me. ||3||

396.g: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
396.t: je lakh karam kamaie'eeh kichh pavai na ba(n)dhaa ||
396.e: One may perform tens of thousands of actions, but attachment to things is not satisfied.

396.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰ ਹੋਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦੩॥
396.t: jan naanak keetaa naam dhar hor chhoddiaa dha(n)dhaa ||4||1||103||
396.e: Servant Nanak has made the Naam his Support. He has renounced other entanglements. ||4||1||103||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

396.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮੈ ਭਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
396.t: sarab sukhaa mai bhaaliaa har jevadd na koiee ||
396.e: I have pursued all pleasures, but none is as great as the Lord.

396.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
396.t: gur tuThe te paieeaai sach saahib soiee ||1||
396.e: By the Pleasure of the Guru's Will, the True Lord Master is obtained. ||1||

396.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
396.t: balihaaree gur aapane sadh sadh kurabaanaa ||
396.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him.

396.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
396.t: naam na visarau ik khin chasaa ih keejai dhaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
396.e: Please, grant me this one blessing, that I may never, even for an instant, forget Your Name. ||1||Pause||

396.g: ਭਾਗਠੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ॥
396.t: bhaagaTh sachaa soi hai jis har dhan a(n)tar ||
396.e: How very fortunate are those who have the wealth of the Lord deep within the heart.

397.g: ਸੋ ਛੂਟੈ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥੨॥
397.t: so chhooTai mahaa jaal te jis gur sabadh nira(n)tar ||2||
397.e: They escape from the great noose of death; they are permeated with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

397.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਤ ਸਰੁ ॥
397.t: gur kee mahimaa kiaa kahaa gur bibek sat sar ||
397.e: How can I chant the Glorious Praises of the Guru? The Guru is the ocean of Truth and clear understanding.

397.g: ਓਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ॥੩॥
397.t: oh aadh jugaadhee jugeh jug pooraa paramesar ||3||
397.e: He is the Perfect Transcendent Lord, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages. ||3||

397.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
397.t: naam dhiaavahu sadh sadhaa har har man ra(n)ge ||
397.e: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, forever and ever, my mind is filled with the Love of the Lord, Har, Har.

397.g: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੦੪॥
397.t: jeeau praan dhan guroo hai naanak kai sa(n)ge ||4||2||104||
397.e: The Guru is my soul, my breath of life, and wealth; O Nanak, He is with me forever. ||4||2||104||

397.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
397.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
397.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

397.g: ਸਾਈ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਭੋਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
397.t: saiee alakh apaar bhoree man vasai ||
397.e: If the Invisible and Infinite Lord dwells within my mind, even for a moment,

397.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਇ ਮੈਡਾ ਹਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
397.t: dhookh dharadh rog mai maiddaa habh nasai ||1||
397.e: then all my pains, troubles, and diseases vanish. ||1||

397.g: ਹਉ ਵੰਞਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਾਈ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
397.t: hau va(n)n(j)aa kurabaan saiee aapane ||
397.e: I am a sacrifice to my Lord Master.

397.g: ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
397.t: hovai anadh ghanaa man tan jaapane ||1|| rahaau ||
397.e: Meditating on Him, a great joy wells up within my mind and body. ||1||Pause||

397.g: ਬਿੰਦਕ ਗਾਲਿੑ ਸੁਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥
397.t: bi(n)dhak gaali(h) sunee sache tis dhanee ||
397.e: I have heard only a little bit of news about the True Lord Master.

397.g: ਸੂਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਇ ਨ ਕੀਮ ਗਣੀ ॥੨॥
397.t: sookhee hoo(n) sukh pai mai na keem ganee ||2||
397.e: I have obtained the peace of all peace, O my mother; I cannot estimate its worth. ||2||

397.g: ਨੈਣ ਪਸੰਦੋ ਸੋਇ ਪੇਖਿ ਮੁਸਤਾਕ ਭਈ ॥
397.t: nain pasa(n)dho soi pekh musataak bhiee ||
397.e: He is so beautiful to my eyes; beholding Him, I have been bewitched.

397.g: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲਈ ॥੩॥
397.t: mai niragun meree mai aap laR lai liee ||3||
397.e: I am worthless, O my mother; He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe. ||3||

397.g: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹਭਾ ਹੂੰ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
397.t: bedh kateb sa(n)saar habhaa hoo(n) baaharaa ||
397.e: He is beyond the world of the Vedas, the Koran and the Bible.

397.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਾਹਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੦੫॥
397.t: naanak kaa paatisaahu dhisai jaaharaa ||4||3||105||
397.e: The Supreme King of Nanak is immanent and manifest. ||4||3||105||

397.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
397.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
397.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

397.g: ਲਾਖ ਭਗਤ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਜਪਤੇ ਪੀਉ ਪੀਉ ॥
397.t: laakh bhagat aaraadheh japate peeau peeau ||
397.e: Tens of thousands of devotees worship and adore You, chanting, ""Beloved, Beloved.""

397.g: ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਉ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
397.t: kavan jugat melaavau niragun bikhiee jeeau ||1||
397.e: How shall You unite me, the worthless and corrupt soul, with Yourself. ||1||

397.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥
397.t: teree Tek govi(n)dh gupaal dhiaal prabh ||
397.e: You are my Support, O Merciful God, Lord of the Universe, Sustainer of the World.

397.g: ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
397.t: too(n) sabhanaa ke naath teree sirasaT sabh ||1|| rahaau ||
397.e: You are the Master of all; the entire creation is Yours. ||1||Pause||

397.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
397.t: sadhaa sahaiee sa(n)t pekheh sadhaa hajoor ||
397.e: You are the constant help and support of the Saints, who behold You Ever-present.

397.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੜਿਆ ਸੇ ਮਰਨਿੑ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
397.t: naam bihoonaRiaa se marani(h) visoor visoor ||2||
397.e: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall die, engulfed in sorrow and pain. ||2||

397.g: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਤਣ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗਉਣੁ ॥
397.t: dhaas dhaasatan bhai miTiaa tinaa gaun ||
397.e: Those servants, who lovingly perform the Lord's service, are freed from the cycle of reincarnation.

397.g: ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨਾੜਾ ਹਾਲੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੩॥
397.t: visariaa jin(h)aa naam tinaaRaa haal kaun ||3||
397.e: What shall be the fate of those who forget the Naam? ||3||

397.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਹਰਿੑਆਉ ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭ ॥
397.t: jaise pas hari(h)aau taisaa sa(n)saar sabh ||
397.e: As are the cattle which have strayed, so is the entire world.

397.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦੬॥
397.t: naanak ba(n)dhan kaaT milaavahu aap prabh ||4||4||106||
397.e: O God, please cut away Nanak's bonds, and unite him with Yourself. ||4||4||106||

397.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
397.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
397.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

397.g: ਹਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਹਿਕੋ ਖਿਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
397.t: habhe thok visaar hiko khiaal kar ||
397.e: Forget all other things, and dwell upon the Lord alone.

397.g: ਝੂਠਾ ਲਾਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿ ॥੧॥
397.t: jhooThaa laeh gumaan man tan arap dhar ||1||
397.e: Lay aside your false pride, and dedicate your mind and body to Him. ||1||

397.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ਤੂੰ ॥
397.t: aaTh pahar saalaeh sirajanahaar too(n) ||
397.e: Twenty-four hours a day, praise the Creator Lord.

397.g: ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
397.t: jeevaa(n) teree dhaat kirapaa karahu moo(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
397.e: I live by Your bountiful gifts - please, shower me with Your Mercy! ||1||Pause||

397.g: ਸੋਈ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥
397.t: soiee ka(n)m kamai jit mukh ujalaa ||
397.e: So, do that work, by which your face shall be made radiant.

397.g: ਸੋਈ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਲਾ ॥੨॥
397.t: soiee lagai sach jis too(n) dheh alaa ||2||
397.e: He alone becomes attached to the Truth, O Lord, unto whom You give it. ||2||

397.g: ਜੋ ਨ ਢਹੰਦੋ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
397.t: jo na ddaha(n)dho mool so ghar raas kar ||
397.e: So build and adorn that house, which shall never be destroyed.

397.g: ਹਿਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ॥੩॥
397.t: hiko chit vasai kadhe na jai mar ||3||
397.e: Enshrine the One Lord within your consciousness; He shall never die. ||3||

397.g: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
397.t: tin(h)aa piaaraa raam jo prabh bhaaniaa ||
397.e: The Lord is dear to those, who are pleasing to the Will of God.

397.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੦੭॥
397.t: gur parasaadh akath naanak vakhaaniaa ||4||5||107||
397.e: By Guru's Grace, Nanak describes the indescribable. ||4||5||107||

397.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
397.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
397.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

397.g: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇ ਕਿਨੇਹਿਆ ॥
397.t: jin(h)aa na visarai naam se kinehiaa ||
397.e: What are they like - those who do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord?

397.g: ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
397.t: bhedh na jaanahu mool saa(n)iee jehiaa ||1||
397.e: Know that there is absolutely no difference; they are exactly like the Lord. ||1||

397.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥
397.t: man tan hoi nihaal tum(h) sa(n)g bheTiaa ||
397.e: The mind and body are enraptured, meeting with You, O Lord.

397.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਮੇਟਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
397.t: sukh paiaa jan parasaadh dhukh sabh meTiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
397.e: Peace is obtained, by the favor of the Lord's humble servant; all pains are taken away. ||1||Pause||

397.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਤਿੰਨੑ ਖੇ ॥
397.t: jete kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd udhaare ti(n)n(h) khe ||
397.e: As many as are the continents of the world, so many have been saved.

397.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ॥੨॥
397.t: jin(h) man vuThaa aap poore bhagat se ||2||
397.e: Those, in whose minds You Yourself dwell, O Lord, are the perfect devotees. ||2||

398.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪਿ ਸੋਈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
398.t: jis no ma(n)ne aap soiee maaneeaai ||
398.e: Those whom You approve, are approved.

398.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩॥
398.t: pragaT purakh paravaan sabh Thaiee jaaneeaai ||3||
398.e: Such a celebrated and honored person is known everywhere. ||3||

398.g: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ॥
398.t: dhinas rain aaraadh sam(h)aale saeh saeh ||
398.e: Day and night, with every breath to worship and adore the Lord

398.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੦੮॥
398.t: naanak kee lochaa poor sache paatisaeh ||4||6||108||
398.e: - please, O True Supreme King, fulfill this, Nanak's desire. ||4||6||108||

398.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
398.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
398.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

398.g: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਇ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
398.t: poor rahiaa srab Thai hamaaraa khasam soi ||
398.e: He, my Lord Master, is fully pervading all places.

398.g: ਏਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
398.t: ek saahib sir chhat dhoojaa naeh koi ||1||
398.e: He is the One Lord Master, the roof over our heads; there is no other than Him. ||1||

398.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
398.t: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh raakhanahaariaa ||
398.e: As it pleases Your Will, please save me, O Savior Lord.

398.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
398.t: tujh bin avar na koi nadhar nihaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
398.e: Without You, my eyes see no other at all. ||1||Pause||

398.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
398.t: pratipaale prabh aap ghaT ghaT saareeaai ||
398.e: God Himself is the Cherisher; He takes care of each and every heart.

398.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
398.t: jis man vuThaa aap tis na visaareeaai ||2||
398.e: That person, within whose mind You Yourself dwell, never forgets You. ||2||

398.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
398.t: jo kichh kare su aap aapan bhaaniaa ||
398.e: He does that which is pleasing to Himself.

398.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
398.t: bhagataa kaa sahaiee jug jug jaaniaa ||3||
398.e: He is known as the help and support of His devotees, throughout the ages. ||3||

398.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
398.t: jap jap har kaa naam kadhe na jhooreeaai ||
398.e: Chanting and meditating up the Lord's Name, the mortal never comes to regret anything.

398.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੦੯॥
398.t: naanak dharas piaas lochaa pooreeaai ||4||7||109||
398.e: O Nanak, I thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please, fulfill my desire, O Lord. ||4||7||109||

398.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
398.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
398.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

398.g: ਕਿਆ ਸੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਗਾਫਲ ਗਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
398.t: kiaa soveh naam visaar gaafal gahiliaa ||
398.e: Why are you sleeping, and forgetting the Name, O careless and foolish mortal?

398.g: ਕਿਤਂੀ ਇਤੁ ਦਰੀਆਇ ਵੰਞਨਿੑ ਵਹਦਿਆ ॥੧॥
398.t: kita(n)ee it dhareeaai va(n)n(j)ni(h) vahadhiaa ||1||
398.e: So many have been washed away and carried off by this river of life. ||1||

398.g: ਬੋਹਿਥੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਮਨ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘੀਐ ॥
398.t: bohithaRaa har charan man chaR la(n)gheeaai ||
398.e: O mortal, get aboard the boat of the Lord's Lotus Feet, and cross over.

398.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
398.t: aaTh pahar gun gai saadhoo sa(n)geeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
398.e: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

398.g: ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗ ਅਨੇਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁੰਞਿਆ ॥
398.t: bhogeh bhog anek vin naavai su(n)n(j)iaa ||
398.e: You may enjoy various pleasures, but they are useless without the Name.

398.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
398.t: har kee bhagat binaa mar mar ru(n)niaa ||2||
398.e: Without devotion to the Lord, you shall die in sorrow, again and again. ||2||

398.g: ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਤਨਿ ਮਰਦਨ ਮਾਲਣਾ ॥
398.t: kapaR bhog suga(n)dh tan maradhan maalanaa ||
398.e: You may dress and eat and apply scented oils to your body,

398.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਸਰਪਰ ਚਾਲਣਾ ॥੩॥
398.t: bin simaran tan chhaar sarapar chaalanaa ||3||
398.e: but without the meditative remembrance of the Lord, your body shall surely turn to dust, and you shall have to depart. ||3||

398.g: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਪੇਖਿਆ ॥
398.t: mahaa bikham sa(n)saar viralai pekhiaa ||
398.e: How very treacherous is this world-ocean; how very few realize this!

398.g: ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੧੦॥
398.t: chhooTan har kee saran lekh naanak lekhiaa ||4||8||110||
398.e: Salvation rests in the Lord's Sanctuary; O Nanak, this is your pre-ordained destiny. ||4||8||110||

398.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
398.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
398.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

398.g: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬੀਐ ॥
398.t: koi na kis hee sa(n)g kaahe garabeeaai ||
398.e: No one is anyone's companion; why take any pride in others?

398.g: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਬੀਐ ॥੧॥
398.t: ek naam aadhaar bhaujal tarabeeaai ||1||
398.e: With the Support of the One Name, this terrible world-ocean is crossed over. ||1||

398.g: ਮੈ ਗਰੀਬ ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
398.t: mai gareeb sach Tek too(n) mere satigur poore ||
398.e: You are the True Support of me, the poor mortal, O my Perfect True Guru.

398.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦਰਸਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
398.t: dhekh tum(h)aaraa dharasano meraa man dheere ||1|| rahaau ||
398.e: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, my mind is encouraged. ||1||Pause||

398.g: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਗਨੋੁ ॥
398.t: raaj maal ja(n)jaal kaaj na kitai ganuo ||
398.e: Royal powers, wealth, and worldly involvements are of no use at all.

398.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੋੁ ॥੨॥
398.t: har keeratan aadhaar nihachal eh dhanuo ||2||
398.e: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is my Support; this wealth is everlasting. ||2||

398.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਤੇਤ ਪਛਾਵਿਆ ॥
398.t: jete maiaa ra(n)g tet pachhaaviaa ||
398.e: As many as are the pleasures of Maya, so many are the shadows they leave.

398.g: ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
398.t: sukh kaa naam nidhaan gurmukh gaaviaa ||3||
398.e: The Gurmukhs sing of the Naam, the treasure of peace. ||3||

398.g: ਸਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੇ ॥
398.t: sachaa gunee nidhaan too(n) prabh gahir ga(n)bheere ||
398.e: You are the True Lord, the treasure of excellence; O God, You are deep and unfathomable.

398.g: ਆਸ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਜੀਅਰੇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੧੧॥
398.t: aas bharosaa khasam kaa naanak ke jeeare ||4||9||111||
398.e: The Lord Master is the hope and support of Nanak's mind. ||4||9||111||

398.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
398.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
398.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

398.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
398.t: jis simarat dhukh jai sahaj sukh paieeaai ||
398.e: Remembering Him, suffering is removed, and celestial peace is obtained.

398.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
398.t: rain dhinas kar joR har har dhiaaieeaai ||1||
398.e: Night and day, with your palms pressed together, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

398.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
398.t: naanak kaa prabh soi jis kaa sabh koi ||
398.e: He alone is Nanak's God, unto whom all beings belong.

398.g: ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
398.t: sarab rahiaa bharapoor sachaa sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
398.e: He is totally pervading everywhere, the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||

398.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਗਿਆਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
398.t: a(n)tar baahar sa(n)g sahaiee giaan jog ||
398.e: Inwardly and outwardly, He is my companion and my helper; He is the One to be realized.

398.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਮਨਾ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
398.t: tiseh araadh manaa binaasai sagal rog ||2||
398.e: Adoring Him, my mind is cured of all its ailments. ||2||

398.g: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
398.t: raakhanahaar apaar raakhai agan maeh ||
398.e: The Savior Lord is infinite; He saves us from the fire of the womb.

399.g: ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
399.t: seetal har har naam simarat tapat jai ||3||
399.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is soothing and cool; remembering it in meditation, the inner fire is quenched. ||3||

399.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
399.t: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh ghanaa naanak jan dhooraa ||
399.e: Peace, poise, and immense bliss, O Nanak, are obtained, when one becomes the dust of the feet of the humble servants of the Lord.

399.g: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੧੨॥
399.t: kaaraj sagale sidh bhe bheTiaa gur pooraa ||4||10||112||
399.e: All of one's affairs are perfectly resolved, meeting with the Perfect Guru. ||4||10||112||

399.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
399.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
399.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

399.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
399.t: gobi(n)dh gunee nidhaan gurmukh jaaneeaai ||
399.e: The Lord of the Universe is the treasure of excellence; He is known only to the Gurmukh.

399.g: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥
399.t: hoi kirapaal dhiaal har ra(n)g maaneeaai ||1||
399.e: When He shows His Mercy and Kindness, we revel in the Lord's Love. ||1||

399.g: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਹ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ॥
399.t: aavahu sa(n)t milaeh har kathaa kahaaneeaa ||
399.e: Come, O Saints - let us join together and speak the Sermon of the Lord.

399.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
399.t: anadhin simareh naam taj laaj lokaaneeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
399.e: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and ignore the criticism of others. ||1||Pause||

399.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
399.t: jap jap jeevaa naam hovai anadh ghanaa ||
399.e: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam, and so I obtain immense bliss.

399.g: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਵਿਣਸਣਾ ॥੨॥
399.t: mithiaa moh sa(n)saar jhooThaa vinasanaa ||2||
399.e: Attachment to the world is useless and vain; it is false, and perishes in the end. ||2||

399.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
399.t: charan kamal sa(n)g neh kinai viralai laiaa ||
399.e: How rare are those who embrace love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.

399.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
399.t: dha(n)n suhaavaa mukh jin har dhiaaiaa ||3||
399.e: Blessed and beautiful is that mouth, which meditates on the Lord. ||3||

399.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਲ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥
399.t: janam maran dhukh kaal simarat miT jaaviee ||
399.e: The pains of birth, death and reincarnation are erased by meditating on the Lord.

399.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੧੩॥
399.t: naanak kai sukh soi jo prabh bhaaviee ||4||11||113||
399.e: That alone is Nanak's joy, which is pleasing to God. ||4||11||113||

399.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
399.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
399.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

399.g: ਆਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਭਿ ਭੁੰਚਹ ॥
399.t: aavahu meet ikatr hoi ras kas sabh bhu(n)cheh ||
399.e: Come, O friends: let us meet together and enjoy all the tastes and flavors.

399.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਮੁੰਚਹ ॥੧॥
399.t: a(n)mirat naam har har japeh mil paapaa mu(n)cheh ||1||
399.e: Let us join together and chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and so wipe away our sins. ||1||

399.g: ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
399.t: tat veechaarahu sa(n)t janahu taa te bighan na laagai ||
399.e: Reflect upon the essence of reality, O Saintly beings, and no troubles shall afflict you.

399.g: ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਤਸਕਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
399.t: kheen bhe sabh tasakaraa gurmukh jan jaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
399.e: All of the thieves shall be destroyed, as the Gurmukhs remain wakeful. ||1||Pause||

399.g: ਬੁਧਿ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥
399.t: budh gareebee kharach laih haumai bikh jaarahu ||
399.e: Take wisdom and humility as your supplies, and burn away the poison of pride.

399.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਹਟੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
399.t: saachaa haT pooraa saudhaa vakhar naam vaapaarahu ||2||
399.e: True is that shop, and perfect the transaction; deal only in the merchandise of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

399.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ॥
399.t: jeeau pi(n)dd dhan arapiaa seiee pativa(n)te ||
399.e: They alone are accepted and approved, who dedicate their souls, bodies and wealth.

399.g: ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਤੇ ॥੩॥
399.t: aapanaRe prabh bhaaniaa nit kel kara(n)te ||3||
399.e: Those who are pleasing to their God, celebrate in happiness. ||3||

399.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਦੁ ਜੋ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਬਿਖਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਕਮਲੀ ॥
399.t: dhuramat madh jo peevate bikhalee pat kamalee ||
399.e: Those fools, who drink in the wine of evil-mindedness, become the husbands of prostitutes.

399.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਅਮਲੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੧੪॥
399.t: raam rasain jo rate naanak sach amalee ||4||12||114||
399.e: But those who are imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, O Nanak, are intoxicated with the Truth. ||4||12||114||

399.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
399.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
399.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

399.g: ਉਦਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਆਰੰਭੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
399.t: audham keeaa karaiaa aara(n)bh rachaiaa ||
399.e: I made the effort; I did it, and made a beginning.

399.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
399.t: naam jape jap jeevanaa gur ma(n)tr dhiraRaiaa ||1||
399.e: I live by chanting and meditating on the Naam. The Guru has implanted this Mantra within me. ||1||

399.g: ਪਾਇ ਪਰਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥
399.t: pai pareh satiguroo kai jin bharam bidhaariaa ||
399.e: I fall at the Feet of the True Guru, who has dispelled my doubts.

399.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
399.t: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee sach saaj savaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
399.e: Bestowing His Mercy, God has dressed me, and decorated me with the Truth. ||1||Pause||

399.g: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
399.t: kar geh leene aapane sach hukam rajaiee ||
399.e: Taking me by the hand, He made me His own, through the True Order of His Command.

399.g: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
399.t: jo prabh dhitee dhaat saa pooran vaddiaaiee ||2||
399.e: That gift which God gave to me, is perfect greatness. ||2||

399.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
399.t: sadhaa sadhaa gun gaie'eeh jap naam muraaree ||
399.e: Forever and ever, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and chant the Name of the Destroyer of ego.

399.g: ਨੇਮੁ ਨਿਬਾਹਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
399.t: nem nibaahio satiguroo prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||3||
399.e: My vows have been honored, by the Grace of God and the True Guru, who has showered His Mercy. ||3||

399.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਲਾਭੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
399.t: naam dhan gun gaau laabh poorai gur dhitaa ||
399.e: The Perfect Guru has given the wealth of the Naam, and the profit of singing the Lord's Glorious Praises.

399.g: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੧੫॥
399.t: vanajaare sa(n)t naanakaa prabh saahu amitaa ||4||13||115||
399.e: The Saints are the traders, O Nanak, and the Infinite Lord God is their Banker. ||4||13||115||

399.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
399.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
399.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

399.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
399.t: jaa kaa Thaakur tuhee prabh taa ke vaddabhaagaa ||
399.e: One who has You as His Master, O God, is blessed with great destiny.

399.g: ਓਹੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਸਦ ਸੁਖੀ ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
399.t: oh suhelaa sadh sukhee sabh bhram bhau bhaagaa ||1||
399.e: He is happy, and forever at peace; his doubts and fears are all dispelled. ||1||

399.g: ਹਮ ਚਾਕਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
399.t: ham chaakar gobi(n)dh ke Thaakur meraa bhaaraa ||
399.e: I am the slave of the Lord of the Universe; my Master is the greatest of all.

399.g: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
399.t: karan karaavan sagal bidh so satiguroo hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
399.e: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes; He is my True Guru. ||1||Pause||

399.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੋ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
399.t: dhoojaa naahee aaur ko taa kaa bhau kareeaai ||
399.e: There is no other whom I should fear.

400.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
400.t: gur sevaa mahal paieeaai jag dhutar tareeaai ||2||
400.e: Serving the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is obtained, and the impassable world-ocean is crossed over. ||2||

400.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
400.t: dhirasaT teree sukh paieeaai man maeh nidhaanaa ||
400.e: By Your Glance of Grace, peace is obtained, and the treasure fills the mind.

400.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
400.t: jaa kau tum kirapaal bhe sevak se paravaanaa ||3||
400.e: That servant, unto whom You bestow Your Mercy, is approved and accepted. ||3||

400.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੋ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪੀਵੈ ॥
400.t: a(n)mirat ras har keeratano ko viralaa peevai ||
400.e: How rare is that person who drinks in the Ambrosial Essence of the Lord's Kirtan.

400.g: ਵਜਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੧੬॥
400.t: vajahu naanak milai ek naam ridh jap jap jeevai ||4||14||116||
400.e: Nanak has obtained the commodity of the One Name; he lives by chanting and meditating on it within his heart. ||4||14||116||

400.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
400.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
400.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

400.g: ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਹਉ ਚੇਰੁਲੀ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
400.t: jaa prabh kee hau cherulee so sabh te uoochaa ||
400.e: I am God's maid-servant; He is the highest of all.

400.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਥੋਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੧॥
400.t: sabh kichh taa kaa kaa(n)ddeeaai thoraa ar moochaa ||1||
400.e: All things, big and small, are said to belong to Him. ||1||

400.g: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੋ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਮਨੀਆ ॥
400.t: jeea praan meraa dhano saahib kee maneeaa ||
400.e: I surrender my soul, my breath of life, and my wealth, to my Lord Master.

400.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਊਜਲੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਗਨੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
400.t: naam jisai kai uoojalee tis dhaasee ganeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
400.e: Through His Name, I become radiant; I am known as His slave. ||1||Pause||

400.g: ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
400.t: veparavaahu ana(n)dh mai naau maanak heeraa ||
400.e: You are Carefree, the Embodiment of Bliss. Your Name is a gem, a jewel.

400.g: ਰਜੀ ਧਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
400.t: rajee dhaiee sadhaa sukh jaa kaa too(n) meeraa ||2||
400.e: One who has You as her Master, is satisfied, satiated and happy forever. ||2||

400.g: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਸੰਗ ਕੀ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਉ ॥
400.t: sakhee saheree sa(n)g kee sumat dhiraRaavau ||
400.e: O my companions and fellow maidens, please implant that balanced understanding within me.

400.g: ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
400.t: sevahu saadhoo bhaau kar tau nidh har paavau ||3||
400.e: Serve the Holy Saints lovingly, and find the treasure of the Lord. ||3||

400.g: ਸਗਲੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ ਸਭ ਕਹਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
400.t: sagalee dhaasee Thaakurai sabh kahatee meraa ||
400.e: All are servants of the Lord Master, and all call Him their own.

400.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਖਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੧੭॥
400.t: jiseh seegaare naanakaa tis sukheh baseraa ||4||15||117||
400.e: She alone dwells in peace, O Nanak, whom the Lord adorns. ||4||15||117||

400.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
400.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
400.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

400.g: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਰੀ ਏਹੁ ਅਚਾਰਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਰੀ ॥
400.t: sa(n)taa kee hoi dhaasaree eh achaaraa sikh ree ||
400.e: Become the servant of the Saints, and learn this way of life.

400.g: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਊਤਮੋ ਭਰਤਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਪਿਖੁ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
400.t: sagal gunaa gun uootamo bharataa dhoor na pikh ree ||1||
400.e: Of all virtues, the most sublime virtue is to see your Husband Lord near at hand. ||1||

400.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੀ ॥
400.t: eih man su(n)dhar aapanaa har naam majeeThai ra(n)g ree ||
400.e: So, dye this mind of yours with the color of the Lord's Love.

400.g: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੁ ਗੁਪਾਲਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
400.t: tiaag siaanap chaaturee too(n) jaan gupaaleh sa(n)g ree ||1|| rahaau ||
400.e: Renounce cleverness and cunning, and know that the Sustainer of the world is with you. ||1||Pause||

400.g: ਭਰਤਾ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਏਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ਰੀ ॥
400.t: bharataa kahai su maaneeaai eh seegaar banai ree ||
400.e: Whatever your Husband Lord says, accept that, and make it your decoration.

400.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਏਹੁ ਤੰਬੋਲਾ ਖਾਇ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
400.t: dhoojaa bhaau visaareeaai eh ta(n)bolaa khai ree ||2||
400.e: Forget the love of duality, and chew upon this betel leaf. ||2||

400.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਪਕੋ ਇਹ ਸਤ ਕੀ ਸੇਜ ਬਿਛਾਇ ਰੀ ॥
400.t: gur kaa sabadh kar dheepako ieh sat kee sej bichhai ree ||
400.e: Make the Word of the Guru's Shabad your lamp, and let your bed be Truth.

400.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
400.t: aaTh pahar kar joR rahu tau bheTai har rai ree ||3||
400.e: Twenty-four hours a day, stand with your palms pressed together, and the Lord, your King, shall meet you. ||3||

400.g: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਚਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਈ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ਰੀ ॥
400.t: tis hee chaj seegaar sabh saiee roop apaar ree ||
400.e: She alone is cultured and embellished, and she alone is of incomparable beauty.

400.g: ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੋ ਭਾਣੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੧੮॥
400.t: saiee suohaagan naanakaa jo bhaanee karataar ree ||4||16||118||
400.e: She alone is the happy soul-bride, O Nanak, who is pleasing to the Creator Lord. ||4||16||118||

400.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
400.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
400.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

400.g: ਡੀਗਨ ਡੋਲਾ ਤਊ ਲਉ ਜਉ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
400.t: ddeegan ddolaa tuoo lau jau man ke bharamaa ||
400.e: As long as there are doubts in the mind, the mortal staggers and falls.

400.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
400.t: bhram kaaTe gur aapanai paae bisaraamaa ||1||
400.e: The Guru removed my doubts, and I have obtained my place of rest. ||1||

400.g: ਓਇ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਦੋਖੀਆ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੂਟੇ ॥
400.t: oi bikhaadhee dhokheeaa te gur te hooTe ||
400.e: Those quarrelsome enemies have been overcome, through the Guru.

400.g: ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਅਬ ਉਨੑਾ ਤੇ ਓਇ ਹਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
400.t: ham chhooTe ab un(h)aa te oi ham te chhooTe ||1|| rahaau ||
400.e: I have now escaped from them, and they have run away from me. ||1||Pause||

400.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਨਤਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
400.t: meraa teraa jaanataa tab hee te ba(n)dhaa ||
400.e: He is concerned with 'mine and yours', and so he is held in bondage.

400.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਟੀ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ ਤਬ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੨॥
400.t: gur kaaTee agiaanataa tab chhuTake fa(n)dhaa ||2||
400.e: When the Guru dispelled my ignorance, then the noose of death was cut away from my neck. ||2||

400.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਤਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਲਉ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
400.t: jab lag hukam na boojhataa tab hee lau dhukheeaa ||
400.e: As long as he does not understand the Command of God's Will, he remains miserable.

400.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥੩॥
400.t: gur mil hukam pachhaaniaa tab hee te sukheeaa ||3||
400.e: Meeting with the Guru, he comes to recognize God's Will, and then, he becomes happy. ||3||

400.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੋਖੀਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
400.t: naa ko dhusaman dhokheeaa naahee ko ma(n)dhaa ||
400.e: I have no enemies and no adversaries; no one is wicked to me.

400.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੧੧੯॥
400.t: gur kee sevaa sevako naanak khasamai ba(n)dhaa ||4||17||119||
400.e: That servant, who performs the Lord's service, O Nanak, is the slave of the Lord Master. ||4||17||119||

400.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
400.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
400.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

400.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
400.t: sookh sahaj aanadh ghanaa har keeratan gaau ||
400.e: Peace, celestial poise and absolute bliss are obtained, singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

400.g: ਗਰਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
400.t: gareh nivaare satiguroo dhe apanaa naau ||1||
400.e: Bestowing His Name, the True Guru removes the evil omens. ||1||

400.g: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
400.t: balihaaree gur aapane sadh sadh bal jaau ||
400.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.
